so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya. sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahitvā masiṃ kareyya.
example_2: so satthārā dinnanaye ṭhatvā satthāraṃ vanditvā, ajja ādiṃ katvā mama santakaṃ dasikasuttamattam'pi maṃ abhibhavitvā anekasatā'pi rājāno vā corā vā gaṇhituṃ samatthā nāma mā hontu, agginā'pi mama santakaṃ mā ḍayhatu, udakena'pi mā vuyhatū'ti patthanaṃ akāsi.

commentary: (MNa) aggipāricariyāyā'ti bahu-aggiparicaraṇena sujjhantī'ti vadanti.

example_1: brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchā bhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udak'orohakā aggiparicārakā. te mataṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṃ nāma okkāmenti.

meaning_1: fire worshipper; attendant of the sacred fire

meaning_1: attending to the sacred fire; ritual fire worship

meaning_1: danger of fire; peril from fire

meaning_1: name of a Brahman family clan

meaning_1: having set fire to; having set alight
example_1: atha kho te, pāpima, gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino tiṇañ'ca kaṭṭhañ'ca gomayañ'ca saṃkaḍḍhitvā āyasmato sañjīvassa kāye upacinitvā aggiṃ datvā pakkamiṃsu.

meaning_1: benevolent (towards); sympathetic (to); wishing well (to); desiring good (for)

meaning_1: who is skilled in what is beneficial
meaning_2: clever in finding what is beneficial

paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, sa ve muni vusitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.

meaning_1: experiencing the meaning; sensitive to the sense; (comm) knowing the meaning of the text
example_1: tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimutt'āyatanaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) atthapaṭisaṃvedino'ti pāḷi-atthaṃ jānantassa.

example_1: sahassam'api ce vācā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ atthapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
example_2: acchariyā h'ete, āvuso, puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ ye gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ paññāya ativijjha passantī'ti

meaning_1: explaining the meaning; giving precedence to the explanation
meaning_2: aiming at the meaning, or at the benefit
example_1: anāpatti atthapurekkhārassa, dhammapurekkhārassa, anusāsanipurekkhārassa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) pāḷiyā atthaṃ vaṇṇayanto atthapurekkhāro (VINa) atthapurekkhārāyā'ti aṭṭhakathaṃ kathentiyā.

meaning_2: for the purpose of explaining the meaning

meaning_1: experiencing the meaning; (comm) understanding the commentary
example_1: yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca.
example_2: yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca. yo c'eva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthappaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammappaṭisaṃvedino ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo atthavase sampassamānena alam'eva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetun'ti.
commentary: (ANa) atthappaṭisaṃvedī'ti aṭṭhakathaṃ ñāṇena paṭisaṃvedī.

grammar: inf of atthaṃ ājānanti, comp vb
meaning_1: to learn the meaning; to understand the meaning (of)
example_1: dūrato'pi kho mayaṃ, āvuso, āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa attham'aññātuṃ

grammar: ger of atthaṃ ājānanti, comp vb
meaning_1: understanding the meaning; comprehending the significance (of)
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

meaning_1: one's own good; benefit for oneself; one's own best interest
example_1: tasmā hi paṇḍito poso, sampassaṃ attham'attano, yoniso vicine dhammaṃ, evaṃ tattha visujjhati.
example_2: tasmā hi paṇḍito poso, sampassaṃ attham'attano, bhujaṅ'gamaṃ pāvakañ'ca, khattiyañ'ca yasassinaṃ, bhikkhuñ'ca sīlasampannaṃ, samma'd'eva samācare'ti.

example_1: yato ca, bhikkhave, verocano abbhudeti yattha ca attham'eti, idaṃ tatiyaṃ suvidūravidūre.
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho rājā korabyo āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca, idha bhavaṃ raṭṭhapāla hatth'atthare nisīdatū'ti.
commentary: (DNt) hatthino piṭṭhiyaṃ attharaṃ hatth'attharaṃ.

example_1: dātā ca ahosi sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāvuraṇānaṃ khomasukhumānaṃ kappāsikasukhumānaṃ koseyyasukhumānaṃ kambalasukhumānaṃ
example_2: seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of attharaṇattha

meaning_1: essence of the meaning; fundamental sense
example_1: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa lābhino, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa na lābhino. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa lābhino bhavissāmā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) attharasassā'ti-ādīsu attharaso nāma cattāri sāmaññaphalāni, dhammaraso nāma cattāro maggā, vimuttiraso nāma amatanibbānaṃ.

example_1: kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'ti ayakaṇṭake vā pakatikaṇṭake vā bhūmiyaṃ koṭṭetvā tattha cammaṃ attharitvā ṭhānacaṅkam'ādīni karoti.

meaning_1: attained the goal; fulfilled one's purpose; got the benefit
example_1: te atthaladdhā sukhitā, viruḷhā buddhasāsane, arogā sukhitā hotha, saha sabbehi ñātibhī'ti.
atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, dīgharattaṃ visuddho kho ayaṃ yakkho, yaṃ kiñci maṃ pañhaṃ pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ atthasañhitaṃ'y'eva pucchissati, no anatthasañhitaṃ.
example_2: yaṃ samaṇo bahuṃ bhāsati, upetaṃ atthasañhitaṃ, jānaṃ so dhammaṃ deseti, jānaṃ so bahu bhāsati.
commentary: (DNa) atthasañhitan'ti atthanissitaṃ kāraṇanissitaṃ.

example_1: pahu santo na bharatī'ti atthasampanno upakaraṇasampanno hutvā'pi na poseti.
kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ
example_2: yañ'ca kho jaññā rahovādaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ tatra kālaññū assa tassa rahovādassa vacanāya.
commentary: (MNa) atthasaṃhitan'ti anekehi'pi nayehi vibhajantena pariyādātuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya atthasampannaṃ, yaṃ vā so atthavādī atthaṃ vadati, tena atthena saṃhitattā atthasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na aññaṃ nikkhipitvā aññaṃ bhāsatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (ANa) kāraṇanissitaṃ katvā vadanto atthasaṃhitena vadati nāma.

meaning_1: to convey a meaning; to make a point
meaning_lit: for the communication of a meaning
example_1: upamā kho my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayaṃ c'ev'ettha attho, samatittiko telapatto'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.
example_2: upamā kho me ayaṃ, sunakkhatta, katā atthassa viññāpanāya.

example_1: atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī, upamā viññūhi desitā, viññissanti mahānāgā, nāgaṃ nāgena desitaṃ.
commentary: (THa) atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī'ti satthu guṇasaṅkhātassa upameyy'atthassa viññāpanī, pakāsanī ayaṃ nāg'ūpamā.
(PYt) atthavacanan'ti attho vuccati anenā'ti atthavacanaṃ.

example_1: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.
commentary: (SNa) atthavatī'ti, atthavatiyo. (SNt) atthavatiyo'ti lokiya-lok'uttar'āttha-saṅgahitā lokiya-kusala-lok'uttaramagga-saṅgaṇhanato.

meaning_2: possessing the goal; or possessing worldly knowledge

example_1: etam'atthavasaṃ ñatvā, paṇḍito sīlasaṃvuto, nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, khippam'eva visodhaye.
example_2: kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca, byādhidhammomhi, byādhiṃ anatīto'ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
commentary: (MNa) atthavasan'ti atth'ānisaṃsaṃ.

example_1: kaṃ pana bhavaṃ vacchāyano atthavasaṃ sampassamāno samaṇe gotame evaṃ abhippasanno'ti?
commentary: (ANa) atthavase'ti kāraṇāni.

meaning_1: with a purpose; with a goal in mind
example_1: atthavasikena, bhikkhave, kulaputtena alaṃ upagantuṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
example_2: tañ'ca kho etaṃ, bhikkhave, kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā, atthavasaṃ paṭicca, n'eva rāj'ābhinītā, na cor'ābhinītā, na iṇ'aṭṭā, na bhay'aṭṭā, na ājīvik'āpakatā.
commentary: (SNa) kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā'ti mama sāsane jātikulaputtā ca ācārakulaputtā ca atthavasikā kāraṇavasikā hutvā kāraṇavasaṃ paṭicca upenti.

meaning_1: who speaks what is beneficial; who says what is meaningful
example_1: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ
commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhadhammika-samparāyik'attha-sannissitam'eva katvā vadatī'ti atthavādī

meaning_1: knowing how to evaluate what's beneficial
example_1: yato ca kho paṇḍito āpadāsu, na vedhatī atthavinicchayaññū, paccatthikāssa dukhitā bhavanti, disvā mukhaṃ avikāraṃ purāṇaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) atthavinicchayaññū'ti kāraṇ'atthavinicchaye kusalo. (JAa) atthavinicchayaññū'ti tassa tassa atthassa vinicchayakusalo.

meaning_1: inspiration from the meaning; (comm) inspiration from the commentary
example_1: yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
example_2: ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) atthavedan'ti aṭṭhakathaṃ nissāya uppannaṃ pītipāmojjaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, in comps, acc sg of attha
meaning_1: for the sake; for the purpose; for the benefit (of)
example_1: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti

meaning_1: will achieve one's goal; will accomplish one's purpose; will succeed
example_1: yañ'c'assa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhavissatī'ti.

meaning_1: fulfills the need (of); achieves a purpose; attains a goal
example_1: no ce abhinipphādeyya, yat'assa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ tattha sāmaṃ vā gantabbaṃ dūto vā pāhetabbo, yaṃ kho tumhe āyasmanto bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇittha na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhoti. yuñjant'āyasmanto sakaṃ, mā vo sakaṃ vinassā'ti.
example_2: yassa c'atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhonti. tesaṃ te dhammā suggahitā dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
commentary: (VINa) na taṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci atthaṃ anubhotī'ti taṃ cīvaracetāpannaṃ tassa bhikkhuno kiñci appamattakam'pi kammaṃ na nipphādeti. (MNa) tañ'c'assa atthaṃ anubhontī'ti yesaṃ maggaphalānaṃ atthāya pariyāpuṇanti. suggahitapariyattiṃ nissāya maggaṃ bhāvetvā phalaṃ sacchikarontā tañ'c'assa dhammassa atthaṃ anubhavanti. paravāde upārambhaṃ āropetuṃ sakkontā'pi sakavāde āropitaṃ dosaṃ icchit'icchitaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā mocetuṃ sakkontā'pi anubhonti'y'eva.

meaning_1: understands the meaning; comprehends the sense (of)
example_1: tena, h'āvuso kaccāna, upamaṃ te karissāmi. upamāya'p'idh'ekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
example_2: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī'ti?
commentary: (MNa) evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyun'ti ettha ke bhagavato imassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti, ke na ājānantī'ti?

example_1: sadā jāgaramānānaṃ, ahoratt'ānusikkhinaṃ, nibbānaṃ adhimuttānaṃ, atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā.
example_2: rūpasokhummataṃ ñatvā, vedanānañ'ca sambhavaṃ, saññā yato samudeti, atthaṃ gacchati yattha ca, saṅkhāre parato ñatvā, dukkhato no ca attato.
commentary: (ANa) atthaṃ gacchati yattha cā'ti yasmiṃ ṭhāne nirujjhati, tañ'ca jānitvā. (DHPa) atthaṃ gacchantī'ti evarūpānaṃ sabbe'pi āsavā atthaṃ vināsaṃ n'atthibhāvaṃ gacchantī'ti attho.

meaning_1: acts for the benefit; works for the welfare (of)
example_1: na, bhikkhave, tathāgato idān'eva lokassa atthaṃ carati, pubbe'pi cari'y'evā'ti

meaning_1: will not achieve one's goal; will not accomplish one's purpose; will not succeed
example_1: yañ'c'assa sārena sārakaraṇīyaṃ tañ'c'assa atthaṃ n'ānubhavissatī'ti.
accī yathā vātavegena khittā, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ, evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ.

meaning_1: advice for welfare; instruction for benefit
example_1: sace na pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, vatteti cakkaṃ pathaviṃ pasāsati, atth'ānusiṭṭhīsu pariggahesu ca, na tena seyyo sadiso ca vijjati.
commentary: (DNa) atth'ānusiṭṭhīsu pariggahesu cā'ti ye atth'ānusāsanesu pariggahā atth'ānatthaṃ pariggāhakāni ñāṇāni, tesū'ti attho.

meaning_1: comprehension of what is beneficial; understanding what is good
example_1: diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho, yo c'attho samparāyiko, atth'ābhisamayā dhīro, paṇḍito'ti pavuccatī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) atth'ābhisamayā'ti atthassa abhisamāgamena, atthappaṭilābhenā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_lit: for the good, the benefit and the happiness
example_1: caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ, mā ekena dve agamittha
example_2: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

grammar: masc, in comps, dat sg of atthāya
meaning_1: for the purpose; for the sake; for the benefit (of)
example_1: yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
example_2: atthāya vata me buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ agā, yass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna, micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ.

example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti.

meaning_1: there is, friend; there is, brother
example_1: kahaṃ pana, bhikkhu, eta'r'ahi so bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti. atth'āvuso, uttaresu janapadesu sāvatthi nāma nagaraṃ. tattha so bhagavā eta'r'ahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti.
atthi, bhikkhave, ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ
example_2: paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule, piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghābalaṃ mamā'ti.

example_1: ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādayanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.
example_2: ye keci pāṇabhūt'atthi, tasā vā thāvarā vā anavasesā, dīghā vā y'eva mahantā vā, majjhimā rassakā aṇukathūlā.

meaning_1: seeker; who wants; who needs; who desires
example_1: evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passati.
example_2: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

example_1: satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.
synonym: atthakara, atthakaraṇa, atthāvaha, upakāra, kusala, sapayojana, sappayojana, sātthaka, sānisaṃsa, hita

example_1: kappiyaṃ taṃ ce chādeti, cīvaraṃ idam'atthikaṃ, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.
synonym: anucchavi, anucchavika, anurūpa, anulomika, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpī, yutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmīcika, sāruppa

example_1: yāya devā manussā ca, sitā tiṭṭhanti atthikā, tarath'etaṃ visattikaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso alagadd'atthiko alagaddagavesī alagaddapariyesanaṃ caramāno. so passeyya mahantaṃ alagaddaṃ. tam'enaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya.
synonym: aṭṭhiya, attha, atthī, anugiddha, apekkha, abhijjhāyanta, ākaṅkhanta, ākaṅkhamāna, iccha, icchaka, icchanta, icchamāna, kāmaka, kāmayamāna, kāmayāna, kāmī, chādayamāna, jappanta, jigiṃsanta, jigiṃsāna, jigīsaka, jigīsanta, jigīsamāna, jigīsāna

meaning_1: believing in the efficacy of action and the existence of the afterlife
example_1: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.

meaning_2: state of seeking, state of being in need of; needing

example_1: atthikavato kho pana te, ambaṭṭha, idh'āgamanaṃ ahosi, yāy'eva kho pan'atthāya āgaccheyyātha, tam'eva atthaṃ sādhukaṃ manasi kareyyātha.

meaning_1: (proponent of) moral effectiveness; doctrine of ethical efficacy; view that merit and the afterlife exist
meaning_2: doctrine that (merit, another world, etc.) exists
example_1: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) atthikavādan'ti atthi dinnaṃ dinnaphalan'ti imaṃ atthikavādaṃ'y'eva vadanti tesaṃ tucchaṃ vacanaṃ musāvilāpo.

meaning_1: who is a proponent of moral effectiveness; supporting the doctrine of ethical efficacy; having the view that merit and the afterlife exist
example_1: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi atthikavādo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) atthikavādan'ti atthi dinnaṃ dinnaphalan'ti imaṃ atthikavādaṃ'y'eva vadanti tesaṃ tucchaṃ vacanaṃ musāvilāpo.

example_1: āyatanaṃ taṃ na hoti yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. adhikaraṇaṃ taṃ na hoti yaṃpaccay'āssa taṃ uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhan'ti.
synonym: āyatana, ārammaṇa, kāraṇa, ṭhāna, nidāna, nibandhana, nimitta
commentary: (SNa) khettaṃ taṃ na hotī'ti-ādīsu'pi viruhan'aṭṭhena taṃ khettaṃ na hoti, patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena vatthu na hoti, paccay'aṭṭhena āyatanaṃ na hoti, kāraṇ'aṭṭhena adhikaraṇaṃ na hoti.

meaning_1: detail; technicality; point of dispute; hot question
example_1: paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamma-adhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
commentary: (MNa) na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesī'ti mañ'ca dhammakāraṇā na kilamesi, na punappunaṃ kathāpesī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (UDa) na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇan'ti dhammadesanāhetu na ca maṃ vihesesi yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ paṭipannattā. yo hi satthu santike dhammaṃ sutvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ vā gahetvā yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ na paṭipajjati, so satthāraṃ viheseti nāma.

meaning_2: (gram) locative case in the sense of containing

meaning_1: who lays charges; who creates legal issues; who starts lawsuits

example_2: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako, tassa ime pañca ādīnavā pāṭikaṅkhā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) adhikaraṇakārako'ti catunnaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ aññatarassa kārako. (NIDD1a) vivādakārakā'ti nānāvacanaṃ karontā. adhikaraṇakārakā'ti vinicchayapāpuṇanavisesakāraṇaṃ karontā.

meaning_2: who causes disputes; who makes lawsuits

meaning_1: rule about being angry over a legal issue
engaged in legal dispute; arguing about a vinaya issue

commentary: (VINa) adhikaraṇajātānan'ti etehi bhaṇḍan'ādīhi uppannavivād'ādhikaraṇānaṃ.

meaning_1: (vinaya) belonging to another class of legal issues
example_1: aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassā'ti āpatt'aññabhāgiyaṃ vā hoti adhikaraṇ'aññabhāgiyaṃ vā.

meaning_1: in the sense of a support
related to settling of a legal issue
example_1: ime kho pan'āyasmanto satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
example_2: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā. tatth'āyasmante, pucchāmi kacci'ttha parisuddhā, dutiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, tatiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā
commentary: (VINa) catubbidhaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ samen'ti vūpasamentī'ti adhikaraṇasamathā. tesaṃ vitthāro khandhake ca parivāre ca vutto, tass'atthaṃ tatth'eva vaṇṇayissāma.

meaning_1: way of settling of a dispute; method of resolving a legal issue
example_1: satta kho pan'ime, ānanda, adhikaraṇasamathā, uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako.
commentary: (MNa) tattha adhikaraṇāni samenti vūpasamentī'ti adhikaraṇasamathā

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of adhikaraṇa
meaning_1: for the sake of; for the purpose of; with regard to
meaning_2: in consequence of, for the sake of
example_1: so tesaṃ bhogānaṃ ārakkhā-adhikaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti, kin'ti me bhoge n'eva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi daheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāy'ādā hareyyun'ti
example_2: yato-adhikaraṇam'enaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjāhi.

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of adhikaraṇa
meaning_1: due to; because of; on account of
example_1: dissanti kho pana rūpa-adhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā.
commentary: (VISMa) rūp'ādhikaraṇan'ti rūpahetu. hetuattho hi ettha adhikaraṇasaddo kām'ādhikaraṇan'ti-ādīsu (ma. ni. 1.168-169) viya.

meaning_1: extra duty; additional obligation; further business
commentary: (ANa) karaṇīy'ādhikaraṇīyesū'ti paṇḍitehi kattabbakiccesu ca atirekakattabbakiccesu ca.

example_1: api ca, bhante, mayam'p'etaṃ jānāma, n'etaṃ bhagavato kappatī'ti. idaṃ me, bhante, candanaphalakaṃ agghati adhikasatasahassaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.

meaning_1: (gram) governing rule which affects those that follow
example_1: adhikāre maṅgale c'eva, nipphanne c'āvadhāraṇe, anantare c'apādāne, athasaddo pavattati.
example_2: kāle'icc'etaṃ adhikār'atthaṃ veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: (gram) fact of being under the governing rule which affects those that follow
(gram) governing rule (which affects those that follow); for the purpose of the following
example_1: kāle'icc'etaṃ adhikār'atthaṃ veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: regarding; concerning; with reference (to); on account (of)
example_1: jīvassa yattako paricchedo yāvajīvaṃ, cittam'adhikicca pavattanti te dhammā'ti adhicittaṃ, pabbatassa tiro tiropabbataṃ, sotassa pati pavattati nāvā iti patisotaṃ, pāsādassa anto antopāsādaṃ.

meaning_1: cutting up; chopping up; grinding up; pulverizing
example_1: asisūn'ūpamā kāmā adhikuṭṭan'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti
commentary: (NIDD1a) asi ca sūnā ca upamā etesan'ti asisūn'ūpamā. adhikuṭṭan'aṭṭhenā'ti chindan'aṭṭhena.

example_1: sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā, khandh'āsaṃ adhikuṭṭanā, yaṃ tvaṃ kāmaratiṃ brūsi, aratī dāni sā mama.

meaning_1: concerning girls; with reference to a young woman
example_1: kumārīsu adhikicca pavattati kathā iti adhikumāri, vadhuyā samīpe pavattati kathā iti upavadhu, gaṅgāya samīpe pavattati kathā iti upagaṅgaṃ, maṇikāya samīpe pavattati kathā iti upamaṇikaṃ.
example_2: napuṃsake vattamānassa abyayībhāvasamāsassa liṅgassa saro rasso hoti. kumārīsu adhikicca pavattati kathā iti adhikumāri. upavadhu, upagaṅgaṃ, upamaṇikaṃ.

meaning_1: very wholesome; highly beneficial; extremely profitable
example_1: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.
commentary: (DNa) adhikusalesū'ti ettha atthi kusalā, atthi adhikusalā. sabbe'pi kām'āvacarā kusalā kusalā nāma, rūp'āvacarā adhikusalā. ubho'pi te kusalā nāma, arūp'āvacarā adhikusalā. sabbe'pi te kusalā nāma, sāvakapāramīpaṭilābhapaccayā kusalā adhikusalā nāma. te'pi kusalā nāma, paccekabodhipaṭilābhapaccayā kusalā adhikusalā. te'pi kusalā nāma, sabbaññutaññāṇappaṭilābhapaccayā pana kusalā idha adhikusalā'ti adhippetā. tesu adhikusalesu dhammesu daḷhasamādāno ahosi avatthitasamādāno.

example_1: sārañ'ca sārato ñatvā, asārañ'ca asārato, te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā.
example_2: so, bhogā me atthi uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā'ti adhigacchati sukhaṃ, adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
synonym: ādeti, upeti, paṭilabhati, pappoti, labhati, vindati
commentary: (ANa) adhigaccheyyā'ti labheyya.

example_1: araṇisahitaṃ dvidhā phālesi, tidhā phālesi, catudhā phālesi, pañcadhā phālesi, dasadhā phālesi, satadhā phālesi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ akāsi, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā udukkhale koṭṭesi, udukkhale koṭṭetvā mahāvāte opuni, app'eva nāma aggiṃ adhigaccheyyan'ti. n'eva so aggiṃ adhigacchi.
synonym: ajjhagami, alattha, alābhesi, paccalattha, paṭilabhi, labhi

meaning_1: reached; attained; entered into a state; reached a condition
example_1: vasitā susānamajjhe, atho'pi khāditāni puttamaṃsāni, hatakulikā sabbagarahitā, matapatikā amatam'adhigacchiṃ.
commentary: (THIa) evaṃbhūtā'pi hutvā adhicca laddhāya kalyāṇamittasevāya amatam'adhigacchi, nibbānaṃ anuppattā.

example_1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya, so yato yato sāyeyya, labheth'eva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ
commentary: (ANa) adhigaccheyyā'ti labheyya.

example_1: so tattha aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbena ādhipateyyena dibbehi rūpehi dibbehi saddehi dibbehi gandhehi dibbehi rasehi dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi.
example_2: siyā, sumaneti bhagavā avoca, yo so, sumane, dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ manussabhūto samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti, mānusakena āyunā, mānusakena vaṇṇena, mānusakena sukhena, mānusakena yasena, mānusakena ādhipateyyena.
commentary: (ANa) adhigaṇhātī'ti adhibhavitvā gaṇhāti ajjhottharati atiseti.

example_1: atthi nu kho me uttari manussadhammo alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso adhigato, yen'āhaṃ pacchime kāle sabrahmacārīhi puṭṭho na maṅku bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
example_2: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāva-adhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.

meaning_1: held (in relation to); possessed (with regard to); found (in)
example_1: imesu khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi, na c'amhi arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo, api ca me, āvuso, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmī'ti adhigataṃ, ayam'aham'asmī'ti na ca samanupassāmī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) asmī'ti adhigatan'ti asmī'ti evaṃ pavattā taṇhāmānā adhigatā.

meaning_1: perceiving as attained; thinking one has achieved (something)
commentary: (VINa) adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino'ti arahatte ñāṇacakkhunā adiṭṭhey'eva, diṭṭhaṃ amhehi arahattan'ti diṭṭhasaññino hutvā. esa nayo appatt'ādīsu.

meaning_1: can be obtained; can be experienced (by)
example_1: na kho, āvuso gotama, sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ.

meaning_1: to get; to attain; to acquire; to obtain
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ odanakummāsan'ti.

meaning_1: having got; having attained; having acquired; having achieved
example_1: tena kho pana samayena lohiccassa brāhmaṇassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, idha samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigaccheyya, kusalaṃ dhammaṃ adhigantvā na parassa āroceyya, kiñ'hi paro parassa karissati.
ayaṃ kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena paṭhamo okāsa-adhigamo anubuddho sukhassa-adhigamāya.
commentary: (DNa) paṭhamo okās'ādhigamo'ti paṭhamajjhānaṃ pañcanīvaraṇāni vikkhambhetvā attano okāsaṃ gahetvā tiṭṭhati, tasmā paṭhamo okās'ādhigamo'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_2: approach to scripture; scribing of scripture

commentary: (MNt) adhigam'atthāyā'ti paṭilābh'atthāya.

meaning_lit: for the purpose of reaching; for the sake of attaining

example_1: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.

meaning_1: will attain; will achieve; will acquire
example_1: tena kho pana maṃ, aggivessana, samayena pañca bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti, yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati, taṃ no ārocessatī'ti.
example_2: tāya'pi kho tvaṃ, āvuso gotama, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya n'ājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ, kiṃ pana tvaṃ eta'r'ahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesan'ti?

example_1: tena kho pana maṃ, rājakumāra, samayena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti, yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati taṃ no ārocessatī'ti.

meaning_1: could get; would find; should attain
meaning_2: could get; would find; should attain

example_1: kadā iṇ'aṭṭo'va daliddako nidhiṃ, ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito, tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ, mah'esino taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

meaning_1: fact of having taken hold of; fact of having been acquired; fact of being possessed

example_1: appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā, appamatto ubho atthe, adhiggaṇhāti paṇḍito.
amamā, apariggahā, niyat'āyukā, visesaguṇā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi ṭhānehi uttarakurukā manussā deve ca tāvatiṃse adhiggaṇhanti jambudīpake ca manusse.
commentary: (DNa) adhiggaṇhātī'ti adhibhavati, aññehi devehi atirekaṃ labhatī'ti attho.

example_1: ye c'assa dhammā akkhātā, sāmaññass'ānulomikā, adhiggahitā tuṭṭhassa, appamattassa sikkhato'ti.
commentary: (ANa) adhiggahitā'ti sabb'ete tuṭṭhacittassa bhikkhuno adhiggahitā honti antogatā na paribāhirā'ti. (ITIa) adhiggahitā'ti sabbe te tuṭṭhacittassa santuṭṭhacittena bhikkhunā adhiggahitā paṭipakkhadhamme abhibhavitvā gahitā honti abbhantaragatā, na bāhiragatā'ti.

meaning_1: what one has practised; what one has rehearsed; what one has prepared
example_1: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattan'ti yaṃ tuyhaṃ dīghena kālena paricitaṃ suppaguṇaṃ, taṃ mama vādaṃ āgamma sabbaṃ khaṇena viparāvattaṃ nivattaṃ.

example_1: anūpavādo anūpaghāto, pātimokkhe ca saṃvaro, mattaññutā ca bhattasmiṃ, pantañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ, adhicitte ca āyogo, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
example_2: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā pañca nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni. katamāni pañca?
commentary: (DNa) aṭṭha samāpattiyo cittaṃ, vipassanāpādakajjhānaṃ adhicittaṃ.

meaning_1: engaged in meditation; devoted to mental development; cultivating the higher mind
example_1: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno oḷārikā upakkilesā kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ
example_2: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā pañca nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni. katamāni pañca?
commentary: (MNa) adhicittamanuyuttenā'ti dasakusalakammapathavasena uppannaṃ cittaṃ cittam'eva, vipassanā-pādaka-aṭṭha-samāpatti-cittaṃ tato cittato adhikaṃ cittan'ti adhicittaṃ. anuyuttenā'ti taṃ adhicittaṃ anuyuttena, tattha yuttappayuttenā'ti attho.

meaning_1: meditation training; development of the higher mind; (comm) suttapiṭaka
example_1: tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
example_2: sikkhā'ti tisso sikkhā, adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā. tatra y'āyaṃ adhisīlasikkhā, ayaṃ imasmiṃ atthe adhippetā sikkhā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) tathā hi, vinayapiṭake visesena adhisīlasikkhā vuttā, sutt'antapiṭake adhicittasikkhā, abhidhammapiṭake adhipaññāsikkhā.

meaning_1: undertaking the training in higher mind; engaging in meditation
example_1: adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇiyāni samaṇakaraṇīyāni.

meaning_2: as regards thought, as to meditation
in regards to thought, to meditation

meaning_1: unlikely; by chance; without cause or reason; exceptional
example_1: adhiccam'idaṃ, bhante, yaṃ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyā'ti.
example_2: evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

meaning_1: it is by chance; it is by accident
example_1: adhiccam'idaṃ, bhante, yaṃ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyā'ti.
example_2: evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.

meaning_1: occurring by chance; spontaneously arisen; accidental; fortuitous
example_1: santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
example_2: kiṃ nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, sayaṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, paraṃkataṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ, sayaṃkatañ'ca paraṃkatañ'ca jarāmaraṇaṃ, udāhu asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ jarāmaraṇan'ti?
commentary: (DNa) adhiccasamuppannan'ti akāraṇasamuppannaṃ. (SNa) adhiccasamuppannan'ti akāraṇena yadicchāya uppannaṃ. (ANa) adhiccasamuppannan'ti ahetunibbattaṃ.

example_1: ayaṃ ubhay'attha dosaṃ disvā ubhayaṃ paṭikkhipati. atha kathaṃ uppanno'ti āha, adhiccasamuppanno'ti yadicchāya samuppanno kenaci kāraṇena vinā uppanno'ti adhiccasamuppannavādo dassito. tena ca ahetukavādo'pi saṅgahito hoti.

meaning_1: believing in fortuitous origination; believing in causeless manifestation
meaning_2: who believes in fortuitous origination; who believes in causeless manifestation
example_1: te ca bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā kim'āgamma kim'ārabbha adhiccasamuppannikā adhiccasamuppannaṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti dvīhi vatthūhi?
commentary: (DNa) adhiccasamuppanno attā ca loko cā'ti dassanaṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ. taṃ etesaṃ atthī'ti adhiccasamuppannikā. adhiccasamuppannan'ti akāraṇasamuppannaṃ.

meaning_2: rarely making transgression; by chance guilty of an offence; occasionally offending
example_1: idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu adhicc'āpattiko hoti anāpattibahulo.
commentary: (VINa) adhicc'āpattiko nāma yo kadāci karahaci āpattiṃ āpajjati.

meaning_1: regarding what is repulsive; concerning what is abhorrent; (comm) highest disgust
meaning_2: as regards what is detestable, as regards scrupulousness
example_1: yāvatā, kassapa, ariyā paramā tapojigucchā, n'āhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi, kuto bhiyyo! atha kho aham'eva tattha bhiyyo, yadidaṃ adhijegucchaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) adhijegucchan'ti idha jigucchabhāvo jegucchaṃ, uttamaṃ jegucchaṃ adhijegucchaṃ, tasmā yadidaṃ adhijegucchaṃ, tattha aham'eva bhiyyo'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

meaning_1: regarding what is repulsive; concerning what is abhorrent
meaning_2: as regards what is detestable, as regards scrupulousness
example_1: tatra maṃ aññataro tapabrahmacārī nigrodho nāma adhijegucche pañhaṃ apucchi. tass'āhaṃ adhijegucche pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākāsiṃ. byākate ca pana me attamano ahosi paraṃ viya mattāyā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) adhijegucche'ti vīriyena pāpajigucchan'ādhikāre pañhaṃ pucchi. (DNa) adhijegucche'ti vīriyena pāpajigucchanabhāve.

meaning_1: concentrating; focusing; fixing one's attention; resolving (on)

meaning_1: having determined; having ordered; having arranged; having managed; having supervised
example_1: maggena chādentassa dve magge adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ maggaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ. pariyāyena chādentassa dve pariyāye adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ pariyāyaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ.

commentary: (VIN 2.5.2.9) dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabban'ti… pariyāyena chādentassa dve pariyāye adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ pariyāyaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ.

evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu bālo abyatto akhettaññū akusalo… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so taṃ nimittaṃ na āsevati na bhāveti na bahulīkaroti na svādhiṭṭhitaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.

meaning_2: determination; decisive resolution; fixing the mind on

meaning_2: having determined, having fixed one's attention

commentary: (MNa) adhiṭṭhāya manasā'ti jhān'ārammaṇacittena adhiṭṭhahitvā.
(VINt) navakamm'ādhiṭṭhāyikan'ti navakammasaṃvidhāyikaṃ.

example_1: handa dāni iminā upāyena pallaṅkaṃ nissāya uppajjissatī'ti gehaṃ gantvā yathā tasmiṃ gehe ṭhapetvā māṇavakassa pallaṅkaṃ aññaṃ na kiñci āsanaṃ dissati tathā adhiṭṭhāsi.

grammar: masc, in comps, abbrev of adhipati
example_1: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, loka-adhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.
example_2: pañcavīsasahassamhi, kappānaṃ manuja-adhipā, abbudanirabbudāni, aṭṭhaṭṭhāsiṃsu khattiyā.

example_1: kodhano dubbaṇṇo hoti, atho dukkham'pi seti so, atho atthaṃ gahetvāna, anatthaṃ adhipajjati.
commentary: (ANa) anatthaṃ adhipajjatī'ti anattho me gahito'ti sallakkheti.

example_1: imāya'pi kho ahaṃ, cunda, paññattiyā n'eva attanā samasamaṃ samanupassāmi kuto bhiyyo. atha kho aham'eva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhipaññatti.
commentary: (DNa) yadidaṃ adhipaññattī'ti yā ayaṃ adhipaññatti nāma. ettha aham'eva bhiyyo uttaritaro na mayā samo atthi. tattha yañ'ca vuttaṃ paññattiyā'ti yañ'ca adhipaññattī'ti ubhayam'etaṃ atthato ekaṃ. bhedato hi paññatti adhipaññattī'ti dvayaṃ hoti. tattha paññatti nāma diṭṭhipaññatti. adhipaññatti nāma khandhapaññatti dhātupaññatti āyatanapaññatti indriyapaññatti saccapaññatti puggalapaññattīti evaṃ vuttā cha paññattiyo. idha pana paññattiyā'ti etthā'pi paññatti c'eva adhipaññatti ca adhippetā, adhipaññattī'ti etthā'pi. bhagavā hi paññattiyā'pi anuttaro, adhipaññattiyā'pi anuttaro. ten'āha, aham'eva tattha bhiyyo yadidaṃ adhipaññattī'ti.

meaning_1: regarding wisdom; concerning understanding; (comm) highest wisdom
example_1: yāvatā, kassapa, ariyā paramā paññā, n'āhaṃ tattha attano samasamaṃ samanupassāmi, kuto bhiyyo! atha kho aham'eva tattha bhiyyo, yadidaṃ adhipaññaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) paññ'ādhikāre'pi kammassakatāpaññā ca vipassanāpaññā ca paññā nāma, maggaphalasampayuttā paramā paññā nāma. adhipaññan'ti ettha liṅgavipallāso veditabbo, ayaṃ pan'etth'attho, yāyaṃ adhipaññā nāma aham'eva tattha bhiyyo'ti.

example_1: na tādiso chando hoti adhicittasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, na tādiso chando hoti adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ.
example_2: tisso imā, bhikkhave, sikkhā yatth'etaṃ sabbaṃ samodhānaṃ gacchati. katamā tisso? adhisīlasikkhā, adhicittasikkhā, adhipaññāsikkhā.
commentary: (DNa) kammassakatañāṇaṃ paññā, vipassanāpaññā adhipaññā.

meaning_1: deep understanding and insight into phenomena; (comm) insight knowledge which grasps conditioned phenomena
example_1: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo lābhī c'eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññā-dhammavipassanāya.
commentary: (ANa) adhipaññā-dhammavipassanāyā'ti saṅkhāra-pariggāhaka-vipassanā-ñāṇassa. tañ'hi adhipaññāsaṅkhātañ'ca, pañcakkhandhasaṅkhātesu ca dhammesu vipassanābhūtaṃ, tasmā adhipaññā-dhammavipassanā'ti vuccatī'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of adhipaññā
meaning_1: with regard to understanding; about wisdom
construction:
adhi + pa + √ñā + ā + āya
adhipaññā + āya

commentary: (VINa) adhipaññāyā'ti lok'uttaramaggabhāvanāya.

meaning_1: higher insight training; development of deeper understanding; (comm) abhidhammapiṭaka

commentary: (VINa) tathā hi, vinayapiṭake visesena adhisīlasikkhā vuttā, sutt'antapiṭake adhicittasikkhā, abhidhammapiṭake adhipaññāsikkhā.

meaning_1: undertaking the training in higher understanding
example_1: adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇiyāni samaṇakaraṇīyāni.
purimañ'ca disaṃ rājā, dhataraṭṭho pasāsati, gandhabbānaṃ adhipati, mahārājā yasassiso.

synonym: adhibhū, ina, inda, issara, īsa, nāyaka, pati, bhattar, rāja, vasī, sāmī

commentary: (MNa) adhimānikā nāma yesaṃ appatte pattasaññāya adhimāno uppajjati, sv'āyaṃ uppajjamāno n'eva lokavaṭṭ'ānusārīnaṃ bālaputhujjanānaṃ uppajjati, na ariyasāvakānaṃ. na hi sotāpannassa sakadāgāmī ahan'ti adhimāno uppajjati, na sakadāgāmissa anāgāmī ahan'ti, na anāgāmino arahā ahan'ti, kārakass'eva pana samathavasena vā vipassanāvasena vā vikkhambhitakilesassa niccaṃ yuttapayuttassa āraddhavipassakassa uppajjati. tassa hi samathavikkhambhitānaṃ vā vipassanāvikkhambhitānaṃ vā kilesānaṃ samudācāraṃ apassato sot'āpanno ahan'ti vā, sakadāgāmī, anāgāmī, arahā ahan'ti vā adhimāno uppajjati, talaṅgaratissa-pabbatavāsi-dhammadinnattherena ovādiyamānattherānaṃ viya.

commentary: (SNPa) anaññaneyyo'ti aññehi idaṃ saccaṃ, idaṃ saccan'ti na netabbo. etena sayambhutaṃ dīpeti, patte vā paccekabodhiñāṇe aneyyatāya abhāvā sayaṃvasitaṃ. samathavipassanāya vā diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivatto, ādimaggena patto niyāmaṃ, sesehi paṭiladdhamaggo, phalañāṇena uppannañāṇo, taṃ sabbaṃ attanā'va adhigato'ti anaññaneyyo.

commentary: (SNa) anaññaposī'ti ṭhapetvā imaṃ attabhāvaṃ aññassa attabhāvassa vā puttadārassa vā aposanatāya anaññaposī.

example_2: katamehi pañcahi? kathaṃ paribhoti, kathikaṃ paribhoti, attānaṃ paribhoti, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.

meaning_1: not lost; not perished; not destroyed
example_1: avissajjite vissajjitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: yo ve anaṭṭhaṃ'va naṭṭhan'ti c'āha, kāme'va so labhataṃ bhuñjatañ'ca, agāramajjhe maraṇaṃ upetu, yo vā bhonto saṅkati kañci'd'eva.
commentary: (VINa) anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī'ti attano cīvarena saddhiṃ bahūni aññesaṃ cīvarāni ekato ṭhapitāni corā haranti. tatr'esa attano cīvare anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī hoti. esa nayo avinaṭṭh'ādīsu'pi.

meaning_1: debt free; without debt; without obligation
example_1: mutte muccassu yogehi, cando rāhuggahā iva, vippamuttena cittena, anaṇā bhuñja piṇḍakan'ti.
example_2: s'āyaṃ bhujissā anaṇā, bhikkhunī bhāvit'indriyā, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, katakiccā anāsavā.
commentary: (THIa) anaṇā bhuñja piṇḍakan'ti kilesaiṇaṃ pahāya anaṇā hutvā raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjeyyāsi. yo hi kilese appahāya satthārā anuññātapaccaye paribhuñjati, so sāṇo paribhuñjati nāma. yath'āha āyasmā bākulo, satt'āham'eva kho ahaṃ, āvuso, sāṇo raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjin'ti (ma. ni. 3.211). tasmā sāsane pabbajitena kāmacchandādiiṇaṃ pahānāya anaṇena hutvā saddhādeyyaṃ paribhuñjitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: unbent; without inclination; epithet of Nibbāna

example_2: anatañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, anatagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.
commentary: (UDa) anatan'ti rūp'ādiārammaṇesu, kāmādīsu ca bhavesu namanato tanninnabhāvena pavattito sattānañ'ca tattha namanato taṇhā natā nāma, n'atthi ettha natā'ti anataṃ, nibbānan'ti attho.

meaning_1: leading to the uninclined; going to the unbent

commentary: (SNa) taṇhānatiyā abhāvena anataṃ.

meaning_1: not gone beyond; not surpassed; not exceeded

meaning_1: perceiving (something) as not kept more than one day
perceiving as not having passed; recognizing (something) as not exceeding
example_1: das'āh'ātikkante vematiko, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. das'āh'ātikkante anatikkantasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) das'āh'ātikkante atikkantasaññī'ti das'āhaṃ atikkante cīvare atikkantaṃ idan'ti evaṃsaññī, das'āhe vā atikkante atikkanto das'āho'ti evaṃsaññī.

commentary: (VINa) anatikkamanīyo'ti na atikkamitabbo.

na + atikkamitvā

commentary: (DNa) anaticārinī'ti sāmikaṃ muñcitvā aññaṃ manasā'pi na pattheti.

commentary: (ANa) kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno'ti taṃ bhikkhābhājanaṃ anatimaññamāno. so hi puṇṇapattaṃ ādāya sīsaṃ nhāto kuladvāresu ṭhatvā ahaṃ aṭṭhacattālīsa vassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ cariṃ, mantā'pi me gahitā, ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ dassāmi, dhanaṃ me dethā'ti yācati. taṃ sutvā manussā yathāsatti yathābalaṃ aṭṭha'pi soḷasa'pi satam'pi sahassam'pi denti. evaṃ sakalagāmaṃ caritvā laddhadhanaṃ ācariyassa niyyādeti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

example_2: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhuttāviṃ pavāritaṃ anatirittena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, handa bhikkhu khāda vā bhuñja vā'ti jānaṃ āsādan'āpekkho, bhuttasmiṃ pācittiyaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on not belonging to a self

example_2: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacitto vakkhāmi, no dos'antaro'ti, ime pañca dhammā ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbā

ṃe > me

construction: na > an + abhi + saṃ + e + ta

meaning_1: not gained full awakening; not woken completely

example_2: mayham'pi kho, mahānāma, pubb'eva sambodhā, anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato, app'assādā kāmā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti, evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ hoti
commentary: (MNa) anabhisambuddhassā'ti appaṭividdhacatusaccassa.

meaning_1: not fully understood; not completely realized
example_1: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā'ti.
yo kho pana, bhante, brahmuno pakativaṇṇo anabhisambhavanīyo so devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ cakkhupathasmiṃ.
commentary: (DNa) anabhisambhavanīyo'ti apattabbo, na taṃ devā tāvatiṃsā passantī'ti attho.

construction: na > an + abhi + saṃ + bhava + nta
example_1: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.

meaning_1: not reaching; not attaining; not realizing
being unable to endure; being incapable (of)

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo āsaṃso? idha, bhikkhave, rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa jeṭṭho putto hoti ābhiseko anabhisitto acalappatto. so suṇāti, itthan'nāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiy'ābhisekena abhisitto'ti.

meaning_2: without a companion; without a helper

example_1: tañ'ce bhikkhu n'ābhinandati n'ābhivadati n'ājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandī. nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi
so dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

example_2: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino samāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ evaṃ pajānissati, anamataggo kho saṃsāro.

construction:

anamatagga + iya

meaning_1: not time for smiling; not time for amusement
example_1: k'āyaṃ eḷagalāgumbe, karoti ahuhāsiyaṃ, na'y'idha naccaṃ vā gītaṃ vā, tāḷaṃ vā susamāhitaṃ, anamhikāle sussoṇi, kiṃ nu jagghasi sobhaṇe.
taggha'si, tāta kumma, khato, taggha upahato. etena hi te, tāta kumma, suttakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayaṃ āpannā byasanaṃ āpannā. gaccha dāni tvaṃ, tāta kumma, na dāni tvaṃ amhākan'ti.
example_2: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, makkaṭo pañc'oḍḍito thunaṃ seti anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.
commentary: (DNa) ayo'ti sukhaṃ, na ayo anayo, dukkhaṃ.

example_1: na'y'idaṃ anayena jīvitaṃ, n'āhāro hadayassa santiko, āhāraṭṭhitiko samussayo, iti disvāna carāmi esanaṃ.
commentary: (THa) na'y'idaṃ anayena jīvitan'ti idaṃ mama jīvitaṃ anayena añāyena veḷudāna-pupphadān'ādi-anesanāya na hoti jīvitanikantiyā abhāvato.

meaning_1: misfortune and disaster; tragedy and ruin
example_1: m'āyaṃ puriso idh'eva anayabyasanaṃ āpajjī'ti!
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sālo vā dhavo vā phandano vā tīhi māluvālatāhi uddhasto pariyonaddho anayaṃ āpajjati, byasanaṃ āpajjati, anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
commentary: (ANa) anayabyasanan'ti avaḍḍhivināsaṃ.

meaning_1: got into trouble; met with misfortune; fallen into difficulty

meaning_1: not an awakened being; unenlightened person
example_1: mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.

anarahant + aṃ

example_1: na kāmasukham'anuyuñjeyya hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamath'ānuyogam'anuyuñjeyya dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.

meaning_1: with ignoble qualities, attacking; (or) ignobly attacking the good qualities
example_1: ye viruddhā sallapanti, viniviṭṭhā samussitā, anariyaguṇam'āsajja, añño'ññavivar'esino.
commentary: (ANa) anariyaguṇam'āsajjā'ti anariyaguṇakathaṃ guṇam'āsajja kathenti. guṇaṃ ghaṭṭetvā kathā hi anariyakathā nāma, na ariyakathā, taṃ kathentī'ti attho.

example_1: yo attano sīlavatāni jantu, anānupuṭṭho'va paresa pāva, anariyadhammaṃ kusalā tam'āhu, yo ātumānaṃ sayam'eva pāva.

commentary: (ANa) anariyapariyesanā'ti anariyānaṃ esanā gavesanā.

example_1: yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ.

meaning_1: ignoble mode of expression; untrue statement; communication without integrity
example_1: sampajānamusāvādo nāma visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā, girā, byappatho, vacībhedo, vācasikā viññatti, aṭṭha anariyavohārā, adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me'ti, assutaṃ sutaṃ me'ti, amutaṃ mutaṃ me'ti

meaning_1: not enough; not sufficient; (comm) (or) not to be relied on
example_1: idh'udāyi, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, idaṃ kho ahaṃ, udāyi, analan'ti vadāmi, pajahathā'ti vadāmi, samatikkamathā'ti vadāmi. ko ca tassa samatikkamo?
commentary: (MNa) analan'ti vadāmī'ti akattabbaālayan'ti vadāmi, taṇh'ālayo ettha na uppādetabbo'ti dasseti. atha vā analaṃ apariyattaṃ, na ettāvatā alam'etan'ti sanniṭṭhānaṃ kātabban'ti vadāmi.

meaning_1: with a dry body; with dry limbs
example_1: dhammo rahado brāhmaṇa sīlatittho, anāvilo sabbhi sataṃ pasattho, yattha have vedaguno sinātā, anallagattā'va taranti pāraṃ.

meaning_1: unconsoled; discouraged; lacking confidence; not convinced
example_1: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, etth'āhaṃ, bhante, anassasaṃ panassasaṃ. ahañ'hi, bhante, channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmī'ti.

example_1: buddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusiṭṭhiṃ na ādiyanti na sussusanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, anassavā avacanakarā paṭilomavuttino, aññen'eva mukhaṃ karonti.

example_1: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikan'ti viditvā ye viññāṇe upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.
sātiyesu anassāvī, atimāne ca no yuto, saṇho ca paṭibhānavā, na saddho na virajjati.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho abhayo rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, bhāseyya nu kho, bhante, tathāgato taṃ vācaṃ yā sā vācā paresaṃ appiyā amanāpā'ti? na khv'ettha, rājakumāra, ek'aṃsenā'ti. ettha, bhante, anassuṃ nigaṇṭhā'ti.

example_2: so tena ñāṇadassanena na majjati nappamajjati na pamādaṃ āpajjati, appamatto samāno asamayavimokkhaṃ ārādheti. aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu tāya asamayavimuttiyā parihāyetha.

example_1: te taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitvā na c'eva aññam'aññaṃ saññāpenti na ca saññattiṃ upagacchanti, na ca nijjhāpenti na ca nijjhattiṃ upagacchanti. te asaññattibalā anijjhattibalā appaṭinissaggamantino tam'eva adhikaraṇaṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharanti, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) appaṭinissaggamantino'ti yesaṃ hi evaṃ hoti, sace amhehi gahitaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ dhammikaṃ bhavissati, gaṇhissāma. sace adhammikaṃ, vissajjessāmā'ti, te paṭinissaggamantino nāma honti. ime pana na tathā mantentī'ti appaṭinissaggamantino.

meaning_1: not given up; not forsaken; not renounced; not abandoned
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭ'ānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā saṃvaseyya vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhin'ti etaṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ.

meaning_1: who is not an equal; who is not a peer
example_1: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, āpattiñ'ca vata āpanno assaṃ, sappaṭipuggalo maṃ codeyya, no appaṭipuggalo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) appaṭipuggalo'ti ettha ayutto paṭipuggalo appaṭipuggalo. imehi āpatt'ādīhi asadisattā paṭisattu paṭisallo codako bhavituṃ ayutto'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: santassa bhūripaññassa, mahāpaññassa vītalobhassa, tathāgatassa sugatassa, appaṭipuggalassa asamassa, visāradassa nipuṇassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
example_2: atthi sakyakule jāto, buddho appaṭipuggalo, sabb'ābhibhū māranudo, sabbattha'm'aparājito.

commentary: (SNa) appaṭipuggalo'ti paṭibhāgapuggalavirahito.

meaning_1: not calm; not internally settled; not at ease; not relaxed
example_1: āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhān'ābhitunnassa sato.
diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ, āvuso, anupāyo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
example_2: chandajāto anakkhāte, manasā ca phuṭo siyā, kāmesu ca appaṭibaddhacitto, uddhaṃsoto'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: not fearful; not frightful; not risky; not dangerous
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.
example_2: sappaṭibhayaṃ nāma tasmiṃ magge corehi manussā hatā dissanti, viluttā dissanti, ākoṭitā dissanti, sappaṭibhayaṃ gantvā appaṭibhayaṃ dassetvā uyyojetabbā, gacchatha bhaginiyo'ti.

meaning_1: with no counterpart; with no one resembling
example_1: ekapuggalo, bhikkhave, loke uppajjamāno uppajjati adutiyo asahāyo appaṭimo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo asamo asamasamo dvipadānaṃ aggo. katamo ekapuggalo?
commentary: (ANa) appaṭibhāgo'ti ye tathāgatena cattāro satipaṭṭhānā'ti-ādinā nayena dhammā desitā, tesu na cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, tayo vā pañca vā'ti-ādinā nayena paṭibhāgaṃ kātuṃ samattho nāma n'atthī'ti appaṭibhāgo.

meaning_1: unresponsive; dumbfounded; speechless; mute; at a loss for words
example_1: evaṃ vutte, uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
commentary: (MNa) appaṭibhāno'ti uttari appassanto.

construction:
na > a + pati + √mā + ā + a
appaṭimā + a
example_1: gantvāna buddho nadikaṃ kakudhaṃ, acch'odakaṃ sāt'udakaṃ vippasannaṃ, ogāhi satthā akilantarūpo, tathāgato appaṭimo ca loke.
example_2: ādāya dantāni gaj'uttamassa, vaggū subhe appaṭime pathabyā, suvaṇṇarājīhi samantamodare, so luddako kāsipuraṃ upāgami, upanesi so rājakaññāya dante, nāgo hato handa imassa dantā.

commentary: (VINa) acchiddena appaṭimaṃsenā'ti-ādīsu yena gahaṭṭhapabbajitesu yo koci pahaṭo vā hoti, gihīnaṃ gaṇḍaphālan'ādīni vejjakammāni vā katāni, tassa kāyasamācāro upacikāhi khāyitatālapaṇṇam'iva chiddo ca paṭimāsituṃ yattha katthaci gahetvā ākaḍḍhituṃ sakkuṇeyyatāya sappaṭimaṃso ca hoti, viparīto acchiddo appaṭimaṃso'ti veditabbo'ti.

meaning_1: not obtaining; not getting; not personally experiencing

yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, appaṭisevato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, paṭisevato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā
iti kho, bhikkhave, vīsati kusalapakkhā, vīsati akusalapakkhā, mahācattārīsako dhammapariyāyo pavattito appaṭivattiyo samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
example_2: etaṃ bhagavatā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin'ti.

construction:

example_1: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃ'y'eva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca karaṇīyaṃ.

example_1: tañ'ca pana appaṭivānīyaṃ, asecanakam'ojavaṃ, pivanti maññe sappaññā, valāhakam'iva panthagū'ti.
commentary: (SNa) tañ'ca pana appaṭivānīyan'ti tañ'ca pana dhammaṃ appaṭivānīyaṃ deseti. bāhirakañ'hi sumadhuram'pi bhojanaṃ punappunaṃ bhuñjantassa na ruccati, apanetha, kiṃ iminā'ti? paṭivānetabbaṃ apanetabbaṃ hoti, na evam'ayaṃ dhammo. imaṃ hi dhammaṃ paṇḍitā vassasatam'pi vassasahassam'pi suṇantā tittiṃ na gacchanti. ten'āha appaṭivānīyan'ti. (THIa) tañ'ca appaṭivānīyan'ti tañ'ca pana dhammaṃ anivattitabhāv'āvahaṃ niyyānikaṃ, abhikkantatāya vā yathā sotujana-savana-manohara-bhāvena anapanīyaṃ

meaning_1: who does not eat without sharing; who shares without reservation

commentary: (ANa) appaṭivibhattabhogī'ti ettha dve paṭivibhattāni nāma āmisapaṭivibhattaṃ pana puggalapaṭivibhattañ'ca. tattha, ettakaṃ dassāmi, ettakaṃ na dassāmī'ti evaṃ cittena paṭivibhajanaṃ āmisapaṭivibhattaṃ nāma. asukassa dassāmi, asukassa na dassāmī'ti evaṃ cittena vibhajanaṃ pana puggalapaṭivibhattaṃ nāma. tadubhayam'pi akatvā yo appaṭivibhattaṃ bhuñjati, ayaṃ appaṭivibhattabhogī nāma.

meaning_1: not abstained; not desisted (from); not given up
example_1: yebhuyyena kho pana, bhante, yakkhā appaṭiviratāy'eva pāṇ'ātipātā, appaṭiviratā adinn'ādānā, appaṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā, appaṭiviratā musāvādā, appaṭiviratā surā-meraya-majja-ppamādaṭṭhānā. tesaṃ taṃ hoti appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
example_2: katame cattāro? santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ, surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā.
commentary: (ANa) surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā'ti pañcavidhāya surāya catubbidhassa merayassa ca pānato aviratā.

meaning_1: not opposed; not against; not averse
example_1: sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddha-appaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.

meaning_2: not reviewed; not reflected; not inspected

meaning_1: having not checked; having not inspected
construction:
na > a + pati + ava + √ikkh + itvā
na + paṭivekkhitvā
commentary: (VINt) appaṭivekkhitvā'ti anupaparikkhitvā.

example_1: catunnaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam'idaṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ'c'eva tumhākañ'ca
example_2: avijjā'ti… adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhaṇā

meaning_1: not being struck; not being hit; not being beaten

example_1: indriyaparopariyatta-ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sattānaṃ āsay'ānusaya-ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, yamakapāṭihīre ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, mahākaruṇāsamāpattiyā ñāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbaññutañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ, sabbattha asaṅgam'appaṭihatam'anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1a) appaṭihatan'ti nirāvaraṇataṃ dasseti. puna sabbaññutaṃ upamāya sādhetu'kāmo

meaning_1: without an escort; without a bodyguard; unimpeded
construction:
na > a + pati + √har > hār + *a + ika
appaṭihāra + ika
example_1: santapaṇītadhammapaccavekkhaṇavasena uppannattā. yathā hi rājavallabho cūḷ'upaṭṭhāko appaṭihārikaṃ yathāsukhaṃ rājakulaṃ pavisanto seṭṭhisenāpati-ādayo pādena paharanto'pi na gaṇeti.
commentary: (SNt) appaṭihārikan'ti paṭiharaṇarahitaṃ appaṭihāraṃ, kenaci anāvaṭan'ti attho.

meaning_1: having few involvements; with few duties; having few activities
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto
example_2: brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) app'aṭṭho'ti appasamārambho.

example_1: atthi pana, bho gotama, añño yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti?
commentary: (ANa) app'aṭṭhatarā'ti yattha bahūhi veyyāvaccakarehi vā upakaraṇehi vā attho n'atthi. (DNt) app'aṭṭhataro'ti pana ativiya appakicco'ti attho.

meaning_1: fact of having few involvements; state of having few duties; fact of having few undertakings

meaning_2: fixing of thought on an object, attainment of a trance

meaning_1: not making an aspiration; not making a wish; not setting an intention
example_1: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ nappaṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānapaccayā na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
commentary: (NIDD1a) appaṇidhānapaccayā'ti na patthanāṭhapanakāraṇena.

meaning_1: due to not making an aspiration; based on not wishing (for the future)
example_1: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ nappaṇidahati, cetaso appaṇidhānapaccayā na tadabhinandati, na tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
commentary: (NIDD1a) appaṇidhānapaccayā'ti na patthanāṭhapanakāraṇena.

meaning_1: not guiding; not applying; not directing
construction:
na > a + pa + ni + √dhā + ya
na + paṇidhāya
example_1: kathañ'c'ānanda appaṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti?
appaṇihitaṃ me bahiddhā cittan'ti pajānāti
commentary: (SNa) bahiddhā'ti mūlakammaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya bahi aññasmiṃ ārammaṇe. appaṇidhāyā'ti aṭṭhapetvā. atha pacchā pure asaṃkhittaṃ vimuttaṃ appaṇihitan'ti pajānātī'ti ettha kammaṭṭhānavasena vā sarīravasena vā desanāvasena vā attho veditabbo.

meaning_2: desireless, not looking to something superior
example_1: saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ pan'āyye, bhikkhuṃ kati phassā phusantīti? saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti, suññato phasso, animitto phasso, appaṇihito phasso'ti.
commentary: (PM) katamo appaṇihito vimokkho? idha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, suññam'idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā'ti. so tattha paṇidhiṃ na karotī'ti, appaṇihito vimokkho. ayaṃ appaṇihito vimokkho. (VINa) rāgadosamohapaṇidhīnaṃ abhāvato appaṇihito'ti vuccati. (MNa) yo dukkhato pariggahetvā dukkhato disvā dukkhato vuṭṭhāti, tassa appaṇihitā nāma.

example_1: ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena pubbe appatarāni c'eva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṃ bahutarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahiṃsu? ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena eta'r'ahi bahutarāni c'eva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantī'ti?

meaning_2: (comm) not worthy of consideration or respect

meaning_1: unestablished; without basis; without support; (comm) without support from below and not hanging from above
construction:
na > a + pati + √ṭhā + ā + a
appatiṭṭhā + a
example_1: kathaṃsu tarati oghaṃ, rattin'divam'atandito, appatiṭṭhe anālambe, ko gambhīre na sīdatī'ti.
example_2: tatr'āp'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, n'eva āgatiṃ vadāmi, na gatiṃ, na ṭhitiṃ, na cutiṃ, na upapattiṃ. appatiṭṭhaṃ, appavattaṃ, anārammaṇam'ev'etaṃ. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) appatiṭṭhe anālambe'ti heṭṭhā apatiṭṭhe upari anālambane.

meaning_1: without relying; not depending; without leaning
example_1: kathaṃ nu tvaṃ, mārisa, ogham'atarī'ti? appatiṭṭhaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, anāyūhaṃ ogham'atarin'ti.
commentary: (SNa) appatiṭṭhan'ti appatiṭṭhahanto.

meaning_1: not standing still; not staying in place; not halting; not fixing on
example_1: kathaṃ nu tvaṃ, mārisa, ogham'atarī'ti? appatiṭṭhaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, anāyūhaṃ ogham'atarin'ti.
commentary: (SNa) appatiṭṭhan'ti appatiṭṭhahanto.

example_1: tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
example_2: viññāṇe ce, bhikkhave, āhāre n'atthi rāgo n'atthi nandī n'atthi taṇhā, appatiṭṭhitaṃ tattha viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ. yattha appatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ, n'atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.

example_1: atha puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ daḷhadhammānaṃ dhanuggahānaṃ susikkhitānaṃ katahatthānaṃ kat'ūpāsanānaṃ catuddisā kaṇḍe khitte appatiṭṭhite pathaviyaṃ gahetvā āharissāmī'ti.

meaning_1: not mentally established; not stable in mind
example_1: cakkhunā kho pan'eva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti appatiṭṭhitacitto adīnamānaso abyāpannacetaso.
commentary: (SNa) appatiṭṭhitacitto'ti kilesavasena aṭṭhitacitto.
notes: obviously a wrong reading, see CDB note 69

commentary: (SNa) appatiṭṭhitacitto'ti kilesavasena aṭṭhitacitto.

example_1: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, santuṭṭhā bhavissāma itar'ītarena cīvarena, itar'ītara-cīvara-santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādino, na ca cīvarahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjissāma.
example_2: vigarahi buddho bhagavā, ananucchavikaṃ, moghapurisa, ananulomikaṃ appatirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
synonym: akappiya, akalla, ananucchavika, anānuloma, abhadraka, asāruppa

meaning_1: not agreeable; disrespectful; not polite; not obedient
example_1: idha, kimila, tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari agāravā viharanti appatissā, dhamme agāravā viharanti appatissā, saṅghe agāravā viharanti appatissā, sikkhāya agāravā viharanti appatissā, samādhismiṃ agāravā viharanti appatissā, appamāde agāravā viharanti appatissā, paṭisanthāre agāravā viharanti appatissā.
commentary: (VINa) appatissā'ti appatissavā. upāsakā'ti vutte vacanam'pi na sotu'kāmā, anādarā'ti attho. appatissayā vā anīcavuttino'ti attho.

meaning_1: not agreeable; disrespectful; not polite; not obedient

meaning_2: not to be turned or rolled back; not to be black; irresistible
example_1: pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rājā cakkavattī dhammen'eva cakkaṃ vatteti, taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appativattiyaṃ kenaci manussabhūtena paccatthikena pāṇinā.
commentary: (ANa) taṃ hoti cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyan'ti taṃ tena evaṃ pavattitaṃ āṇācakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ hoti.

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti
example_2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ, āpattiṃ āpanno'ti. jānanti maṃ bhikkhū āpattiṃ āpanno'ti, iti so kupito hoti appatīto. yo c'eva kho, āvuso, kopo yo ca appaccayo, ubhayam'etaṃ aṅgaṇaṃ.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.8) appatīto'ti tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.

meaning_1: not reached; not attained; not gained; not accomplished; not found
example_1: sekhassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅgan'ti karitvā n'āññaṃ ek'aṅgam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bah'ūpakāraṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikāro.
example_2: veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā, n'atthi me pubben'āparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanābalan'ti.

meaning_1: unattained; unaccomplished; which has not been reached
example_1: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya vīriyaṃ ārabhatha appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
commentary: (MNa) appattassa pattiyā'ti appattassa arahattassa pāpuṇan'atthaṃ.

meaning_1: not fulfilled one's intention; not achieved one's goal; (comm) not attained arahantship
example_1: sekhassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato ajjhattikaṃ aṅgan'ti karitvā n'āññaṃ ek'aṅgam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bah'ūpakāraṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasikāro.
example_2: yo'pi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sekkho appattamānaso anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamāno viharati, so'pi pathaviṃ pathavito abhijānāti, pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññāya pathaviṃ mā maññi
commentary: (SNa) appattamānaso'ti appatt'ārahatto

meaning_1: not yet reached twenty years of age
example_1: ūnavīsativasso nāma appattavīsativasso.
atthi pana, bho gotama, añño yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'atthataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti?
commentary: (DNt) app'atthataro'ti pana ativiya appakicco, attho c'ettha kiccaṃ, ttha-kārassa ṭṭha-kāraṃ katvā app'aṭṭhataro'ti'pi pāṭho.

meaning_1: having not reached; having not arrived (at)
construction:
na > a + pa + √ap + tvā
na + patvā
example_1: gamanena na pattabbo, lokass'anto kudācanaṃ, na ca appatvā lok'antaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.
example_2: so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
commentary: (SNa) appatvā'ti saṅkhāralokassa antaṃ appatvā.

meaning_1: lacking stamina; without endurance; with no staying power
example_1: akkandati parodati, dubbalo appathāmako, na so pātāle paccuṭṭhāsi, atho gādham'pi n'ājjhagā.
example_2: atha vā, abalaṃ puggalaṃ dubbalaṃ appabalaṃ appathāmakaṃ hīnaṃ nihīnaṃ omakaṃ lāmakaṃ chatukkaṃ parittaṃ, yassa n'atthi saddhābalaṃ vīriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) appathāmako'ti ñāṇathāmassa parittatāya parittathāmako. (NIDD1a) appathāmakā'ti appo paritto thāmo etesaṃ vāyāmo ussāho'ti appathāmakā.

meaning_1: who does not understand correctly; who grasps in the wrong way
meaning_lit: not grasping with the right hand
example_1: pavāreti ce'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu, vadantu maṃ āyasmanto, vacanīyo'mhi āyasmantehī'ti, so ca hoti dubbaco, dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato, akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ
example_2: bhikkhū pan'eva dubbacajātiko hotī'ti dubbaco hoti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato akkhamo appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ.
commentary: (VINa) yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ appaṭipajjanato padakkhiṇena anusāsaniṃ na gaṇhātī'ti appadakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ. (MNa) ayaṃ anusāsaniṃ padakkhiṇato na gaṇhāti, vāmato gaṇhāti, tasmā appadakkhiṇaggāhī'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: who has little vision; with limited understanding
meaning_2: of little vision; of little knowledge
example_1: dijo yathā kubbanakaṃ pahāya, bahupphalaṃ kānanam'āvaseyya, evaṃ p'ahaṃ appadasse pahāya, mah'odadhiṃ haṃso'r'iva ajjhapatto.
commentary: (NIDD2) appadasse pahāyā'ti yo ca bāvarī brāhmaṇo ye c'aññe tassa ācariyā buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ upādāya appadassā parittadassā thokadassā omakadassā lāmakadassā chatukkadassā vā. (SNPa) appadasse'ti bāvaripabhutike parittapaññe.

example_1: so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti
commentary: (PMa) anibbiddhapubban'ti anamatagge saṃsāre antaṃ pāpetvā anibbiddhapubbaṃ. appadālitapubban'ti tass'eva atthavacanaṃ, antakaraṇen'eva apadālitapubban'ti attho.

meaning_1: with no light; without a lamp
commentary: (VINa) appadīpe'ti padīpacandasūriyaaggīsu ekenā'pi anobhāsite. ten'ev'assa padabhājane, anāloke'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: living a mildly difficult life; (comm) living in suffering just because of a minor mistake
example_1: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto app'ātumo appadukkhavihārī.
commentary: (ANa) appadukkhavihārī'ti appakena'pi pāpena dukkhavihārī.

example_1: abyāpannacitto hoti appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo ime sattā averā hontu abyāpajjā anīghā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantū'ti
yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa, tam'eva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ'va khitto.
example_2: yo daṇḍena adaṇḍesu, appaduṭṭhesu dussati, dasannam'aññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ, khippam'eva nigacchati.

meaning_1: not angry; not offended; not upset
example_1: te n'ātivelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni nappadūsenti. te aññam'aññaṃ appaduṭṭhacittā akilantakāyā akilantacittā.

meaning_1: who abuses an innocent; who wrongs the blameless
example_1: n'āphusantaṃ phusati ca, phusantañ'ca tato phuse, tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti… appaduṭṭhapadosī puggalo, taṃ puggalaṃ kammaṃ phusantam'eva kammaṃ phusati, vipāko vā phusati.

meaning_1: with no malevolent intention; with no bad purpose in mind; with no evil designs
example_1: abyāpannacitto kho pana hoti appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo, ime sattā averā abyābajjhā anīghā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantū'ti.

grammar: pp of na padhaṃsati, in comps
meaning_1: not attacked; not assaulted; not violated (by)
commentary: (VINt) padhaṃsitāyā'ti dūsitāya.

example_1: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? appadhaṃsiyo hoti abbhantarehi vā bāhirehi vā paccatthikehi paccāmittehi, rāgena vā dosena vā mohena vā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.

meaning_2: fixing of thought on an object, attainment of a trance
example_1: yo kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā vacīsaṅkhāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo ariyo anāsavo lok'uttaro maggaṅgo.
example_2: taṃ nimittaṃ āsevantena bhāventena bahulīkarontena mettāya vuttanayen'eva tikacatukkajjhānavasena appanā vaḍḍhetabbā.
commentary: (MNa) ek'aggo hutvā ārammaṇe appetī'ti appanā.
notes: The occurrence of appanā the Suttapiṭaka is unusual, the sequence of synonyms normally only occurs in Abhidhamma.

example_1: tesaṃ kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ? upacārasamādhi kusalavīthiyaṃ javitvā bhav'aṅgaṃ otarati, appanāsamādhi divasabhāge appetvā nisinnassa divasabhāgam'pi kusalavīthiyaṃ javati, na bhav'aṅgaṃ otarati. imesu dvīsu samādhīsu nimittapātubhāvena upacārasamādhinā samāhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti.
commentary: (VISM) paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo'ti ādivacanato pana yā parikamm'ānantarā ek'aggatā, ayaṃ appanāsamādhī'ti evaṃ upacārappanāvasena duvidho.

example_1: yāni ca kho tāni sen'āsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi sen'āsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī'ti
example_2: brāhmaṇatissabhaye pana bhātaragāmavāsino nāgattheriyā anārocetvā'va palāyiṃsu. therī paccūsasamaye ativiya appanigghoso gāmo, upadhāretha tāvā'ti daharabhikkhuniyo āha.
commentary: (VINa) appanigghosan'ti nagaranigghosasaddena appanigghosaṃ. (THa) appanigghosan'ti, nissaddaṃ saddasaṅghaṭṭanarahitaṃ.

meaning_1: with little food, drink, or possessions
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
commentary: (ANa) app'annapānabhojane'ti parittaka-annapāna-bhojane.

meaning_1: unthinkable; which cannot be proliferated about; which cannot be conceptualized
example_1: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth'aññaṃ kiñcī'ti, iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti.
commentary: (ANa) appapañcaṃ papañcetī'ti na papañcetabbaṭṭhāne papañcaṃ karoti, anācaritabbaṃ maggaṃ carati.

meaning_1: lacking in wisdom; low in intelligence
example_1: upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ, saṃsāram'āpajja param'parāya, tass'appapañño abhisaddahanto, upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ.
example_2: giriduggacaraṃ chetaṃ, appapaññaṃ acetasaṃ, akāle ovadaṃ bhikkhu, mando'va paṭibhāti maṃ.
commentary: (MNa) tass'appapañño'ti tassa tādisassa appapaññassa añño appapañño abhisaddahanto. (SNa) appapaññan'ti nippaññaṃ.

example_1: catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito'ti vuccati. katamehi catūhi?
commentary: (ANa) papatito'ti patito cuto.

meaning_1: with a small retinue; with a tiny circle
commentary: (MNt) tattha parivārasampattiyā abhāvaṃ dassento appaparivārā'ti āha.

example_1: ajātā nāma pathavī, suddhapāsāṇā suddhasakkharā suddhakaṭhalā suddhamarumbā suddhavālikā appapaṃsukā appamattikā, yebhuyyenapāsāṇā, yebhuyyenasakkharā, yebhuyyenakaṭhalā, yebhuyyenamarumbā, yebhuyyenavālikā.
jātā nāma pathavī, suddhapaṃsu suddhamattikā appapāsāṇā appasakkharā appakaṭhalā appamarumbā appavālikā, yebhuyyenapaṃsukā, yebhuyyenamattikā.
commentary: (VINa) appapāsāṇ'ādīsu appā pāsāṇā etthā'ti appapāsāṇā'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

meaning_1: with little merit; having no spiritual wealth
example_1: lābhī c'amhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appapuññā app'esakkhā na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānan'ti.
commentary: (VINa) appapuññā'ti parittapuññā. (VVa) appapuññā'ti mandabhāgyā apuññā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.

meaning_2: with few men, with few males

meaning_1: of little fruit; yielding negligible results
example_1: brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti.
so catassannaṃ parisānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti parimaṇḍalehi padabyañjanehi appabaddhehi anusayasamugghātāya. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.
viññāṇaṃ pabhaṅgu. yo tassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅ'gamo, idaṃ appabhaṅgū'ti.
commentary: (SNa) pabhaṅgun'ti pabhijjanasabhāvaṃ. evam'idha aniccalakkhaṇam'eva kathitan'ti.

example_1: etha tumhe, āvuso, appabhassā hotha, bhasse pariyantakārino'ti, iti bhassapariyante samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā.
commentary: (ANa) appabhassā'ti appakathā. (ANt) appabhasso'vā'ti parimitakatho'y'eva ek'antena kathetabbass'eva kathanato.

(VINt) appabhikkhuko'ti katipayabhikkhuko. tadā kira bhikkhū yebhuyyena majjhimadese'y'eva vasiṃsu, tasmā tattha katipayā eva ahesuṃ. te ca ekasmiṃ gāme eko, ekasmiṃ nigame dve'ti evaṃ visuṃ visuṃ vasiṃsu.

example_1: sammaggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa appabhītassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
appabhogo mahātaṇho, khattiye jāyate kule, so ca rajjaṃ patthayati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco daliddo hoti appassako appabhogo. evarūpo, bhikkhave, aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati.
commentary: (ANa) appabhogā'ti upabhoga-paribhoga-bhaṇḍaka-rahitā.

meaning_1: fact of having little wealth; poorness
example_1: iti kho, māṇava… app'abhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appabhogattaṃ upaneti, mahābhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahābhogattaṃ upaneti, nīcakulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā nīcakulīnattaṃ upaneti, uccākulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā uccākulīnattaṃ upaneti

meaning_1: leading to being poor; conducive to having little wealth
example_1: app'abhogasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyy'āvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.

meaning_1: not being careless; not being negligent; being vigilant
example_1: ye me pavutte siṭṭhipade, anusikkhanti jhāyino, kāle te appamajjantā, na maccuvasagā siyun'ti.
commentary: (SNa) appamajjantā'ti… appamādaṃ karontā.

meaning_1: immeasurable state of mind; epithet of the four divine dwellings

meaning_1: distributor of insignificant items; who gives out small items; sundries dispenser
example_1: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo

meaning_1: state of attentive understanding; fact of having vigilant wisdom
example_1: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā appamattapaññatā saṃvattantī'ti.

ye rāgadosavinayā, avijjāsamatikkamā, sekkhā apacay'ārāmā, appamatt'ānusikkhare, te namassāmi mātalī'ti.

ajātā nāma pathavī, suddhapāsāṇā suddhasakkharā suddhakaṭhalā suddhamarumbā suddhavālikā appapaṃsukā appamattikā, yebhuyyenapāsāṇā, yebhuyyenasakkharā, yebhuyyenakaṭhalā, yebhuyyenamarumbā, yebhuyyenavālikā.

meaning_1: with immeasurable mind; with unrestricted mind

meaning_1: with immeasurable perception; having limitless awareness

example_1: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.

meaning_1: of immeasurable beauty; epithet of a class of devas
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇasubhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇasubhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
