meaning_1: living a life beyond measure; epithet of an arahant; (comm) living unlimited (by lust etc.)

meaning_1: of immeasurable radiance; epithet of a class of devas
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇ'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇ'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

meaning_lit: section on carefulness with elided repetitions

meaning_1: due to diligence; through heedfulness; by means of alertness
meaning_2: due to diligence; through heedfulness; by alertness

meaning_1: rooted in carefulness; stemming from heedfulness; originating from alertness

meaning_1: delighting in diligence; devoted to conscientiousness; taking pleasure in alertness

meaning_1: converging upon carefulness; coming together in heedfulness; merging in alertness
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.

meaning_lit: not made to be carried back
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, nanu evaṃ sante tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ appāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti? addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ appāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti.

meaning_1: not a being; not a living being
example_1: appāṇe vemitako, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appāṇe appāṇasaññī, anāpatti.

construction:
na > a + pa + √an + a + ka
na + pāṇa + ka
example_1: yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, sace hoti bhutt'āvaseso sace ākaṅkhati bhuñjati, no ce ākaṅkhati appaharite vā chaḍḍeti, appāṇake vā udake opilāpeti
example_2: tena hi tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, taṃ pāyasaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍehi appāṇake vā udake opilāpehī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) appāṇake'ti nippāṇake piṇḍapāt'ajjhottharaṇena maritabbapāṇakarahite vā mahāudakakkhandhe. paritt'odake eva hi bhattapakkhepena āḷulite sukhumapāṇakā maranti, na mahātaḷāk'ādīsū'ti. pāṇak'ānurakkhaṇ'atthañ'hi etaṃ vuttaṃ.

construction:
na > a + pa + √an + a + ka
na + pāṇa + ka
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ appāṇakaṃ'y'eva jhānaṃ jhāyeyyan'ti. so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
commentary: (MNa) appāṇakan'ti nirassāsakaṃ

meaning_1: perceiving (something) as not containing living beings
example_1: sappāṇake appāṇakasaññī tiṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā siñcati vā siñcāpeti vā, anāpatti. appāṇake sappāṇakasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appāṇake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

meaning_1: perceiving (something) as not a being; regarding as not a living being
example_1: appāṇe vemitako, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appāṇe appāṇasaññī, anāpatti.

meaning_1: healthy; seldom sick; free from illness
example_1: ehi tvaṃ, māṇavaka, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ app'ābādhaṃ app'ātaṅkaṃ lah'uṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha
example_2: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.
commentary: (DNa) app'ātaṅko'ti niddukkho.

example_1: etha, tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi bhuñjamānā app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānissatha app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'cā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) appātaṅkatan'ti niddukkhataṃ.

example_1: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto app'ātumo appadukkhavihārī.
commentary: (ANa) app'ātumo'ti ātumā vuccati attabhāvo, tasmiṃ mahante'pi guṇaparittatāya app'ātumo'y'eva.

meaning_1: with few issues; with few considerations
meaning_2: with few matters to be done; with little involvement
example_1: brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti.
ehi tvaṃ, māṇavaka, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ app'ābādhaṃ app'ātaṅkaṃ lah'uṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha
example_2: addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) app'ābādho'ti arogo. (ANa) appābādhānan'ti nirābādhānaṃ.

example_1: etha, tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi bhuñjamānā app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānissatha app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'cā'ti.
example_2: addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) appābādhatan'ti nirābādhataṃ.

example_1: iti kho, māṇava, app'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā app'āyukattaṃ upaneti, dīgh'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā dīgh'āyukattaṃ upaneti, bavh'ābādha-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā bavh'ābādhattaṃ upaneti, app'ābādhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā app'ābādhattaṃ upaneti

meaning_1: leading to being well; conducive to being healthy
example_1: app'ābādhasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, sattānaṃ aviheṭhakajātiko hoti pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā.

meaning_1: with a small income; with little revenue
example_1: sac'āyaṃ kulaputto app'āyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti, tassa bhavanti vattāro, udumbarakhādikaṃ v'āyaṃ kulaputto bhoge khādatī'ti.

meaning_1: to fulfil; to satisfy; to comfort

example_1: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā tena bhotā brahmunā nimmitā, te mayaṃ aniccā addhuvā app'āyukā cavanadhammā itthattaṃ āgatā'ti.

meaning_2: shorter lived; with a shorter lifespan
construction:
appa + āyu + ka + tara
appāyuka + tara
example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīgh'āyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca. ye pana te sattā pacchā upapannā, te app'āyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.

meaning_1: fact of being short-lived; shortness of life
example_1: iti kho, māṇava, app'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā app'āyukattaṃ upaneti, dīgh'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā dīgh'āyukattaṃ upaneti

meaning_1: leading to being short-lived; conducive to a short lifespan
example_1: no ce kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, sace manussattaṃ āgacchati yattha yattha paccājāyati app'āyuko hoti. app'āyuka-saṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, pāṇ'ātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho aday'āpanno pāṇabhūtesu.
commentary: (MNa) app'āyuka-saṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ pāṇ'ātipātī'ti yaṃ idaṃ pāṇ'ātipātakammaṃ, esā app'āyuka-saṃvattanikā paṭipadā'ti. (ANa) app'āyuka-saṃvattaniko'ti tena parittakena kammavipākena app'āyuko hoti, dinnamattāya vā paṭisandhiyā vilīyati mātukucchito nikkhantamatte vā. evarūpo hi na aññassa kassaci nissando, pāṇ'ātipātass'eva gatamaggo eso'ti.

meaning_1: thrown off; tossed off; discharged; scattered
example_1: upasanto uparato, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, appāsi pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto.
commentary: (THa) appāsī'ti adhunā pahāsī'ti attho.

meaning_1: eating little food; taking little to eat
example_1: eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto
commentary: (SNa) app'āhāran'ti bhojane mattaññutāya mit'āhāraṃ, vikālabhojana-paṭikkhepa-vasena vā paritt'āhāraṃ. (ANa) app'āhāro'ti mand'āhāro.

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

meaning_1: with few wishes; wanting little; having few needs; modest
example_1: asaṃsaṭṭhaṃ gahaṭṭhehi, anāgārehi c'ūbhayaṃ, anokasārim'app'icchaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
example_2: app'iccho so, bhikkhu, kulaputto. sante'y'eva attani kusaladhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne.
commentary: (SNa) app'iccho'ti santaguṇaniguhanatā, paccayapaṭiggahaṇe ca mattaññutā, etaṃ appicchalakkhaṇan'ti iminā lakkhaṇena samannāgato.

meaning_1: talk on the fewness of wishes; talk about desiring little; discussion about modesty
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā, attanā ca santuṭṭho santuṭṭhikathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriy'ārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā'ti, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa kathāvatthūni.
commentary: (ANa) appicchakathā'ti app'icchā hothā'ti kathanakathā.

meaning_1: fact of having few wishes; contentment
example_1: tañ'hi tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ app'icchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya subharatāya vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattissati
example_2: app'icchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā, makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukhassa, iti'ssu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) santaguṇanigūhanatā pana paṭiggahaṇe ca mattaññutā app'icchatā nāma, tāya samannāgato puggalo attani vijjamānam'pi guṇaṃ paṭicchādetu'kāmatāya, saddho samāno saddho'ti maṃ jano jānātū'ti na icchati. sīlavā, pavivitto, bahussuto, āraddhavīriyo, samādhisampanno, paññavā, khīṇ'āsavo samāno khīṇ'āsavo'ti maṃ jano jānātū'ti na icchati, seyyathā'pi majjh'antikatthero.

example_1: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha
example_2: cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti āyataṃ vā hotu vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā saṇhaṃ vā.
synonym: ekagghana, ekaghana, gahana, gāḷha, ghana, tibba, thira, bahala, sanda, sahita
commentary: (VINa) appitan'ti ghanaṃ.

meaning_2: done away with; brought to conclusion

meaning_1: with few females; with fewer women
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni app'itthikāni bahupurisāni tāni duppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi
ovadeyy'ānusāseyya, asabbhā ca nivāraye, satañ'hi so piyo hoti, asataṃ hoti appiyo.
example_2: ye ca kho keci kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti tesaṃ appiyo attā

example_1: yañ'hi appiyo appiyassa kareyya, taṃ te attanā'va attano karonti, tasmā tesaṃ appiyo attā.
example_2: sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati no'pi appiyaṃ, tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.
synonym: amitta, ari, diṭṭha, disa, viddesī, sapatta

example_1: evam'eva kho, rājakumāra, yaṃ tathāgato vācaṃ jānāti abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sā ca paresaṃ appiyā amanāpā, na taṃ tathāgato vācaṃ bhāsati.
synonym: akanta, akantiya, amanāpa, amanāpika, amanāpiya, nanikāma, paṭikūla, paṭikkūla, lūkhasa
commentary: (MNa) appiyā amanāpā'ti n'eva piyā na manāpā. iminā nayen'eva sabbattha attho daṭṭhabbo.

example_1: attānañ'ca parañ'ca anupahacca kho pana, bhikkhave, dānaṃ datvā yattha yattha tassa dānassa vipāko nibbattati, aḍḍho ca hoti mahaddhano mahābhogo, na c'assa kutoci bhogānaṃ upaghāto āgacchati aggito vā udakato vā rājato vā corato vā appiyadāy'ādato vā. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca sappurisadānānī'ti.
example_2: hoti so samayo, yaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, tattha na sukaraṃ appadhanena yāpetuṃ, tathāvidhe āgate dubbhikkhe vā me bhavissati. yathārūpā āpadā uppajjanti aggito vā udakato vā appiyadāy'ādato vā, tathārūpāsu vā uppannāsu āpadāsu me bhavissatī'ti'pi puriso nidhiṃ nidhetī'ti.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
example_2: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe sārajjati, appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso.

meaning_1: (singular) a certain; (plural) some; a few; several
example_1: app'ekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app'ekacce yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app'ekacce nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu
example_2: dukkho itthibhāvo, akkhāto purisadammasārathinā, sapattikam'pi hi dukkhaṃ, app'ekaccā sakiṃ vijātāyo.
commentary: (THIa) app'ekaccā sakiṃ vijātāyo'ti ekaccā itthiyo ekavāram'eva vijātā, paṭhamagabbhe vijāyanadukkhaṃ asahantiyo.

meaning_1: but some days; sometimes; on some occasions
example_1: app'ekadā, bho gotama, uḷārāni uḷārāni khādanīyāni khādanti, uḷārāni uḷārāni bhojanāni bhuñjanti, uḷārāni uḷārāni sāyanīyāni sāyanti, uḷārāni uḷārāni pānāni pivanti.
example_2: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā puṇṇiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena app'ekadā tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti app'ekadā nappaṭibhātī'ti?

example_1: tesaṃ pāturahu ñāṇaṃ, amanussāna'dassanaṃ, app'eke satam'addakkhuṃ, sahassaṃ atha sattariṃ.
commentary: (DNa) app'eke satam'addakkhun'ti tesu bhikkhūsu ekacce bhikkhū amanussānaṃ sataṃ addasaṃsu.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsamuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati

meaning_2: applies the mind (to); fixes the mind (on)
example_1: aññe abhiññā appenti, abhiññā vasibhāvitā, vikubbanā vikubbanti, aññen'ekasahassiyo.
commentary: (APAa) appenti samāpajjanti.

meaning_1: to apply; to establish; to fix; to direct

meaning_2: having applied the mind (to); having fixed the mind (on)

meaning_1: of little influence; insignificant; unimportant; (comm) with no retinue
construction: appa + yasas + ka appayasas > appesas + ka
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ñāto hoti yasassī. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti.
example_2: lābhī c'amhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appapuññā app'esakkhā na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) app'esakkhā'ti appaparivārā, purato vā pacchato vā gacchantaṃ na labhanti.

meaning_1: of less influence; more insignificant; less important
meaning_2: of less influence; more insignificant; less important
construction:
appa + yasas + ka + tara
appesakkha + tara
example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīgh'āyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca. ye pana te sattā pacchā upapannā, te app'āyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.

meaning_1: fact of being of little influence
construction:
appa + yasas + ka + tta
appesakkha + tta
example_1: appesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appesakkhattaṃ upaneti, mahesakkhasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahesakkhattaṃ upaneti, app'abhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā appabhogattaṃ upaneti, mahābhogasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahābhogattaṃ upaneti

meaning_1: leading to being of little influence; conducive to being unimportant
example_1: no ce kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, sace manussattaṃ āgacchati yattha yattha paccājāyati appesakkho hoti. appesakkhasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, issāmanako hoti, paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu issati upadussati issaṃ bandhati.

meaning_1: it is likely that; perhaps; maybe; hopefully; if only; please may; it would be good
example_1: so aham'pi gamissāmi, nagaraṃ mithilaṃ pati, app'eva maṃ so bhagavā, sabbadukkhā pamocaye.
example_2: app'eva nāma mayaṃ kadāci karahaci tena bhotā gotamena samāgaccheyyāma? app'eva nāma siyā koci'd'eva kathāsallāpo'ti!

meaning_1: it would be good if; perhaps; hopefully; if only
example_1: app'eva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā'ti.
example_2: app'eva nāma mayam'pi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā'ti. evañ'ca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya, antamaso piṇḍapātamattam'pi, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

meaning_1: it would be good if; perhaps; hopefully; if only
example_1: app'evanām'imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā'ti

meaning_1: little water; small amount of water
example_1: mamāyite passatha phandamāne, macche'va app'odake khīṇasote, etam'pi disvā amamo careyya, bhavesu āsattim'akubbamāno.
example_2: phandamānaṃ pajaṃ disvā, macche app'odake yathā, aññam'aññehi byāruddhe, disvā maṃ bhayam'āvisi.

meaning_2: unconcerned, indifferent; free from care; not being active or exerting oneself

meaning_1: overcome by covetousness and unsuitable greed; overpowered by greed and immoral desire
example_1: katamā ca, gahapati, paññāsampadā? abhijjhā-visamalobh'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.

example_1: idha, cunda, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ abhijjhitā hoti, aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mam'assā'ti.

meaning_1: with direct knowledge; with experiential understanding; with realization

meaning_1: having directly known; having understood experientially

meaning_1: direct knowledge; higher understanding; specialized knowledge

commentary: (DNa) abhiññā'ti abhijānitvā.

example_1: atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ'ca lokaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī'ti
example_2: tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.

meaning_2: scope of higher understanding from meditation

commentary: (APt) abhi visesaṃ jānāti etenā'ti abhiññāṇaṃ.

example_2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ sambahulehi abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ
commentary: (VINa) abhiññātā abhiññātā'ti pākaṭā pākaṭā.

example_2: amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anabhiññātā. amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhiññātā'ti.

example_1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, ayaṃ kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo abhiññātakolañño c'eva abhiññātassa ca brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa antevāsī. agaru kho pana bhagavato evarūpehi kulaputtehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hotī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) abhiññātakolañño'ti pākaṭakulajo. tadā kira jambudīpe ambaṭṭhakulaṃ nāma pākaṭakulam'ahosi. abhiññātassā'ti rūpa-jāti-manta-kulāpadesehi pākaṭassa. (DNt) abhiññātakule jāto abhiññātakolañño.

meaning_1: serving as a basis for higher knowledges; acting as a support for psychic powers

example_1: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti
example_2: ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.
commentary: (ANa) abhiññāyā'ti abhijānitvā.

meaning_1: realizable by oneself through direct knowledge; able to be experienced by direct understanding
example_1: so appamāṇena samādhinā subhāvitena yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
example_2: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, so yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
commentary: (MNa) abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassā'ti abhiññāya sacchikātabbassa.

meaning_1: personally experiencing direct knowledge; intimate experience of higher understanding
example_1: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, so yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya, tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi.

meaning_1: attained perfection and mastery of experiential understanding; (comm) attained arahantship
example_1: idh'udāyi, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī… vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī viharati… citte citt'ānupassī viharati… dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. tatra ca pana me sāvakā bahū abhiññāvosānapāramippattā viharanti.

meaning_1: who has attained perfect understanding; who has completely understood
example_1: pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati, atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññāvosito muni, sabbavositavosānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) abhiññāvosito'ti jānitvā kiccavosānena vosito.

meaning_1: should be understood; should be taken; should be interpreted
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bho gotama, ahu'd'eva kaṅkhā, ahu vicikicchā, kathaṃ nāma samaṇassa gotamassa dhammo abhiññeyyo'ti ?
example_2: eko, āvuso, dhammo bahukāro, eko dhammo bhāvetabbo, eko dhammo pariññeyyo, eko dhammo pahātabbo, eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo, eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo, eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho, eko dhammo uppādetabbo, eko dhammo abhiññeyyo, eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.

meaning_1: deadly sin; heinous crime; great wrong
example_1: catūh'apāyehi ca vippamutto, cha ca-abhiṭhānāni abhabba kātuṃ, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
commentary: (SNPa) abhiṭhānānī'ti oḷārikaṭṭhānāni, tāni esa cha abhabbo kātuṃ. tāni ca aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyyā'ti-ādinā (a. ni. 1.271, ma. ni. 3.128, vibha. 809) nayena ekakanipāte vuttāni mātughāta-pitughāta-arahantaghāta-lohit'uppāda-saṅghabheda-aññasatthār'uddesakammāni veditabbāni. tāni hi kiñ'c'āpi diṭṭhisampanno ariyasāvako kunthakipillikampi jīvitā na voropeti, apica kho pana puthujjanabhāvassa vigarahaṇatthaṃ vuttāni. puthujjano hi adiṭṭhisampannattā evaṃmahāsāvajjāni abhiṭhānāni'pi karoti, dassanasampanno pana abhabbo tāni kātun'ti.
notes: 1. killing one's mother, 2. killing one's father, 3. killing an arahant, 4. intentionally causing the Buddha's blood to be spilled, 5. causing a schism in the community, 6. recognizing any teacher other than the Buddha

example_1: tañ'ce aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā bahūhi cīvarehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, santar'uttaraparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tato cīvaraṃ sāditabbaṃ. tato ce uttari sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: tañ'ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ evaṃ carantaṃ evaṃ viharantaṃ rājāno vā rājamah'āmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā, bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ, ehi, bho purisa, kiṃ te ime kāsāvā anudahanti, kiṃ muṇḍo kapālam'anucarasi, ehi hīnāy'āvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu, puññāni ca karohī'ti.

example_1: upārambhaṃ na sikkheyya, khalitañ'ca na gāhaye, na-abhihare n'ābhimadde, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.
example_2: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno abhiharati abhimaddati anupajagghati khalitaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

commentary: (DNa) so abhiharatī'ti so taṃ sīlaṃ abhiharati, upar'ūpari vaḍḍheti. sīlaṃ me paripuṇṇaṃ, tapo āraddho, alam'ettāvatā'ti na vīriyaṃ vissajjeti.

ujumaggamhi akkhāte, gacchatha mā nivattatha, attanā coday'attānaṃ, nibbānam'abhihāraye.

commentary: (THa) nibbānam'abhihāraye'ti, attānaṃ nibbānaṃ abhihareyya upaneyya, yathā naṃ sacchikaroti, tathā paṭipajjeyyā'ti attho. (SNPa) van'antam'abhihāraye'ti apapañcito gihipapañcena vanaṃ eva gaccheyya.

example_2: tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā rahovādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sasakkaṃ, taṃ rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya.
commentary: (MNa) abhūtavādī'ti yaṃ n'atthi, tassa vattā. (ANa) abhūtavādī'ti bhūtaṃ na vadati, abhūtaṃ vadati nāma.

example_1: ye te, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkh'ājīviṃ ek'aṃsena upakkosati upavadatī'ti, kacci te bhoto gotamassa vuttavādino, na ca bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vād'ānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?
commentary: (DNa) abhūtenā'ti bhūt'atthavirahitena.

example_1: musāvādo, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattaniko. yo sabbalahuso musāvādassa vipāko, manussabhūtassa abhūt'abbhakkhāna-saṃvattaniko hoti.
commentary: (ANa) abhūt'abbhakkhāna-saṃvattaniko hotī'ti abhūtena abbhakkhānaṃ saṃvatteti, yena kenaci kataṃ tass'eva upari patati.

example_1: cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā vikālavisikhācariy'ānuyoge. attā'pi'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, puttadāro'pi'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, sāpateyyaṃ'pi'ssa aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ hoti, saṅkiyo ca hoti pāpakesu ṭhānesu, abhūtavacanañ'ca tasmiṃ rūhati, bahūnañ'ca dukkhadhammānaṃ purakkhato hoti.
abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vā'pi katvā na karomi c'āha, ubho'pi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.
example_2: samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ
commentary: (MNa) abhūtavādī'ti yaṃ n'atthi, tassa vattā. (ANa) abhūtavādī'ti bhūtaṃ na vadati, abhūtaṃ vadati nāma. (ANa) asabhāvaṃ vadatī'ti abhūtavādī.

commentary: (PMa) ariyapuggalānan'ti aṭṭhannaṃ.

meaning_1: who has become noble; who has awakened
example_1: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe āneñjappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ariyappattā viharanti.
commentary: (ANa) ariyappattā'ti puthujjanabhāvaṃ atikkamma ariyabhāvaṃ pattā.

meaning_1: taught by the Noble One; preached by the Buddha
example_1: dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme, sadā ramati paṇḍito.

meaning_1: realm of the noble ones; state of awakening
example_1: so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, dibbaṃ ariyabhūmiṃ upehisi.
commentary: (DHPa) dibbaṃ ariyabhūmin'ti evaṃ vīriyaṃ karonto rāg'ādīnaṃ malānaṃ nīhaṭatāya niddhantamalo aṅgaṇābhāvena anaṅgaṇo nikkileso hutvā pañcavidhaṃ suddh'āvāsabhūmiṃ pāpuṇissasī'ti attho.

meaning_1: what is called the realm of the noble ones
path of the noble ones; path to awakening; noble way
example_1: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo sammādiṭṭhi magg'aṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
example_2: niddā tandī vijambhitā, aratī bhattasammado, etena nappakāsati, ariyamaggo idha pāṇinan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ariyamaggo'ti lok'uttaramaggo.

meaning_1: developing the noble path; cultivating the path to awakening

example_1: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo sammādiṭṭhi magg'aṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.

meaning_1: making friends with noble ones; befriending awakened beings
example_1: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.

meaning_2: noble vehicle; vehicle of the nobles

meaning_1: noble community; (or) community of noble ones
example_1: sugatassa orasānaṃ, puttānaṃ mārasenamathanānaṃ, aṭṭhannam'pi samūhaṃ, sirasā vande ariyasaṅghaṃ.
commentary: (DNt) ariyānaṃ saṅgho'ti ariyasaṅgho, ariyo ca so, saṅgho cā'ti vā ariyasaṅgho, taṃ ariyasaṅghaṃ.

meaning_1: truth of the Buddha; noble truth
example_1: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena sacc'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. etañ'hi, bhikkhu, paramaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yadidaṃ, amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ.
example_2: tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, ariyasaccāna dassanaṃ, nibbānasacchikiriyā ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) ariyasaccānan'ti ariyabhāvakarānaṃ saccānaṃ. (SNa) tasmā ariyasaccānī'ti yasmā tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni, tasmā ariyānaṃ saccānī'ti vuccanti. na hi vitathāni ariyā ariyasaccato paṭivijjhanti. (KHPa) ariyasaccānī'ti ariyāni saccāni, avitathāni avisaṃvādakānī'ti attho.

example_1: avasesā ariyasaccakathā ṭhapetvā jāti-ādīnaṃ padabhājanakathaṃ visuddhimagge vitthāritāy'eva.
tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, ariyasaccānadassanaṃ. nibbānasacchikiriyā ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
commentary: (KHPa) ariyasaccānaṃ dassanaṃ ariyasaccānadassanaṃ, ariyasaccāni dassanan'ti'pi eke, taṃ na sundaraṃ.

meaning_1: disciple of the noble ones; a noble disciple
example_1: kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti
example_2: idha, gahapati, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati
commentary: (ITIa) ariyasāvako'ti ariyassa buddhassa bhagavato sāvako

meaning_lit: discourse on the disciple of the noble ones

example_1: pañcahi, bhikkhave, vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati sār'ādāyinī ca hoti var'ādāyinī ca kāyassa. katamehi pañcahi?

meaning_1: noble in nature; distinguished in character
meaning_2: having the (moral) nature of a noble one, of sublime practice
example_1: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalena sīlena samannāgato
commentary: (MNa) catupārisuddhisīlena sīlavā. taṃ pana sīlaṃ ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ, ten'āha ariyasīlī'ti.

example_1: katamāni dve? ariyasukhañ'ca anariyasukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.
commentary: (ANa) ariyasukhan'ti aputhujjanasukhaṃ.

meaning_1: in the Buddha's training; in the discipline of the noble one
example_1: ruṇṇam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ. ummattakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ. komārakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakahasitaṃ.
example_2: maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati, maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.

meaning_2: practising the traditions of the noble ones, belonging to the noble tradition; who recites the Ariyavaṃsasutta

meaning_1: noble tradition; lineage of noble ones
example_1: yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato, ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito.
commentary: (DNa) ariyavaṃsā'ti ariyānaṃ vaṃsā. yathā hi khattiyavaṃso, brāhmaṇavaṃso, vessavaṃso, suddavaṃso, samaṇavaṃso, kulavaṃso, rājavaṃso, evaṃ ayam'pi aṭṭhamo ariyavaṃso ariyatanti ariyapaveṇī nāma hoti. so kho pan'āyaṃ ariyavaṃso imesaṃ vaṃsānaṃ mūlagandh'ādīnaṃ kāḷ'ānusāritagandh'ādayo viya aggam'akkhāyati. ke pana te ariyā yesaṃ ete vaṃsā'ti? ariyā vuccanti buddhā ca paccekabuddhā ca tathāgatasāvakā ca, etesaṃ ariyānaṃ vaṃsā'ti ariyavaṃsā. ito pubbe hi satasahassakapp'ādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake taṇhaṅ'karo medhaṅ'karo saraṇaṅ'karo dīpaṅ'karo'ti cattāro buddhā uppannā, te ariyā, tesaṃ ariyānaṃ vaṃsā'ti ariyavaṃsā.

meaning_1: way of living of the noble ones; sublime state
meaning_2: way of living of the noble ones; sublime state
example_1: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.
commentary: (DNa) ariyavāsā'ti ariyā eva vasiṃsu vasanti vasissanti etesū'ti ariyavāsā.

example_1: yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pi, ān'āpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti.

meaning_1: of noble conduct; leading a noble life
example_1: tath'eva khantisoraccaṃ, dhammā yasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā, ariyavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, hīnajaccam'pi pūjaye.
example_2: sagāravo sappaṭisso vinīto, apāpako adhisīle visuddho, so mātaraṃ pitarañ'c'āpi jantu, dhammena poseti ariyavutti.
commentary: (VVa) ariyavuttī'ti parisuddhavutti. (JAa) ariyavuttinan'ti ariyācāre vattamānānaṃ.

meaning_1: noble mode of expression; communication with integrity
example_1: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.
commentary: (DNa) ariyavohārā'ti ariyānaṃ sappurisānaṃ vohārā.

grammar: masc gen pl of ariya, irreg form of ariyānaṃ
example_1: paccattaṃ veditabbo hi dhammo, sudesito cakkhumat'ānubuddho, ahañ'hi tumh'eva upāsamāno, sutvāna ariyāna subhāsitāni.
commentary: (DNa) ariyāna subhāsitānī'ti tumhehi vuccamānāni buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ subhāsitāni.

meaning_1: realm of the noble ones; (comm) middle region of India
commentary: (ANa) ariy'āyatane'ti majjhimadese.

example_1: kathañ'ca, visākhe, ariy'uposatho hoti? upakkiliṭṭhassa, visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
commentary: (ANa) ariy'uposatho'ti ariyānaṃ upavasana-uposatho.

meaning_1: insulting a noble person; blaming an arahant
example_1: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkosako paribhāsako ariy'ūpavādo sabrahmacārīnaṃ, ṭhānam'etaṃ avakāso yaṃ so ekādasannaṃ byasanānaṃ aññataraṃ byasanaṃ nigaccheyya.
example_2: bhagavā taṃ turitaturitaṃ āgacchantaṃ disvā'va āvajjento aññāsi, ayaṃ aggasāvake akkositu'kāmo āgato'ti. sakkā nu kho paṭisedhetun'ti ca āvajjento, na sakkā paṭisedhetuṃ, theresu aparajjhitvā kālaṅ'kato ek'aṃsena padumaniraye nibbattissatī'ti disvā, sāriputtamoggallāne'pi nāma garahantaṃ sutvā na nisedhetī'ti vādamocan'atthaṃ ariy'ūpavādassa ca mahāsāvajjabhāva-dassan'atthaṃ mā h'evan'ti tikkhattuṃ paṭisedhesi.

meaning_1: wrong view of insulting a noble person
slandering the noble ones; finding fault with awakened beings
meaning_2: speaking ill of the noble ones, insulting the noble ones
example_1: yaṃ musā bhaṇato pāpaṃ, yaṃ pāpaṃ ariy'ūpavādino, mittadduno ca yaṃ pāpaṃ, yaṃ pāpaṃ akataññuno, tam'eva pāpaṃ phusatu, yo te dubbhe sujampatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ariy'ūpavādino'ti kokalikassa viya pāpaṃ.

meaning_1: Buddha's eight-part path; noble eight-fold path
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc'indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjh'aṅgā, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo
example_2: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.
example_2: passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, duṭṭha-aruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti.

meaning_1: collection of wounds; mass of sores
example_1: passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.

meaning_1: like a mind with a running sore; mentally septic
example_1: aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo, vijj'ūpamacitto puggalo, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo. katamo ca, bhikkhave, aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
commentary: (ANa) aruk'ūpamacitto'ti purāṇavaṇasadisacitto.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.
commentary: (SNa) arugatto'ti vaṇasarīro. tesaṃ'y'eva arūnaṃ pakkattā pakkagatto.

meaning_1: with open sores on the body
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.
commentary: (SNa) arugatto'ti vaṇasarīro. tesaṃ'y'eva arūnaṃ pakkattā pakkagatto.

meaning_1: red light; reddish colour in the sky; rosy-fingered dawn
example_1: tatiyam'pi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante pacchime yāme, uddhaste aruṇe, nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
example_2: sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, aruṇ'uggaṃ. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi.
commentary: (UDa) uddhaste aruṇe'ti uggate aruṇe, aruṇo nāma puratthimadisāya sūriyodayato puretaram'eva uṭṭhitobhāso.

example_1: sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aruṇo nāma rājā pitā ahosi. pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.

meaning_1: name of the royal capital of king Aruṇavā
meaning_2: name of the royal capital of king Aruṇavā
example_1: pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti. aruṇassa rañño aruṇavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
example_2: aruṇavatiyā nagare, ahosiṃ pūpiko tadā, mama dvārena gacchantaṃ, sikhinaṃ addasaṃ jinaṃ.
commentary: (APAa) aruṇavatiyā nagare'ti ā samantato ālokaṃ karonto uṇati uggacchatīti aruṇo, so tasmiṃ vijjatī'ti aruṇavatī, tasmiṃ nagare ālokaṃ karonto sūriyo uggacchatī'ti attho.

example_1: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā ahosi aruṇavā nāma. rañño kho pana, bhikkhave, aruṇavato aruṇavatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.

meaning_2: lets the dawn arise, appear (while doing something); (carries on doing something) until dawn

meaning_1: name of a group of deities
example_1: sukkā karambhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā saha, odātagayhā pāmokkhā, āguṃ devā vicakkhaṇā.
commentary: (DNa) sukkā karambhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā sahā'ti ete sukk'ādayo tayo, tehi saha veghanasā ca āgatā.

meaning_1: first break of day; dawnrise; morning twilight
example_1: sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, aruṇ'uggaṃ. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi.

meaning_2: appearance of the reddish colour before sunrise
example_1: taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ hotī'ti ekādase aruṇ'uggamane nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
example_2: nissaggiyaṃ hotī'ti saha aruṇ'uggamanā nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: with raw sores; with festering wounds
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya. tassa kusakaṇṭakā c'eva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, arupakkāni gattāni vilekheyyuṃ. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso bhiyyosomattāya tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.
rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
example_2: aparā'pi, tisso taṇhā kāmataṇhā rūpataṇhā arūpataṇhā

meaning_1: formless state; formless phenomenon; formless attainment
example_1: rūpehi, bhikkhave, arūpā santatarā'ti, ayam'ek'ānupassanā. arūpehi nirodho santataro'ti, ayaṃ dutiy'ānupassanā.
example_2: ye ca rūpe pariññāya, arūpesu asaṇṭhitā, nirodhe ye vimuccanti, te janā maccuhāyino'ti.

meaning_1: formless aggregate; i.e. feeling, perception, intention, and consciousness
example_1: arūpin'ti ettha pana arūpakasiṇalābhiṃ, arūpakkhandhagocaraṃ vā'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

meaning_1: living in the formless realms; settled in an immaterial state
example_1: ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.
aparā'pi tisso taṇhā, kāmataṇhā, rūpataṇhā, arūpataṇhā.
commentary: (DNa) rūpataṇh'ādīsu rūpabhave chandarāgo rūpataṇhā. arūpabhave chandarāgo arūpataṇhā. ucchedadiṭṭhisahagato rāgo nirodhataṇhā.

example_1: arūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante
example_2: mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito, saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu, n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitaṃ.
commentary: (THa) arūpadhātusū'ti arūpabhavesu.

meaning_1: ripening in the formless realm; bearing fruit in the immaterial world
example_1: arūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

meaning_1: connected with the formless realm; connected with formless meditation
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, sāmiso vimokkho? rūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho sāmiso vimokkho. katamo ca, bhikkhave, nirāmiso vimokkho? arūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho nirāmiso vimokkho.

meaning_1: existence in the formless realm; immaterial being
example_1: kati pan'āvuso, bhavā'ti? tayo'me, āvuso, bhavā, kāmabhavo, rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo'ti.
example_2: arūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante

meaning_2: whose thoughts are like a (tender) sore

meaning_1: passion for immaterial existence; desire for formless existence
example_1: rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
example_2: pañca oram'bhāgiyāni saññojanāni, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo. pañca uddham'bhāgiyāni saññojanāni, rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā.
commentary: (NIDD1a) arūparāgā'ti arūpabhave chandarāgā.

commentary: (SNa) ahārī aparihārī'ti udakaṃ na harati na pariharati, na pariyādiyatī'ti attho. (SNt) bahi vissandanavasena udakaṃ na haratī'ti ahārī, parito na paggharatī'ti aparihārī.

na + hāretvā

corpses of snakes, dogs, and humans

meaning_1: corpse of a snake; dead body of serpent

example_2: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā parisuddhā pariyodātā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā ahikuṇapaṃ vā kukkurakuṇapaṃ vā manussakuṇapaṃ vā racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.

example_1: pupphitakālato paṭṭhāya abbohārikaṃ. allarukkhato pana ahicchattakaṃ gaṇhanto rukkhattacaṃ vikopeti, tasmā tattha pācittiyaṃ. rukkhapappaṭikāya'pi es'eva nayo.
commentary: (PYt) ahiṃ sappaṃ chādetī'ti ahicchattaṃ, taṃ'y'eva ahicchattakaṃ.

example_1: sukarāni asādhūni, attano ahitāni ca, yaṃ ve hitañ'ca sādhuñ'ca, taṃ ve paramadukkaraṃ.
tath'eva tvam'pi ahitahite, samaṃ mettāya bhāvaya, mettāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī'ti.
akusalañ'ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, pahīnaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvatteyya n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahathā'ti.
example_2: atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khanasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

meaning_1: not wishing good; wanting misfortune; wishing ill (for)
example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, araññe pavane mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ. tam'enaṃ mahāmigasaṅgho upanissāya vihareyya. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo.

meaning_1: not compassionate for the welfare of; not concerned for the good of
example_1: na maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, hit'ānukampī evaṃ vadesi, ahit'ānukampī maṃ tvaṃ, pāpima, evaṃ vadesi. tuyhañ'hi, pāpima, evaṃ hoti, yesaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ desessati, te me visayaṃ upātivattissantī'ti.

grammar: nt, dat sg of na hita
construction:
na > a + √dhā + ita + āya
ahita + āya
example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujana-ahitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
example_2: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujana-ahitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

example_1: atha kho milindo rājā khaggaparivārito viya gajo, garuḷaparivārito viya nāgo, ajagaraparivārito viya kotthuko, mahiṃsaparivuto viya accho, nāg'ānubaddho viya maṇḍūko, saddūl'ānubaddho viya migo, ahituṇḍikasamāgato viya pannago, majjārasamāgato viya undūro, bhūtavejjasamāgato viya pisāco… bhīto…
commentary: (APt) ahino tuṇḍena mukhena dibbatī'ti ahituṇḍiko, ṇiko, vāḷaggāho'hituṇḍiko'ti amaramālā.

meaning_1: not defective in any sense; with fully functional faculties

meaning_1: not scorned; not looked down on; not despised

idha bhikkhu ekaccassa evaṃ hoti, ahu vata me, taṃ vata me n'atthi, siyā vata me, taṃ vat'āhaṃ na labhāmī'ti.

meaning_1: state of the dimension of infinite space; element of the base of infinity of space

meaning_1: dimension of nothingness; sphere of emptiness; base of nothingness
example_1: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
example_2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo ākiñcaññ'āyatana-adhimutto assa.

meaning_1: state of the dimension of nothingness; element of the sphere of emptiness
example_1: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

meaning_1: dependent on the dimension of nothingness; based on the sphere of emptiness
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about the dimension of nothingness

meaning_1: connected with the dimension of nothingness; concerned with the base of nothingness
example_1: ākiñcaññ'āyatana-paṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

meaning_1: having the dimension of nothingness as peak; with the sphere of emptiness as apex
example_1: sabbaso vā pana viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. ākiñcaññ'āyatanaparam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato'ti.
commentary: (VISM) upekkhāvihārissa pana, sattā sukhitā vā hontu dukkhato vā vimuccantu, sampattasukhato vā mā vimuccantū'ti ābhogābhāvato sukha-dukkh'ādi-param'attha-gāha-vimukha-bhāvato avijjamānaggahaṇadukkhaṃ cittaṃ hoti. ath'assa param'atthagāhato vimukhabhāvaparicitacittassa param'atthato avijjamāna-ggahaṇa-dukkha-cittassa ca anukkam'ādhigataṃ viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma sabhāvato avijjamāne param'atthabhūtassa viññāṇassa abhāve cittaṃ upasaṃharato appakasiren'eva tattha cittaṃ pakkhandati. iti upekkhā ākiñcaññ'āyatanassa upanissayo hoti, na tato paraṃ, tasmā ākiñcaññāyatanaparamā'ti vuttā'ti.

meaning_1: recognition of dimension of nothingness; perception of dimension of nothingness (in)
example_1: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… ākiñcaññ'āyatane ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatane n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññā vibhūtā hoti

meaning_1: aware of dimension of nothingness; percipient of dimension of nothingness (in)
example_1: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… na ākiñcaññ'āyatane ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaññī assa, na n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatane n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññī assa

meaning_1: beneficial for the dimension of nothingness; supportive for the base of nothingness
example_1: ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ūpagaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā ākiñcaññ'āyatanasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.

meaning_1: attainment of the dimension of nothingness; attainment of the sphere of emptiness
example_1: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino'ti. so tāya ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpattiyā attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
example_2: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayam'pi kho ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

meaning_1: associated with the dimension of nothingness; connected with the sphere of emptiness
example_1: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākiñcaññ'āyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

meaning_1: connection with the dimension of nothingness; concern with the base of nothingness
example_1: evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojane se vante. so evam'assa veditabbo, ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimutto purisapuggalo'ti.

meaning_1: refined and true perception of the dimension of nothingness
example_1: tassa yā purimā viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

meaning_1: with a refined and true perception of the dimension of nothingness
example_1: tassa yā purimā viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

meaning_lit: discourse on the dimension of nothingness

meaning_1: intent on the dimension of nothingness; fixed on the base of nothingness
example_1: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimutto assa. ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī c'eva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañ'ca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañ'ca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati

meaning_1: gone to the dimension of nothingness; epithet of a class of devas
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākiñcaññāyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākiñcaññāyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

meaning_1: rebirth into dimension of nothingness; reappearance in the sphere of emptiness
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, n'āyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāva'd'eva ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ūpapattiyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) yāva'd'eva ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ūpapattiyā'ti yāva saṭṭhi-kappasahass'āyuparimāṇe ākiñcaññ'āyatanabhave upapatti, tāva'd'eva saṃvattati, na tato uddhaṃ.

meaning_2: origin of the state of nothingness

example_1: yaṃnūna mayaṃ yena gosiṅgasālavanadāyo ten'upasaṅkameyyāma. tattha mayaṃ appasaddā app'ākiṇṇā phāsuṃ vihareyyāmā'ti.
example_2: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā bhagavati abhippasannā.

meaning_1: impure in deed; coarse in action
example_1: yv'āyaṃ bhisāni khanati, puṇḍarīkāni bhañjati, evaṃ ākiṇṇakamm'anto, kasmā eso na vuccatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ākiṇṇakamm'anto'ti evaṃ aparisuddhakamm'anto. akhīṇakamm'anto'ti'pi pāṭho, kakkhaḷakamm'anto'ti attho. (JAa) ākiṇṇakamm'anto'ti kakkhaḷakamm'anto dāruṇakamm'anto. (SNt) ākiṇṇakamm'anto'ti taṇhādiṭṭhi-ādivasena akusalakamm'anto diṭṭhimohataṇh'ādivasena ādito paṭṭhāya kusalakammānaṃ paṭikkhepanato. diṭṭhivasena ca kathinakakkhaḷakharigatattā akhīṇakamm'anto kakkhaḷakamm'anto'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: full of people; crowded with people; packed with people; (comm) endless people
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti? evaṃ, bhante, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ākiṇṇamanussā'ti janasamākulā. (SNa) ākiṇṇamanussan'ti nirantaramanussaṃ.

meaning_1: full of supernatural beings; packed with daemons
example_1: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, devānaṃ āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā c'eva hoti phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇayakkhā ca subhikkhā ca, evam'eva kho, ānanda, kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā c'eva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.

synonym: kakkhaḷa, caṇḍa, caṇḍī, rudda, ruddha, ludda, verambha
commentary: (SNa) ākiṇṇaluddo'ti bahupāpo gāḷhapāpo vā, tasmā na vuccati. (JAa) ākiṇṇaluddo'ti gāḷhaluddo. (SNt) ākiṇṇaluddo'ti ākiṇṇo hutvā kakkhaḷo. ten'āha bahupāpo'ti-ādi.

meaning_1: living crowded together; cramped living conditions
example_1: dubbhikkhe kho pana manussā yena subhikkhaṃ tena saṅkamanti. tattha saṅgaṇikavihāro hoti ākiṇṇavihāro. saṅgaṇikavihāre kho pana sati ākiṇṇavihāre na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevituṃ.

meaning_1: stirs up; heaps up; kicks up
example_1: kayirā ce kayirāth'enaṃ, daḷham'enaṃ parakkame, sithilo hi paribbājo, bhiyyo ākirate rajaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) bhiyyo ākirate rajan'ti atirekaṃ upari kilesarajaṃ ākirati. (DHPa) bhiyyo ākirate rajan'ti abbhantare vijjamānaṃ rāgaraj'ādiṃ evarūpo samaṇadhammo apanetuṃ na sakkoti, atha kho tassa upari aparam'pi rāgaraj'ādiṃ ākiratī'ti attho.

example_1: atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ñātidāsiṃ etadavoca, sac'etaṃ, bhagini, chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ, idha me patte ākirā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tahaṃ tahaṃ olokentā piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, ākirante'pi atikkante'pi na jānanti
example_2: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, aññesaṃ dento omasati, aññassa bhājane ākiranto omasati, uttaribhaṅge, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) ākirante'pī'ti piṇḍapātaṃ dente'pi.

example_1: pavanā ābhataṃ paṇṇaṃ, atelañ'ca aloṇikaṃ, mama dvāre ṭhitaṃ disvā, sakaṭāhena ākiriṃ.
commentary: (CPa) sakaṭāhena ākirin'ti iminā attano kiñci'pi asesetvā dinnabhāvaṃ dasseti.

example_1: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpak'antevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya
example_2: santi, bhikkhave, jātarūpassa oḷārikā upakkilesā paṃsuvālukā sakkharakaṭhalā. tam'enaṃ paṃsudhovako vā paṃsudhovak'antevāsī vā doṇiyaṃ ākiritvā dhovati sandhovati niddhovati.

example_1: yo vāruṇī addhano akiñcano, pipāso pivaṃ papāgato, udakam'iva iṇaṃ vigāhati, ākulaṃ kāhiti khippam'attano.

meaning_1: able to take a beating; can be pounded
example_1: evaṃ vutte, bhante, rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ kho te, makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ākoṭṭanakkhamo'ti saviññāṇakassa tāva ākoṭṭanaphalake ṭhapetvā kucchiyaṃ ākoṭitassa kucchi bhijjati, karīsaṃ nikkhamati. sesī ākoṭitassa sīsaṃ bhijjati, mattaluṅgaṃ nikkhamati. aviññāṇako khaṇḍakhaṇḍitaṃ gacchati. tasmā evam'āha.

meaning_1: makes beat; causes to pound; makes pummel
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

example_2: sappaṭibhayaṃ nāma ārāme ārām'ūpacāre corehi manussā hatā dissanti, viluttā dissanti, ākoṭitā dissanti.

meaning_1: pounded back and front; beaten this way and that
example_1: atha kho āyasmā nando bhagavato mātucchāputto ākoṭitapaccākoṭitāni cīvarāni pārupitvā akkhīni añjetvā acchaṃ pattaṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
example_2: upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi, icchām'ahaṃ, samma rattapāṇi, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pīt'āvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rajitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti.

commentary: (MNa) ākoṭeyyā'ti ujukaṃ piṭṭhiyaṃ pahareyya.

meaning_1: having beaten; having pounded; having pummelled
example_1: jivhaṃ baḷisena gahetvā ārajay'ārajayā vihanantī'ti tattha asipattavane vegena dhāvitvā patitānaṃ musāvādīnaṃ nerayikānaṃ nirayapālā jivhaṃ baḷisena nikkaḍḍhitvā yathā manussā allacammaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pattharitvā khilehi ākoṭenti, evaṃ ākoṭetvā pharasūhi phāletvā phāletvā ekam'ekaṃ koṭiṃ chindetvā vihananti, chinnachinnā koṭi punappunaṃ samuṭṭhāti.
atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro, tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno āḷindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
example_2: atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi.
commentary: (MNa) aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesī'ti agganakhena kavāṭe saññaṃ adāsi.

example_1: tesaṃgahaṇena samāsa-taddhit'ākhyāta-kitakānaṃ vibhattipaccayapad'akkhar'āgamā ca lopā honti. vāsiṭṭho, venateyyo
example_2: idha ākhyāte aniddiṭṭhesu sādhanesu kvaci dhātu vibhatti paccayānaṃ dīgha viparīt'ādesa lop'āgama'icc'etāni kāriyāni jinavacan'ānurūpāni kātabbāni.

example_1: iti ākhyātakappe paṭhamo kaṇḍo.
example_2: iti ākhyātakappe catuttho kaṇḍo. ākhyātakappo niṭṭhito.

meaning_1: situated near a place of execution

example_1: ācariyo me bhante hohi āyasmato nissāya vacchāmi
example_2: upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.

example_2: na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti

meaning_1: payment for a teacher; teacher's fee
example_1: imehi nāma, bhante, aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhaṃ āyasmato ānandassa pūjaṃ na karissāmī'ti!

meaning_1: teacher and student; master and apprentice

meaning_2: having brought, having fetched, having produced
example_1: yaṃ hoti kūlapaluggaṃ vā mūsik'ukkaro vā taṃ kājena āharitvā bhājanaṃ karitvā evam'āha, ettha yo icchati taṇḍulapaṭibhastāni vā muggapaṭibhastāni vā kaḷāyapaṭibhastāni vā nikkhipitvā yaṃ icchati taṃ haratū'ti.

meaning_1: fetching; captivating; enticing; (or) accessorized; embellished; enhanced
meaning_2: which has been added to; dependent on accessories
example_1: sākuntiko'va sakuṇiṃ, yathā bandhitum'icchati, āharimena rūpena, na maṃ tvaṃ bādhayissasi.
commentary: (THIa) āharimena rūpenā'ti kesamaṇḍan'ādinā sarīrajagganena c'eva vatth'ābharaṇ'ādinā ca abhisaṅkhārikena rūpena vaṇṇena kittimena cāturiyenā'ti attho.

example_1: sace, hotu, bhante, āhariyissatī'ti bhaṇati, corā vattabbā, manussā idh'ūpacaranti apasakkathā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) tāvatakaṃ āharīyatan'ti tāvatakaṃ āharāpiyatu gaṇhiyatu, yattakaṃ icchatha, tattakaṃ gaṇhathā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: yāguyā paṭisaṃvidite, tassā parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma. bhattena paṭisaṃvidite, tassa parivāro āhariyyati, etaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ nāma.
te mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āhaṃsu, saṃvijjati kho, bho, imesu sattasu rajjesu pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ, tato bhoto yāvatakena attho, tāvatakaṃ āharīyatan'ti.
commentary: (DNa) tāvatakaṃ āharīyatan'ti tāvatakaṃ āharāpiyatu gaṇhiyatu, yattakaṃ icchatha, tattakaṃ gaṇhathā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_2: brings, fetches, conveys; takes, collects; uses
example_1: sac'āyaṃ kumāro tuyhaṃ vā pamādam'anvāya dhātiyā vā pamādam'anvāya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kaṭhalaṃ vā mukhe āhareyya, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?
commentary: (MNa) mukhe āhareyyā'ti mukhe ṭhapeyya.

example_1: na me, āvuso, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamo'sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo. satthaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, āharissāmi, n'āvakaṅkhāmi jīvitan'ti.
sace āyasmato channassa n'atthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā, ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi. mā āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi. yāpet'āyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāmā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) satthaṃ āharesī'ti jīvitahārakaṃ satthaṃ āhari, kaṇṭhanāḷiṃ chindi.
notes: mā satthaṃ āharesi lit. 'don't take the knife', i.e. 'don't commit suicide'.

meaning_1: they said; they told; they spoke
example_1: saccaṃ kir'evam'āhaṃsu, narā ekacciyā idha, kaṭṭhaṃ niplavitaṃ seyyo, na tv'ev'ekacciyo naro'ti.
example_2: bhante, sace ayyā imaṃ temāsaṃ idha vaseyyuṃ, mayaṃ saraṇesu patiṭṭhāya sīlāni gaṇheyyāmā'ti āhaṃsu

example_1: katamo eko dhammo? sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā.
example_2: kāyagutto vacīgutto, āhāre udare yato, saccaṃ karomi niddānaṃ, soraccaṃ me pamocanaṃ.
commentary: (VIN) āhāro nāma udakadantaponaṃ ṭhapetvā yaṃkiñci ajjhoharaṇīyaṃ, eso āhāro nāma. (DNa) āhāraṭṭhitikā'ti paccayaṭṭhitikā.

example_1: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

meaning_1: depletion of food; running out of sustenance; exhaustion of nutrition
example_1: devalokato hi devaputtā āyukkhayena puññakkhayena āhārakkhayena kopenā'ti catūhi kāraṇehi cavanti.

meaning_1: subsisting on food; dependent on fuel
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, pañca nīvaraṇā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
example_2: katamo eko dhammo abhiññeyyo? sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā. ayaṃ eko dhammo abhiññeyyo.
commentary: (SNa) āhāraṭṭhitiko'ti paccayaṭṭhitiko. (ANa) āhāraṭṭhitikā'ti āhārato ṭhiti etesan'ti āhāraṭṭhitikā

example_1: chandaparisuddhi, chand'āharānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chandaparisuddhi-āhāraṇaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? chandaparisuddhi-āhāraṇaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

meaning_1: for food; for the purpose of eating
example_1: yāmakālikaṃ satt'āhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ āhār'atthāya paṭiggaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ajjhohāre ajjhohāre āpatti dukkaṭassa.

meaning_1: ending of sustenance; cessation of fuel
example_1: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.
example_2: tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
commentary: (SNa) tadāhāranirodhā'ti tesaṃ āhārānaṃ nirodhena.

meaning_1: leading to the cessation of sustenance
example_1: siyā, āvuso. yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako āhārañ'ca pajānāti, āhārasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, āhāranirodhañ'ca pajānāti, āhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

meaning_2: with source of nourishment and guide (of craving)
example_1: āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ, tassa nissaraṇaṃ santaṃ, atakk'āvacaraṃ dhuvaṃ.
commentary: (ITIa) catubbidho āhāro ca taṇhāsaṅkhātā netti ca pabhavo samuṭṭhānaṃ etassā'ti āhāranettippabhavaṃ. sabbo'pi vā paccayo āhāro. idha pana taṇhāya nettiggahaṇena gahitattā taṇhāvajjā veditabbā. tasmā āhāro ca netti ca pabhavo etassā'ti āhāranettippabhavaṃ. āhāro eva vā nayan'aṭṭhena pavattan'aṭṭhena nettī'ti evam'pi āhāranettippabhavaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of āhārapaccaya
meaning_1: dependent on food; due to fuel
example_1: yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti sabbaṃ āhārapaccayā
example_2: yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ sambhoti, sabbaṃ āhārapaccayā, āhārānaṃ nirodhena, n'atthi dukkhassa sambhavo.

example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
example_2: tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, ekaṃ'y'eva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.

meaning_1: having the characteristic of food; having the quality of nutriment
example_1: etasmiñ'hi sutte nippariyāyena āhāralakkhaṇā dhammā āhārā'ti vuttā, idha pana pariyāyena paccayo āhāro'ti vutto. sabbadhammānañ'hi paccayo laddhuṃ vaṭṭati.
commentary: (ANt) kabaḷīkār'āhār'ādīnaṃ oj'aṭṭhamakarūp'āharaṇ'ādi nippariyāyena āhārabhāvo. yathā hi kabaḷīkār'āhāro oj'aṭṭhamakarūp'āharaṇena rūpakāyaṃ upatthambhenti, evaṃ phass'ādayo vedan'ādi-āharaṇena nāmakāyaṃ upatthambheti, tasmā sati'pi janakabhāve upatthambhakabhāvo oj'ādīsu sātisayo labbhamāno mukhyo āhār'aṭṭho'ti te eva nippariyāyena āhāralakkhaṇā dhammā vuttā

meaning_1: arising of food; source of sustenance
example_1: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.
example_2: ko ca, bhikkhave, kāyassa samudayo? āhārasamudayā kāyassa samudayo, āhāranirodhā kāyassa atthaṅ'gamo.
commentary: (SNa) āhārasamudayā kāyassa samudayo'ti āhārasamudayena kāyasamudayo.

meaning_1: (what is) produced by food; generated by sustenance; come into being because of fuel
example_1: tadāhārasambhavan'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati. tadāhārasambhavan'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āhārasambhavassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.

meaning_1: produced by food; proceeding from food
example_1: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya āhāro pahātabbo. taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbā.
commentary: (ANa) āhārasambhūto'ti āhārena sambhūto āhāraṃ nissāya vaḍḍhito.

meaning_2: Chapter 2 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

example_1: ūn'ūdaro yo sahate jighacchaṃ, danto tapassī mitapānabhojano, āhārahetu na karoti pāpaṃ, taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇam'āhu loke.
commentary: (JAa) āhārahetū'ti atijighacchapiḷito'pi yo pāpaṃ lāmakakammaṃ na karoti dhammasenāpati-sāriputtatthero viya. ahaṃ panajja āhārahetu pāpaṃ na karomi, tasmā mam'eva sīlaṃ mahantan'ti.

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu adinnaṃ mukhadvāraṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya aññatra udakadantaponā, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya

example_1: aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgataṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo āhāraṃ āhāreti, n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya
example_2: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.

example_1: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, ekaṃ'y'eva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhāritā. siyā kho pana te, sāriputta, evam'assa, mahā nūna tena samayena kolo ahosī'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, sāriputta, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. tadā'pi etaparamo'y'eva kolo ahosi seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi.

meaning_1: cutting off food; stopping eating; starvation
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sabbaso āhār'upacchedāya paṭipajjeyyan'ti.

commentary: (VINa) āhār'ūpahāro'ti āhāro ca upahāro ca gahaṇañ'ca dānañ'ca, na amhehi kiñci āhaṭaṃ na upāhaṭaṃ tayā saddhiṃ kayavikkayo vohāro amhākaṃ n'atthī'ti dīpenti.

meaning_1: recognition of the unpleasantness of food; perception of the repulsiveness of food
example_1: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
example_2: āhāre paṭikūlasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
commentary: (SNa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññā'ti odanakummās'ādimhi ajjhoharaṇīye paṭikūlasaññā. (ANa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññaṃ bhāvetī'ti asitapīt'ādi-bhede kabaḷīkāre āhāre gamanapaṭikūl'ādīni nava paṭikūlāni paccavekkhantassa uppajjanakasaññaṃ bhāveti, uppādeti vaḍḍhetī'ti attho. tassā'pi bhāvanānayo visuddhimagge vitthārito'y'eva.

meaning_1: recognizing the unpleasantness of food; perceiving the repulsiveness of food
example_1: etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.
commentary: (MNa) āhāre paṭikūlasaññī'ti navannaṃ pāṭikulyānaṃ vasena kabaḷīkār'āhāre paṭikūlasaññī.

example_1: byañjanaṃ kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atināmeti.
example_2: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.

example_1: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā, balaṃ gahetvā, vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.

meaning_1: recognition of the unpleasantness of food; perception of the repulsiveness of food
example_1: katame nava dhammā uppādetabbā? nava saññā, asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke-anabhiratisaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā. ime nava dhammā uppādetabbā.
commentary: (DNa) āhārepaṭikūlasaññā'ti āhāraṃ pariggaṇhantassa uppannasaññā.

meaning_lit: discourse on the repulsiveness of food

example_1: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
example_2: yato kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ, atha me te pañca bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu, bāhulliko samaṇo gotamo, padhānavibbhanto, āvatto bāhullāyā'ti.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihāre āhiṇḍanti, abhikkamath'āyasmanto, abhikkamath'āyasmanto! idān'āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatī'ti.
example_2: evaṃ, tātā'ti kho te dārakā tassa vuḍḍhapabbajitassa paṭissuṇitvā khurabhaṇḍaṃ ādāya nāḷiyāvāpakena anugharakaṃ anugharakaṃ āhiṇḍanti, loṇam'pi, telam'pi, taṇḍulam'pi, khādanīyam'pi saṃharantā.
commentary: (NIDD1a) āhiṇḍantī'ti tattha tattha vicaranti.

example_1: evaṃ, devā'ti kho so puriso rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭissutvā kevalakappaṃ toraṇavatthuṃ āhiṇḍanto n'āddasa tathārūpaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā yaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo payirupāseyya.
example_2: evaṃ, ācariyā'ti kho jīvako komārabhacco tassa vejjassa paṭissutvā khaṇittiṃ ādāya takkasilāya samantā yojanaṃ āhiṇḍanto na kiñci abhesajjaṃ addasa.

meaning_1: stocked up; heaped up; provided with fuel
example_1: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
tiṭṭhaṃ caraṃ nisinno vā, sayāno yāvatāssa vigatamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāram'idha'm'āhu.
example_2: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.
commentary: (SNa) āhū'ti kathenti.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena aggikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa nivesane aggi pajjalito hoti āhuti paggahitā.
commentary: (SNPa) āhutī'ti aggihomakammaṃ.

meaning_1: smell of an oblation; whiff of a sacrifice
example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma brāhmaṇā āhutigandhena dhāvanti, ettha bhuñjissāma, ettha bhuñjissāmā'ti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, santi tiracchānagatā pāṇā gūthabhakkhā, te dūrato'va gūthagandhaṃ ghāyitvā dhāvanti, ettha bhuñjissāma, ettha bhuñjissāmā'ti.
āhuneyyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu? bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro'ti.
example_2: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
commentary: (MNa) āhuneyyassā'ti āhutiṃ paṭiggahetuṃ yuttassa.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tatth'eva rājagahe vassaṃ vasi, tattha hemantaṃ, tattha gimhaṃ. manussā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, āhundarikā samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ disā andhakārā, na imesaṃ disā pakkhāyantī'ti.
commentary: (VINa) āhundarikā'ti sambādhā. (VISMa) āhundarikan'ti samantato, upari ca ghanasañchannaṃ sambādh'aṭṭhānaṃ.
notes: perhaps related to Sanskrit √huṇḍ to collect, accumulate?

meaning_2: open, unenclosed; or crowded (like Āḷakamandā); (also ālakamanda)

meaning_1: name of a heavenly capital city
example_1: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, devānaṃ āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā c'eva hoti phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇayakkhā ca subhikkhā ca, evam'eva kho, ānanda, kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā c'eva ahosi phītā ca bahujanā ca ākiṇṇamanussā ca subhikkhā ca.
commentary: (DNa) āḷakamandā'ti aparam'pi āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī.

example_1: atha kho hatthako āḷavako jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasa bhagavantaṃ gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare nisinnaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) hatthako āḷavako'ti hatthato hatthaṃ gatattā evaṃladdhanāmo āḷavako rājaputto.

example_1: atha kho māro pāpimā āḷavikāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo vivekamhā cāvetu'kāmo yena āḷavikā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āḷavikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi

example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti? evaṃ, bhante, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) iddhā'ti samiddhā (SNa) iddhan'ti telamadhuphāṇit'ādīhi samiddhaṃ.

example_1: atha kho cittassa gahapatino etadahosi, yo kho imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako bhikkhu tass'āyaṃ evarūpo iddh'ānubhāvo'ti.
evañ'hi te, bhikkhave, paṭhamā migajātā na parimucciṃsu nevāpikassa iddh'ānubhāvā.
commentary: (MNa) iddh'ānubhāvā'ti yathākāmaṃ kattabbabhāvato, vasībhāvo'y'eva hi ettha iddhī'ti ca ānubhāvo'ti ca adhippeto.

meaning_1: performance of supernormal ability; display of psychic power
example_1: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kos'ohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
example_2: atha kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsiṃ, ettāvatā brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca saddañ'ca me sossanti, na ca maṃ dakkhantī'ti. antarahito imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsiṃ.
commentary: (SNa) iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharī'ti adhiṭṭhān'iddhiṃ akāsi.

meaning_1: psychic power; psychic potency; supernormal ability
example_1: haṃs'ādiccapathe yanti, ākāse yanti iddhiyā, nīyanti dhīrā lokamhā, jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ.
example_2: mama saṅkappam'aññāya, satthā loke anuttaro, manomayena kāyena, iddhiyā upasaṅkami.

example_1: rājā, ānanda, mahāsudassano sattahi ratanehi samannāgato ahosi catūhi ca iddhīhi.
āmis'iddhi ca dhamm'iddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve iddhiyo. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ iddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ dhamm'iddhī'ti.

commentary: (DNa) iddhinimmitam'ivā'ti iddhimatā iddhiyā tathā nimmitaṃ iva.

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, iddhipādo? yo so, bhikkhave, maggo yā paṭipadā iddhilābhāya iddhipaṭilābhāya saṃvattati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, iddhipādo.
commentary: (PMa) iddhipaṭilābhāyā'ti parihīnānaṃ vā iddhīnaṃ vīriy'ārambhavasena puna lābhāya, upasaggavasena vā padaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ. (VISMa) iddhipaṭilābhāyā'ti iddhiyā punappunaṃ labhamānāya, bahulīkaraṇāyā'ti attho.

meaning_1: attained psychic power; possessing supernormal ability
example_1: tevijjā iddhipattā ca, cetopariyāyakovidā, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, bahū buddhassa sāvakā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) iddhipattā'ti iddhividhañāṇaṃ pattā.

meaning_1: partial psychic power; limited supernormal ability; (comm) three paths and fruits
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā iddhipadesaṃ abhinipphādessanti sabbe te catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā.
commentary: (SNa) piddhipadesan'ti tayo ca magge tīṇi ca phalāni. (SNt) iddhipadesan'ti iddhiyā ekadesaṃ. ko pana so'ti āha, tayo ca magge tīṇi ca phalānī'ti.

meaning_2: mastery of or possession of supernormal power
example_1: ime kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro iddhipādā paññattā iddhipahutāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivikubbanatāya.
commentary: (DNa) iddhipahutāyā'ti iddhipahonakatāya.

meaning_1: miracle of psychic power; wonder of supernormal ability
example_1: imaṃ kho ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, iddhipāṭihāriye ādīnavaṃ sampassamāno iddhipāṭihāriyena aṭṭīyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi
example_2: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahakaṃ etadavoca, sādhu me, bhante, ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetū'ti.
commentary: (ANa) iddhipāṭihāriyan'ti ijjhanavasena iddhi, paṭiharaṇavasena pāṭihāriyaṃ, iddhi'y'eva pāṭihāriyaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ.

meaning_1: discussion about the miracle of psychic power
basis for success; road to power; basis for spiritual power
example_1: cittasmiṃ vasībhūt'āmhi, iddhipādā subhāvitā, sabbabandhanamutt'āmhi, na taṃ bhāyāmi āvuso'ti.
example_2: yassa kassaci, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā
commentary: (DNa) iddhipādā'ti ettha ijjhan'aṭṭhena iddhi, patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena pādā'ti veditabbā.

example_1: pubb'eva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato etadahosi, ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo iddhipādabhāvanāyā'ti?

meaning_1: leading to the development of psychic power
example_1: iddhiṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi iddhipādañ'ca iddhipādabhāvanañ'ca iddhipādabhāvanāgāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

meaning_lit: connected with the basis for success
discourse on the basis for spiritual power
discourse on the basis for spiritual power

example_1: yo vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, saṃvejesi ca devatā.
example_2: yattha eke vihaññanti, āruhantā siluccayaṃ, tassa buddhassa dāy'ādo, sampajāno patissato, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, kassapo abhirūhati.
commentary: (PM) katamāni dasa iddhibalāni? adhiṭṭhānā iddhi, vikubbanā iddhi, manomayā iddhi, ñāṇavipphārā iddhi, samādhivipphārā iddhi, ariyā iddhi, kammavipākajā iddhi, puññavato iddhi, vijjāmayā iddhi, tattha tattha sammā payogappaccayā ijjhan'aṭṭhena iddhi, imāni dasa iddhibalāni.

meaning_1: supported by psychic power; helped by psychic ability
example_1: yo vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, saṃvejesi ca devatā.
example_2: yattha eke vihaññanti, āruhantā siluccayaṃ, tassa buddhassa dāy'ādo, sampajāno patissato, iddhibalen'upatthaddho, kassapo abhirūhati.
commentary: (THa) iddhibalen'upatthaddho'ti iminā sarīrakhedābhāvaṃ.

meaning_1: who has psychic powers; possessing supernormal ability
example_1: mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno. te dūrato'pi passanti, āsannā'pi na dissanti, cetasā'pi cittaṃ pajānanti.
example_2: bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅ'gamo.
commentary: (ANa) iddhimā cetovasippatto'ti iddhisampanno cittassa vasibhāvapatto khīṇ'āsavo.

meaning_1: truly they are supernormal!; they must have psychic powers!
example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, saṭhāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā ketabino, iddhimantāssunām'ime tatiyā migajātā parajanā, imañ'ca nāma nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ paribhuñjanti, na ca nesaṃ jānāma āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā.
devatā'pi kho santi iddhimantiniyo dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduniyo. tā dūrato'pi passanti, āsannā'pi na dissanti, cetasā'pi cittaṃ jānanti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ iddhimantīnaṃ yadidaṃ uppalavaṇṇā.
commentary: (NIDD1a) devatā'pi kho santi iddhimantiniyo'ti devatā'pi evaṃ saṃvijjanti ijjhanapabhāvavantiniyo.

grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of iddhi
example_1: haṃs'ādiccapathe yanti, ākāse yanti iddhiyā, nīyanti dhīrā lokamhā, jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ.

commentary: (PMa) iddhilābhāyā'ti attano santāne pātubhāvavasena iddhīnaṃ lābhāya. (VISMa) iddhilābhāyā'ti iddhiyā adhigamāya.
