commentary: (DNa) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti iddhivikubbanabhāvāya, nānappakārato katvā dassan'atthāya. (PMa) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti iddhiyā vividhakaraṇabhāvāya. (DNt) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti vikubban'iddhiyā vividharūpakaraṇāya. ten'āha nānappakārato katvā dassan'atthāyā'ti. (VISMa) iddhivikubbanatāyā'ti iddhiyā vividharūpakāraṇāya, vikubban'iddhiyā'ti attho.

example_1: so tathābhāvitena cittena parisuddhena pariyodātena iddhividhañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti.
commentary: (PMa) iddhividhañāṇāyā'ti iddhikoṭṭhāse, iddhivikappe vā ñāṇ'atthāya.

meaning_1: teaching about the types of supernormal ability

meaning_lit: discourse on the various kinds of psychic power

meaning_1: kinds of psychic power; types of supernormal ability
example_1: so sace ākaṅkhati, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, eko'pi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhā'pi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ
ime kho, bho, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro iddhipādā paññattā iddhipahutāya iddhivisavitāya iddhivikubbanatāya.
commentary: (DNa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhivipajjanabhāvāya, punappunaṃ āsevanavasena ciṇṇavasitāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (PMa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti vividhaṃ visesaṃ savati janeti pavattetī'ti visavī, vividhaṃ savanaṃ vā assa atthī'ti visavī, tassa bhāvo visavitā. tassā visavitāya, iddhiyā vividha-visesa-pavattana-bhāvāyā'ti attho. (DNt) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhiyā nipphādane yogyabhāvāya. anek'atthattā hi dhātūnaṃ yogyattho vi-pubbo su-saddo, visavanaṃ vā pajjanaṃ visavitā, tattha kāmakāritā visavitā. (VISMa) iddhivisavitāyā'ti iddhiyā vividhānisaṃsapasavanāya.

meaning_1: what here?; what then?; here then
example_1: idha no, āvuso, ko viseso, ko adhippayāso, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin'ti?
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto app'ātumo appadukkhavihārī.

meaning_1: here or there; (comm) in this world or the next
example_1: appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
example_2: yass'ūbhay'ante paṇidh'īdha n'atthi, bhav'ābhavāya idha vā huraṃ vā, nivesanā tassa na santi keci, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) idha vā huraṃ vā'ti idhaloke vā paraloke vā.

meaning_2: here, in this world or existence
example_1: idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.
example_2: na hi verena verāni, sammant'īdha kudācanaṃ, averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano.
commentary: (THa) idhā'ti imasmiṃ loke attabhāve vā.

meaning_1: here; in this regard; in this case
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

meaning_1: (comm) in this teaching; here in this doctrine
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na rūpaññū hoti, na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti, na āsāṭikaṃ hāretā hoti, na vaṇaṃ paṭicchādetā hoti, na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti
commentary: (ANa) idhā'ti imasmiṃ sāsane.

example_1: veditvā so sucaritassa phalaṃ, uṇhīsasīsattam'idh'ajjhagamā, byākaṃsu byañjananimittadharā, pubbaṅ'gamo bahujanaṃ hessati.
yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, taṃ te dhammaṃ idh'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) taṃ te dhammaṃ idh'aññāyā'ti te therā taṃ dhammaṃ idha tumhākaṃ sāsane jānitvā.

meaning_1: here there are; here there is
example_1: vedāni viceyya kevalāni, samaṇānaṃ yān'idh'atthi brāhmaṇānaṃ, sabbavedanāsu vītarāgo, sabbaṃ vedam'aticca vedagū so.
example_2: na mānakāmassa damo idh'atthi, na monam'atthi asamāhitassa, eko araññe viharaṃ pamatto, na maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran'ti.

example_1: etth'ete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhā'pi byāpādā'pi sārambhā'pi saṃvattanti. t'eva ariyasāvakassa idha'm'anusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti.
commentary: (MNa) idham'anusikkhato'ti imasmiṃ sāsane sikkhantassa te tayo'pi kilesā antarāyakarā honti.

example_1: idhalokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, paralokam'pi nissāya jhāyati, yam'p'idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'pi nissāya jhāyati. evaṃ kho, sandha, purisakhaḷuṅkajhāyitaṃ hoti.
example_2: catūhi kho, visākhe, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti. katamehi catūhi?

meaning_1: thoughts about this world; speculation about the present life
example_1: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu idhalokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paralokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na idhalokaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me idhalokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: recognition of this world; perception of this world (in); concept of the present life
example_1: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… idhaloke idhalokasaññā vibhūtā hoti, paraloke paralokasaññā vibhūtā hoti, yam'p'idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tatrā'pi saññā vibhūtā hoti.

meaning_1: aware of this world; percipient of this world (in)
example_1: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭil… na n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatane n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññī assa, na idhaloke idhalokasaññī assa, na paraloke paralokasaññī assa, saññī ca pana assā'ti?

meaning_1: here could be; there might be
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, idh'assa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭ'āgāraṃ ullitt'āvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phusit'aggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
commentary: (ANa) idhassā'ti imasmiṃ loke assa.

meaning_1: suppose there were; imagine there was
example_1: sakkā, bhikkhave'ti bhagavā avoca. idh'assu, bhikkhave, cattāro sāvakā vassasat'āyukā vassasatajīvino. te divase divase kappasatasahassaṃ kappasatasahassaṃ anussareyyuṃ.
commentary: (ANa) idh'assū'ti idha bhaveyyuṃ.

example_1: sataṃ sahassāni'pi dhuttakānaṃ, idh'āgatā tādisakā bhaveyyuṃ, lomaṃ na iñjāmi na santasāmi, na māra bhāyāmi tam'ekikā'pi.
etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya. nisīdatu, bhante, bhagavā, idaṃ āsanaṃ paññattan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) yadidaṃ idhāgamanāyā'ti yo ayaṃ idh'āgamanāya vāro, taṃ, bhante, cirassam'akāsī''ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.
commentary: (JAa) idh'āgamā'ti, tāta, imaṃ assamapadaṃ āgato.

meaning_1: possesses here; achieves here; attains here
example_1: satta c'ussade idh'ādhigacchati, hatthapādamudutañ'ca vindati, āhu byañjananimittakovidā, khajjabhojjarasalābhitāya naṃ.
example_2: tasmā hi paññā'va dhanena seyyā, yāya vosānam'idh'ādhigacchati, abyositattā hi bhav'ābhavesu, pāpāni kammāni karoti mohā.
commentary: (THa) tasmā hi paññā'va dhanena seyyā, yāya vosānam'idh'ādhigacchatī'ti paññā'va dhanato pāsaṃsatarā, yāya paññāya vosānaṃ bhavassa pariyosānabhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ adhigacchati.

meaning_1: here Ānanda; in this regard Ānanda
example_1: idh'ānanda, bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti.
example_2: idh'ānanda bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
commentary: (ANa) idh'ānanda, bhikkhuno'ti, ānanda, imasmiṃ sāsane bhikkhuno.

example_1: yatv'āhaṃ, āvuso, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, n'ābhijānāmi aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisituṃ, aññatra tena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena.
commentary: (SNa) aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisitun'ti ṭhapetvā bhagavantaṃ aññaṃ mayhaṃ satthā'ti evaṃ uddisituṃ na jānāmi.

example_1: yaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho

meaning_1: having seen; having paid a visit (to)
example_1: labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti
example_2: yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti, udāhu vippalapan'tass'eva coraghātā sīsaṃ chindeyyun'ti?

example_1: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya

meaning_1: in the name of; on account of; for the sake of; especially for
meaning_2: with reference to, on account of, for
example_1: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa vā gahapatāniyā vā cīvaracetāpannaṃ upakkhaṭaṃ hoti, iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthan'nāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī'ti
example_2: tena kho pana samayena pukkusāti nāma kulaputto bhagavantaṃ uddissa saddhāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.8) bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissā'ti bhikkhuss'atthāya, bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā, bhikkhuṃ acchādetu'kāmo. (VINa) ettha uddissā'ti apadissa ārabbha. yasmā pana yaṃ uddissa upakkhaṭaṃ hoti, taṃ tass'atthāya upakkhaṭaṃ nāma hoti.

meaning_1: specially prepared food; meal made on purpose
example_1: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakaṭaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.
commentary: (DNa) uddissakatan'ti imaṃ tumhe uddissa katan'ti evaṃ ārocitabhikkhaṃ.

meaning_1: specially prepared food; meal made on purpose
example_1: seyyath'idaṃ, nando vaccho, kiso saṃkicco, makkhali gosālo, etehi, bho gotama, acelakā mutt'ācārā hatth'āpalekhanā naehibhaddantikā natiṭṭhabhaddantikā na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti
commentary: (DNa) uddissakatan'ti imaṃ tumhe uddissa katan'ti evaṃ ārocitabhikkhaṃ.

meaning_1: is appointed; is assigned; is designated (from)
example_1: ettakā me bhikkhū saṅghato uddissathā'ti dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ chaṭṭhī saṅghagatā dakkhiṇā. ettakā me bhikkhuniyo saṅghato uddissathā'ti dānaṃ deti, ayaṃ sattamī saṅghagatā dakkhiṇā.

yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti.
commentary: (VINa) uddissamāne'ti uddisiyamāne.

meaning_1: brought in the name of; brought especially for
meaning_2: brought in the name of; brought especially for
example_1: idaṃ, deva, pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ devaññ'eva uddiss'ābhataṃ, taṃ devo paṭiggaṇhātū'ti.

meaning_1: small water bucket; little pail (for drawing water from a well)
meaning_2: small pot or ladle for drawing water
example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma udakamaṇiko hutvā uddekaniko assa, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ bhoto udāyissa bhavissati. mā bhavaṃ, udāyi, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ cari, mā bhavaṃ, udāyi, ācariyo hutvā antevāsīvāsaṃ vasī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) udañcaniko'ti udakavārako. (MNt) udañcaniko'ti udañcano.

meaning_1: proposition; synopsis; statement in brief; summary; introduction
example_1: yaṃ kho no, āvuso, bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
example_2: ataramāno'va bhāseyya, no taramāno. janapadaniruttiṃ n'ābhiniveseyya, samaññaṃ n'ātidhāveyyā'ti, ayam'uddeso araṇavibhaṅgassa.
commentary: (MNa) uddesan'ti mātikaṃ

example_1: sādhikam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha attakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.
example_2: etāni pañca kammāni, chand'āharaṇ'ādīni pātimokkh'uddesato paṭhamaṃ kattabbatā, uposathassa uposathakammassa pubbakiccan'ti vuccati. pubbakiccānī'ti akkhātāni.

example_1: yehi, ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho rūpakāye adhivacanasamphasso paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
commentary: (DNa) tathā tathā uddisitabbato uddesā.

example_1: bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, uddesā no cāvetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. yo eva vo uddeso so eva vo uddeso hotu.
commentary: (DNa) uddesā no cāvetu'kāmo'ti attano anusāsaniṃ gāhāpetvā amhe amhākaṃ uddesato cāvetu'kāmo.

example_1: so samaṇ'uddeso bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
example_2: ajja't'agge te, āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa na c'eva so bhagavā satthā apadisitabbo

example_1: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
example_2: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.6) att'uddesan'ti attano atthāya. (VINa) att'uddesan'ti, mayhaṃ esā'ti evaṃ attā uddeso assā'ti att'uddesā, taṃ att'uddesaṃ.

grammar: masc, agent, in comps, from uddisati
example_1: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo
commentary: (ANa) bhatt'uddesako'ti salākabhatt'ādīnaṃ uddesako.

meaning_1: ?? careful attention to the recitation and questioning; (or) recitation, questioning and paying proper attention
example_1: sā sutvā mā tumhe tesaṃ gatabhāvaṃ cintayittha, attano uddesa-paripucchā-yonisomanasikāresu'y'eva yogaṃ karothā'ti vatvā bhikkhācāravelāyaṃ pārupitvā attadvādasamā gāmadvāre nigrodhamūle aṭṭhāsi.

meaning_1: included in the Pātimokkha recitation; contained in the Pātimokkha chanting
example_1: bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
commentary: (VIN 1.2.12) uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesū'ti pātimokkhapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu. (VINa) uddesapariyāpannesū'ti uddese pariyāpannesu antogadhesu. yassa siyā āpatti, so āvikareyyā'ti evaṃ saṅgahitattā anto pātimokkhassa vattamānesū'ti attho.

meaning_2: food specially prepared for a specific number of persons

meaning_1: detailed analysis of a brief statement; summary and exposition
example_1: bhagavā etadavoca, uddesavibhaṅgaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) uddesavibhaṅgan'ti uddesañ'ca vibhaṅgañ'ca, mātikañ'ca vibhajanañ'cā'ti attho.

meaning_lit: discourse with detailed analysis of a brief statement

meaning_1: synonym for the recitation of precepts
commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: comes up for recitation; arrives for chanting
example_1: ime kho pan'āyasmanto terasa saṅgh'ādisesā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
example_2: sādhikam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, diyaḍḍhasikkhāpadasataṃ anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchati yattha attakāmā kulaputtā sikkhanti.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?
commentary: (MNa) pannarasavass'uddesikā'ti pannarasavassavayā.

meaning_1: referring to; meant for; intended for; appointed to
example_1: yassa nūna, ānanda, evam'assa, ahaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmī'ti vā, mam'uddesiko bhikkhusaṅgho'ti vā, so nūna, ānanda, bhikkhusaṅghaṃ ārabbha kiñci'd'eva udāhareyya.
commentary: (SNa) mam'uddesiko'ti ahaṃ uddisitabb'aṭṭhena uddeso assā'ti mam'uddesiko, mam'eva uddissitvā maṃ paccāsīsamāno bhikkhusaṅgho hotu mama accayena mā vā ahosi, yaṃ vā taṃ vā hotū'ti iti vā pana yassa assā'ti attho.

example_1: okāsaṃ me bhante thero detu pāṭimokkhaṃ uddesituṃ.

so tattha pheṇ'uddehakaṃ paccati. so tattha pheṇ'uddehakaṃ paccamāno sakim'pi uddhaṃ gacchati, sakim'pi adho gacchati, sakim'pi tiriyaṃ gacchati. so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
commentary: (ANa) pheṇ'uddehakan'ti pheṇaṃ uddehitvā, ussādetvā'ti attho.

example_1: dasa'y'imāni, bhikkhave, saṃyojanāni. katamāni dasa? pañc'oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
example_2: uddh'aggalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, uddh'aggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍal'āvaṭṭāni dakkhiṇ'āvaṭṭakajātāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

meaning_1: going upwards; headed in a good direction
example_1: taṃ idh'eva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti siṅgālā vā khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti, yañ'ca khv'assa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ… taṃ uddhagāmi hoti visesagāmi.

meaning_1: with raised tips; having pointed-up ends; with erect points
meaning_2: with the tips turned upwards, prominent, beneficial
example_1: uddh'aggalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, uddh'aggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍal'āvaṭṭāni dakkhiṇ'āvaṭṭakajātāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

meaning_1: having body hair with raised tips; having body-hair with pointed-up ends; fourteenth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
example_1: uddh'aggalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, uddh'aggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjanavaṇṇāni kuṇḍal'āvaṭṭāni dakkhiṇ'āvaṭṭakajātāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
commentary: (MNa) uddh'aggalomo'ti āvaṭṭapariyosāne uddh'aggāni hutvā mukhasobhaṃ ullokayamānāni viya ṭhitāni lomāni assā'ti uddh'aggalomo.

meaning_2: resulting in a lofty end; promoting spiritual welfare; lit. relating to upper point
example_1: samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddh'aggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhapenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. sakkā nu kho, bhante, evam'eva diṭṭh'eva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ paññapetun'ti?
example_2: tathārūpesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddh'aggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) uddhaggikan'ti-ādīsu upar'ūparibhūmīsu phaladānavasena uddhamaggam'assā'ti uddhaggikā.

example_1: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, uddhaṅ'gamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭh'āsayā vātā, aṅgam'aṅg'ānusārino vātā, assāso passāso… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu.
evam'evaṃ kho, soṇa, acc'āraddhavīriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati, atisithilavīriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati.
example_2: kathābāhulle sati uddhaccaṃ, uddhatassa asaṃvaro, asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā
commentary: (ANa) uddhaccāya saṃvattatī'ti uddhatabhāvāya saṃvattati.

meaning_1: restlessness and fidgetiness; agitation and edginess
example_1: kathañ'c'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thinamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti.

meaning_1: obstacle of restlessness and fidgetiness; hindrance of agitation and edginess
example_1: katame pañca dhammā pahātabbā? pañca nīvaraṇāni, kāmacchanda-nīvaraṇaṃ, byāpāda-nīvaraṇaṃ, thinamiddha-nīvaraṇaṃ, uddhaccakukucca-nīvaraṇaṃ, vicikicchā-nīvaraṇaṃ. ime pañca dhammā pahātabbā.

meaning_1: restlessness and uneasiness; agitation and anxiety
example_1: idh'āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti
example_2: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti
commentary: (ANa) uddhaccañ'ca kukkuccañ'ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ.

meaning_1: serving as a basis for restlessness and fidgetiness; giving support to agitation and edginess
example_1: uddhaccakukkuccaṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannañ'c'eva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañ'ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.

meaning_1: obstacle of restlessness and fidgetiness; hindrance of agitation and edginess
example_1: caṅgavāran'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmacchandanīvaraṇassa, byāpādanīvaraṇassa, thīnamiddhanīvaraṇassa, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇassa, vicikicchānīvaraṇassa.

meaning_1: obsessed by restlessness and fidgetiness; consumed by agitation and edginess
example_1: uddhaccakukkucca-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so uddhaccakukkuccaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.
example_2: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu idhalokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti.

meaning_1: afflicted with restlessness and fidgetiness; overcome by agitation and edginess
example_1: uddhaccakukkucca-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so uddhaccakukkuccaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

meaning_1: overcome by restlessness and fidgetiness; overpowered by agitation and edginess
example_1: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati. uddhaccakukkucc'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.

meaning_1: closely associated with restlessness; connected with agitation
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando uddhaccasahagato uddhaccasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando.
commentary: (ADha) dvādasamassa samayavavatthāne uddhaccena sampayuttan'ti uddhaccasampayuttaṃ. (VISMa) aññesu akusalacittesu labbhamānam'pi uddhaccaṃ visesato etth'eva balavaṃ, tato eva sampayuttadhammesu padhānaṃ hutvā pavattatī'ti idam'eva uddhaccena visesetvā vuttaṃ uddhaccasampayuttan'ti.

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando uddhaccasahagato uddhaccasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando.
commentary: (SNa) uddhaccasahagato'ti idha bhikkhu chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto nisīdati. ath'assa cittaṃ uddhacce patati. so buddhadhammasaṅghaguṇe āvajjetvā cittaṃ hāsetvā tosetvā kammaniyaṃ katvā puna chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karoti. ath'assa puna cittaṃ uddhacce patati.

example_1: s'āhaṃ sugatassa sāvikā, magg'aṭṭh'aṅgikayānayāyinī, uddhaṭasallā anāsavā, suññ'āgāragatā ramām'ahaṃ.
example_2: nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.

meaning_1: who has pulled out the arrow; who has extracted the barb

commentary: (ADha) upanissayapaccayo'ti idha pana ayaṃ tāva vacan'attho, tadadhīnavuttitāya attano phalena nissito, na paṭikkhitto'ti nissayo. yathā pana bhuso āyāso upāyāso, evaṃ bhuso nissayo upanissayo. balavakāraṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā balavakāraṇabhāvena upakārako dhammo upanissayapaccayo'ti veditabbo.

meaning_1: having the supporting conditions; with requisite preconditions
example_1: ceto paricca manas'ākāsī'ti tassā parisāya cittaṃ paccekaṃ paricchinditvā manasi akāsi te volokesi. bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātun'ti maggaphaladhammaṃ adhigantuṃ samattho, upanissayasampanno'ti attho.
commentary: (ANa) upanissayasampannaṃ hotī'ti sampanna-upanissayaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: due to decisive support; because of being a necessary supporting condition
meaning_lit: by the power of nearby support
example_1: akusalakammabhavassa upanissayavasena'pi sahajāt'ādi-vasena'pi. upapattibhavassa pana sabbassā'pi upanissayavasen'eva.
bhikkhu pan'eva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatth'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañ'ca gāravo ca.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.13) upanissāya viharatī'ti tattha paṭibaddhā honti cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārā.

example_1: tenah'ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī'ti.
example_2: yaṃnūna mayaṃ amuṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ nevāpikassa upanissāya āsayaṃ kappeyyāma.

meaning_1: dependent on; clinging to; relying on
example_1: ete ca ñatvā upanissitā'ti, ñatvā munī nissaye so vimaṃsī, ñatvā vimutto na vivādam'eti, bhav'ābhavāya na sameti dhīro'ti.
alatthaṃ yadidaṃ sādhu, n'ālatthaṃ kusalaṃ iti. ubhayen'eva so tādī, rukkhaṃ'v'upanivattati.
synonym: abbajati, āgacchati, pacceti, paṭikkamati, punarāgamati, punupeti

example_1: kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkha-upanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.
example_2: sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhava-upanītā kusalā vadānā.
commentary: (SNa) jar'ūpanītassā'ti jaraṃ upagatassa, jarāya vā maraṇasantikaṃ upanītassa.

example_1: saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yañño-upanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti, pañca ca usabhasatāni pañca ca vacchatarasatāni pañca ca vacchatarisatāni pañca ca ajasatāni pañca ca urabbhasatāni thūṇā-upanītāni honti yaññ'atthāya.
commentary: (SNa) thūṇ'ūpanītānī'ti thūṇaṃ upanītāni, thūṇāya baddhāni honti. (SNt) upanītāni yaññaṃ yajituṃ ārambhāya.

example_1: yāvañ'c'idaṃ bhoto gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa, upanītehi vacanappathehi samudācariyamānassa, chavivaṇṇo c'eva pariyodāyati, mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati, yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
commentary: (MNa) upanītehī'ti upanetvā kathitehi.

example_1: sara catur'odadhī, upanīte assuthaññarudhiramhi, sara ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena samaṃ.
upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.
commentary: (DHPa) upanītavayo'ti upā'ti nipātamattaṃ, nītavayo'ti vigatavayo atikkantavayo, tvañ'c'asi dāni tayo vaye atikkamitvā maraṇamukhe ṭhito'ti attho.

meaning_1: trained; instructed; initiated (in); (comm) caused to reach
example_1: sādhu, bhikkhave, upanītā kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, iminā sandiṭṭhikena dhammena akālikena ehipassikena opaneyyikena paccattaṃ veditabbena viññūhi.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idh'āssu dve māṇavakā bhātaro saudariyā, eko ajjhāyako upanīto eko anajjhāyako anupanīto. kam'ettha brāhmaṇā paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā'ti?
commentary: (MNa) upanītā kho me tumhe'ti mayā, bhikkhave, tumhe iminā sandiṭṭhik'ādisabhāvena dhammena nibbānaṃ upanītā, pāpitā'ti attho.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
at the end of life; come to the last stage of life
example_1: upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.
commentary: (DHPa) upanītavayo'ti upā'ti nipātamattaṃ, nītavayo'ti vigatavayo atikkantavayo, tvañ'c'asi dāni tayo vaye atikkamitvā maraṇamukhe ṭhito'ti attho.

example_1: addhā kho te ayaṃ, aggivessana, āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā, api ca te ahaṃ byākarissāmi.
commentary: (MNa) āsajja upanīyā'ti guṇe ghaṭṭetvā c'eva upanetvā ca.

meaning_1: is carried away; is led to the end; is brought to a conclusion; (comm) slowly approaches death
meaning_2: is brought up to, is carried away
example_1: upanīyati jīvitam'appam'āyu, jar'ūpanītassa na santi tāṇā, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) upanīyatī'ti parikkhīyati nirujjhati, upagacchati vā, anupubbena maraṇaṃ upetī'ti attho

meaning_1: is led on; is driven on (by)
example_1: upanīyati kho ayaṃ, brāhmaṇā, loko jarāya byādhinā maraṇena. evaṃ upanīyamāne kho, brāhmaṇā, loke jarāya byādhinā maraṇena, yo idha kāyena saṃyamo vācāya saṃyamo manasā saṃyamo, taṃ tassa petassa tāṇañ'ca leṇañ'ca dīpañ'ca saraṇañ'ca parāyaṇañ'cā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) upanīyatī'ti upasaṃharīyati. ayaṃ hi jātiyā jaraṃ upanīyati, jarāya byādhiṃ, byādhinā maraṇaṃ, maraṇena puna jātiṃ. tena vuttaṃ, upanīyatī'ti.

meaning_1: being led on; being driven on (by)
example_1: upanīyati kho ayaṃ, brāhmaṇā, loko jarāya byādhinā maraṇena. evaṃ upanīyamāne kho, brāhmaṇā, loke jarāya byādhinā maraṇena, yo idha kāyena saṃyamo vācāya saṃyamo manasā saṃyamo, taṃ tassa petassa tāṇañ'ca leṇañ'ca dīpañ'ca saraṇañ'ca parāyaṇañ'cā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) upanīyatī'ti upasaṃharīyati. ayaṃ hi jātiyā jaraṃ upanīyati, jarāya byādhiṃ, byādhinā maraṇaṃ, maraṇena puna jātiṃ. tena vuttaṃ, upanīyatī'ti.

meaning_1: (of money) to produce; to come up with
example_1: so kismiñci'd'eva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne na sakkuṇeyya upanīhātuṃ dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā.

meaning_1: could be assumed; could be supposed
example_1: attano bhātiṭṭhāne bhātaraṃ sahāyaṭṭhāne sahāyaṃ parikkhāraṭṭhāne vā parikkhāran'ti kismiñci ṭhāne parassa attānaṃ iminā kiñcanabhāvena upanetabbaṃ na passatī'ti attho.
idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appamattakam'pi pāpakammaṃ kataṃ tam'enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
example_2: atha khv'assa pubb'eva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tath'attāya upanetī'ti.

example_1: att'upanāyikan'ti te vā kusale dhamme attani upaneti attānaṃ vā tesu kusalesu dhammesu upaneti.

meaning_1: to lead; to carry; to guide (to)
example_1: yathā hi mugga-māsa-ppamāṇā'pi pāsāṇasakkharā udake pakkhittā uppilavamānā nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ heṭṭhā'va pavisati, evam'evaṃ antamaso sakkāyadiṭṭhi'pi saggaṃ upanetuṃ samatthā nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ apāyesu'y'eva nimujjāpetī'ti.
te sāvake upanetvā pabbajite, sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhitacittā pabbajitesu, kāyassa bhedā pāṇ'upacchedā hīne kāye patiṭṭhitā.

desento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ tādiso'va, adesento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ tādiso'va. upanento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvake tādiso'va, anupanento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvake tādiso'va.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: dve jālino munino aṭṭhako ca, atha kosallo buddho atho subāhu, upanemiso nemiso santacitto, sacco tatho virajo paṇḍito ca.
yadeva kho tvaṃ, ambaṭṭha, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ āsajja āsajja avacāsi, atha kho so bhavaṃ gotamo amhe'pi evaṃ upaneyya upaneyya avaca.
commentary: (DNa) amhe'pi evaṃ upaneyya upaneyyā'ti brāhmaṇo kho pana ambaṭṭha pokkharasātī'ti-ādīni vatvā evaṃ upanetvā upanetvā paṭicchannaṃ kāraṇaṃ āvikaritvā suṭṭhu dās'ādibhāvaṃ āropetvā avaca, tayā amhe akkosāpitā'ti adhippāyo.

example_1: nanu tvaṃ, bhikkhu, passasi brahmaparisaṃ sannipatitan'ti? iti kho maṃ, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā brahmaparisaṃ upanesi.
sace kho tvaṃ, mārisa, evaṃ pajānāsi, sace tvaṃ evaṃ anubuddho, mā sāvake upanesi, mā pabbajite, mā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, mā pabbajitānaṃ, mā sāvakesu gedhim'akāsi, mā pabbajitesu.
example_2: ahesuṃ kho, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā paṭijānamānā. te sāvake upanesuṃ pabbajite, sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesuṃ pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhim'akaṃsu pabbajitesu
commentary: (MNa) mā sāvake upanesī'ti gihisāvake vā pabbajitasāvake vā taṃ dhammaṃ mā upanayasi.

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, kammānaṃ vipāko? tividh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, kammānaṃ vipākaṃ vadāmi, diṭṭh'eva dhamme, upapajje vā, apare vā pariyāye. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammānaṃ vipāko.
commentary: (NPt) diṭṭhe vā dhamme attabhāve, upapajje vā anantarabhave, apare vā pariyāye bhave deti nibbattetī'ti evaṃ phalanibbattakasaṅkhāraṃ vā taṃsampayuttaṃ taṇhaṃ vā bhagavā āha.

example_1: tena so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. yañ'ca kho so idha pāṇ'ātipātī hoti adinn'ādāyī hoti… micchādiṭṭhi hoti tassa diṭṭh'eva dhamme vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti upapajja vā apare vā pariyāye.
commentary: (NPt) evaṃ imāya tividhāya saṅkhāracetanāya sampayuttā tividhā taṇhā tividhaṃ phalaṃ diṭṭhe vā dhamme attabhāve, upapajje vā anantarabhave, apare vā pariyāye bhave deti nibbattetī'ti evaṃ phalanibbattakasaṅkhāraṃ vā taṃsampayuttaṃ taṇhaṃ vā bhagavā āha.

example_1: atha v'āssa agārāni, aggi ḍahati pāvako, kāyassa bhedā duppañño, nirayaṃ so-upapajjati.
example_2: yattha nu kho, bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, sakkā nu kho so, bhante, gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā'ti?
commentary: (ANa) upapajjatī'ti suddhasīle patiṭṭhito devaloke nibbattati.

example_1: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.
synonym: nibbattati, pabhavati, vuppajjati, sañjāyati, samudayati, samudeti

meaning_1: is suitable; is acceptable; is admissible
example_1: cakkhu attā'ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. cakkhussa uppādo'pi vayo'pi paññāyati.
commentary: (MNa) na upapajjatī'ti na yujjati.

example_1: so sace ākaṅkhati, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākamm'ūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ
commentary: (VINa) cavamāne upapajjamāne'ti ettha cutikkhaṇe vā upapattikkhaṇe vā dibbacakkhunā daṭṭhuṃ na sakkā, ye pana āsannacutikā idāni cavissanti te cavamānā. ye ca gahitapaṭisandhikā sampatinibbattā vā, te upapajjamānā'ti adhippetā. te evarūpe cavamāne upapajjamāne ca passāmī'ti dasseti.

example_1: m'āyaṃ āyasmā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjī'ti! evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.
example_2: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

meaning_2: (from upapajjati) who comes into existence, is reborn (in)
example_1: abhijānām'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajitvā vā yājetvā vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjitā, ahaṃ tena samayena purohito brāhmaṇo ahosiṃ tassa yaññassa yājetā'ti.

tena so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. yañ'ca kho so idha pāṇ'ātipātī hoti adinn'ādāyī hoti… micchādiṭṭhi hoti tassa diṭṭh'eva dhamme vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti upapajjitvā vā apare vā pariyāye.
commentary: (MNt) upapajjitvā'ti tattha tattha bhave nibbattitvā.

example_1: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, idh'ekacco puggalo akusalaṃ kammaṃ cetanāya cetayitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya.
example_2: bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti?
commentary: (MNa) sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti sahabhāvaṃ upagaccheyyaṃ.

example_1: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.
example_2: sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho ahaññ'ev'eko jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītā'ti.

meaning_1: appearance; occasion; occurrence; happening; taking place
example_1: ahi vicchikā satapadī nakulā biḷārā mūsikā ulūkā, ye vā pan'aññe'pi keci tiracchānayonikā sattā manusse disvā saṃsappanti. iti kho, bhikkhave, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti. yaṃ karoti tena upapajjati.

meaning_1: having a certain type of rebirth; with a certain destination
example_1: jimhagatikassa kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, jimh'upapattikassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi, ye vā ek'antadukkhā nirayā yā vā saṃsappajātikā tiracchānayoni.

meaning_1: which leads to acquiring rebirth; related to re-arising
meaning_2: leading to the obtaining of rebirth, or a new existence
example_1: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti.
commentary: (ANa) upapattipaṭilābhiyānī'ti yehi anantarā upapattiṃ paṭilabhati. bhavapaṭilābhiyānī'ti upapattibhavassa paṭilābhāya paccayāni.

meaning_1: danger of rebirth; peril of reappearance

example_1: sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ, mahābrahm'ābhitiṭṭhati, upapanno jutimanto, bhismākāyo yasassiso.

ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, api pana tumhe āyasmanto yā tā devatā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, tāsaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ saddaṃ suṇātha, suppaṭipannāttha, mārisā, ujuppaṭipannāttha, mārisā, ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya
example_2: avihaṃ upapannāse, vimuttā satta bhikkhavo, rāgadosaparikkhīṇā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) upapannāse'ti nibbattivasena upagatā

example_1: santi loke munayo, janā vadanti ta'y'idaṃ kathaṃsu, ñāṇa-upapannaṃ no muniṃ vadanti, udāhu ve jīvitena-upapannaṃ.
example_2: apissu taṃ jano disvā evam'āha, abhirūpo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata, bho, rañño nāgo, kāy'upapanno vata, bho, rañño nāgo'ti!
commentary: (ANa) kāy'upapanno'ti sarīrasampattiyā upapanno, paripuṇṇ'aṅgapaccaṅgo'ti attho.

meaning_1: laden with fruit; full of fruit
example_1: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo. tatr'assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na c'assu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.
commentary: (MNa) upapannaphalan'ti phal'ūpapannaṃ bahuphalaṃ.

meaning_1: explores; examines; investigates; inspects; inquires; looks (into)
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhante, cetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko, yato yato imassa dhammapariyāyassa paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkheyya, labheth'eva attamanataṃ, labheth'eva cetaso pasādaṃ
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhātuso upaparikkhati, āyatanaso upaparikkhati, paṭiccasamuppādaso upaparikkhati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī hoti.
synonym: upadhāreti, upavicarati, oloketi, tīreti, paṭivicarati, pavicarati, pavicinati, passati, vicāreti, vicināti, vīmaṃsati, voloketi, samannesati, samanvesati

example_1: tassa taṃ passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññ'eva khāyeyya, tucchakaññ'eva khāyeyya, asārakaññ'eva khāyeyya.
example_2: tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhataṃ nijjhānaṃ khamanti.

example_1: saddho ca, puṇṇiya, bhikkhu hoti, no ca upasaṅkamitā, n'eva tāva tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti. yato ca kho, puṇṇiya, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti upasaṅkamitā ca, evaṃ tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā paṭibhāti.
example_2: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitā. tatra'pi mayā sannisinnapubbañ'c'eva, sallapitapubbañ'ca, sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā.

meaning_1: wanting to visit; wishing to meet
example_1: cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, api ca devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ kehici kehici kiccakaraṇīyehi byāvaṭo, ev'āhaṃ n'āsakkhiṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.

meaning_1: to approach; to visit; to go (to)
example_1: na arahati bhavaṃ kūṭadanto samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ. samaṇo tv'eva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ kūṭadantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ
example_2: na kho, bhikkhu, sukaro so bhagavā amhehi upasaṅkamituṃ, aññāhi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi parivuto.

meaning_1: having approached; having gone; having drawn near (to)
example_1: ty'āhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi, saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti?
example_2: upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi, yadā'yaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmī'ti.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.3) upasaṅkamitvā'ti tattha gantvā.

example_1: disvā pāsādachāyāyaṃ, caṅkamantaṃ nar'uttamaṃ, tattha naṃ upasaṅkamma, vandisaṃ puris'uttamaṃ.
example_2: eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti

example_1: annena pānena upaṭṭhahimhā, pāde-upasaṅgayha sake nivesane, kutomukhā nāma ime bhavanto, buddhassa dhammāni paṭiggahesuṃ.
commentary: (DNa) pād'ūpasaṅgayhā'ti pāde upasaṅgayha pādadhovana-pādamakkhan'ānuppadānena pūjetvā c'eva vanditvā ca.

example_1: dhammo nāma buddhabhāsito, sāvakabhāsito, isibhāsito, devatābhāsito, atth'ūpasañhito, dhamm'ūpasañhito.
commentary: (VINa) atth'ūpasañhito'ti aṭṭhakathānissito. dhamm'ūpasañhito'ti pāḷinissito, ubhayenā'pi vivaṭṭ'ūpanissitam'eva vadati.

meaning_1: calmed; cooled; composed; still; calm; at peace; tranquil
example_1: santakāyo santavāco, santavā susamāhito, vantalok'āmiso bhikkhu, upasanto'ti vuccati.
example_2: upasanto uparato, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, dhunāti pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto'ti.
commentary: (MNa) upasantā'ti nibbutā.

meaning_2: name of Vessabhū Buddha's attendant; lit. calmed
example_1: vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa upasanto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.

meaning_1: with a calm mind; with a peaceful heart
example_1: visenibhūto upasantacitto, nāgo'va danto carati anejo, bhikkhu susīlo suvimuttacitto, so ty'āhutiṃ bhuñjatu aggapiṇḍaṃ.

meaning_2: of calm appearance, looking at peace
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upasantapadisso bhante bhagavā bhāti'r'iva bhagavato mukhavaṇṇo vippasannattā indriyānaṃ. santena nūn'ajja bhante bhagavā vihārena vihāsī'ti?
commentary: (DNa) upasantapadisso'ti upasantadassano.
(ANa) upasant'upasanto'ti upasanto viya upasanto.

example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu tāva'd'eva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasant'ūpasanto hoti yāva na amanāpā vacanapathā phusanti.
piyo me, bhante, udayabhaddo kumāro. iminā me, bhante, upasamena udayabhaddo kumāro samannāgato hotu yen'eta'r'ahi upasamena bhikkhusaṅgho samannāgato'ti.
example_2: ete kho, bhikkhave, ubho ante anupagamma majjhimā paṭipadā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā, cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

meaning_1: leading to peace; conducive to calm
example_1: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañc'indriyāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu saddh'indriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ
commentary: (MNa) upasamamānaṃ gacchati, kiles'ūpasamatthaṃ vā gacchatī'ti upasamagāmī.

meaning_1: has ceased; has become extinct; is extinguished
meaning_2: becomes calm or quiet; ceases; is allayed, is extinguished
example_1: dharaṇī ca siñcati vāti, māluto vijjutā carati nabhe, upasamanti vitakkā, cittaṃ susamāhitaṃ mamā'ti.
commentary: (THa) upasamanti vitakkā'ti utusappāyasiddhena samathavipassan'ādhigamena pubbabhāge tadaṅg'ādi-vasena vūpasantā hutvā kāmavitakk'ādayo sabbe'pi nava mahāvitakkā ariyamagg'ādhigamena upasamanti. anavasesato samucchijjantī'ti. vattamānasamīpatāya ariyamaggakkhaṇaṃ vattamānaṃ katvā vadati. atīt'atthe vā etaṃ paccuppannavacanaṃ.

meaning_2: fixing the mind on tranquility; resolving for calmness
fixing the mind on tranquility; resolution for calmness

meaning_1: being calm; being cool; being settled
leading to mental peace; conducive to tranquillity
example_1: evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite.

meaning_1: pleasure of peace; happiness of tranquillity
example_1: idaṃ vuccati nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ. āsevitabbaṃ, bhāvetabbaṃ, bahulīkātabbaṃ, na bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā'ti, vadāmi.
example_2: yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) upasamasukhan'ti rāg'ādivūpasamatthāya sukhaṃ.

meaning_1: having calmness as a basis; with tranquillity as foundation; established in peace
example_1: catur'ādhiṭṭhāno ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? paññ'ādhiṭṭhāno, sacc'ādhiṭṭhāno, cāg'ādhiṭṭhāno, upasam'ādhiṭṭhāno.
example_2: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena upasam'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. eso hi, bhikkhu, paramo ariyo upasamo yadidaṃ, rāgadosamohānaṃ upasamo.

example_1: katamo ekadhammo? dhamm'ānussati … saṅgh'ānussati… sīl'ānussati… cāg'ānussati… devat'ānussati… ān'āpānassati… maraṇassati… kāyagatāsati… upasam'ānussati. ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) upasamaṃ ārabbha uppannā anussati upasam'ānussati, sabbadukkh'ūpasam'ārammaṇāya satiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. duvidho vā upasamo accant'ūpasamo ca khay'ūpasamo ca. accant'ūpasamo nāma nibbānaṃ, khay'ūpasamo nāma maggo. evam'etaṃ duvidham'pi upasamaṃ anussarantassa uppannā sati upasam'ānussatī'ti ayam'ettha attho.

example_1: idh'āvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desiyati upasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito.
commentary: (DNa) opasamiko'ti kiles'ūpasamakaro.

example_1: ajjhattam'ev'upasame, na aññato bhikkhu santim'eseyya, ajjhattaṃ upasantassa, n'atthi attāṃ kuto nirattāṃ vā.
commentary: (NIDD1) ajjhattam'ev'upasame'ti. ajjhattaṃ rāgaṃ sameyya, dosaṃ sameyya, mohaṃ sameyya, kodhaṃ… upanāhaṃ… makkhaṃ… paḷāsaṃ… issaṃ… macchariyaṃ… māyaṃ… sāṭheyyaṃ… thambhaṃ… sārambhaṃ… mānaṃ… atimānaṃ… madaṃ… pamādaṃ… sabbe kilese… sabbe duccarite… sabbe darathe… sabbe pariḷāhe… sabbe santāpe… sabb'ākusal'ābhisaṅkhāre sameyya upasameyya vūpasameyya nibbāpeyya paṭipassambheyyā'ti, ajjhattam'ev'upasame. (SNPa) ajjhattam'ev'upasame'ti attani eva rāg'ādi-sabbakilese upasameyya.

example_1: abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ pitu sakkassa kamm'ante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā.
example_2: khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti. so ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hoti.
commentary: (MNa) upasampajja vihareyyā'ti paṭilabhitvā vihareyya.

meaning_1: becoming fully ordained; taking higher ordination
example_1: bhikkhunī upasampajja, pubbajātim'anussariṃ, dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ, vimalaṃ sādhubhāvitaṃ.
commentary: (THIa) bhikkhunī upasampajjā'ti vasse paripuṇṇe upasampajjitvā bhikkhunī hutvā.

meaning_1: undertaking; taking up; putting into action
example_1: yadā tumhe, kālāmā, attanā'va jāneyyātha, ime dhammā kusalā, ime dhammā anavajjā, ime dhammā viññuppasatthā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī'ti, atha tumhe, kālāmā, upasampajja vihareyyātha.

meaning_1: becomes fully ordained; takes higher ordination
meaning_2: attains, enters on, becomes fully ordained
example_1: vibbhantakassa, bhikkhave, parivāso na ruhati. so ce puna upasampajjati, tassa tadeva purimaṃ parivāsadānaṃ. yo parivāso dinno sudinno, yo parivuttho suparivuttho, avaseso parivasitabbo.

meaning_2: attained, entered on, became fully ordained

example_1: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
example_2: āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.

example_1: nihacca jāṇuṃ vanditvā, sammukhā añjaliṃ akaṃ, ehi bhadde'ti maṃ avaca, sā me āsu-upasampadā.
example_2: es'āhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca, labheyy'āhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan'ti.

example_1: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo
example_2: aṅgulipatodako nāma aṅguliyā'pi tudanti upasampanno upasampannaṃ has'ādhippāyo kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
commentary: (VIN) anupasampanno nāma bhikkhuñ'ca bhikkhuniñ'ca ṭhapetvā avaseso anupasampanno nāma.

example_1: acira-upasampanno kho pan'āyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti
example_2: bhikkhū'ti bhikkhako'ti bhikkhu, bhikkhācariyaṃ ajjhupagato'ti bhikkhu, bhinnapaṭadharo'ti bhikkhu, samaññāya bhikkhu, paṭiññāya bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhū'ti bhikkhu, tīhi saraṇagamanehi upasampanno'ti bhikkhu
commentary: (VINa) upasampanno nāma uparibhāvaṃ samāpanno, patto'ti attho. bhikkhubhāvo hi uparibhāvo, tañ'c'esa yathāvuttena kammena samāpannattā, upasampanno'ti vuccati

meaning_1: perceiving (someone) as a higher ordained monastic
perceiving (someone) as a higher ordained monastic
example_1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī uyyojeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. upasampanne vematiko uyyojeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. upasampanne anupasampannasaññī uyyojeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
example_2: upasampanne upasampannasaññī cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (VBt) upasampanne anupasampannasaññī amūlakena saṅgh'ādisesenā'ti sukkavissaṭṭhi-kāyasaṃsagg'ādinā saṅgh'ādises'āpattiyā vatthunā'ti veditabbaṃ. na hi anupasampannassa saṅgh'ādises'āpatti nāma atthi.

meaning_2: ordains, receives into the Saṅgha (with the upasampadā ordination)

meaning_lit: to cause to be gone near together
discourse on should be allowed to give higher ordination
who causes to go near together
example_1: asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi upasampādetā

meaning_1: ordains (someone) as a monastic; gives higher ordination (to)
example_1: catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. api ca m'ettha puggalavemattatā viditā'ti.
example_2: yo upasampādeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, dasavaggena vā atirekadasavaggena vā gaṇena upasampādetun'ti.
commentary: (VINt) aññaṃ upasampādetī'ti upajjhāyo kammavācācariyo vā hutvā upasampādeti.

meaning_lit: to cause to go near together
meaning_2: to ordain as a monk; to give higher ordination

meaning_1: having ordained (someone) as a monastic; having given higher ordination (to)
meaning_lit: having caused to go near together

meaning_2: ordaining as a monk; giving higher ordination

meaning_1: is calmed; is cooled; is settled
example_1: sahassam'api ce vācā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ atthapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.

meaning_1: (of fire) goes out; dies; cools down
example_1: mahāgini pajjalito, anāhāro'pasammati, aṅgāresu ca santesu, nibbuto'ti pavuccati.

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of upasarada
example_1: samās'antagatānaṃ nāmānam'anto saro kvaci akāro hoti. devānaṃ rājā devarājo, devarājā, devānaṃ sakhā devasakho, devasakhā, pañca ahāni pañc'āhaṃ, satt'āhaṃ, pañcagavaṃ, chatt'upāhanaṃ, upasaradaṃ, visāl'akkho, vimukho.

meaning_1: having approached; having gone; having drawn near (to)
commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.3) upasaṅkamitvā'ti tattha gantvā.

example_1: abhisaṅkhataṃ nirārambhaṃ, yaññaṃ kālena kappiyaṃ, tādisaṃ upasaṃyanti, saññatā brahmacārayo.
commentary: (ANa) upasaṃyantī'ti upagacchanti.

example_1: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti
so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati
example_2: upadhi dukkhassa mūlan'ti, iti viditvā nirupadhi upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (ANa) upasaṃharatī'ti ñāṇena ānisaṃsaṃ disvā otāreti.

example_1: dasah'ākārehi pesuññaṃ upasaṃharati, jātito'pi, nāmato'pi, gottato'pi, kammato'pi, sippato'pi, ābādhato'pi, liṅgato'pi, kilesato'pi, āpattito'pi, akkosato'pi.
example_2: bhiṃsāpeyyā'ti upasampanno upasampannaṃ bhiṃsāpetu'kāmo rūpaṃ vā saddaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā rasaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbaṃ vā upasaṃharati. bhāyeyya vā so na vā bhāyeyya, āpatti pācittiyassa.

example_1: tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjeṭṭhakāya durattavaṇṇam'ev'assa aparisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.
atha kho dhanañ'jānī brāhmaṇī bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa bhattaṃ upasaṃharantī upakkhalitvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi
commentary: (SNt) upasaṃharantī'ti upanentī.

meaning_1: (of the eyes or mind) focused; concentrated on
example_1: atha kho bhagavā kāpaṭikassa māṇavassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya yena kāpaṭiko māṇavo tena cakkhūni upasaṃhāsi.
atha kho, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro ekattena attānaṃ upasaṃharati, ekattena attānaṃ upasaṃharitvā sakkassa devānam'indassa pallaṅke pallaṅkena nisīditvā deve tāvatiṃse āmantesi
yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamma-upasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
example_2: katame pañca? cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāma-upasaṃhitā rajanīyā… ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāmaguṇā. yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ kāmānaṃ assādo.
commentary: (DNa) kām'ūpasaṃhitānī'ti kām'assādayuttāni. (MNa) kām'ūpasaṃhitā'ti ārammaṇaṃ katvā uppajjamānena kāmena upasaṃhitā. (ANa) kām'ūpasaṃhitan'ti kāmanissitaṃ duvidhe kāme ārabbha uppajjanakaṃ.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.
tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā padumaṃ upasiṅghati.
brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasīdarī taṇhacchido ca sīdarī

(MNt) ten'āha bhagavā, dhammā'pi kho, bhikkhave, pahātabbā, pag'eva adhammā'ti (ma. ni. 1.240). upādānaseṭṭhan'ti idaṃ n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-bhavassa sabbabhav'aggatādassanaparaṃ, na pana ariyabhav'aggassa upādānaseṭṭhatā-paṭisedhaparaṃ.

meaning_1: enjoying grasping; taking pleasure in acquisition
example_1: upādān'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, upādānaratassa upādānasammuditassa, upādānanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

meaning_1: graspable; which can be used for support; which could be clung to; which can be taken possession of
example_1: rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, upādāniyo dhammo, yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, upādāniyesu dhammesu ādīnav'ānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
commentary: (DNa) sāsavo upādāniyo'ti āsavānañ'c'eva upādānānañ'ca paccayabhūto. iti tebhūmakadhammam'eva niyameti.

meaning_lit: discourse on things to be clung to
discourse on what can be clung to
discourse on what can be clung to

example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: agitation through clinging; anxiety through attachment
example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, upādāparitassanā hoti? idha, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) upādāparitassanan'ti gahaṇena uppannaṃ paritassanaṃ.

meaning_1: taking; taking up; grasping (onto); taking possession (of)
example_1: puṇṇo nāma, āvuso, āyasmā mantāṇiputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ sataṃ bah'ūpakāro hoti. so amhe iminā ovādena ovadati, upādāya, āvuso ānanda, asmī'ti hoti, no anupādāya.
example_2: yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, nāmarūpaṃ? vedanā, saññā, cetanā, phasso, manasikāro, idaṃ vuccati nāmaṃ. cattāro ca mahābhūtā, catunnañ'ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.
example_2: chasu loko samuppanno, chasu kubbati santhavaṃ, channam'eva upādāya, chasu loko vihaññatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) upādāyā'ti tāni'y'eva ca upādāya āgamma paṭicca pavattati.

example_1: sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpannena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehī'ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ
example_2: na sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādessāmi bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāyā'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.8) kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāyā'ti sādh'atthiko mah'aggh'atthiko.

example_1: cattār'imāni, gahapati, sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya. katamāni cattāri? atthisukhaṃ, bhogasukhaṃ, ānaṇyasukhaṃ, anavajjasukhaṃ.
pāpakaṃ nāma jīvitaṃ aḍḍhānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya daliddānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ lāmakaṃ, sadhanānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya adhanānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ, devānaṃ jīvitaṃ upādāya manussānaṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakaṃ.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, nāmarūpaṃ? vedanā, saññā, cetanā, phasso, manasikāro, idaṃ vuccati nāmaṃ. cattāro ca mahābhūtā, catunnañ'ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāyarūpaṃ.
te maṃ catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ upādāy'upādāya pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ, puṭṭho puṭṭho c'āhaṃ tesaṃ byākareyyaṃ, byākatañ'ca me byākatato dhāreyyuṃ, na ca maṃ dutiyakaṃ uttari paṭipuccheyyuṃ.

meaning_1: derived matter; accessory form; co-nascent material phenomena
what is grasped; fuel of existence; what is taken possession of
example_1: evaṃ sammā dvayat'ānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā'ti.

meaning_1: grasped; clung to; attached to; taken as mine; taken possession of
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhu, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu? yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kesā… karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu.
commentary: (MNa) upādinnan'ti ādinnaṃ gahitaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ, sarīr'aṭṭhakan'ti attho.

meaning_1: grasped; clung to; attached to; taken as mine; taken possession of
example_1: so rūpaṃ viññāṇaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti attā me'ti. tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
tato aparena samayena samanuggāhīyamāno vā asamanuggāhīyamāno vā aññabhāgiyañ'c'eva taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ hoti kocideso lesamatto upādinno, bhikkhu ca dosaṃ patiṭṭhāti, saṅgh'ādiseso.
example_2: koci deso lesamatto upādinno'ti tesaṃ dasannaṃ lesānaṃ aññataro leso upādinno hoti.
commentary: (VIN) koci deso lesamatto upādinno'ti tesaṃ dasannaṃ lesānaṃ aññataro leso upādinno hoti.

meaning_1: grasped; clung to; attached to; taken as mine; taken possession of

meaning_1: place where the continuity that is grasped occurs

commentary: (DNt) upādinnakasantati-pavattiṭṭhāne'ti kammajarūpasantatiyā pavattiṭṭhāne aphuṭaṃ nāma na hotī'ti sambandho.

example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, ettāvatā saupavajjo'ti vadāmi. yo kho, sāriputta, tañ'ca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, aññañ'ca kāyaṃ upādiyati, tam'ahaṃ saupavajjo'ti vadāmi.
example_2: so evaṃ asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.
commentary: (ANa) na kiñci loke upādiyatī'ti kiñci ekam'pi saṅkhāragataṃ taṇhāvasena na upādiyati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati.
notes: passive in form, active in meaning.

example_2: taṃ, bhikkhave, attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyetha, yaṃsa attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

example_1: sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam'ahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto vihareyyan'ti. upādiyamāno kho, bhikkhu, baddho mārassa, anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato'ti.
example_2: ahañ'hi rūpaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, vedanaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saññaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saṅkhāreyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, viññāṇaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ.
notes: passive in form, active in meaning.

example_1: bhav'ev'āhaṃ bhayaṃ disvā, bhavañ'ca vibhav'esinaṃ, bhavaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ kiñci, nandiñ'ca na upādiyin'ti.
example_2: ahañ'hi rūpaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, vedanaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saññaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, saṅkhāreyeva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ, viññāṇaṃ'y'eva upādiyamāno upādiyiṃ.

meaning_1: having grabbed hold of; having grasped (something with)
meaning_2: having grasped hold (of); having clung (to); having taken possession (of)
example_1: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upādiyitvā nisīdati.

meaning_1: remnant of grasping; remaining fuel of existence

example_1: evaṃ sammā dvayat'ānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā'ti.

example_1: upāyakusalen'āhaṃ, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā yoniso paṭipajjitvā, bhave cittaṃ udabbahin'ti.
example_2: evaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ karuṇāyitvā tato paraṃ eten'eva upāyena piyapuggale, tato majjhatte, tato verimhī'ti anukkamena karuṇā pavattetabbā.
synonym: ñāya, niyāma, nīhāra, pakāra, patha, pariyāya, magga, vidhi
commentary: (THa) upāyakusalenā'ti vineyyānaṃ daman'ūpāyacchekena kovidena buddhena bhagavatā hetubhūtena.

commentary: (MNa) taṇhādiṭṭhiyo hi tebhūmakadhamme upentī'ti upāyā

meaning_1: skilful in ways; adept in methods
example_1: upāyakusalena-ahaṃ, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā yoniso paṭipajjitvā, bhave cittaṃ udabbahin'ti.

meaning_1: skill in means; expertise in expedient methods
meaning_2: skill in means; skill in expedience
example_1: tīṇi kosallāni, āyakosallaṃ, apāyakosallaṃ, upāyakosallaṃ.

meaning_2: knowing the means, knowing the way

example_1: yathā, mahārāja, puriso rañño cakkavattissa madhuṃ vā madhupiṇḍikaṃ vā aññaṃ vā upāyanaṃ abhihareyya, tam'enaṃ rañño dvārapālo evaṃ vadeyya akālo, bho, ayaṃ rañño dassanāya, tena hi, bho, tava upāyanaṃ gahetvā sīghasīghaṃ paṭinivatta, pure tava rājā daṇḍaṃ dhāressatī'ti.
example_2: upāyanañ'ca te deva, n'āññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ, sabbasākuṇikāgāme, taṃ passa manuj'ādhipa.
commentary: (JAa) upāyanan'ti paṇṇākāraṃ.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
example_2: taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti
commentary: (ANa) upāyāsehī'ti adhimatt'āyāsa-lakkhaṇa-upāyāsehi.

meaning_1: full of difficulty; very afflicted; greatly troubled
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.

commentary: (SNa) upay'upādānā'ti taṇh'ūpaya-diṭṭh'ūpayavasena dve upayā, kām'upādān'ādīni cattāri upādānāni ca.

compound_construction: upāya ca upādāna ca abhinivesa ca vinibandha ca
example_1: upāy'upādān'ābhinivesa-vinibandho khv'āyaṃ, kaccāna, loko yebhuyyena. tañ'c'āyaṃ upay'upādānaṃ cetaso adhiṭṭhānaṃ abhinives'ānusayaṃ na upeti na upādiyati n'ādhiṭṭhāti, attā me'ti.
commentary: (SNa) upay'upādān'ābhinivesa-vinibandho'ti upayehi ca upādānehi ca abhinivesehi ca vinibandho. tattha upayā'ti dve upayā taṇh'upayo ca diṭṭh'upayo ca. upādān'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: engaging and grasping; approaching and clinging; going near and grabbing hold

meaning_2: skillfully; in the right way; by a stratagem

example_1: te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.
example_2: upārambhaṃ na sikkheyya, khalitañ'ca na gāhaye, n'ābhihare n'ābhimadde, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.
commentary: (MNa) nindā-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti attano nindābhayena ghaṭṭanabhayena upavādabhayena cā'ti attho. (SNa) nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti viññūnaṃ santikā nindābhayena ca ghaṭṭanabhayena ca dos'āropanabhayena ca upārambhabhayena ca.

meaning_1: with a fault-finding mind; with a critical attitude
example_1: makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
commentary: (ANa) upārambhacitto'ti niggah'āropanacitto.

meaning_1: criticizes; finds fault; challenges; refutes; confutes (with)
example_1: nanu, mālukyaputta, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇ'ūpamena upārambhena upārambhissanti? daharassa hi, mālukyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sakkāyo'ti'pi na hoti, kuto pan'assa uppajjissati sakkāyadiṭṭhi?

meaning_1: for the purpose of debating; for the sake of argument

commentary: (MNa) te upārambh'ānisaṃsā cevā'ti te paresaṃ vāde dos'āropan'ānisaṃsā hutvā pariyāpuṇantī'ti attho. (SNa) upārambh'ānisaṃsan'ti ayaṃ pucchāya doso, ayaṃ vissajjane'ti evaṃ vādados'ānisaṃsaṃ.

example_1: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, tapassi, anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya. ṭhānañ'ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo upālissa gahapatissa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya.

meaning_1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk of those learned in the Vinaya
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of monks

commentary: (ANa) vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ upālī'ti vinayadharānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ upālitthero aggo'ti dasseti. thero kira tathāgatass'eva santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tathāgatass'eva santike vinayapiṭakaṃ uggaṇhitvā bhārukacchakavatthuṃ, ajjukavatthuṃ, (pārā. 158) kumārakassapavatthun'ti imāni tīṇi vatthūni sabbaññutaññāṇena saddhiṃ saṃsandetvā kathesi. tasmā vinayadharānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.
notes: Theragāthā verses 249-251 (TH3.11, TH180) are attributed to him.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahatiyā gihiparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti bālakiniyā parisāya upālipamukhāya.
commentary: (MNa) upālipamukhāyā'ti upālijeṭṭhakāya… upālipamukhāyā'ti upāligahapati'y'eva tattha thokaṃ sappañño, so tassā pamukho jeṭṭhako. tenā'pi vuttaṃ upālipamukhāyā'ti.

example_1: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, vaṇijjā upāsakena akaraṇīyā. katamā pañca? satthavaṇijjā, sattavaṇijjā, maṃsavaṇijjā, majjavaṇijjā, visavaṇijjā.

meaning_1: family of lay disciples; household of supporters
meaning_2: family of lay disciples; household of supporters

meaning_1: outcaste lay disciple; low class lay devotee

meaning_1: fact of being a devotee; fact of being a disciple
meaning_2: fact of being a devotee; fact of being a disciple
example_1: te tattha sabb'eva ahaṃ pure'ti, upāsakattaṃ paṭivedayitvā, pakkāmi sattho anumodamāno, yakkh'iddhiyā anumato punappunaṃ.
example_2: ekanahutaṃ upāsakattaṃ paṭivedesi.

meaning_1: reject lay disciple; worst kind of lay devotee

meaning_1: reject lay disciple; worst kind of lay devotee
example_1: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca. katamehi pañcahi?
commentary: (ANa) upāsakapatikuṭṭho'ti upāsakapacchimako.

meaning_1: a lotus of a lay disciple; a blossom of lay devotee
example_1: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'ca. katamehi pañcahi?
commentary: (ANt) guṇasobhā-kittisadda-sugandhatāhi upāsako'va padumaṃ upāsakapadumaṃ. tathā upāsakapuṇḍarīkaṃ.

example_1: tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitena'pi sā attamanā hoti. atittā'va, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti. sace, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.

meaning_1: a lotus of a lay disciple; a blossom of a lay devotee
example_1: saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, akotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, kammaṃ pacceti no maṅgalaṃ, na ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, idha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'cā'ti.
commentary: (ANt) guṇasobhā-kittisadda-sugandhatāhi upāsako'va padumaṃ upāsakapadumaṃ. tathā upāsakapuṇḍarīkaṃ.

meaning_1: state of being a lay disciple; lay devotee
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkaṇṭhito anabhirato sāmaññā cavitukāmo bhikkhubhāvaṃ aṭṭīyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno gihibhāvaṃ patthayamāno upāsakabhāvaṃ patthayamāno ārāmikabhāvaṃ patthayamāno sāmaṇerabhāvaṃ patthayamāno titthiyabhāvaṃ patthayamāno titthiyasāvakabhāvaṃ patthayamāno assamaṇabhāvaṃ patthayamāno asakyaputtiyabhāvaṃ patthayamāno, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ buddhaṃ paccakkheyyanti vadati viññāpeti.

te ārāmikabhūtā vā upāsakabhūtā vā pañcasikkhāpade samādāya vattanti. iti samaṇo gotamo sāvakānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito, samaṇañ'ca pana gotamaṃ sāvakā sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharantī'ti.

meaning_1: a stain of a lay disciple; a filthy lay devotee

meaning_1: a gem of a lay disciple; a jewel of a lay devotee
example_1: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'cā'ti.
commentary: (ANt) ayaṃ pana viseso, catunnam'pi parisānaṃ ratijanan'aṭṭhena upāsako'va ratanaṃ upāsakaratanaṃ.

meaning_1: one hundred lay disciples; one hundred lay devotees
example_1: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. ten'ev'antaravassena parinibbāyi.
example_2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
commentary: (ANa) pañcamattehi upāsakasatehī'ti sot'āpanna-sakadāgāmīnaṃ'y'eva ariyasāvakaupāsakānaṃ pañcahi satehi parivuto bhuttapātarāso gandhamālavilepenacuṇṇāni gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami.

meaning_2: Chapter 2 of the Brāhmaṇasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: attends (to); pays attention (to); sits at the feet (of)
meaning_2: attends or serve; sits at the feet (of)

commentary: (THIa) ye sukkaṃ na upāsanti, desentiṃ buddhasāsanan'ti buddhassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ yāthāvato desentiṃ pakāsentiṃ sukkaṃ theriṃ ye na upāsanti na payirupāsanti. te ime rājagahe manussā kiṃ katā'ti yojanā.

example_1: kaliṅgar'ūpadhānā, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ. tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) upāsanasmin'ti sippānaṃ abhiyoge ācariyānañ'ca payirupāsane. te kira tadā pāto'va uṭṭhāya sippasālaṃ gacchanti, tattha sippaṃ uggahetvā sajjhāy'ādīhi abhiyogaṃ katvā mukhaṃ dhovitvā yāgupānāya gacchanti. yāguṃ pivitvā puna sippasālaṃ gantvā sippaṃ gaṇhitvā sajjhāyaṃ karontā pātarāsāya gacchanti. katapātarāsā samānā mā pamādena ciraṃ nidd'okkamanaṃ ahosī'ti khadiraghaṭikāsu sīse ca pāde ca upadahitvā thokaṃ nipajjitvā puna sippasālaṃ gantvā sippaṃ gahetvā sajjhāyanti. sāyaṃ sajjhāyaṃ karontā ca gehaṃ gantvā bhuttasāyamāsā paṭhamayāmaṃ sajjhāyaṃ katvā sayanakāle tath'eva kaliṅgaraṃ upadhānaṃ katvā sayanti. evaṃ te akkhaṇavedhino vālavedhino ca ahesuṃ. idaṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

meaning_2: service; attendance; sitting at the feet (of)

example_1: addasā kho āyasmā ānando sambahule licchavikumārake santh'āgāre upāsanaṃ karonte, dūrato'va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipātente, poṅkh'ānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) upāsanaṃ karonte'ti kaṇḍakhipanasippaṃ karonte.

meaning_1: attending; serving; following; sitting at the feet (of)
meaning_2: attending; serving; following; sitting at the feet (of)

commentary: (DNa) tumhe pana seṭṭham'upāsamānā'ti uttamaṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ upāsamānā anuttare buddhasāsane vā.

commentary: (ANa) yaṃ disvā domanassaṃ uppajjati, taṃ domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ nāma. yaṃ disvā upekkhā uppajjati, taṃ upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ nāmā'ti veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: serving as a basis for equanimity;  giving support to mental poise
example_1: aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.

meaning_1: producing equanimity; resulting in mental poise
example_1: cha upekkh'ūpavicārā. cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā upekkhāṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya upekkhāṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati.

example_1: cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

meaning_1: theme of mental balance; cause for mental poise
example_1: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tīṇi nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni, kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ paggahanimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ upekkhānimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ.
