example_1: katamāni dve? sāt'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ upekkh'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

meaning_1: which possesses purification of awareness by equanimity; (or) with purity of equanimity and mindfulness
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
example_2: sa kho so, gahapati, ariyasāvako imaṃ'y'eva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyath'idaṃ, ekam'pi jātiṃ dve'pi jātiyo…
commentary: (VINa) upekkhāsatipārisuddhin'ti upekkhāya janitasatipārisuddhiṃ. imasmiñ'hi jhāne suparisuddhā sati. yā ca tassā satiyā pārisuddhi, sā upekkhāya katā na aññena, tasmā etaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhin'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: perfectly purified by equanimity and mindfulness; (or) with pure equanimity and mindfulness
example_1: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanan'ti.

meaning_1: equanimity as an element of awakening; mental poise as a factor of enlightenment
example_1: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti, upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti.
example_2: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

meaning_1: serving as a basis for equanimity as an element of awakening; giving support to mental poise as a factor of enlightenment
example_1: upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno c'eva upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī'ti.

meaning_1: serving as a basis for equanimity as an element of awakening; giving support to mental poise as a factor of enlightenment
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
commentary: (SNa) upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā'ti upekkhāya ārammaṇadhammā, atthato pana majjhatt'ākāro upekkhāṭṭhānīyā dhammo'ti veditabbo.

meaning_1: accompanied by mental balance; full of equanimity
example_1: so upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.
example_2: imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkam'pi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, sappītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, nippītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, sātasahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi, upekkhāsahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi.
commentary: (MNa) upekkhāsahagatan'ti catukkanaye catutthajjhānasamādhiṃ pañcakanaye pañcamajjhānasamādhiṃ.

meaning_1: comfort and mental poise; ease and equanimity
example_1: tassa yā purimā samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti.

meaning_1: ease of equipoise; comfort of non-reactivity; (comm) pleasure of the fourth jhāna
example_1: kiñ'ca tattha iñjitasmiṃ? yadeva tattha upekkhāsukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
commentary: (ANa) upekkhāsukhan'ti catutthajjhānasukhaṃ.

meaning_1: refined and true perception of the comfort of equanimity
meaning_2: refined and true perception of equanimity
example_1: tassa yā purimā samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

meaning_1: with a refined and true perception of the ease of equanimity
meaning_2: with a refined and true perception of equanimity
example_1: tassa yā purimā samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

meaning_1: bound by gratification to the pleasure of equanimity
example_1: tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the pleasure of equanimity
example_1: tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound by the gratification from the pleasure of equanimity
example_1: tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.
sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.
commentary: (ANa) upekkhāsetadantavā'ti cha'ḷ'aṅg'upekkhāmayehi setadantehi samannāgato. (THa) upekkhā setadantā te etassa atthī'ti, upekkhāsetadantavā.

example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, abhijānāmi tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, upekkhāvihārasmiṃ hoti.

meaning_1: living in a state of equanimity; dwelling with perfect mental poise
example_1: evaṃ, bhante. sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, brahmā upekkhāvihārī'ti. taṃ me idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā sakkhidiṭṭho, bhagavā hi, bhante, upekkhāvihārī'ti.

meaning_1: neutral; to be experienced with equanimity; serving as a basis for mental poise
example_1: saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca upekkhāvedaniyā, manoviññāṇañ'ca adukkham'asukhavedaniyaṃ. phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati adukkham'asukhā vedanā.
commentary: (SNt) evaṃ rūpā ca manāpā upekkhāvedaniyā'ti etthā'pi yath'ārahaṃ vattabbaṃ.

meaning_1: power of equipoise; faculty of equanimity
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upekkh'indriyaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā n'eva sātaṃ n'āsātaṃ vedayitaṃ
example_2: jīvit'indriyaṃ, sukh'indriyaṃ, dukkh'indriyaṃ, somanass'indriyaṃ, domanass'indriyaṃ, upekkh'indriyaṃ
commentary: (PMa) sukhadukkh'ākārapavattiṃ upekkhati majjhatt'ākārasaṇṭhitattā ten'ākārena pavattatī'ti upekkhā, majjhattalakkhaṇe ind'aṭṭhaṃ kāretī'ti indriyaṃ, upekkhā eva indriyaṃ upekkh'indriyaṃ.

meaning_1: ending of equipoise; cessation of the faculty of equanimity
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… upekkh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā

meaning_1: leading to the ending of equipoise; going to the cessation of the faculty of equanimity
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… upekkh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā

meaning_1: appearance of equipoise; arising of the faculty of equanimity
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… upekkh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā…

meaning_1: exploration with equanimity; examination with non-reactivity
example_1: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, iti cha somanass'upavicārā, cha domanass'upavicārā, cha upekkh'upavicārā.

meaning_1: exploration with equanimity; examination with non-reactivity
example_1: iti cha somanass'ūpavicārā, cha domanass'ūpavicārā, cha upekkh'ūpavicārā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

meaning_2: having become neutral; having become indifferent

example_1: sace ca pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, karissatha karotha vā, na vo dukkhā pamuty'atthi, upecca'pi palāyatan'ti.
example_2: tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

example_1: na te dukkhā pamuty'atthi, upecca-api palāyato, sace bhāyasi dukkhassa, sace te dukkham'appiyaṃ.
commentary: (THIa) atha pana taṃ pāpakammaṃ āyatiṃ karissasi, eta'r'ahi karosi vā, niray'ādīsu catūsu apāyesu manussesu ca tassa phalabhūtaṃ dukkhaṃ ito etto vā palāyante mayi n'ānubandhissatī'ti adhippāyena upecca sañcicca palāyatopi te tato pāpato mutti mokkhā n'atthi, gatikāl'ādi-paccay'antara-samavāye sati vipaccate evā'ti attho. uppaccā'ti vā pāṭho, uppatitvā'ti attho.

example_1: saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yaññ'opanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.
example_2: yo ca vantakasāvassa, sīlesu susamāhito, upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.

example_1: dukkaraṃ vā'pi karonti, sekhā sīlasamāhitā, ṭhitattā anagāriy'upetassa, tuṭṭhi hoti sukh'āvahā'ti.
example_2: anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.

example_1: tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
evaṃ vutte yasmiṃ samaye upeti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti. yasmiṃ samaye apeti, asaññī tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti. itth'eke abhisaññānirodhaṃ paññapenti.
example_2: middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.

example_1: vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
example_2: upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attā nirattā na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.

example_1: tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bādhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.
example_2: yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
example_2: satthaṃ nāma ekatodhāraṃ ubhatodhāraṃ paharaṇaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ubhatopakkha
meaning_1: in this double manner; in this dual way; in a double whammy
example_1: yassa kassaci, aggivessana, evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ uppannā'pi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannā'pi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa, evaṃ kho, aggivessana, abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca.
commentary: (MNa) ubhatopakkhan'ti sukhaṃ ekaṃ pakkhaṃ dukkhaṃ ekaṃ pakkhan'ti evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ hutvā.

meaning_1: burnt at both ends; scorched on both sides
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, chav'ālātaṃ ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ, n'eva gāme kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati, n'āraññe kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati.
commentary: (SNa) ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagatan'ti pamāṇena aṭṭh'aṅgulamattaṃ dvīsu ṭhānesu ādittaṃ majjhe gūthamakkhitaṃ. (VISMa) ubhatopadittan'ti ubhosu koṭīsu daḍḍhaṃ.

meaning_1: with both (husband and wife) having faith
example_1: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññataraṃ kulaṃ ubhatopasannaṃ hoti. saddhāya vaḍḍhati, bhogena hāyati, yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati purebhattaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā taṃ sabbaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vissajjetvā app'ekadā anasitā acchanti.
commentary: (VINa) ubhatopasannan'ti dvīhi pasannaṃ upāsakena'pi upāsikāya'pi. tasmiṃ kira kule ubho'pi te sot'āpannāy'eva

example_1: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno, tassa ubhatopasse vadhakā uppateyyuṃ, tassa tatonidānaṃ chambhitattaṃ uppajjeyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, chambhitattaṃ udapādi, chambhitatt'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

meaning_1: hermaphrodite; with male and female sexual characteristics
meaning_2: having the sexual characteristics of both sexes; hermaphrodite
commentary: (VINa) ubhatobyañjanā'ti itthinimittena ca purisanimittena cā'ti ubhohi byañjanehi samannāgatā.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
commentary: (MNa) ubhatobyūḷan'ti ubhato rāsibhūtaṃ.

meaning_1: on both sides; in both ways
example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ.
example_2: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto.

meaning_1: smoothed on both sides; softened on both sides
example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ.
example_2: upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi, icchām'ahaṃ, samma rattapāṇi, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pīt'āvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rajitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti maṇipāsāṇena ubhosu passesu suṭṭhu vimaṭṭhaṃ ghaṭṭetvā uppāditacchaviṃ.

meaning_1: liberated in both ways; emancipated in two regards; epithet of an arahant
meaning_2: liberated in both sides; emancipated in two ways
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, idh'assa bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, tam'ahaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, ehi me tvaṃ, bhikkhu, paṅke saṅkamo hohī'ti, api nu kho so saṅkameyya vā aññena vā kāyaṃ sannāmeyya, no'ti vā vadeyyā'ti?
example_2: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c'assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
commentary: (DNa) ubhatobhāgavimutto'ti dvīhi bhāgehi vimutto, arūpasamāpattiyā rūpakāyato vimutto, maggena nāmakāyato vimutto'ti.

meaning_1: liberation in both ways; freedom in both regards
meaning_2: liberation in both ways; freedom in both regards
example_1: imāya ca ānanda ubhatobhāgavimuttiyā aññā ubhatobhāgavimutti uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā n'atthī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) imāya ca ānanda ubhatobhāgavimuttiyā'ti ānanda ito ubhatobhāgavimuttito.

meaning_2: on both sides, in both respects

meaning_1: double-mouthed; with an opening at each end

example_2: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.

meaning_1: with red pillows on both sides; (comm) with red cushions for head and feet
example_1: kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so pallaṅke seti gonak'atthate paṭalik'atthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāne, atha kho so dukkhaññ'eva seti kodh'ābhibhūto.
example_2: tatr'assa pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno
commentary: (ANa) ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno'ti sīs'ūpadhānañ'ca pād'ūpadhānañ'cā'ti pallaṅkassa ubhato ṭhapitalohitak'ūpadhāno.

example_1: bhikkhunī nāma ubhatosaṅghe upasampannā.
commentary: (VINa) ubhato saṅghe'ti bhikkhunisaṅghe ñatticatutthena bhikkhusaṅghe ñatticatutthenā'ti aṭṭhavācikavinayakammena upasampannā.

meaning_2: garland with a stalk on both sides

meaning_1: analysis of the monks' and nuns' training rules; first three books of the Vinaya Piṭaka
example_1: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ catutthassa pārājikassa vatthum'pi pucchi, nidānam'pi pucchi, puggalam'pi pucchi, paññattim'pi pucchi, anupaññattim'pi pucchi, āpattim'pi pucchi, anāpattim'pi pucchi. eten'eva upāyena ubhatovibhaṅge pucchi. puṭṭho puṭṭho āyasmā upāli vissajjesi.

meaning_1: analysis of the monks' and nuns' training rules, chapters and accessories; books of the Vinaya Piṭaka
construction:
ubhatovibhaṅga + niddesa + khandhaka + parivāra + ā
ubhatovibhaṅganiddesakhandhakaparivāra + ā

commentary: (VINt) idāni sutt'ādīni nav'aṅgāni vibhajitvā dassento āha tattha ubhatovibhaṅga-niddesa-khandhaka-parivārā'ti-ādi.

having the sexual characteristics of both sexes; hermaphrodite

commentary: (SNPa) ubh'antam'abhiññāyā'ti ubho ante abhijānitvā.

example_1: tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha tato tvaṃ bāhiya n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena
example_2: saddhāya sīlena ca yā'dha vaḍḍhati, paññāya cāgena sutena c'ūbhayaṃ, sā tādisī sīlavatī upāsikā, ādīyati sāram'idh'eva attano'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ubhaya
meaning_1: from both sides; in both ways
meaning_2: on both sides; in both ways
example_1: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsalohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati. purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti, ubhayato abbocchinnaṃ idha loke patiṭṭhitañ'ca paraloke patiṭṭhitañ'ca. ayaṃ tatiyā dassanasamāpatti.
commentary: (DNa) ubhayato abbocchinnan'ti dvīhi'pi bhāgehi acchinnaṃ.

meaning_1: in both cases; on both sides
example_1: idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.
example_2: sace kho atth'eva paro loko, evaṃ imassa bhoto purisapuggalassa ubhay'attha kaṭaggaho, yañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, yañ'ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati.
commentary: (ANa) ubhay'attha kaliggāho'ti ubhay'esam'pi diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikānaṃ atthānaṃ kaliggāho, parājayaggāho'ti attho. (DHPa) idam'assa paraloke vipākasocanaṃ. evaṃ so ubhay'attha socati'y'eva.

meaning_1: benefit of both; welfare of both
example_1: att'atthaṃ vā ñassati par'atthaṃ vā ñassati ubhay'atthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ sacchikarissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
example_2: ubhay'atthaṃ vā hi bhikkhave sampassamānena alam'eva appamādena sampādetun'ti

meaning_2: in both ways; in both cases

grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of ubhayantara
example_1: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, ubhay'antarena n'āhosi, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā.

meaning_1: hurting both; affliction of both; harm to both (self and other)
example_1: yaṃ nu kho ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo idaṃ me kāyakammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya
example_2: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti.

meaning_2: between the two; within the two

grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of ubhayamantara
example_1: yato tvaṃ, māluṅkyaputta, na tattha, tato tvaṃ, māluṅkyaputta, n'ev'idha, na huraṃ, na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.
example_2: nissitassa calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n'atthi. calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti. natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti. āgatigatiyā asati cut'ūpapāto na hoti. cut'ūpapāte asati n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

meaning_1: both of these; both of them
example_1: ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā, ye ca samparāyikā kāmā, yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā, ubhayam'etaṃ māradheyyaṃ, mārass'esa visayo, mārass'esa nivāpo, mārass'esa gocaro.
example_2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ, āpattiṃ āpanno'ti. jānanti maṃ bhikkhū āpattiṃ āpanno'ti, iti so kupito hoti appatīto. yo c'eva kho, āvuso, kopo yo ca appaccayo, ubhayam'etaṃ aṅgaṇaṃ.

meaning_1: both mixed up; both mingled together; combined with both
example_1: imesu kho, vāseṭṭha, catūsu vaṇṇesu evaṃ ubhayavokiṇṇesu vattamānesu kaṇhasukkesu dhammesu viññugarahitesu c'eva viññuppasatthesu ca yadettha brāhmaṇā evam'āhaṃsu
commentary: (DNa) ubhayavokiṇṇesu vattamānesū'ti ubhayesu vokiṇṇesu missībhūtesu hutvā vattamānesu. katamesu ubhayesū'ti? kaṇhasukkesu dhammesu viññugarahitesu c'eva viññuppasatthesu ca. (DNt) ubhayavokiṇṇe'ti vacanavipallāsena vuttan'ti āha ubhayesu vokiṇṇesū'ti.

meaning_1: benefit of both; welfare of both
example_1: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti

meaning_1: both parts; both sides; both aspects
example_1: evam'ass'āyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo susamatto samādinno, ubhay'aṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati, riñcati akusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) ubhay'aṃsaṃ… ubhay'antaṃ ubhayakoṭṭhāsaṃ

meaning_2: developed in both parts; practiced for both aspects or objects; (ubhayaṃsa)
example_1: idha, mahāli, bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ubhay'aṃsabhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānañ'ca rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kām'ūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ dibbānañ'ca saddānaṃ savanāya piyarūpānaṃ kām'ūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) ubhayaṃsabhāvito'ti ubhay'aṃsāya ubhayakoṭṭhāsāya bhāvito'ti attho.

meaning_1: in both directions; on both sides; in both ways
meaning_2: on both sides; in both ways
example_1: api ca, mahārāja, katamena taṃ nemi, yena vā pāpakammā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, yena vā kalyāṇakammā kalyāṇakammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti? ubhayen'eva maṃ, mātali, nehī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ubhayen'eva maṃ mātali nehī'ti mātali dvīhi maggehi maṃ nehi, ahaṃ nirayaṃ passitu'kāmo devalokam'pī'ti. paṭhamaṃ katamena nemīti. paṭhamaṃ nirayamaggena nehī'ti.

meaning_1: benefit of both; good of both parties
example_1: ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca, paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
example_2: yo ca sīlañ'ca paññañ'ca, sutañ'c'attani passati, ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca.
commentary: (JAa) ubhinnam'atthaṃ caratī'ti yo idha puggalo ete sīl'ādayo guṇe attani passati, so mayhaṃ ācārasīlam'pi atthi, paññā'pi sutapariyatti'pi atthī'ti tathato jānitvā gaṇaṃ pariharanto attano ca paresañ'ca attānaṃ parivāretvā carantānan'ti ubhinnam'pi attham'eva carati.

example_1: ocarako nāma bhaṇḍaṃ ocaritvā ācikkhati, itthan'nāmaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharā'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. so taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharati, āpatti ubhinnaṃ pārājikassa.
ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca, paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
example_2: ubhinnaṃ tikicchantānaṃ, attano ca parassa ca, janā maññanti bālo'ti, ye dhammassa akovidā'ti.

example_2: mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici. iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.

meaning_1: both sides; both ends; both extremes
example_1: yo ubho'nte viditvāna, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so'dha sibbinim'accagā'ti.
atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho'pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubho'pi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalam'pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
example_2: abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vā'pi katvā na karomi c'āha, ubho'pi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.

meaning_1: victory in both worlds; success here and hereafter
example_1: yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpak'āpagato chaddisāpaṭicchādī ubholokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti.
commentary: (DNa) ubholokavijayāyā'ti ubhinnaṃ idhalokaparalokānaṃ vijinan'atthāya.

commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.9) ubho'va santā ekenā'ti dve'pi janā ekena.

example_1: giriguhan'ti dvinnaṃ pabbatānaṃ antarā, ekasmiṃ'y'eva vā umaṅgasadisaṃ mahāvivaraṃ.

example_1: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṅ'gotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrā'p'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṅ'gotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃ-sukhadukkha-ppaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto idh'ūpapanno'ti.
commentary: (VINa) evaṃgotto'ti bhaggavo vā gotamo vā (MNa) evaṃgotto'ti tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ ekagotto.

meaning_1: and thus; if like this; but like this
example_1: evañ'ca te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi vuccamānā tath'eva paggaṇheyyuṃ, te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya
example_2: evañ'ca kho eso, bhikkhu, pañho pucchitabbo

meaning_1: even if this; even if this is the case
example_1: purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti. evañ'c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati, idappaccayā avijjā'ti
commentary: (SNa) evañ'c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, assā'ti, bhikkhave, evaṃ ce etaṃ bhaveyya, nirantaraṃ sattisatehi haññamānassa dukkhadomanassehi sahevesa sacc'ābhisamayo bhaveyya ce'ti attho.

example_1: evañ'c'ettha, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa hoti, dhammaṃ nesaṃ desessan'ti.

meaning_1: exactly like this; in exactly the same way
example_1: evañ'hi te, moggallāna, sikkhitabbaṃ
example_2: tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā, amhākañ'c'ev'āyaṃ pabbajjā avañjhā bhavissati saphalā saudrayā'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: seeing in this way; having such insight
meaning_2: seeing in this way; having such insight
example_1: sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto, yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam'evadassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmi vikappayeyya.
commentary: (SNPa) tam'eva'dassin'ti taṃ evaṃ visuddhadassiṃ.

meaning_1: with just this view; (or) having such a view
example_1: ty'āhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi, saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto evaṃvādino evadiṭṭhino, yaṃ kiñc'āyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ issaranimmānahetū'ti? te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā āmā'ti paṭijānanti.
commentary: (UDa) evaṃ idāni vattabb'ākārena pavattā diṭṭhi etesan'ti evaṃdiṭṭhino.

meaning_1: thus that; in this way that
example_1: iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: thus with three circles; with such three phases
example_1: yāvakīvañ'ca me, bhikkhave, imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evan'tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādas'ākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi
commentary: (SNa) tiparivaṭṭan'ti saccañāṇa-kiccañāṇa-katañāṇa-saṅkhātānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ parivaṭṭānaṃ vasena tiparivaṭṭaṃ.

example_1: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.

meaning_1: asserting thus; declaring thus; preaching thus
example_1: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ, bhikkhave, evam'akkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, samaṇo gotamo na kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpetī'ti.
example_2: yathā ca pana kāmehi visaṃyuttaṃ viharantaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ akathaṃkathiṃ chinnakukkuccaṃ bhav'ābhave vītataṇhaṃ saññā n'ānusenti, evaṃvādī kho ahaṃ, āvuso, evam'akkhāyī'ti

example_1: saṅgho pabbatam'iva attānam'ācarati, pabbatāyati. taḷākaṃ samuddam'iva attānam'ācarati, samuddāyati, saddo cicciṭam'iva attānam'ācarati, cicciṭāyati, vasiṭṭhassa apaccaṃ vāsiṭṭho. evam'aññe'pi yojetabbā.
example_2: att'icch'atthe'ti kim'atthaṃ? aññassa pattam'icchati. evam'aññe'pi yojetabbā.

example_1: puratthimāya disāyā'ti-ādimhi bhūtam'atthaṃ katvā evam'attho veditabbo, samiddhe kira mahānagare sattaratanasampanno rājā cakkavatti rajjaṃ anusāsati, tass'etaṃ paccantanagaraṃ rājāyuttavirahitaṃ, atha purisā āgantvā amhākaṃ, deva, nagare āyuttako n'atthi, dehi no kiñci āyuttakan'ti āhaṃsu.

meaning_1: instructs in such a manner; teaches like this
meaning_2: instructs in such a manner; teaches like this
example_1: idha, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu evam'anusāsati, evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasikarotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha, idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathā'ti. idaṃ vuccati, kevaṭṭa, anusāsanīpāṭihāriyaṃ.
evam'ayaṃ puggalo āyatiṃ aparihānadhammo bhavissatī'ti.
example_2: gambhīro c'āyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīr'āvabhāso ca. etassa, ānanda, dhammassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam'ayaṃ pajā tantākulakajātā kulagaṇṭhikajātā muñjapabbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.

meaning_1: he would (think) thus; this would occur to him
example_1: tassā evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti.
example_2: tassa purisassa uttiṇṇassa pāraṅ'gatassa evam'assa, bahukāro kho me ayaṃ kullo, im'āhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo.

meaning_1: such about him; this regarding him
example_1: so evam'assa veditabbo, āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto lok'āmis'ādhimutto purisapuggalo'ti.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āraññako mago baddho pāsarāsiṃ adhisayeyya. so evam'assa veditabbo, anayam'āpanno byasanam'āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.

meaning_1: thus to him; thus to it
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkameyya, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha tiṭṭheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo
example_2: tena kuṭikārakena bhikkhunā kuṭivatthuṃ sodhetvā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo

example_1: te pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharonti, imaṃ mayaṃ pañhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchissāma. evaṃ ce no puṭṭho evaṃ byākarissati, evam'assa mayaṃ vādaṃ āropessāma.

meaning_1: tasting like this; having such a flavour
example_1: so ahosi vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno, seyyathā'pi nāma sampannaṃ vā sappi sampannaṃ vā navanītaṃ evaṃvaṇṇo ahosi. seyyathā'pi nāma khuddamadhuṃ aneḷakaṃ, evam'assādo ahosi.
te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi evam'assu vacanīyā, m'āyasmanto evaṃ avacuttha, na c'eso bhikkhu dhammavādī, na c'eso bhikkhu vinayavādī, m'āyasmantānam'pi saṅghabhedo ruccittha
example_2: kā upanisā savanāyā'ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evam'assu vacanīyā, yāva'd'eva dvayatānaṃ dhammānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāyā'ti. kiñ'ca dvayataṃ vadetha?

meaning_1: they should be spoken to thus; they should be replied to in this way
example_1: kā upanisā savanāyā'ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evam'assu vacanīyā, yāva'd'eva dvayatānaṃ dhammānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāyā'ti. kiñ'ca dvayataṃ vadetha?
example_2: evaṃvādino, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam'assu vacanīyā, yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāya?

example_1: attā me uppajjati ca veti cā'ti icc'assa evam'āgataṃ hoti. tasmā taṃ na upapajjati, cakkhu attā'ti yo vadeyya. iti cakkhu anattā.

meaning_1: like this, etc.; thus and so on
example_1: dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā [syā. pī. potthakesu dubbaṇo ca hoti durūpo supāpako'ti evam'ādinā pulliṅgikavasena dissati] dassanāya
example_2: phalubījan'ti ucchu veḷu naḷo'ti evam'ādi. aggabījan'ti ajjukaṃ phaṇijjakan'ti evam'ādi. bījabījan'ti sālivīhi-ādi pubb'aṇṇañ'c'eva muggamās'ādi apar'aṇṇañ'ca.

example_1: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ
commentary: (VINa) evam'āyupariyanto'ti evaṃ vassasataparam'āyupariyanto vā caturāsīti-kappasahassa-param'āyupariyanto vā. (MNa) evam'āyupariyanto'ti evaṃ sattapaññāsavassa-koṭisaṭṭhivassa-satasahass'āyupariyanto.

example_1: taṃ ce te purisā evam'āroceyyuṃ, yagghe deva jāneyyāsi, yo te so puriso dāso kammakāro pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅ'kārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī mukhullokako, so, deva, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
kiṃ nu kho mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa evam'ārocimha, imāsañ'ca imāsañ'ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ mayaṃ lābhino'ti
example_2: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ tissaṃ bhagavā etadavoca, saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, tissa, sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evam'ārocesi, api me, āvuso, madhurakajāto viya kāyo… hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
commentary: (DNa) evam'ārocesī'ti sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ dethā'ti-ādinā nayena ārocesi. (SNa) evam'ārocesī'ti dhammikaṃ samaṇā'tiādīni vadamānā sāsanassa niyyānikaṃ guṇaṃ kathesi. tañ'ca paribbājikāya kathaṃ sutvā pañcamattāni kulasatāni sāsane otariṃsū'ti.

example_1: evam'āvuso'ti kho therā bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paccassosuṃ.
example_2: āyām'āvuso cunda, yen'āyasmā channo ten'upasaṅkamissāma gilānapucchakā'ti. evam'āvuso'ti kho āyasmā mahācundo āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosi.

example_1: vejjo, ayye, evam'āha, mā kira, ayye, pure kiñci adāsi
example_2: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evam'āha, aham'pi kho, brāhmaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmī'ti.

meaning_1: they said this; they spoke thus
example_1: tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamī'ti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno evam'āha, ime hi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kim'aṅgaṃ pan'āhan'ti?
example_2: apissu maṃ, aggivessana, devatā disvā evam'āhaṃsu, kālaṅ'kato samaṇo gotamo'ti. ekaccā devatā evam'āhaṃsu, na kālaṅ'kato samaṇo gotamo, api ca kālaṅ'karotī'ti.

meaning_1: eating such food; of such diet
example_1: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ
commentary: (VINa) evam'āhāro'ti sālimaṃs'odan'āhāro vā pavattaphalabhojano vā. (MNa) evam'āhāro'ti dibbasudh'āhāro.

example_1: sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavaṃ'y'eva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, no ca kho bhikkhū ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, evam'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa ten'aṅgena.
example_2: catunnaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evam'idaṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañ'c'eva tumhākañ'ca

meaning_1: thus here one; so here a certain; thus in this case some; so some people here
example_1: evaṃ dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
idaṃ vatvāna [idaṃ vatvā evam'īdisesu ṭhānesu]
example_2: bahūnaṃ [bahunnaṃ evam'īdise aviññāṇakappakaraṇe]

meaning_1: thus in such; likewise in similar
example_1: idaṃ vatvāna [idaṃ vatvā evam'īdisesu ṭhānesu]
āguṃ [āgū, āgu evam'upari'pi] vañcanikā saṭhā
evam'etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.

meaning_1: so it is; just like that; exactly like that
example_1: evam'etaṃ bhaginiyo evam'etaṃ bhaginiyo!
example_2: ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.
commentary: (SNa) evam'etaṃ, mahārājā'ti idha bhagavā imaṃ suttaṃ sabbaññubhāsitaṃ karonto āha.

example_1: iti so viggahañ'ca vivādañ'ca vighātañ'ca vihesañ'ca attani sampassamāno tañ'c'eva diṭṭhiṃ pajahati aññañ'ca diṭṭhiṃ na upādiyati. evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hoti.
commentary: (MNa) evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hotī'ti evaṃ viggah'ādi-ādīnavaṃ disvā tāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti.

example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā taṃ nissāya taṃ āgamma y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ pajahatha, taṃ samatikkamatha. evam'etissā pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etissā samatikkamo hoti.

tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni tāni nissāya tāni āgamma yāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni tāni pajahatha, tāni samatikkamatha. evam'etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.
example_2: evam'etesaṃ, bhikkhave, sutt'antānaṃ tathāgatabhāsitānaṃ gambhīrānaṃ gambhīr'atthānaṃ lok'uttarānaṃ suññatappaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ antaradhānaṃ bhavissati.

meaning_1: like this here; thus in this case
example_1: bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti. evam'ettha, bhagavā, bhavissati, evam'ettha, sugata, bhavissatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) evametthā'ti evaṃ mayhaṃ ettha bhavissati.

example_1: evamesā kasī kaṭṭhā, sā hoti amatapphalā, etaṃ kasiṃ kasitvāna, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

meaning_1: similarly; in the same way; so too; just so
example_1: atītam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi
example_2: evam'eva kho, poṭṭhapāda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti.

meaning_1: similarly; in the same way; so too
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjh'aṅge bhāveti, satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkaroti.
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatāsati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti

meaning_1: similarly indeed; truly in the same way; in exactly the same way
example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

meaning_1: similarly; in exactly the same way; so too
example_1: maṃ ce'pi tumhe, bhikkhave, etam'atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, aham'pi taṃ evam'evaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ mahākaccānena byākataṃ
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti. evam'evaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.

meaning_1: similarly this; in the same way this; so too he; just so he
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, gaṅgā nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā samuddaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati, evam'ev'āyaṃ bhoto gotamassa parisā sagahaṭṭhapabbajitā nibbānaninnā nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā nibbānaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.

meaning_1: likewise; just like this; similarly; so too
example_1: yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.
example_2: supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.

meaning_1: so captivating; so bewitching; so enchanting
example_1: sannipatitvā taṃ saṅkhadhamaṃ etadavocuṃ, ambho, kassa nu kho eso evaṃrajanīyo evaṅkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evam'bandhanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo'ti.

meaning_1: such; similar kind of; of such quality
example_1: idha mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me, yo'haṃ evarūpehi sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṃ viharāmī'ti
example_2: evarūpo, bhikkhave, aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati.

meaning_1: did such a thing; performed such an action
example_1: māssu, bho satta, puna'pi evarūpam'akāsī'ti. aññe pāṇinā pahariṃsu, aññe leḍḍunā pahariṃsu, aññe daṇḍena pahariṃsu.

meaning_1: even such; even such kind of
example_1: evarūpā'pi kho me, aggivessana, uppannā dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.

grammar: adj, comp, fem nom sg of evarūpa
meaning_1: of such kind; of such quality
example_1: ye kho te bhikkhū sekkhā apattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti tesu me ayaṃ evarūpī anusāsanī hoti.
commentary: (MNa) evarūpī'ti evaṃjātikā.

example_1: evarūpe'pi, āvuso, puggale kāruññaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ anuddayā'y'eva upaṭṭhāpetabbā anukampā'y'eva upaṭṭhāpetabbā
acchariyaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa, abbhutaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa! evarūpe'pi nāma sāvakayuge parinibbute n'atthi tathāgatassa soko vā paridevo vā!

meaning_1: just like that; exactly like this
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.
example_2: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanati, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo assadoso.

example_1: ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha.
example_2: amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.

example_1: devo ca sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya. ev'assu tāni, bhikkhave, bījāni vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ.
commentary: (ANa) ev'assū'ti evaṃ bhaveyyuṃ.

meaning_1: we see it like this; we understand it in this way
meaning_lit: it is like this for us here
example_1: bhavapaccayā nu kho, bhikkhave, jāti, no vā, kathaṃ vā ettha hotī'ti? bhavapaccayā, bhante, jāti, evaṃ no ettha hoti, bhavapaccayā jātī'ti.

meaning_1: I see it like this; I understand it in this way
meaning_lit: it is like this for me here

example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde
example_2: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati assapuraṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.

meaning_1: this being the case; this being so
example_1: saññā nu kho, oḷāriko ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa rūpī cātumahābhūtiko kabaḷīkārāhārabhakkho. evaṃ santaṃ kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.
example_2: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

meaning_1: in this situation; this being the case
example_1: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
commentary: (ANa) evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hotī'ti, bhikkhave, etaṃ imasmiṃ ca kāraṇe sati ayaṃ puggalo na kathetuṃ yutto nāma hoti.

meaning_1: this being the case; this being so
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, nanu evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti? addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti
example_2: evaṃ sante kho, uttara, andho bhāvit'indriyo bhavissati, badhiro bhāvit'indriyo bhavissati.

example_1: evaṃ vutte, so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
example_2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.

example_1: ye pana te bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsu tatra, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti, dhammaṃ nesaṃ desessan'ti.
example_2: tattha hatth'ārohassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato… rakkhat'eva soṇḍaṃ.

meaning_1: thus; this; like this; similarly; in the same manner; just as; such
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharati subhagavane sālarājamūle. tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti.
example_2: accī yathā vātavegena khittā, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ, evaṃ munī nāmakāyā vimutto, atthaṃ paleti na upeti saṅkhaṃ.

example_1: nanu te, bhikkhave, yāva'd'eva kantārassa nittharaṇ'atthāya āhāraṃ āhāreyyun'ti? evaṃ, bhante
example_2: bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjālitun'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

meaning_1: having such intention; of such disposition
example_1: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā, aho vata aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā parihāyeyyuṃ, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍheyyun'ti.
commentary: (MNa) evaṃadhippāyā'ti evaṃladdhikā.

meaning_1: not past this; subject to this in future; yet to experience this
example_1: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti
commentary: (DNa) evaṃanatīto evaṃ uddhumāt'ādibhāvaṃ anatikkanto'ti.

meaning_1: just as easily; with as little difficulty as this
example_1: evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti, ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu.

meaning_1: having such a future state; with such a future destination
meaning_2: such a future state; such a future destination
example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.
commentary: (DNa) evaṃ abhisamparāyā'ti idaṃ purimapadass'eva vevacanaṃ, evaṃvidhaparalokā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: so desirable; so pleasurable; so enticing
example_1: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

meaning_1: having such desire; with such wish
example_1: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā, aho vata aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā parihāyeyyuṃ, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍheyyun'ti.
commentary: (MNa) evaṃkāmā'ti evaṃicchā.

meaning_1: acting like this; doing such things
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ, ayañ'ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso evaṃkārī tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

meaning_2: in such a state; of such a kind
example_1: yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi evaṃgatāni puthusipp'āyatanāni, te diṭṭh'eva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti, te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīṇenti, mātāpitaro sukhenti pīṇenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīṇenti
commentary: (DNa) evaṃgatānī'ti evaṃ pavattāni.

meaning_1: having such a destination; leading to such a destiny
meaning_2: producing or having a future course of this kind
example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.
commentary: (DNa) evaṃgatikā'ti evaṃ niraya-tiracchāna-pettivisaya-gatikānaṃ aññataragatikā. (DNt) atha vā evaṃgatikā'ti evaṃgamanā, evaṃniṭṭhā'ti attho.

meaning_1: held in such a way; thus grasped onto
meaning_2: held in such a way; thus grasped onto
example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.
commentary: (DNa) evaṃgahitā'ti diṭṭhisaṅkhātā tāva diṭṭhiṭṭhānā, sassato attā ca loko cā'ti evaṃgahitā ādinnā, pavattitā'ti attho.

meaning_1: of such family clan; of this lineage
example_1: jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?
example_2: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto
commentary: (VINa) evaṃgotto'ti bhaggavo vā gotamo vā (MNa) evaṃgotto'ti tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ ekagotto.

meaning_1: with the thought; with the idea
example_1: yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ pasīdeyyuṃ, pasannā ca me pasann'ākāraṃ kareyyun'ti, evarūpassa kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti.
commentary: (VIBHt) evaṃcitto'ti evaṃ lābhasakkārasiloka-sannissita-citto.

meaning_1: having such interest; of such inclination
example_1: yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, sattā evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evaṃadhippāyā, aho vata aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā dhammā parihāyeyyuṃ, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dhammā abhivaḍḍheyyun'ti.
commentary: (MNa) evaṃchandā'ti evaṃajjhāsayā.

meaning_1: of such and such a class; of this kind of family
meaning_2: of such and such a class; of this kind of family
example_1: evaṃjaccā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti'pi, evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā evaṃsīlā evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti'pī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) evaṃjaccā'ti vipassī-ādayo khattiyajaccā, kakusandhādayo brāhmaṇajaccā'ti.

meaning_1: just as quickly; as immediately as this
example_1: evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti, ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu.

meaning_1: so brutal; so savage; as vicious as
having such a view; holding such an opinion
example_1: api ca kho evaṃdiṭṭhikā ahesuṃ, sassato loko iti'pi, asassato loko iti'pi, antavā loko iti'pi, anantavā loko iti'pi, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ iti'pi, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ iti'pi, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā iti'pi
example_2: yaṃ te titthiyā sundariparibbājikaṃ hantvā samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ avaṇṇaṃ pakāsayitvā evaṃ etaṃ lābhaṃ yasasakkāraṃ sammānaṃ paccāharissāmā'ti te evaṃdiṭṭhikā evaṃkhantikā evaṃrucikā evaṃladdhikā evaṃajjhāsayā evaṃadhippāyā
commentary: (NIDD1a) evaṃdiṭṭhikā'ti evaṃladdhikā. yathā taṃ lābhādiṃ nibbattessāmā'ti evaṃ ayaṃ laddhi tesaṃ atthi, tathā atthi me vuttappakāro dhammo'ti etesaṃ khamati c'eva ruccati ca, evaṃsabhāvam'eva vā tesaṃ cittaṃ atthi me cittan'ti. tadā tesaṃ diṭṭhi vā, diṭṭhiyā saha khanti vā, diṭṭhikhantīhi saddhiṃ ruci vā, diṭṭhikhantirucīhi saddhiṃ laddhi vā, diṭṭhikhantiruciladdhīhi saddhiṃ ajjhāsayo vā, diṭṭhikhantiruciladdhiajjhāsayehi saddhiṃ adhippāyo vā hotī'ti dassento evaṃdiṭṭhikā… evaṃadhippāyā'ti āha.

meaning_1: of such a view; who holds the theory that; of the opinion that; who thinks that
example_1: evam'eva kho, poṭṭhapāda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti.
example_2: ahañ'hi, bho gotama, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhī, yo koci diṭṭhaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me diṭṭhan'ti, n'atthi tato doso
commentary: (UDa) evaṃ idāni vattabb'ākārena pavattā diṭṭhi etesan'ti evaṃdiṭṭhino.

meaning_1: living for so long; having such a long lifespan
example_1: ko pan'etaṃ bhoto kassapassa āroceti, atthi devā tāvatiṃsā'ti vā evaṃdīgh'āyukā devā tāvatiṃsā'ti vā.

meaning_1: of such nature; of such character
example_1: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.
example_2: so imam'eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, ayam'pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto'ti
commentary: (MNa) evaṃdhammo'ti ettha pana samādhipakkhikā dhammā dhammā'ti adhippetā.

example_1: ettha dāni mayaṃ there bhikkhū kiṃ vakkhāma, yatra hi nāma evaṃnavo bhikkhu satthāraṃ parirakkhitabbaṃ maññissati.
jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ evaṃnāmā evaṃgottā'ti vā, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti, amukasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā'ti?
example_2: amutr'āsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evam'āhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evam'āyupariyanto
commentary: (VINa) evaṃnāmo'ti vessantaro vā jotipālo vā. (MNa) evaṃnāmo'ti tatrā'pi tusitabhavane setaketu nāma devaputto ahosiṃ.

example_1: vaṭajālikāyan'ti evaṃnāmake vihāre. so kira vaṭavane niviṭṭhattā vaṭajālikā'ti saṅkhaṃ gato.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.

meaning_1: such a claim; such an assertion
example_1: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca te dhamme samādāya vattissāma, evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.
commentary: (ANt) evaṃpaṭiñño'ti salākaggahaṇ'ādīsu kittakā vihāre samaṇā'ti gaṇanāya āraddhāya aham'pi samaṇo, aham'pi samaṇo'ti paṭiññaṃ datvā salākaggahaṇ'ādīni karotī'ti samaṇo ahan'ti evaṃsamaṇappaṭiñño.

meaning_1: practising like this; going along like this; who practices in such a way
example_1: suppaṭipann'āttha, mārisā, ujuppaṭipann'āttha, mārisā, ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya. mayam'pi hi, mārisā, evaṃpaṭipannā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā'ti? iti puṭṭhā no'ti vadanti.
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yadidaṃ sukhā paṭipadā khipp'ābhiññā. evaṃpaṭipannā'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā. evaṃpaṭipannānam'pi kho, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo.

meaning_1: clung to in such a way; thus adhered to
meaning_2: clung to in such a way; thus adhered to
example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato pajānāti, ime diṭṭhiṭṭhānā evaṃgahitā evaṃparāmaṭṭhā evaṃgatikā bhavanti evaṃabhisamparāyā'ti, tañ'ca tathāgato pajānāti, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāti, tañ'ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasati, aparāmasato c'assa paccattaññ'eva nibbuti viditā.
commentary: (DNa) evaṃparāmaṭṭhā'ti nirāsaṅkacittatāya punappunaṃ āmaṭṭhā parāmaṭṭhā, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti pariniṭṭhāpitā. kāraṇasaṅkhātā pana diṭṭhiṭṭhānā yathā gayhamānā diṭṭhiyo samuṭṭhāpenti, evaṃ ārammaṇavasena ca pavattanavasena ca āsevanavasena ca gahitā. anādīnavadassitāya punappunaṃ gahaṇavasena parāmaṭṭhā.

meaning_1: having such faith; with confidence like this
meaning_2: having such faith; having such confidence
example_1: uḷārā kho te ayaṃ, sāriputta, āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ek'aṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito, evaṃpasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati, na c'āhu na ca bhavissati na c'eta'r'ahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyan'ti.
commentary: (DNa) evaṃpasanno'ti evaṃ uppannasaddho, evaṃ saddahāmī'ti attho.

meaning_1: so captivating; so bewitching; so enchanting
example_1: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, esā, kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma, yassā eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti.

meaning_1: yes indeed; exactly so; most certainly
example_1: evaṃbyākho ahaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti.

commentary: (SNa) okilinīvatthusmiṃ uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti sā kira aṅgāracitake nipannā vipphandamānā viparivattamānā paccati, tasmā uppakkā c'eva hoti uṇhena agginā pakkasarīrā, okilinī ca kilinnasarīrā, bindūni'ssā sarīrato paggharanti, okirinī ca aṅgārasamparikiṇṇā. tassā hi heṭṭhato'pi kiṃsukapupphavaṇṇā aṅgārā, ubhayapassesu'pi, ākāsato'pi'ssā upari patanti. tena vuttaṃ, uppakkaṃ okiliniṃ okirinin'ti.

commentary: (ANa) kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamamānā'ti randhagavesitāya upārambhapariyesanavasena kāḷakadhammaṃ okkamamānā. apica duṭṭhacittena puggalaṃ ghaṭṭentā'pi taṃ kaṇhadhammaṃ attano dahantā'pi lābhasakkār'atthaṃ kathentā'pi kaṇhadhammaṃ okkamanti'y'eva. (ANt) kaṇhadhamman'ti paccatte upayogavacanan'ti āha kaṇhasabhāvo hutvā abhijāyatī'ti, taṃ antogadhahetu-atthaṃ padaṃ, uppādetī'ti attho.

meaning_1: dark half of the month; waning moon; new moon

example_1: mātugāmo puriso ca, āveṇikā tidhammo ca, kodhano upanāhī ca, issukī maccharena ca, aticārī ca dussīlo, appassuto ca kusīto, muṭṭhassati pañcaveraṃ, kaṇhapakkhe pakāsito.
ye imesaṃ bhavataṃ dhammā akusalā akusalasaṅkhātā, sāvajjā sāvajjasaṅkhātā, asevitabbā asevitabbasaṅkhātā, na alam'ariyā na alam'ariyasaṅkhātā, kaṇhā kaṇhasaṅkhātā.

meaning_1: common krait; Bungarus caeruleus; (or) black cobra; Naja naja
example_1: asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañc'ime ādīnavā mātugāme.
example_2: mahanto ca so puriso cā'ti mahāpuriso, kaṇho ca so sappo cā'ti kaṇhasappo, nīlañ'ca taṃ uppalañ'cā'ti nīl'uppalaṃ, lohitañ'ca taṃ candanañcā'ti lohitacandanaṃ

meaning_1: black in nature; of evil nature

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubb'eva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato setā kimī kaṇhasīsā pādehi ussakkitvā yāva jāṇumaṇḍalā paṭicchādesuṃ.

meaning_1: black and white; dark and light
example_1: seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, jacc'andho puriso, so na passeyya kaṇhasukkāni rūpāni, na passeyya nīlakāni rūpāni, na passeyya pītakāni rūpāni, na passeyya lohitakāni rūpāni
example_2: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā, sāvajj'ānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā.
commentary: (MNa) kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgan'ti kaṇhaṃ c'eva sukkañ'ca, tañ'ca kho sappaṭibhāgaṃ savipakkhaṃ katvā, kaṇhaṃ paṭibāhitvā sukkan'ti sukkaṃ paṭibāhitvā kaṇhan'ti evaṃ sappaṭibhāgaṃ katvā kaṇhasukkaṃ deseti. kaṇhaṃ desento'pi saussāhaṃ savipākaṃ deseti, sukkaṃ desento'pi saussāhaṃ savipākaṃ deseti. (MNa) kaṇhasukkavipākan'ti sukhadukkhavipākaṃ.

meaning_1: bad and good; negative and positive
example_1: atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇh'āsukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
commentary: (MNa) kaṇhasukkan'ti vomissakakammaṃ.

meaning_1: with black and white and their counterparts; having black and white (states) and their opposites
example_1: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā, sāvajj'ānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā.
example_2: evaṃvādiṃ kho, bhikkhave, satthāraṃ arahati sāvako upasaṅkamituṃ dhammassavanāya. tassa satthā dhammaṃ deseti uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sappaṭibhāgā'ti kaṇhasukkāy'eva. kaṇhā hi kaṇhavipākadānato, sukkā ca sukkavipākadānato sappaṭibhāgā nāma, sadisavipākakoṭṭhāsā'ti attho. paṭipakkhabhūtassa vā bhāgassa atthitāya sappaṭibhāgā. kaṇhānañ'hi sukkā paṭipakkhabhāgā, sukkānañ'ca kaṇhā paṭipakkhabhāgā'ti evam'pi sappaṭibhāgā.

meaning_1: with bad and good results; having positive and negative consequences
example_1: atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇh'āsukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
commentary: (MNa) kaṇhasukkavipākan'ti sukhadukkhavipākaṃ. missakakammañ'hi katvā akusalena tiracchānayoniyaṃ maṅgalahatthiṭṭhān'ādīsu uppanno kusalena pavatte sukhaṃ vediyati. kusalena rājakule'pi nibbatto akusalena pavatte dukkhaṃ vediyati.

meaning_1: with black trail; leaving soot in its wake
example_1: pahūtabhakkhaṃ jālinaṃ, pāvakaṃ kaṇhavattaniṃ, daharo'ti n'āvajāneyya, na naṃ paribhave naro.
commentary: (SNa) kaṇhavattanin'ti vattanī'ti maggo, agginā gatamaggo kaṇho hoti kāḷako, tasmā kaṇhavattanī'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: with bad results; having negative consequences
example_1: atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ, atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇh'āsukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
commentary: (MNa) kaṇhavipākan'ti apāye nibbattanato kāḷakavipākaṃ.

meaning_1: name of a royal family of serpents
example_1: sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya. katamāni cattāri? virūp'akkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.

meaning_1: black class of beings; lowest class of beings
example_1: ko sutvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇh'ābhijātiyo, tasmā hi attakāmena, mahattam'abhikaṅkhatā, saddhammo garukātabbo, saraṃ buddhāna'sāsanan'ti.
example_2: tatr'idaṃ, bhante, pūraṇena kassapena kaṇh'ābhijāti paññattā, orabbhikā sūkarikā sākuṇikā māgavikā luddā macchaghātakā corā coraghātakā bandhan'āgārikā ye vā pan'aññe'pi keci kurūrakamm'antā.
commentary: (MNa) kaṇh'ābhijātiko'ti caṇḍāl'ādinīcakule jāto.

meaning_1: of low birth; belonging to an inferior social class
example_1: brahmabhūtaṃ atitulaṃ, mārasenappamaddanaṃ, ko disvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇh'ābhijātiko.
commentary: (MNa) kaṇh'ābhijātiko'ti caṇḍāl'ādinīcakule jāto.

meaning_1: belonging to the black class of beings
example_1: idh'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. idha pan'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. idha pan'ānanda, ekacco kaṇh'ābhijātiyo samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.
commentary: (ANa) kaṇh'ābhijātiko'ti kāḷakajātiko.

example_1: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca, kathaṃ gotto'si, ambaṭṭhā'ti? kaṇhāyano'ham'asmi, bho gotamā'ti.
khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti abbhaññāsi.
example_2: yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
commentary: (MNa) kataṃ karaṇīyan'ti… kiccaṃ niṭṭhāpitan'ti attho.

example_1: na paresaṃ vilomāni, na paresaṃ kat'ākataṃ, attano'va avekkheyya, katāni akatāni ca.
aṭṭhīnaṃ nagaraṃ kataṃ, maṃsalohitalepanaṃ, yattha jarā ca maccu ca, māno makkho ca ohito.
nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.
example_2: samāpajjeyyā'ti katena kataṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. katena akataṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. katena kat'ākataṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (VIN) nānappakārakaṃ nāma katam'pi akatam'pi kat'ākatam'pi. kataṃ nāma sīs'ūpagaṃ gīv'ūpagaṃ hatth'ūpagaṃ pād'ūpagaṃ kaṭ'ūpagaṃ. akataṃ nāma ghanakataṃ vuccati. kat'ākataṃ nāma tadubhayaṃ.

meaning_1: who has committed a theft; who has committed a crime
example_1: theyyasattho nāma corā katakammā vā honti akatakammā vā, rājānaṃ vā theyyaṃ gacchanti suṅkaṃ vā pariharanti.
example_2: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhante, bhikkhū ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ piṇḍāya carantā candanikam'pi pavisanti, oligalle'pi papatanti, kaṇṭak'āvāṭam'pi ārohanti, suttam'pi gāviṃ ārohanti, māṇavehi'pi samāgacchanti katakammehi'pi akatakammehi'pi, mātugāmo'pi te asaddhammena nimanteti.
commentary: (MNa) katakammehī'ti katacorakammehi. corā kira katakammā yaṃ nesaṃ devataṃ āyācitvā kammaṃ nipphannaṃ, tassa upahāratthāya manusse māretvā galalohit'ādīni gaṇhanti. te aññesu manussesu māriyamānesu kolāhalā uppajjissanti, pabbajitaṃ pariyesanto nāma n'atthī'ti maññamānā bhikkhū gahetvā mārenti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: dependent on contact of past action
who has done the job; who has done what needs to be done; who has fulfilled the obligation; epithet of an arahant
example_1: khīṇ'āsavassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanassa samma'd'aññāvimuttassa ayam'anudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya
example_2: yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññāvimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti
commentary: (SNa) catūhi maggehi karaṇīyaṃ etesaṃ katan'ti katakaraṇīyā.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.
commentary: (ANa) akatakalyāṇo'ti-ādīsu kalyāṇaṃ vuccati puññakammaṃ, taṃ akataṃ etenā'ti akatakalyāṇo. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: finished the job; done what needs to be done; epithet of an arahant
example_1: pāragū anupādāno, katakicco anāsavo, tuṭṭho āyukkhayā hoti, mutto āghātanā yathā.
example_2: jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) katakicco'ti catūhi maggehi kiccaṃ katvā ṭhito. (DHPa) catūhi maggehi soḷasannaṃ kiccānaṃ katattā katakiccaṃ

meaning_1: who has done wrong; who has done dirty things; who has committed sin
example_1: kiṃ sundarikā karissati, kiṃ payāgo kiṃ bāhukā nadī, veriṃ katakibbisaṃ naraṃ, na hi naṃ sodhaye pāpakamminaṃ.
example_2: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.
commentary: (ANa) kibbisan'ti samalaṃ aparisuddhakammaṃ

meaning_1: who has done good; who has made merit
example_1: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatapāpo hoti akataluddo akatakibbiso katakalyāṇo katakusalo katabhīruttāṇo. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.
example_2: yo'pi c'ettha katakusalo hoti, tam'pi ñātirogabhogabyasan'ādīnaṃ aññatarena byasanena samannāgataṃ disvā vā sutvā vā tesaṃ abhāve'pi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ anatikkantattā, dukkhito'va ayan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) puññakammam'eva hi kosallasambhūtattā kusalaṃ

meaning_2: a massage device made of a string with small balls

meaning_1: how many factors?; how many components?
example_1: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kat'aṅgavippahīnaṃ kat'aṅgasamannāgatan'ti? paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgavippahīnaṃ, pañc'aṅgasamannāgataṃ.

meaning_1: possessing how many factors?; endowed with how many components?
example_1: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kat'aṅgavippahīnaṃ kat'aṅgasamannāgatan'ti?

meaning_1: how many factors are abandoned?; how many components are given up?
example_1: paṭhamaṃ pan'āvuso, jhānaṃ kat'aṅgavippahīnaṃ kat'aṅgasamannāgatan'ti?
commentary: (MNa) kat'aṅgavippahīnan'ti idha pana kiṃ pucchati? nirodhaṃ samāpajjanakena bhikkhunā upakārānupakārāni aṅgāni jānitabbāni, tāni pucchissāmī'ti pucchati, vissajjanaṃ pan'ettha pākaṭam'eva. iti heṭṭhā nirodhapādakaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ gahitaṃ, upari tassa anantarapaccayaṃ n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatan-asamāpattiṃ pucchissati. antarā pana cha samāpattiyo saṃkhittā, nayaṃ vā dassetvā vissaṭṭhā'ti veditabbā.

meaning_2: having raised one's hands in salutation

example_1: gāravo ca nivāto ca, santuṭṭhi ca kataññutā, kālena dhammassavanaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
example_2: siyā kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ jarasiṅgāle yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā, na tv'eva idh'ekacce sakyaputtiyapaṭiññe siyā yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā.
commentary: (SNa) kataññutā'ti katajānanaṃ. (KHPa) kataññutā nāma appassa vā bahussa vā yena kenaci katassa upakārassa punappunaṃ anussaraṇabhāvena jānanatā. apica nerayik'ādi-dukkha-parittāṇato puññāni eva pāṇīnaṃ bah'ūpakārāni, tato tesam'pi upakār'ānussaraṇatā kataññutā'ti veditabbā. sā sappurisehi pasaṃsanīy'ādi-nānappakāra-vises'ādhigama-hetuto maṅgalan'ti vuccati. āha ca dve'me, bhikkhave, puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ. katame dve? yo ca pubbakārī yo ca kataññū katavedī'ti (a. ni. 2.120).

meaning_1: gratefulness and thankfulness; gratitude and appreciativeness
example_1: katamehi catūhi? kāyasucaritena, vacīsucaritena, manosucaritena, kataññutākataveditā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge'ti.
commentary: (SNa) kataññutā'ti katajānanaṃ. kataveditā'ti katavisesajānanaṃ.

example_1: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kataññuno bhavissāma katavedino, na ca no amhesu appakam'pi kataṃ nassissatī'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban'ti.
example_2: kataññunā me bhavituṃ vaṭṭatī'ti ekaṃ satasahassaṃ gāhāpetvā cūḷaseṭṭhissa samīpaṃ gato

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of kata
example_1: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano, dāsā'ti vā pessā'ti vā kammakarā'ti vā, tesaṃ katañ'ca katato jānāti akatañ'ca akatato jānāti, gilānakānañ'ca bal'ābalaṃ jānāti khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyañ'c'assa paccaṃsena saṃvibhajati.
commentary: (ANa) katañ'ca katato jānissāma, akatañ'ca akatato'ti sakaladivasaṃ idaṃ nāma kammaṃ katvā āgatānaṃ, upaḍḍhadivasaṃ idaṃ nāma kammaṃ katvā āgatānaṃ, nikkammānaṃ gehe nisinnānaṃ idaṃ nāma dātuñca evañ'ca kātuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti evaṃ jānissāma.

meaning_2: doing of, fact of having done
example_1: ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī'ti? katattā ca, brāhmaṇa, akatattā ca.
example_2: iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.

grammar: nt, abstr, abl sg of katatta
meaning_1: because of doing; from the fact of having done
example_1: ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī'ti? katattā ca, brāhmaṇa, akatattā ca.
example_2: iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: friendly reception made (by); kind welcome (of); hospitality shown (by)
example_1: tato sabbam'pi therena dinnakaṃ cetiyaghare ekaṃ varapotthakacitt'attharaṇaṃ na agghati. tato āhaṃsu, therena katapaṭisanthāro sukato codetuṃ vā sāretuṃ vā na labbhā, gīvā vā avahāro vā n'atthī'ti. evaṃ mah'ānisaṃso paṭisanthāro'ti sallakkhetvā kattabbo paṇḍitena bhikkhunā'ti.

meaning_1: familiar with others' doctrines; well acquainted with the beliefs of others; skilled in another's dogma
example_1: katamāni cattāri? idh'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi ekacce khattiyapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe, te bhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.
commentary: (MNa) kataparappavāde'ti viññātaparappavāde c'eva parehi saddhiṃ katavādaparicaye ca.

meaning_2: completed the preparations; done the arrangement
having practised or made acquaintance with

meaning_1: fact of being acquainted; fact of being familiar
example_1: sahapaṃsukīḷikā'ti etena nesaṃ dīgharattaṃ kataparicayabhāvaṃ dasseti. samāgaccheyyun'ti sālāya vā rukkhamūle vā sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyuṃ.

meaning_1: who has done evil; who has done wrong
example_1: puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.
commentary: (ANa) katapāpo'ti-ādīsu pāpaṃ vuccati lāmakaṃ akusalakammaṃ.

meaning_1: who has made merit; who has done good; has gained spiritual wealth
example_1: idha modati pecca modati, katapuñño ubhay'attha modati, so modati so pamodati, disvā kammavisuddhim'attano.
