example_1: katame cattāro? uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, kammaphal'ūpajīvī na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī, uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī c'eva kammaphal'ūpajīvī ca, n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti. catutthaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) uṭṭhānavīriyen'eva divasaṃ vītināmetvā tassa nissandaphalamattaṃ kiñci'd'eva labhitvā jīvikaṃ kappeti, taṃ pana uṭṭhānaṃ āgamma kiñci puññaphalaṃ nappaṭilabhati, ayaṃ uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī nāma. cātumahārājike pana deve ādiṃ katvā sabbe'pi devā uṭṭhānavīriyena vinā puññaphalass'eva upajīvanato kammaphal'ūpajīvino na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino nāma. rājarājamah'āmatt'ādayo uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino ca kammaphal'ūpajīvino ca. nerayikasattā n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino na kammaphal'ūpajīvino.

meaning_1: who is bound by actions; who is related to actions
example_1: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
commentary: (MNa) kammaṃ etesaṃ bandhū'ti kammabandhū. kammañātakā'ti attho.

meaning_2: being as action, kamma-process becoming, kammically accumulative existence
breaking into action, effecting of action
destroying the force or compulsion of action

meaning_1: born from actions; (or) having deeds as one's womb
example_1: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
commentary: (MNa) kammaṃ etesaṃ yoni kāraṇan'ti kammayonī

meaning_1: enjoying work; delighting in activity; taking pleasure in work; devoted to activity
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto
commentary: (ANa) tasmiṃ'y'eva kamme rato'ti kammarato.

meaning_1: characterized by one's actions; defined by one's deeds
example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kammalakkhaṇo bālo, kammalakkhaṇo paṇḍito'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na lakkhaṇakusalo hoti.
commentary: (ANa) kāyadvār'ādipavattaṃ kammaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ sañjānanakāraṇaṃ assā'ti kammalakkhaṇo

meaning_1: fact of being the owner of one's actions; fact that actions are one's property
example_1: tattha ca anulomikā khanti vipassanāñāṇaṃ. yathābhūtañāṇaṃ pana kammasakatāñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: having action as its reality; with deeds as its substance; with activity as fundamental; (comm) having action as inherent nature
example_1: purimāni, bho gotama, divasāni purimatarāni soṇakāyano māṇavo yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca, samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññapeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññapento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa, kammasacc'āyaṃ, bho, loko kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) kammasacc'āyaṃ bho loko'ti bho ayaṃ loko kammasabhāvo.

meaning_1: time of work; time of physical activity
example_1: tatth'āyaṃ samayo diyaḍḍho māso seso gimhānan'ti vassānassa paṭhamo māso icc'ete aḍḍhateyyamāsā uṇhasamayo, pariḷāhasamayo, gilānasamayo, kammasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, vātavuṭṭhisamayo
commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.7) kammasamayo nāma antamaso pariveṇam'pi sammaṭṭhaṃ hoti, kammasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: undertaking of activity; doing of a deed
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
commentary: (ANa) kammasamādānānan'ti samādiyitvā katānaṃ kusal'ākusalakammānaṃ, kammam'eva vā kammasamādānaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on the undertaking of activity

meaning_1: undertaking activity; initiating action; performing deeds
example_1: purimāni, bho gotama, divasāni purimatarāni soṇakāyano māṇavo yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca, samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññapeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññapento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa, kammasacc'āyaṃ, bho, loko kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti kammasamārambhena tiṭṭhati. kammaṃ āyūhanto'va tiṭṭhati, anāyūhanto ucchijjatī'ti dīpeti.

meaning_1: continuing through initiating action; persisting through the performance of deeds
example_1: samaṇo gotamo sabbakammānaṃ akiriyaṃ paññapeti, sabbakammānaṃ kho pana akiriyaṃ paññapento ucchedaṃ āha lokassa, kammasacc'āyaṃ, bho, loko kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) kammasamārambhaṭṭhāyī'ti kammasamārambhena tiṭṭhati. kammaṃ āyūhanto'va tiṭṭhati, anāyūhanto ucchijjatī'ti dīpeti.

example_1: yaṃ, bhikkhave, mohapakataṃ kammaṃ mohajaṃ mohanidānaṃ mohasamudayaṃ, taṃ kammaṃ akusalaṃ taṃ kammaṃ sāvajjaṃ taṃ kammaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ, taṃ kammaṃ kammasamudayāya saṃvattati, na taṃ kammaṃ kammanirodhāya saṃvattati.
commentary: (ANa) taṃ kammaṃ kammasamudayāya saṃvattatī'ti taṃ kammaṃ aññesam'pi vaṭṭagāmikammānaṃ samudayāya piṇḍakaraṇ'atthāya saṃvattati.
(VMVt) kammasampattiyo'ti sampannakammāni, visuddhakammānī'ti attho.

meaning_2: similar in consequence to the deed done

meaning_1: owner of actions; actions are one's property
example_1: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
commentary: (MNa) tattha kammaṃ etesaṃ sakaṃ attano bhaṇḍakan'ti kammassakā.

meaning_1: fact of being the owner of one's actions; fact that actions are one's property
example_1: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, puggale āghāto jāyetha, kammassakatā tasmiṃ puggale adhiṭṭhātabbā, kammassako ayam'āyasmā kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammappaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissati kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissatī'ti, evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.
commentary: (ADha) kammassakataṃ vā'ti idaṃ kammaṃ sattānaṃ sakaṃ, idaṃ no sakan'ti evaṃ jānanañāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: I am the owner of my actions; my actions are my own property
example_1: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
commentary: (MNa) tattha kammaṃ etesaṃ sakaṃ attano bhaṇḍakan'ti kammassakā.

meaning_2: round of kamma, phase of kamma

meaning_1: (vinaya) proclamation of the legal proposition; official legal statement
example_1: upasampādessāmī'ti gaṇaṃ vā ācariyaṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā.
example_2: ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā. kammavācāpariyosāne āpatti pācittiyassa.

meaning_1: (vinaya) completion of the legal statement; conclusion of the legal proposition
meaning_lit: end of stating of the matter
example_1: ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā. kammavācāpariyosāne upajjhāyassa āpatti pācittiyassa. gaṇassa ca ācariyassa ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
example_2: ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ. dvīhi kammavācāhi dukkaṭā. kammavācāpariyosāne āpatti pācittiyassa.

meaning_1: (proponent of the) doctrine of causality; who hold the view that actions have consequences
who is a proponent of the doctrine of causality; who holds the view that actions have consequences
meaning_2: holding the view of the efficacy of karma
example_1: te'pi, bhikkhave, makkhali moghapuriso paṭibāhati, n'atthi kammaṃ, n'atthi kiriyaṃ, n'atthi vīriyan'ti. aham'pi, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kammavādo c'eva kiriyavādo ca vīriyavādo ca.

meaning_1: believing actions have consequences; professing a belief in kamma
example_1: ito kho so, vaccha, ekanavuto kappo yam'ahaṃ anussarāmi, n'ābhijānāmi kañci ājīvakaṃ sagg'ūpagaṃ aññatra ekena, so'p'āsi kammavādī kiriyavādī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) so'p'āsi kammavādī'ti so'pi kammavādī ahosi, kiriyam'pi na paṭibāhittha. tañ'hi ekanavutikappamatthake attānaṃ'y'eva gahetvā katheti. tadā kira mahāsatto pāsaṇḍapariggaṇhan'atthaṃ pabbajito tassa'pi pāsaṇḍassa nipphalabhāvaṃ jānitvā vīriyaṃ na hāpesi, kiriyavādī hutvā sagge nibbattati. tasmā evam'āha.

meaning_1: fruit of actions; results of one's deeds
example_1: kammavipāko, bhikkhave, acinteyyo, na cintetabbo, yaṃ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.
example_2: pittaṃ semhañ'ca vāto ca, sannipātā utūni ca, visamaṃ opakkamikaṃ, kammavipākena aṭṭhamī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) kammavipāko'ti diṭṭhadhammavedanīy'ādīnaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko.

meaning_1: skilled in the results of action; (or) skilled in action and its results
example_1: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ, kammaṃ passanti paṇḍitā, paṭiccasamuppādadassā, kammavipākakovidā.
commentary: (MNa) kammavipākakovidā'ti sammān'āvamān'ārahakule kammavasena uppatti hoti, aññā'pi hīnapaṇītatā hīnapaṇīte kamme vipaccamāne hotī'ti. evaṃ kammavipākakusalā.

meaning_1: caused by the effect of actions; generated by the results of one's deeds
example_1: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
example_2: iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā vātasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā sannipātikā ābādhā utupariṇāmajā ābādhā visamaparihārajā ābādhā opakkamikā ābādhā kammavipākajā ābādhā sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo'ti.
commentary: (SNa) kammavipākajānī'ti kevalaṃ kammavipākato jātāni. tesu'pi hi uppannesu vuttanayen'eva koci kusalaṃ karoti, koci akusalaṃ, koci adhivāsento nipajjati. evaṃ sabbavāresu tividhāva vedanā honti. (ANa) kammavipākajā'ti balavakammavipākasambhūtā.

meaning_1: understanding of the fruit of actions; knowledge of the results of deeds
occasion for the fruit of actions

example_1: idha modati pecca modati, katapuñño ubhay'attha modati, so modati so pamodati, disvā kammavisuddhim'attano.

meaning_1: turning around of kamma; revolution of deeds; cycle of action
example_1: hantā labhati hantāraṃ, jetāraṃ labhate jayaṃ, akkosako ca akkosaṃ, rosetārañ'ca rosako, atha kammavivaṭṭena, so vilutto viluppatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) kammavivaṭṭenā'ti kammapariṇāmena, tassa vilumpanakammassa vipākadānena. (SNt) kammavivaṭṭenā'ti kammassa vivaṭṭanena, paccayalābhena laddhāvasarena vivaṭṭetvā vigamitena kammenā'ti attho.

meaning_1: does a deed; performs an action (with)
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca paṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ karoti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anusotagāmī puggalo.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti

example_1: anupubbena medhāvī, thokaṃ thokaṃ khaṇe khaṇe, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.
example_2: kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā rajena ca malena ca pariyonaddhā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā na c'eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca pariyodapeyyuṃ, raj'āpathe ca naṃ nikkhipeyyuṃ.
commentary: (MNa) kammārakulā… kaṃsapātikārakānaṃ kammārānaṃ gharato

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya adhimatto saddo hoti, evam'eva kho me, aggivessana, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
commentary: (MNa) kammāragaggariyā'ti kammārassa gaggaranāḷiyā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma nikkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkha-kammāraputta-ukkāmukha-sukusala-sampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
example_2: evaṃ me sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane
commentary: (DNa) kammāraputtassā'ti suvaṇṇakāraputtassa.

meaning_1: story of Cunda the smith's son
who carries blacksmith's tools; (or) shaven blacksmith
example_1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro kammārabhaṇḍu mātāpitūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūsu pabbajito hoti.
commentary: (VINa) kammārabhaṇḍū'ti tulādhāramuṇḍako suvaṇṇakāraputto, pañcasikho taruṇadārako'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: fit to participate in a legal action
example_1: anāpatti adhammena vā vaggena vā na kamm'ārahassa vā kammaṃ katan'ti jānanto ukkoṭeti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (VVt) tathā kamm'ārahassa cā'ti yassa saṅgho kammaṃ karoti, so n'eva kammapatto, n'āpi chand'āraho, apica kamm'āraho'ti

meaning_1: enjoying activity; taking pleasure in work
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto
commentary: (DNa) kammaṃ ārāmo etesan'ti kamm'ārāmā'ti.

example_1: yāvakīvañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na kamm'ārāmā bhavissanti na kammaratā na kamm'ārāmatam'anuyuttā, vuddhi'y'eva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti, kammarato, kamm'ārāmatam'anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti, bhassarato, bhass'ārāmatam'anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti, niddārato, nidd'ārāmatam'anuyutto. ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
commentary: (DNa) kammaṃ ārāmo etesan'ti kamm'ārāmā'ti. kamme ratā'ti kammaratā. kamm'ārāmatam'anuyuttā'ti yuttā payuttā anuyuttā. (ITIa) tattha kammaṃ āramitabbato ārāmo etassā'ti kamm'ārāmo. kamme rato'ti kammarato. kamm'ārāmataṃ kamm'ābhiratiṃ anuyutto payutto'ti kamm'ārāmatam'anuyutto. tattha kammaṃ nāma itikattabbaṃ kammaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, cīvaravicāraṇaṃ, cīvarakaraṇaṃ, upatthambhanaṃ, pattatthavikaṃ, aṃsabandhanaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ, dhamakaraṇaṃ, ādhārakaṃ, pādakathalikaṃ, sammajjanī'ti evamādīnaṃ upakaraṇānaṃ karaṇaṃ, yañ'ca vihāre khaṇḍaphull'ādi-paṭisaṅkharaṇaṃ.

meaning_1: enjoyment of activity; pleasure of work
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kamm'ārāmo hoti kammarato kamm'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhass'ārāmo hoti bhassarato bhass'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, nidd'ārāmo hoti niddārato nidd'ārāmataṃ anuyutto
example_2: na kamm'ārāmatā, na bhass'ārāmatā, na nidd'ārāmatā, na saṅgaṇik'ārāmatā, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, asaṃsagg'ārāmatā, nippapañc'ārāmatā.
commentary: (DNa) kamme ratā'ti kammaratā.

example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo, bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārake.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) yassa antar'antarā bhinnāni, tassa antar'antarā visabhāgabinduvicitrā gāvī viya kammāsaṃ nāma hoti.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī, na santatakārī na santatavutti, sīlesu dussīlo ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā sīlavā'ti.

meaning_1: name of a town in the Kuru country
meaning_2: name of a town in the Kuru country
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo.
commentary: (DNa) kammāsadhamman'ti ettha keci dha-kārassa da-kārena atthaṃ vaṇṇayanti. kammāso ettha damito'ti kammāsadammo. kammāso'ti kammāsapādo porisādo vuccati. tassa kira pāde khāṇukena viddhaṭṭhāne vaṇo ruhanto cittadārusadiso hutvā ruhi. tasmā kammāsapādo'ti paññāyittha. so ca tasmiṃ okāse damito

meaning_1: name of a town in the Kuru country
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo, bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārake.
commentary: (MNa) kururaṭṭhavāsīnaṃ kira kuruvattadhammo tasmiṃ kammāso jāto, tasmā taṃ ṭhānaṃ kammāso ettha dhammo jāto'ti kammāsadhamman'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: fact of performing actions which obstruct one
commentary: (ANa) kamm'āvaraṇatāyā'ti pañc'ānantariyakammehi.

meaning_1: absence of an action which obstructs

kāyasuciṃ vacīsuciṃ, cetosuciṃ anāsavaṃ, suciṃ soceyyasampannaṃ, āhu ninhātapāpakan'ti.

meaning_1: conduct of a dog; dog's behaviour

meaning_1: hot ash hell; burning ember hell

meaning_1: name of a hell; (comm) the heat of household life
example_1: kukkuḷā ubbhato tāta, kukkuḷaṃ patitum'icchasi, narakā ubbhato tāta, narakaṃ patitum'icchasi.

ku'icc'etassa kad hoti sare pare. kucchitaṃ annaṃ kadannaṃ, kucchitaṃ asanaṃ kadassanaṃ.

meaning_2: burning sensation in the stomach; stomach inflammation

for looking after the stomach; for taking care of the belly

commentary: (MNa) kucchimatī'ti āpannasattā.

meaning_1: disease of the stomach; stomach pain

meaning_1: son of a good family; respectable young man; young gentleman

meaning_1: stingy with families; selfish about supporters
example_1: āvāsamaccharinī hoti, kulamaccharinī hoti, lābhamaccharinī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharinī hoti, dhammamaccharinī hoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yath'ābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye.

meaning_2: selfishness, meanness in regard to (supportive) families

meaning_1: family lineage; family heritage; family tree
example_1: ariyaṃ kho ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, lok'uttaraṃ dhammaṃ purisassa sandhanaṃ paññapemi. porāṇaṃ kho pan'assa mātāpettikaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ anussarato yattha yatth'eva attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti tena ten'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

meaning_1: from family to family; from house to house
example_1: kulākulaṃ piṇḍikāya caranto, indriyagutto nipako satīmā, sevetha pantāni sen'āsanāni, bhayā pamutto abhaye vimutto.
commentary: (SNa) idāni saṅghe vasamānassa bhikkhuno bhikkhācāravattaṃ ācikkhanto kulākulan'ti-ādim'āha.

example_1: tayo kho, bhante kassapa, atthavase paṭicca bhagavatā kulesu tikabhojanaṃ paññattaṃ, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, mā pāp'icchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ, kul'ānuddayatāya ca.
commentary: (SNa) kul'ānuddayatāya cā'ti bhikkhusaṅghe uposathapavāraṇaṃ katvā samaggavāsaṃ vasante manussā salākabhatt'ādīni datvā saggaparāyaṇā bhavanti, iti imāya kul'ānuddayatāya ca paññattan'ti attho. (VBt) kul'ānuddayatāya cā'ti kulānaṃ pasādarakkhaṇ'atthaṃ. (KVt) kul'ānuddayatāyā'ti kul'ānukampakatāya.

example_1: laṭukikā'pi kho, ambaṭṭha, sakuṇikā sake kulāvake kāmalāpinī hoti. sakaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, ambaṭṭha, sakyānaṃ yadidaṃ kapilavatthuṃ, n'ārahat'āyasmā ambaṭṭho imāya appamattāya abhisajjitun'ti.
commentary: (DNa) kulāvake'ti nivāsanaṭṭhāne.

example_1: kacci te kuṭikā n'atthi, kacci n'atthi kulāvakā, kacci santānakā n'atthi, kacci mutto'si bandhanā'ti.

meaning_1: woman of the family; mistress of the household; a woman of good family
meaning_2: woman of the family; mistress of the household; a woman of good family

example_2: te kul'itthīhi kuladhītāhi kulakumārīhi kulasuṇhāhi kuladāsīhi saddhiṃ ekabhājane'pi bhuñjanti, ekathālake'pi pivanti, ek'āsane'pi nisīdanti, ekamañce'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ekapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti, ek'attharaṇapāvuraṇā'pi tuvaṭṭenti

meaning_1: part of a family; belonging to a household
example_1: khīṇakulīne kapaṇe, anubhūtaṃ te dukhaṃ aparimāṇaṃ, assū ca te pavattaṃ, bahūni ca jātisahassāni.
example_2: nagaramhi kusumanāme, pāṭaliputtamhi pathaviyā maṇḍe, sakyakulakulīnāyo, dve bhikkhuniyo hi guṇavatiyo.
commentary: (DNa) brāhmaṇakulīnā'ti brāhmaṇesu kulīnā kulasampannā. (THIa) sakyakulakulīnāyo'ti sakyakule kuladhītaro, sakyaputtassa bhagavato sāsane pabbajitatāya evaṃ vuttaṃ.

example_1: āyuṃ arogiyaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, saggaṃ uccākulīnataṃ, ratiyo patthayantena, uḷārā apar'āparā.

meaning_2: (a bed), having the legs in the shapes of a crab

meaning_1: who approaches families; who visits houses

commentary: (SNa) kul'ūpako'ti kulagharānaṃ upagantā.

commentary: (SNa) kul'ūpaghātaṃ maññe carasī'ti kulāni upaghātento viya hananto viya āhiṇḍasi.

meaning_2: (being) a family associate; (one) dependent on, intimate with, household or several households

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati. tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjī'ti.
commentary: (KVa) kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti yasmiṃ kule nimantito, tato aññāni kulāni paviseyya.

example_1: ye taranti aṇṇavaṃ saraṃ, setuṃ katvāna visajja pallalāni, kullañ'hi jano bandhati, tiṇṇā medhāvino janā'ti.

meaning_2: belonging to the family; part of the home
state of a man of nobility; shallow state (of meditation)

meaning_1: like a boat; similar to a raft
example_1: kull'ūpamaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desitaṃ, ājānantehi dhammā'pi vo pahātabbā pag'eva adhammā.

meaning_1: tip of a blade of Kusa grass
meaning_2: point of a blade of kusa
example_1: māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
example_2: pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūti vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.
commentary: (ITIa) pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggenā'ti yathā kucchitabhāvena pūtibhūtaṃ macchaṃ kusatiṇ'aggena yo puriso upanayhati puṭabandhavasena bandhati, tassa te kusā apūtikā'pi pūtimacchasambandhena pūti duggandham'eva vāyanti.

meaning_1: garment made from strips of kusa grass
example_1: so sāṇāni'pi dhāreti masāṇāni'pi dhāreti chavadussāni'pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni'pi dhāreti tirīṭāni'pi dhāreti ajinam'pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam'pi dhāreti kusacīram'pi dhāreti vākacīram'pi dhāreti phalakacīram'pi dhāreti kesakambalam'pi dhāreti vāḷakambalam'pi dhāreti ulūkapakkham'pi dhāreti
commentary: (MNa) kusacīran'ti kusatiṇaṃ ganthetvā katacīraṃ.

meaning_1: spread with blades of kusa grass
example_1: upavutthassa me pubbe, yiṭṭhu'kāmassa me sato, aggi pajjalito āsi, kusapattaparitthato.
commentary: (DNa) aggi pajjalito āsi, kusapattaparitthato'ti kusapattehi paritthato sappidadhimadhu-ādīni pakkhipitvā aggi jalayitum'āraddho āsi, evaṃ aggiṃ jāletvā mahājanassa dānaṃ dassāmī'ti evaṃ cintetvā ṭhitassa mamā'ti ayam'ettha attho.

example_1: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, vikalake tosetvā kusapātaṃ kātun'ti.

meaning_1: healthy; beneficial; useful; good; wholesome; karmically profitable

example_2: kusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyena kammaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.

commentary: (PMa) kusalasaddo tāva ārogy'ānavajja-cheka-sukhavipākesu dissati.

example_2: vicittavatth'ābharaṇā, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, kusalā naccagītassa, sakkassa paricārikā.

meaning_1: master (of); expert (in); adept (in) familiar (with); person skilled (in)
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agāriyabhūto vīṇāya tantissare'ti?
example_2: kāmesu n'ābhigijjheyya, manas'ānāvilo siyā, kusalo sabbadhammānaṃ, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.

meaning_1: good; benefit; merit; good deed; doing good
example_1: yathā'pi puppharāsimhā, kayirā mālāguṇe bahū, evaṃ jātena maccena, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ bahuṃ.
example_2: kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha. sakkā, bhikkhave, kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ. no ce'daṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvethā'ti.

example_1: tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

meaning_1: skillful course of action; wholesome kind of deed
example_1: dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu dasa kusalakammapathā sabbena sabbaṃ antaradhāyissanti, dasa akusalakammapathā atibyādippissanti
commentary: (PMa) dasa akusalakammapathā nāma pāṇ'ātipāto adinn'ādānaṃ kāmesumicchācāro'ti tīṇi kāyaduccaritāni, musāvādo pisuṇā vācā pharusā vācā samphappalāpo'ti cattāri vacīduccaritāni, abhijjhā byāpādo micchādiṭṭhī'ti tīṇi manoduccaritāni.

example_1: taṃ kissa hetu? na h'ettha, bhikkhave, atthi dhammacariyā, samacariyā, kusalakiriyā, puññakiriyā. aññam'aññakhādikā ettha, bhikkhave, vattati dubbalakhādikā.

meaning_1: seeking what is good; looking for what is beneficial
example_1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃ kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃ.
commentary: (MNa) kiṃ kusalagavesī'ti kiṃ kusalan'ti gavesamāno.

example_1: kiṃ pan'eso, samma sārathi, pabbajito nāmā'ti? eso kho, deva, pabbajito nāma sādhu dhammacariyā sādhu samacariyā sādhu kusalacariyā sādhu puññakiriyā sādhu avihiṃsā sādhu bhūt'ānukampā'ti.

meaning_1: good quality; wholesome state; skilful quality
example_1: sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! app'iccho so, bhikkhu, kulaputto. sante'y'eva attani kusaladhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne.

meaning_1: interest in good qualities; impulse for wholesome states; desire for skilful traits
fact of having skilful qualities; fact of having good principles; virtuousness; wholesomeness
example_1: idha, brāhmaṇa, bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya, bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
commentary: (ANa) ariye ñāye'ti sahavipassanake magge. kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā'ti'pi tass'eva nāmāni.

meaning_1: teaching good qualities; explaining wholesome states
having wholesome qualities; possessing skilful attributes
example_1: kiṃ nu kho, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā sabbesaṃ'y'eva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti? sabb'ākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgato'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sabb'ākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgato'ti ettha sabbesaṃ'y'eva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti. āma vaṇṇetī'ti vutte yathā pucchā, tathā attho vutto bhaveyya. evaṃ byākaraṇaṃ pana na bhāriyaṃ. appahīnaakusalo'pi hi pahānaṃ vaṇṇeyya, bhagavā pana pahīn'ākusalatāya yathākārī tathāvādī'ti dassetuṃ evaṃ byākāsi. sukkapakkhe'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: taking up good qualities; undertaking skilful states
example_1: evam'etaṃ, bhaddiya, evam'etaṃ, bhaddiya! sabbe ce'pi, bhaddiya, khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhamm'ūpasampadāya, sabbesam'pi'ssa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
commentary: (ANa) kusaladhamm'ūpasampadāyā'ti kusaladhammānaṃ sampādan'atthāya, paṭilābh'atthāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: tisso kusaladhātuyo, nekkhammadhātu, abyāpādadhātu, avihiṃsādhātu.

meaning_1: based on wholesome states; founded on what is skilful
example_1: tassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhāti, so tena saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati
commentary: (MNa) upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhātī'ti idha vipassan'upekkhā adhippetā. upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhātī'ti idha chaḷaṅg'upekkhā, sā pan'esā kiñ'c'āpi khīṇ'āsavassa iṭṭh'āniṭṭhesu ārammaṇesu arajjanādi-vasena pavattati, ayaṃ pana bhikkhu vīriyabalena bhāvanāsiddhiyā attano vipassanaṃ khīṇ'āsavassa chaḷaṅg'upekkhāṭhāne ṭhapetī'ti vipassanā'va chaḷaṅg'upekkhā nāma jātā. (MNt) kusalanissitaṃ nimittan'ti kusalacittappavattikāraṇaṃ (MNt) kusalanissitan'ti kusalena nissitaṃ nissayitabbaṃ.

meaning_lit: on the side of the skilful
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, vīsati kusalapakkhā, vīsati akusalapakkhā, mahācattārīsako dhammapariyāyo pavattito appaṭivattiyo samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
commentary: (MNa) vīsati kusalapakkhā'ti sammādiṭṭhi'ādayo dasa, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttā dasā'ti evaṃ vīsati kusalapakkhā honti.

meaning_1: connected with the beneficial; siding with the skillful
meaning_lit: on the side of the wholesome
meaning_2: practice belonging to the group of good qualities
example_1: ye keci, bhikkhave, dhammā kusalā kusalabhāgiyā kusalapakkhikā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvessati, satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkarissati.

meaning_1: part of the wholesome; associated with what is beneficial
example_1: ye keci, bhikkhave, dhammā kusalā kusalabhāgiyā kusalapakkhikā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvessati, satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkarissati.
tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, kusalamūlāni. katamāni tīṇi? alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ.
example_2: yadapi, bhikkhave, alobho tadapi kusalamūlaṃ. yadapi aluddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi kusalaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) kusalamūlan'ti alobh'āditividhakusaladhammo. (ANa) kusalamūlan'ti kusal'ajjhāsayo.

meaning_1: asks after another's health; asks how are you?
heap of the wholesome; pile of benefit
example_1: kusalarāsī'ti, bhikkhave, vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya. kevalo h'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kusalarāsi, yadidaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.

meaning_lit: discourse on the heap of wholesome

example_1: tayo kusalasaṅkappā, nekkhammasaṅkappo, abyāpādasaṅkappo, avihiṃsāsaṅkappo.

meaning_1: what is considered good; what is considered beneficial
example_1: siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, ye no dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tehi vivecetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. kusalā c'eva vo te dhammā hontu kusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.
tisso kusalasaññā, nekkhammasaññā, abyāpādasaññā, avihiṃsāsaññā.
samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalasīlena samannāgato
example_2: yam'pi, bhante, bhagavā sīlavā vuddhasīlo ariyasīlo kusalasīlo kusalasīlena samannāgato, idam'pi kho ahaṃ, bhante, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno bhagavati evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karomi, mett'ūpahāraṃ upadaṃsemi.
commentary: (DNa) catupārisuddhisīlena sīlavā, taṃ pana sīlaṃ ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ. ten'āha, ariyasīlī'ti. tadetaṃ anavajj'aṭṭhena kusalaṃ. ten'āha, kusalasīlī'ti. kusalasīlenā'ti idam'assa vevacanaṃ.

meaning_1: skilled in ethical conduct; conducting oneself skilfully
example_1: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalena sīlena samannāgato
commentary: (MNa) tadeva anavajj'aṭṭhena kusalaṃ, ten'āha kusalasīlī'ti. kusalena sīlenā'ti idam'assa vevacanaṃ.

meaning_1: achieving good; attaining what is skilful
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññanti, bhonto devā tāvatiṃsā, yāva supaññattā c'ime tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro satipaṭṭhānā paññattā kusalass'ādhigamāya.
commentary: (DNa) kusalass'ādhigamāyā'ti maggakusalassa c'eva phalakusalassa ca adhigam'atthāya. ubhayam'pi h'etaṃ anavajj'aṭṭhena khem'aṭṭhena vā kusalam'eva.

meaning_1: doing good deeds; undertaking skilful actions; making merit
meaning_2: to be committed to the good
example_1: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalass'ūpasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.

meaning_1: healthy thinking; wholesome thought; skilful thinking
example_1: tayo'me, bhikkhave, kusalavitakkā anandhakaraṇā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhikā avighātapakkhikā nibbānasaṃvattanikā. katame tayo?

meaning_1: good result of actions; wholesome fruit of deeds
meaning_2: fruit of result of good action

meaning_1: asked how one is; enquired about one's health
example_1: tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

grammar: masc pl, sometimes derog, from kusala
example_1: sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.
example_2: taṃ vā'pi ganthaṃ kusalā vadanti, yaṃ nissito passati hīnam'aññaṃ, tasmā hi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ bhikkhu na nissayeyya.

meaning_2: right practices or actions; good conduct; virtues; factors conducing to well-being

meaning_1: skilful and unskilful; wholesome and unwholesome; good and bad
example_1: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā, sāvajj'ānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā.
commentary: (SNa) kusal'ākusalā dhammā'ti-ādīsu kusalā'ti kosallasambhūtā anavajjasukhavipākā. akusalā'ti akosallasambhūtā sāvajjadukkhavipākā.

meaning_1: what is skilful and what is unskilful; what is wholesome and what is unwholesome; what is good and what is bad
example_1: dīgharatt'āhaṃ bhotā gotamena sahakathī. sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo saṃkhittena kusal'ākusalaṃ desetū'ti.

meaning_1: wholesome and unwholesome action; skilful and unskilful deeds
what is called good and bad intention
seeking what is good; (comm) seeking omniscience
example_1: paradhammikānam'pi na santaseyya, disvā'pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, ath'āparāni abhisambhaveyya, parissayāni kusal'ānuesī.
commentary: (DNa) kiṃ kusal'ānuesī'ti kiṃ kusalan'ti anuesanto pariyesanto. tattha, kiṃ kusalan'ti sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ adhippetaṃ, taṃ gavesanto'ti attho.

meaning_1: outflow of good; wholesome result; stream of merit
meaning_2: outflow of good; issue of good
example_1: ayaṃ paṭhamo puññ'ābhisando kusal'ābhisando sukhass'āhāro.
commentary: (SNa) puññ'ābhisandā kusal'ābhisandā'ti puññanadiyo kusalanadiyo. (ANt) kusal'ābhisandā'ti kusalānaṃ pavāhā.

meaning_1: with wholesome outcomes; with good future results

example_1: ekam'pi ce pāṇam'aduṭṭhacitto, mettāyati kusalī tena hoti, sabbe ca pāṇe manas'ānukampī, pahūtamariyo pakaroti puññaṃ.
kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) kusalan'ti idaṃ vacanaṃ imassa atthī'ti kusalī, tesaṃ therānaṃ tvaṃ kusalaṃ anavajjaṃ bhāsasi, thomesi pasaṃsasi, paṇḍito'si devaputtā'ti vadati.

meaning_2: (comm) coming from what is good, resulting from what is good; producing good in the future

meaning_1: connected with the wholesome; to do with the skilful
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.
example_2: yam'pi'ssa kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam'pi'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti. yasmiṃ, bhante, samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, imāni'ssa pañca ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na hontī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dān'ādiupakaraṇānaṃ asampattiyā uppajjamānaṃ pana kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassan'ti

meaning_1: headed by Kusāvatī, the royal capital
meaning_2: headed by Kusāvatī, the royal capital
example_1: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa caturāsīti nagarasahassāni ahesuṃ kusāvatī-rājadhāni-ppamukhāni

meaning_1: grounds for laziness; basis for sloth
example_1: aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, kusītavatthūni. katamāni aṭṭha?
commentary: (ANa) kusītavatthūnī'ti kusītassa alasassa vatthūni patiṭṭhā, kosajjakāraṇānī'ti attho.

meaning_1: (taking from) the mouth of a pot
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo acelako hoti mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano na-ehibhaddantiko natiṭṭhabhaddantiko, n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati, so na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhāti na khaḷopimukho paṭiggaṇhāti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ…
commentary: (DNa) na kaḷopimukhā'ti kaḷopī'ti ukkhali vā pacchi vā, tato'pi na gaṇhati. kasmā? kumbhikaḷopiyo maṃ nissāya kaṭacchunā pahāraṃ labhantī'ti.

example_1: caṇḍaṃ kukkuraṃ parivajjeti, ahiṃ khāṇuṃ kaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ sobbhaṃ papātaṃ candanikaṃ oḷigallaṃ
example_2: kīdiso, bho purisa, kiṃsuko'ti? so evaṃ vadeyya, kāḷako kho, ambho purisa, kiṃsuko, seyyathā'pi jhāmakhāṇū'ti.

example_1: tasmiṃ khaṇe thāmasampanno eko sūrapuriso vegena taṃ pāpuṇi. so taṃ disvā ekaṃ vatiṃ laṅghanto khadirakhāṇukaṃ akkami, khāṇuko piṭṭhipādena nikkhami. lohitena paggharantena laṅghamāno yāti.

meaning_1: place full of stumps and thorns
example_1: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, āsabhacammaṃ saṅkusatena suvihataṃ vigatavalikaṃ, evam'eva kho, ānanda, bhikkhu yaṃ imissā pathaviyā ukkūlavikkūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ amanasikaritvā pathavīsaññaṃ paṭicca manasi karoti ekattaṃ.

meaning_2: name of a Brahman village in Magadha

construction:
khāṇu + mant + a + ka
khāṇumata + ka

ayasā'va malaṃ samuṭṭhitaṃ, tat'uṭṭhāya tam'eva khādati, evaṃ atidhonacārinaṃ, sāni kammāni nayanti duggatiṃ.
example_2: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, biḷāro sandhisamalasaṅkaṭīre ṭhito ahosi mudumūsiṃ maggayamāno, yadā'yaṃ mudumūsi gocarāya pakkamissati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā khādissāmī'ti.

example_1: asso'va jiṇṇo nibbhogo, khādanā apanīyati, bālakānaṃ pitā thero, par'āgāresu bhikkhati.
commentary: (VINa) catubhāgaṃ khādanan'ti odanassa catutthabhāgappamāṇaṃ khādanaṃ, taṃ hatthahāriyassa muggasūpassa vasena veditabbaṃ.

example_1: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane. katame pañca? cakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonandhati, bhattam'assa chādeti.
bhante, nāgadīpaṃ gantvā macche khādin'ti. āvuso, tava macchakhādanena kammaṃ n'atthi, āpattiṃ kir'asi āpanno'ti.

meaning_1: edible food; raw food; non-staple food (e.g. vegetables, sweets)
example_1: yam'pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatra'p'ime mukh'āvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī'ti.
example_2: annānam'atho pānānaṃ, khādanīyānaṃ atho'pi vatthānaṃ, laddhā na sannidhiṃ kayirā, na ca parittase tāni alabhamāno.
commentary: (DNa) khādanīyāni nāma piṭṭhakhajjak'ādīni. (VIN 2.5.4.5) khādanīyaṃ nāma pañca bhojanāni, yāmakālikaṃ satt'āhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādanīyaṃ nāma.

example_1: tatr'āyam'adhippāyo, mayā nimantitānaṃ vassaṃvutthānaṃ tumhākaṃ temāsaṃ divase divase pāto yāgukhajjakaṃ, majjh'anhike khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ, sāy'anhe anekavidha pānavikati gandhapupph'ādīhi pūjāsakkāro'ti evam'ādiko yo deyyadhammo dātabbo assa, so na dinno'ti.
bhante pubbe dīpino eḷake khādanti ahaṃ pana eḷake dīpino anubandhitvā murumurū'ti khādante addasaṃ
example_2: kiñ'c'āpi so tāni khādanto c'eva paribhuñjanto ca sukhito bhogasamappito viya gacchati, atha kho taṃ n'eva koci, sukhito ayaṃ mahābhogo'ti maññati

meaning_2: act of feeding, causing to be eaten

example_1: petāni bhoti puttāni, khādamānā tuvaṃ pure, tuvaṃ divā ca ratto ca, atīva paritappasi.
commentary: (THIa) khādamānā'ti lokavohāravasena khuṃsanavacanam'etaṃ. loke hi yassā itthiyā jātajātā puttā maranti, taṃ garahantā puttakhādinī'tiādiṃ vadanti.

meaning_2: cause to eat; feeds; causes to be eaten

example_1: sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.
commentary: (SNPa) rājakhādāyā'ti rājakhādanīyena, bhattavetanenā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: having made (someone) eat (something); having caused to be eaten (by)

meaning_2: causing to make to eat or bite
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bālo passati rājāno coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente… palālapīṭhakam'pi karonte tattena'pi telena osiñcante sunakhehi'pi khādāpente jīvantam'pi sūle uttāsente asinā'pi sīsaṃ chindante.

meaning_1: wanting to eat; wishing to devour

meaning_1: smell of lye; odour of alkaline soda
example_1: kiñ'c'āpi taṃ hoti vatthaṃ parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ, atha khv'assa hoti y'eva anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato. tam'enaṃ rajako sāmikānaṃ deti.

meaning_1: foothold; footing; ground for standing on (in)

commentary: (SNa) gādhan'ti patiṭṭhaṃ

meaning_1: finds a footing; stands firmly; is well grounded; finds a support

example_2: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā. ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.

meaning_1: gets a foothold; finds a footing

commentary: (SNa) gādham'edhatī'ti udakaṃ otaraṇakāle gambhīre udake patiṭṭhaṃ labhati.

meaning_2: stood fast, had a firm footing

example_1: yathā'pi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandham'aheṭhayaṃ, paleti rasam'ādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
example_2: yathā brahmā tathā eko, yathā devo tathā duve, yathā gāmo tathā tayo, kolāhalaṃ tat'uttarin'ti.

example_1: gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ
cakkhūhi n'eva lol'assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca n'ānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) gāmakathāya āvaraye sotan'ti tiracchānakathāto sotaṃ āvareyya.

meaning_1: village monastery; house in a village
example_1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gāmak'āvāse vassaṃvuṭṭhā sāvatthiṃ agamaṃsu vattasampannā iriyāpathasampannā duccoḷā lūkhacīvarā.
commentary: (PYt) gāmak'āvāsan'ti gāmo'y'eva khuddak'aṭṭhena gāmako, tasmiṃ kārito āvāso gāmak'āvāso, taṃ.

meaning_2: village magistrate; village chief (with a connotation of dishonesty?)
commentary: (VINa) gāmakūṭo'ti vinicchay'āmacco.

meaning_1: corrupt village magistrate; crooked judge; (or) village headman
example_1: tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kākā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti. so sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃ'y'eva rājagahe gāmakūṭako ahosi
commentary: (SNa) gāmakūṭako'ti vinicchay'āmacco. (SNt) vinicchay'āmacco'ti raññā aḍḍakaraṇe ṭhapito vinicchayamah'āmatto. so hi gāmajanakāyaṃ kūṭeti vañcetī'ti gāmakūṭako'ti vuccati. keci tādiso eva gāmajeṭṭhako gāmakūṭako'ti vadanti.

example_1: ye kho te samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ āgacchanti, atithī no te honti. atithī kho pan'amhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā.
commentary: (ANa) dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettānī'ti ettha māgadhikaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ atthi khuddakaṃ, atthi majjhimaṃ, atthi mahantaṃ. khuddakaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ ito cattālīsaṃ usabhāni, ito cattālīsan'ti gāvutaṃ hoti, majjhimaṃ ito gāvutaṃ, ito gāvutan'ti aḍḍhayojanaṃ hoti, mahantaṃ ito diyaḍḍhagāvutaṃ, ito diyaḍḍhagāvutan'ti tigāvutaṃ hoti. tesu khuddakena gāmakkhettena tīṇi, khuddakena ca majjhimena ca dve gāmakkhettāni tassa attabhāvo. tigāvutañ'hi'ssa sarīraṃ.

example_1: hitvān'ahaṃ ñātigaṇaṃ, dāsakammakarāni ca, gāmakhettāni phītāni, ramaṇīye pamodite.
commentary: (THIa) gāmakhettānī'ti gāme ca pubb'aṇṇ'āpar'aṇṇa-viruhana-kkhettāni ca, gāmapariyāpannāni vā khettāni.

example_1: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, goṇo kiṭṭh'ādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā, ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya, tam'eva purimaṃ daṇḍasamphassaṃ samanussaranto.
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ, ayañ'ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti. taṃ kaṇṭako'ti iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo.

example_1: adinn'ādāyī hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā taṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.
commentary: (MNa) gāmagataṃ vā'ti antogāme vā ṭhapitaṃ.

example_1: yassa kassaci, mahānāma, kulaputtassa pañca dhammā saṃvijjanti, yadi vā rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa, yadi vā raṭṭhikassa pettanikassa, yadi vā senāya senāpatikassa, yadi vā gāmagāmaṇikassa, yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, ye vā pana kulesu paccek'ādhipaccaṃ kārenti, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā, raṭṭhiko … pettaṇiko… senāpatiko… gāmagāmaṇiko … pūgagāmaṇiko yāva'd'atthaṃ seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharanto yāvajīvaṃ pūgagāmaṇikattaṃ kārento pūgassa vā piyo manāpo'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
commentary: (ANa) gāmagāmaṇikassā'ti gāmānaṃ gāmaṇikassa, gāmasāmikassā'ti attho. (ANa) gāmagāmaṇiko'ti gāmabhojako.

meaning_2: sacking or plundering of a village

meaning_2: village raider; village looter; village plunderer

yathā ca dhataraṭṭho suvaṇṇahaṃso na gāmadvāre āvāṭak'ādīsu paṭivasati, navutihaṃsasahassaparivāro hutvā cittakūṭapabbate'y'eva paṭivasati. yathā ca catuddīp'issaro cakkavattirājā na nīcakule uppajjati, asambhinnajāti-khattiyakule'y'eva pana uppajjati.

meaning_1: collected in the village area; gathered near the village

meaning_1: dwelling in the vicinity of a village; accommodation in a village area

example_1: imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti, gilānabhattaṃ detha, gilān'upaṭṭhākabhattaṃ detha, gilānabhesajjaṃ dethā'ti. jīvako'pi komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi.

example_1: agilāno vematiko tat'uttari āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa. agilāno gilānasaññī tat'uttariṃ āvasathapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
commentary: (KVt) gilānassa gilānasaññino'ti gilānassa pana gilāno ahan'ti saññino anuvasitvā bhuñjantassa anāpatti.

meaning_1: time of sickness; occasion of illness
example_1: tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, addhānagamanasamayo, nāv'ābhiruhanasamayo, mahāsamayo, samaṇabhattasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
example_2: param'parabhojane aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, gilānasamayo, cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.4.2) gilānasamayo nāma antamaso pādā'pi phalitā honti. gilānasamayo'ti bhuñjitabbaṃ. (VIN 2.5.6.7) gilānasamayo nāma yassa vinā nahānena na phāsu hoti, gilānasamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.

example_1: atha kho bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.

meaning_2: Chapter 8 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
Chapter 2 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

example_1: atha kho bhagavā navavādañ'ca sutvā gilānavādañ'ca, appaññāto bhikkhū'ti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami.

meaning_1: recovered from the illness; got better
example_1: atha kho bhagavato so ābādho paṭipassambhi. atha kho bhagavā gilānavuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamma vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
example_2: atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa so ābādho paṭippassambhī'ti. atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ gilānavuṭṭhitaṃ aciravuṭṭhitaṃ gelaññā etadavoca
commentary: (JAa) gilānavuṭṭhitan'ti paṭhamaṃ gilānaṃ pacchā vuṭṭhitaṃ.

example_1: bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā vuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti, alam'etaṃ sabban'ti avuttaṃ hoti, na gilān'ātirittaṃ hoti, etaṃ anatirittaṃ nāma.
commentary: (VINa) gilān'ātirittan'ti ettha na kevalaṃ yaṃ gilānassa bhutt'āvasesaṃ hoti, taṃ gilān'ātirittaṃ, atha kho yaṃkiñci gilānaṃ uddissa ajja vā sve vā yadā vā icchati, tadā khādissatī'ti āhaṭaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ gilān'ātirittan'ti veditabbaṃ.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gilānāvuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. tassa evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ kho gilānāvuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño, hand'āhaṃ nipajjāmī'ti.
example_2: atha khalu, bho, puṇṇamukhassa phussakokilassa so ābādho paṭippassambhī'ti. atha khalu, bho, kuṇālo sakuṇo taṃ puṇṇamukhaṃ phussakokilaṃ gilānāvuṭṭhitaṃ aciravuṭṭhitaṃ gelaññā etadavoca
commentary: (JAa) gilānavuṭṭhitan'ti paṭhamaṃ gilānaṃ pacchā vuṭṭhitaṃ.

example_1: imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.

meaning_1: attending to the sick; nursing those ill
meaning_2: who attends the sick; who cares for a sick person
example_1: atha kho tassa gilān'upaṭṭhākassa bhikkhuno etadahosi, bhagavatā paññattaṃ na anissitena vatthabban'ti. ahañ'c'amhi nissayakaraṇīyo, ayañ'ca bhikkhu gilāno, kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban'ti?
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhākīnaṃ yadidaṃ suppiyā upāsikā.

meaning_1: caring for the sick; looking after the unwell
meaning_2: tending or nursing of the sick
example_1: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānena bhattavetan'ānuppadānena gilān'upaṭṭhānena acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena samaye vossaggena.
commentary: (DNa) gilānupaṭṭhānenā'ti aphāsukakāle kammaṃ akāretvā sappāyabhesajj'ādīni datvā paṭijagganena.

meaning_1: like a sick person; similar to a patient
example_1: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tayo'me gilān'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo?
jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
example_2: yo andhakāre tamasi pabhaṅ'karo, verocano maṇḍalī uggatejo. mā rāhu gilī caram'antalikkhe, pajaṃ mamaṃ rāhu pamuñca sūriyan'ti.

example_1: tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.
commentary: (NPa) ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassā'ti ayaṃ, bhikkhu, kilesamārassa baḷisabhūtaṃ rūpataṇhaṃ gilitvā ṭhito'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: swallowed the hook; taken the bait (of)
example_1: tam'enaṃ aññataro āmisacakkhu maccho gileyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.
commentary: (NPa) ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassā'ti ayaṃ, bhikkhu, kilesamārassa baḷisabhūtaṃ rūpataṇhaṃ gilitvā ṭhito'ti vuccati.

example_1: mā appakassa hetu, kāmasukhassa vipulaṃ jahī sukhaṃ, mā puthulomo'va baḷisaṃ, gilitvā pacchā vihaññasi.
commentary: (THIa) mā puthulomo'va baḷisaṃ gilitvā'ti āmisalobhena baḷisaṃ gilitvā byasanaṃ pāpuṇanto puthulomo'ti laddhanāmo maccho viya kāme apariccajitvā mā pacchā vihaññasi pacchā vighāṭaṃ āpajjasi.

meaning_1: known to householders; understood by laypeople
example_1: suṇātu me, āvuso, saṅgho. sant'amhākaṃ sikkhāpadāni gihigatāni. gihino'pi jānanti, idaṃ vo samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī'ti.
commentary: (VINt) gihigatānī'ti gihipaṭisaṃyuttānī'ti vadanti. gihīsu gatāni, tehi ñātāni gihigatānī'ti evaṃ pan'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

meaning_2: emblem or characteristic sign of a householder

meaning_1: layperson's duty; householder's responsibility; (comm) the five precepts
example_1: katame pañca? bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, santo sappurisā bhajanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, gihidhammā anapagato hoti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dāne ānisaṃsā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) gihidhammā anapagato hotī'ti akhaṇḍapañcasīlo hoti.

meaning_1: not avoided the layperson's duty; not strayed from the householder's responsibility; (comm) with unbroken five precepts
example_1: katame pañca? bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, santo sappurisā bhajanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, gihidhammam'anupagato hoti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dāne ānisaṃsā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) gihidhammā anapagato hotī'ti akhaṇḍapañcasīlo hoti.

meaning_1: rule about making laywomen give massages

meaning_2: kind or style of (under) garment worn by a householder
in the way a householder wears his (under) garments
wife of a householder; woman who lives the household (worldly and sensual) life

geha + inī
example_1: atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ek'upāsikā'pi sāvikā gihinī odātavasanā brahmacārinī yā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā'ti?
commentary: (VIN) gihinī nāma agārinī vuccati.

meaning_1: concerned with laypeople; connected with householders
example_1: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, ahaṃ yā c'eva imesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ āpatti yā ca attano āpatti, imesañ'c'eva āyasmantānaṃ atthāya attano ca atthāya, saṅghamajjhe tiṇ'avatthārakena deseyyaṃ, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ ṭhapetvā gihipaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) gihipaṭisaṃyuttan'ti gihīnaṃ hīnena khuṃsana-vambhana-dhammika-paṭissavesu āpannā āpatti.

meaning_1: suitable for a householder; fit for a layperson
example_1: idha ca mahīpatissa kāmabhogī, gihipatirūpakā bahū bhavanti, yadi ca jahati sabbakāmabhogaṃ, labhati anuttaraṃ uttamadhan'aggan'ti.

meaning_1: assembly of laypeople; congregation of householders
example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.

meaning_2: kind or style of (under) garment worn by a householder
in the way a householder wears his (under) garments

example_1: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ tiṇ'avatthārakena vūpasameyya, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttan'ti.
commentary: (VINa) gihipaṭisaṃyuttan'ti gihīnaṃ hīnena khuṃsana-vambhana-dhammika-paṭissavesu āpannaṃ āpattiṃ.

meaning_1: state of being a householder; layperson
as a layperson; as a householder
example_1: caturāsīti vassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresi. caturāsīti vassasahassāni gihibhūto dhamme pāsāde brahmacariyaṃ cari.
tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca na paripūreti.
example_2: gihibhogā parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca dubbhago, paridhaṃsamāno pakireti, chav'ālātaṃ'va nassati.
commentary: (SNa) gihibhogā ca parihīno'ti yo agāre vasantehi gihīhi dāyajje bhājiyamāne bhogo laddhabbo assa, tato ca parihīno. (ITIa) gāthāsu gihibhogā'ti kāmasukhasambhogato.

meaning_2: distinctive marks or character of a householder

meaning_1: excessively involved in the instruction of laypeople
example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando ativelaṃ gihisaññattibahulo viharati.
commentary: (SNa) gihisaññattibahulo'ti rattiñ'ca divā ca bahukālaṃ gihī saññāpayanto.

meaning_1: initiative of a householder; undertaken by a layperson
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhuniparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā, pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.9) gihisamārambho nāma ñātakā vā honti pavāritā vā pakatipaṭiyattaṃ vā. (VINa) gihīnaṃ samārambho gihisamārambho

meaning_1: fetter to lay life; bond to being a householder
example_1: atthi nu kho, bho gotama, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass'antakaro'ti? n'atthi kho, vaccha, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass'antakaro'ti.
commentary: (MNa) gihisaṃyojanan'ti gihibandhanaṃ gihiparikkhāresu nikantiṃ.

meaning_1: association with householders; mingling with laypeople
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu saṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
example_2: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bālo hoti abyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno, gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati ananulomikehi gihisaṃsaggehi, tañ'ce saṅgho nissāreti, sunissārito. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ, tañ'ce saṅgho nissāreti, sunissārito.
commentary: (VINa) ananulomikehi gihisaṃsaggehī'ti pabbajitānaṃ ananucchavikehi sahasokit'ādīhi gihisaṃsaggehi.

meaning_1: involved with laypeople; mixed up with (the affairs of) householders
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhu, manussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati, sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, manussaggāho.

meaning_1: correct course for a layperson; suitable way for a householder
example_1: catūhi kho, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. katamehi catūhi?
commentary: (ANa) gihisāmīcipaṭipadan'ti gihīnaṃ anucchavikaṃ paṭipattiṃ.

meaning_1: suitable for householders; appropriate for laypeople
example_1: yāni c'imāni, bhante, bhagavatā gihisāmīcikāni sikkhāpadāni desitāni, n'āhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani khaṇḍaṃ samanupassāmī'ti. lābhā te, gahapati, suladdhaṃ te, gahapati!
commentary: (SNa) gihisāmīcikānī'ti gihīnaṃ anucchavikāni.

meaning_1: path of practice suitable for a layperson; way appropriate for a householder
example_1: catūhi kho, gahapati, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihisāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. katamehi catūhi?
commentary: (ANa) gihisāmīcipaṭipadan'ti gihīnaṃ anucchavikaṃ paṭipattiṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on appropriate course for a layperson

example_1: katamāni dve? gihisukhañ'ca pabbajitasukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.
commentary: (ANa) gihisukhan'ti gihīnaṃ sabbakāmanipphattimūlakaṃ sukhaṃ.

family_set: epithets of stream entry; types of ariyas

commentary: (VINt) gihivikatan'ti gihīhi kataṃ paññattaṃ, gihisantakan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
(VIN) gihiveyyāvaccaṃ nāma agārikassa yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā khādanīyaṃ vā pacati, sāṭakaṃ vā veṭhanaṃ vā dhovati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

commentary: (DNa) cetiyacārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā'ti ye ca tāva tattha tattha cetiy'aṅgaṇaṃ sammajjantā, āsanāni dhovantā bodhimhi udakaṃ siñcantā āhiṇḍanti, tesu vattabbam'eva n'atthi asukavihāre cetiyaṃ vandissāmā'ti nikkhamitvā pasannacittā antarā kālaṅkarontā'pi anantarāyena sagge patiṭṭhahissanti yevā'ti dasseti.

meaning_1: name of an area in Sri Lanka; Mihintale
meaning_2: name of a mountain in Sri Lanka, present Mihintale
tree that is an object of veneration, sacred tree

meaning_lit: for the purpose of paying respect to a shrine
construction:
cetiya + vandana + attha + āya
cetiyavandanattha + āya

meaning_2: name of the people from Ceta
example_1: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū cetiyesu viharanti sahajaniye.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā parito parito janapadesu paricārake abbhatīte kālaṅ'kate upapattīsu byākaroti kāsikosalesu vajjimallesu cetivaṃsesu kurupañcālesu majjhasūrasenesu

meaning_2: name of the people from Ceta
example_1: seyyath'idaṃ, aṅgānaṃ, magadhānaṃ, kāsīnaṃ, kosalānaṃ, vajjīnaṃ, mallānaṃ, cetīnaṃ, vaṅgānaṃ, kurūnaṃ, pañcālānaṃ, macchānaṃ, sūrasenānaṃ, assakānaṃ, avantīnaṃ, gandhārānaṃ, kambojānaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etaṃ kalaṃ n'āgghati soḷasiṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
sadevakassa lokassa, ete vo sukhasammatā, yattha c'ete nirujjhanti, taṃ nesaṃ dukkhasammataṃ.
example_2: no c'etaṃ chando jāyetha, na'y'idaṃ ussaheyya, no c'ete dhammā nijjhānaṃ khameyyuṃ, na'y'idaṃ chando jāyetha.

example_1: phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti. itth'ete'pi dhammā calā c'eva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.
idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti
example_2: asañcetanikaṃ, bhante, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto no mahāsāvajjaṃ paññapetī'ti. sace pana, gahapati, cetetī'ti? mahāsāvajjaṃ, bhante, hotī'ti.
commentary: (VINa) bāhullāya cetetī'ti bāhulattāya ceteti kappeti pakappeti. (SNa) yañ'ca, bhikkhave, cetetī'ti yaṃ cetanaṃ ceteti, pavattetī'ti attho.

meaning_1: barrenness of mind; unproductive state of mind
example_1: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañca cetokhilā appahīnā, pañca cetasovinibandhā asamucchinnā, so vat'imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (MNa) cetokhilā'ti cittassa thaddhabhāvā kacavarabhāvā khāṇukabhāvā.

example_1: tassa kāyikā'pi darathā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi darathā pavaḍḍhanti, kāyikā'pi santāpā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi santāpā pavaḍḍhanti, kāyikā'pi pariḷāhā pavaḍḍhanti, cetasikā'pi pariḷāhā pavaḍḍhanti. so kāyikadukkham'pi cetodukkham'pi paṭisaṃvedeti.
commentary: (DNa) cetodukkhasamappitā'ti domanassasamappitā.

meaning_1: filled with mental suffering; anguished; tormented
meaning_2: filled with mental suffering; anguished; tormented
example_1: idamāyasmato ānandassa vacanaṃ sutvā mallā ca mallaputtā ca mallasuṇisā ca mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā cetodukkhasamappitā app'ekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapātaṃ papatanti, āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti
commentary: (DNa) cetodukkhasamappitā'ti domanassasamappitā. (VISMa) cetodukkhasamappitā'ti cetasikadukkhasamaṅgino.

example_1: tañ'ca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa. ijjhat'āvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi visuddhattā.
commentary: (SNa) ijjhissati sīlavato cetopaṇidhī'ti samijjhissati sīlavantassa cittapatthanā.

meaning_1: by means of mental inclination; due to one's wish
example_1: santi, bhikkhu, sītavalāhakā nāma devā. tesaṃ yadā evaṃ hoti, yaṃnūna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā vaseyyāmā'ti, tesaṃ taṃ cetopaṇidhim'anvāya sītaṃ hoti. ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yen'ekadā sītaṃ hotī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) cetopaṇidhimanvāyā'ti cittaṭṭhapanaṃ āgamma.

meaning_1: because of mental corruption; due to bad mentality
example_1: yathā haritvā nikkhipeyya, evam'eva tathāvidho, cetopadosahetu hi, sattā gacchanti duggatin'ti.

meaning_1: encompassing another's mind; knowing another's thoughts (with)
example_1: api ca me tvaṃ, bhaddāli, dīgharattaṃ cetasā cetoparicca vidito, na c'āyaṃ moghapuriso mayā dhamme desiyamāne aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇātī'ti.
example_2: cetopariccañāṇañ'ca, sotadhātu visodhitā, iddhī'pi me sacchikatā, patto me āsavakkhayo, chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) cetasā cetopariccā'ti attano cittena tassa cittaṃ paricchinditvā. (THIa) cetopariccañāṇañ'cā'ti cetopariyañāṇañ'ca visodhitan'ti sambandho, adhigatan'ti attho.

meaning_1: reading the mind; encompassing the mind
example_1: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.

meaning_1: understanding others' minds; knowing another's thoughts
meaning_2: understanding the ways of others' thought, encompassing of mind (with mind)
example_1: cetopariyañāṇañ'ca, sotadhātu visodhitā, iddhī'pi me sacchikatā, patto me āsavakkhayo, cha me'bhiññā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.
commentary: (PMa) cetopariyañāṇan'ti ettha pariyātī'ti pariyaṃ, paricchindatī'ti attho. cetaso pariyaṃ cetopariyaṃ, cetopariyañ'ca taṃ ñāṇañ'cā'ti cetopariyañāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: reading the mind; encompassing the mind (of)
example_1: vīmaṃsakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena tathāgate samannesanā kātabbā sammāsambuddho vā no vā iti viññāṇāyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) cetopariyāyan'ti cittavāraṃ cittaparicchedaṃ.

meaning_1: skilled in mind-reading; expert in encompassing (another's) mind
example_1: tevijjā iddhipattā ca, cetopariyāyakovidā, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, bahū buddhassa sāvakā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) cetopariyāyakovidā'ti paresaṃ citt'ācāre kusalā.

meaning_1: knowledge obtained by encompassing the mind of another
meaning_2: knowledge obtained by encompassing the mind of another
example_1: ettha ca hi te, sāriputta, atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu, cetasā cetopariyāyañāṇaṃ n'atthi.

meaning_1: train of thought; state of mind; mental process
example_1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya… gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
example_2: atha kho brahmā sahampati bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjita vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya

meaning_1: reading state of mind; understanding train of thought; comprehending (another's) mental processes
example_1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya… gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
example_2: atha khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, bakassa brahmuno cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evam'eva, ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ subhagavane sālarājamūle antarahito tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahosiṃ.

meaning_1: due to mental clarity; due to bright mentality
example_1: yathā haritvā nikkhipeyya, evam'eva tathāvidho, cetopasādahetu hi, sattā gacchanti suggatin'ti.
pañc'aṅgiko sammāsamādhi, pītipharaṇatā, sukhapharaṇatā, cetopharaṇatā, ālokapharaṇatā, paccavekkhaṇanimittaṃ. ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā.
commentary: (DNa) paresaṃ ceto pharamānā uppajjatī'ti cetopariyapaññā cetopharaṇatā nāma.

meaning_1: mental sagacity; being a sage in thought
example_1: kāyamuniṃ vacīmuniṃ, cetomuniṃ anāsavaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) kāyamunin'ti kāyadvāre muniṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ, kāyena vā muniṃ. sesadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: peace of mind; mental stillness; mental serenity; tranquillity of mind
example_1: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā na divasaṃ atināmeti, n'āpi riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti.
example_2: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassā'ti niyak'ajjhatte appanācittasamādhissa. (ANa) anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathan'ti niyak'ajjhatte cittasamādhiṃ āsevati bhāveti, samathakammaṭṭhāne yuttappayutto hoti.

meaning_1: devoted to tranquillity of mind; practising internal peace
example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.
example_2: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu paṭisallān'ārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato, ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno, vipassanāya samannāgato, brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto'ti attano cittasamathe yutto, ettha hi ajjhattan'ti vā attano'ti vā etaṃ ekatthaṃ, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ. bhumm'atthe pan'etaṃ samathan'ti upayogavacanaṃ. anū'ti iminā upasaggena yoge siddhaṃ.

meaning_1: proper way conducive to peace of mind; correct course for tranquillity of mind; proper procedure for mental peace
example_1: cetosamathasāmīciṃ, sikkhamānaṃ sadā sataṃ, satataṃ pahit'atto'ti, āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) cetosamathasāmīcin'ti cittasamathassa anucchavikaṃ paṭipadaṃ.

meaning_1: stability of mind; stillness of mind; meditative composure
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
example_2: katamo eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho? ānantariko cetosamādhi. ayaṃ eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho.

meaning_1: caused by mental contact; produced by mental impressions; born from mind experience
example_1: tattha katamaṃ domanassaṃ? yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ, cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ, cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā.
commentary: (ADha) cetosamphassajan'ti cittasamphasse jātaṃ.

example_1: tassa kāyikā'pi darathā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi darathā pahīyanti, kāyikā'pi santāpā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi santāpā pahīyanti, kāyikā'pi pariḷāhā pahīyanti, cetasikā'pi pariḷāhā pahīyanti. so kāyasukham'pi cetosukham'pi paṭisaṃvedeti.
commentary: (MNa) kāyasukhan'ti pañcadvārikasukhaṃ. cetosukhan'ti manodvārikasukhaṃ. ettha ca pañcadvārikajavanena samāpajjanaṃ vā vuṭṭhānaṃ vā n'atthi, uppannamattakam'eva hoti. manodvārikena sabbaṃ hoti. ayañ'ca maggavuṭṭhānassa paccayabhūtā balavavipassanā, sā'pi manodvāriken'eva hoti.

example_1: kāyasuciṃ vacīsuciṃ, cetosuciṃ anāsavaṃ, suciṃ soceyyasampannaṃ, āhu ninhātapāpakan'ti.

meaning_1: who has attained mental mastery; in control of one's mind
example_1: yo ve kilesāni pahāya pañca, paripuṇṇasekho aparihānadhammo, cetovasippatto samāhit'indriyo, sa ve ṭhit'atto'ti naro pavuccati.
example_2: tassa tattha na h'eva kho sukhino dhammapadā plavanti, api ca kho bhikkhu iddhimā cetovasippatto devaparisāyaṃ dhammaṃ deseti. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ vā so dhammavinayo, yatth'āhaṃ pubbe brahmacariyaṃ acarin'ti.
commentary: (ANa) cetovasippatto'ti cittavasībhāvaṃ patto. evarūpo khīṇ'āsavo hoti, idha pana anāgāmī kathito. (ANa) iddhimā cetovasippatto'ti iddhisampanno cittassa vasibhāvapatto khīṇ'āsavo.

meaning_1: beneficial for managing the mind; conducive to mental investigation
example_1: yā ca kho ayaṃ, ānanda, kathā abhisallekhikā cetovicāraṇasappāyā ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati
yā ca kho ayaṃ, ānanda, kathā abhisallekhikā cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā ek'antanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati
commentary: (MNt) cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā'ti kusalacitt'uppattiyā nivārakānaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ dūrībhāvakaraṇena cetovinīvaraṇasaṅkhātānaṃ samathavipassanānaṃ sappāyā. samathavipassanā-cittass'eva vā vibhūtibhāvakaraṇāya sappāyā upakārikā'ti cetovinīvaraṇasappāyā.

example_1: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cetovimutto ca hoti paññāvimutto ca hoti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho iti'pi, saṃkiṇṇaparikho iti'pi, abbūḷh'esiko iti'pi, niraggaḷo iti'pi, ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto iti'pi.
commentary: (MNt) so cetovimutto nāmā'ti so ariyo cetovimutto nāma hoti.

meaning_1: mental liberation; emancipation of heart; (comm) samadhi obtained from fruition
example_1: akuppā cetovimutti etadattham'idaṃ brāhmaṇa brahmacariyaṃ
example_2: khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti. so ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hoti.
commentary: (ANa) rāgavirāgā cetovimuttī'ti rāgassa khayavirāgena cetovimutti nāma hoti. phalasamādhiss'etaṃ nāmaṃ. (DNa) akuppā cetovimuttī'ti arahattaphalavimutti.

example_1: tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti. tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi. balavīriye parihīne cetovimutti parihāyi.
commentary: (MNa) cetovimutti parihāyī'ti ettha cetovimutti nāma araññe vasissāmā'ti uppann'ājjhāsayo, so parihāyī'ti attho.

meaning_1: with mental liberation as fruit; resulting in emancipation of heart
example_1: katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?
commentary: (MNa) phalakkhaṇe nibbattā cetovimutti phalaṃ assā'ti cetovimuttiphalā. tadeva cetovimuttisaṅkhātaṃ phalaṃ ānisaṃso assā'ti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā.

meaning_1: with mental liberation as fruit and benefit; with emancipation of heart as result and advantage
example_1: katihi pan'āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā cā'ti?
commentary: (MNa) phalakkhaṇe nibbattā cetovimutti phalaṃ assā'ti cetovimuttiphalā. tadeva cetovimuttisaṅkhātaṃ phalaṃ ānisaṃso assā'ti cetovimuttiphal'ānisaṃsā.

meaning_1: accomplished in mental liberation; endowed with emancipation of heart
example_1: cetovimuttisampannā, atho paññāvimuttiyā, bhabbā te antakiriyāya, na te jātijarūpagā'ti.

meaning_1: devoid of mental liberation; lacking emancipation of heart
example_1: tañ'ca maggaṃ na jānanti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ, cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā, abhabbā te antakiriyāya, te ve jātijar'ūpagā.
commentary: (SNPa) cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā'ti ettha arahattaphalasamādhi rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, arahattaphalapaññā avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti veditabbā.

example_1: eso ce, bhante, maggo esā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya, atha kiñ'carahi idh'ekacce bhikkhū cetovimuttino ekacce bhikkhū paññāvimuttino'ti?

meaning_1: skilled in the expansion of mind
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetovivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako.
commentary: (ANt) ceto'ti c'ettha cittasīsena samādhi vutto, tasmā cetaso samādhissa vivaṭṭanaṃ cetovivaṭṭo, ekasmiṃ'y'ev'ārammaṇe samādhicittaṃ vivaṭṭetvā heṭṭhimassa heṭṭhimassa upar'ūpari hāpanato rūp'āvacarajjhānalābhī cetovivaṭṭakusalo nāma.

meaning_1: conducive to opening the heart; beneficial for revealing the mind
example_1: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu y'āyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
commentary: (ANa) samathavipassanā-cittassa vivaraṇe sappāyā upakārakā'ti cetovivaraṇasappāyā.

example_1: telappadīpo c'ettha jhāyeyya, catasso ca pajāpatiyo manāpamanāpena paccupaṭṭhitā assu. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, sukhaṃ vā so sayeyya no vā? kathaṃ vā te ettha hotī'ti?
example_2: sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.

meaning_1: and here; and in this case
example_1: lobhanaṃ madanañ'c'etaṃ, mohanaṃ rajavaḍḍhanaṃ, sāsaṅkaṃ bahuāyāsaṃ, n'atthi c'ettha dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.
commentary: (THIa) n'atthi c'ettha dhuvaṃ ṭhitī'ti etasmiṃ dhane dhuvabhāvo ca ṭhitibhāvo ca n'atthi, cañcalam'anavaṭṭhitam'evā'ti attho.

example_1: bahuṃ ve saraṇaṃ yanti, pabbatāni vanāni ca, ārāmarukkhacetyāni, manussā bhayatajjitā.
example_2: ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.
