mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ
commentary: (VINa) dvatticchadanassa pariyāyan'ti chadanassa dvattipariyāyaṃ

meaning_1: name of a type of elephant
meaning_2: name of a race of elephants
example_1: kālāvakañ'ca gaṅgeyyaṃ, paṇḍaraṃ tambapiṅgalaṃ, gandha-maṅgala-hemañ'ca, uposatha-chaddant'ime dasā'ti.
commentary: (APt) chabbaṇṇadantatāya chaddanto.

example_1: aparam'pi divasaṃ nāgarājā saparivāro nhān'atthāya chaddantadahaṃ otari. atha dve taruṇanāgā soṇḍāhi usirakalāpe gahetvā kelāsakūṭaṃ majjantā viya nhāpesuṃ.

meaning_1: section on covering the six directions

meaning_2: covering, protecting, in the six directions
example_1: yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpak'āpagato chaddisāpaṭicchādī ubholokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti.
commentary: (DNa) chaddisāpaṭicchādī'ti cha disā paṭicchādento. (DNa) chaddisāpaṭicchādī'ti yathā chahi disāhi āgamanabhayaṃ na āgacchati, khemaṃ hoti nibbhayaṃ evaṃ viharanto chaddisāpaṭicchādī'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: consisting of six elements; having six states; consisting of six properties
example_1: chaddhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.
commentary: (MNa) tattha cha dhātuyo assā'ti chadhāturo.

meaning_1: with six entrances; with six gates
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
commentary: (SNa) chadvāran'ti nagaradvāraṃ nāma ekam'pi hoti dve'pi satam'pi sahassam'pi, idha pana satthā chadvārikanagaraṃ dassento evam'āha.

meaning_1: merely protecting the six sense doors

meaning_2: belonging to the six doors of the senses

meaning_1: consisting of six elements; having six states; consisting of six properties
example_1: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.
example_2: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha'y'imā, bhikkhu, dhātuyo, pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu.
commentary: (MNa) cha dhātuyo assā'ti chadhāturo.

meaning_1: detailed analysis of the six states
example_1: yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccatī'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. imaṃ kho me tvaṃ, bhikkhu, saṃkhittena chadhātuvibhaṅgaṃ dhārehī'ti.

meaning_1: interest (in); self-interest (in); desire (for); wish (for); intention (to); impulse (for)
example_1: tassa na tādiso chando hoti adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, na tādiso chando hoti adhicittasikkhāsamādāne seyyathā'pi aññesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
example_2: etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.
commentary: (ANa) idañ'hi idha chando'ti dubbalarāgass'ādhivacanaṃ. (ANa) chando'ti kattu'kamyatāchando.

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkameyya, pācittiyaṃ.

meaning_2: voluntary collection; free-will offering; general collection
example_1: upāsakā bhikkhunisaṅghassa cīvar'atthāya chandakaṃ saṃharitvā, aññatarassa pāvārikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā, bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
commentary: (VINa) chandakan'ti idaṃ nāma dhammakiccaṃ karissāma, yaṃ sakkotha, taṃ dethā'ti evaṃ paresaṃ chandañ'ca ruciñ'ca uppādetvā gahitaparikkhārass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

meaning_1: fact of being motivated by self interest; state of being driven by desire
example_1: suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. ayaṃ itthan'nāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakato bhikkhū chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpeti.
commentary: (VINa) chandagāmitā… bhayagāmitā pāpentī'ti ete chandagāmino ca… bhayagāmino cā'ti evaṃ chandagāmitāya'pi… bhayagāmitāya'pi pāpenti, yojentī'ti attho.

meaning_1: motivated by self interest; driven by desire
example_1: chandagāmino ca bhikkhū, dosagāmino ca bhikkhū, mohagāmino ca bhikkhū, bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti, ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī'ti.
commentary: (VINa) chandagāmino'ti chandena gacchantī'ti.

meaning_1: born from desire; originated from one's interest; self-produced
example_1: chandajaṃ aghaṃ chandajaṃ dukkhaṃ, chandavinayā aghavinayo, aghavinayā dukkhavinayo'ti.
commentary: (SNa) chandajan'ti taṇhāchandato jātaṃ.

meaning_1: whose interest has arisen (in); whose desire has sprung up (for); who is intent (on)
example_1: chandajāto anakkhāte, manasā ca phuṭo siyā, kāmesu ca appaṭibaddhacitto, uddhaṃsoto'ti vuccati.
example_2: tassa ce kāmayānassa, chandajātassa jantuno, te kāmā parihāyanti, sallaviddho'va ruppati.
commentary: (DHPa) chandajāto'ti kattu'kāmatāvasena jātachando ussāhapatto.

example_1: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.
manussattaṃ liṅgasampatti, hetu satthāradassanaṃ, pabbajjā guṇasampatti, adhikāro ca chandatā, aṭṭhadhammasamodhānā, abhinīhāro samijjhati.
commentary: (SNPa) chandatā'ti kattu'kamyatā. sā yassa balavatī hoti, tassa ijjhati.

meaning_1: desire and ill-will; craving and aversion
example_1: evañ'hi vuttaṃ samaṇena jānatā, tasmā hi te sappurisā pasaṃsiyā, dhamme ṭhitā ye na karonti pāpakaṃ, na chandadosā na bhayā ca gāmino, parisāya maṇḍo ca pan'esa vuccati, evañ'hi vuttaṃ samaṇena jānatā'ti.

meaning_1: diversity of interests; variety of impulses
example_1: katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? nava nānattā, dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ
commentary: (DNa) saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattan'ti saṅkappanānattatāya rūpe chando sadde chando'ti evaṃ chandanānattaṃ uppajjati.

meaning_1: with interest as source; originating in desire
meaning_2: originate in desire; have a source in interest
example_1: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.
example_2: yaṃ kho kiñci atītam'addhānaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjamānaṃ uppajji sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ. chando hi mūlaṃ dukkhassa.
commentary: (DNa) chandanidānan'ti ettha pariyesanachando, paṭilābhachando, paribhogachando, sannidhichando, vissajjanachando'ti pañcavidho chando.

meaning_1: dependent on interest; based on desire
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
commentary: (SNa) chandapaccayā aṭṭha-lobha-sahagata-citta-sampayuttā vedanā veditabbā

meaning_1: produced by interest; generated by desire
example_1: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.

meaning_1: (vinaya) consent and purity; consent and innocence
example_1: chandaparisuddhi, utu'kkhānaṃ, bhikkhugaṇanā ca, ovādo, uposathassa etāni, pubbakiccan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: (vinaya) consent and purity; consent and innocence
commentary: (KVa) chandapārisuddhī'ti ettha uposathakaraṇ'atthaṃ sannipatite saṅghe bahi uposathaṃ katvā āgatena sannipatitaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā kāyasāmaggiṃ adentena chando dātabbo. yo'pi gilāno vā hoti kiccappasuto vā, tenā'pi pārisuddhiṃ dentena chando'pi dātabbo.

meaning_2: consent, purity and announcing the seasons

meaning_1: for the purpose of giving up interest; for the abandoning of desire
example_1: kim'atthiyaṃ nu kho, bho ānanda, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti? chandappahān'atthaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) chandappahān'atthan'ti taṇhāchandassa pahān'atthaṃ.

meaning_1: rooted in interest; originating from desire; stemming from intention
example_1: chandamūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, manasikārasambhavā sabbe dhammā, phassasamudayā sabbe dhammā, vedanāsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā
commentary: (ANa) chandamūlakā'ti ajjhāsayacchando kattu'kamyatāchando taṃ mūlaṃ etesan'ti chandamūlakā.

meaning_1: interest and passion; desire and lust
example_1: idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.
example_2: rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, upādāniyo dhammo, yo chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) chandarāgo'ti evaṃ akusalavitakkena vitakkite vatthusmiṃ dubbalarāgo ca balavarāgo ca uppajjati. idañ'hi idha chando'ti dubbalarāgass'ādhivacanaṃ.

meaning_1: founded on interest and passion; based on desire and lust
example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati? atītānaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti.
commentary: (ANa) chandarāgaṭṭhāniye'ti chandarāgassa kāraṇabhūte.

meaning_1: end of interest and passion; cessation of desire and lust
meaning_2: end of interest and passion; cessation of desire and lust
example_1: chandarāgo ca hi, ānanda, n'ābhavissa sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ kassaci kimhici, sabbaso chandarāge asati chandarāganirodhā api nu kho ajjhosānaṃ paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

meaning_1: fact of being bound to interest and desire
example_1: iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

meaning_1: abandoning of interest and passion; letting go of desire and lust
example_1: yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo. yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho'ti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
example_2: yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo. yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ
commentary: (MNa) chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti nibbānaṃ. nibbānañ'hi āgamma kāmesu chandarāgo vinīyati c'eva pahīyati ca, tasmā nibbānaṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti ca vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: interest, desire and dislike; impulse, affection and ill-will
compound_construction: chanda ca rāga ca byāpāda ca
example_1: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evam'assa, taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso, chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
commentary: (MNa) chandarāgabyāpādenā'ti so avijjāsaṅkhāto visadoso chandarāgena ca byāpādena ca ruppati kuppati.

meaning_1: due to interest and passion; under the influence of desire and lust
example_1: ye ca rūpe pamāṇiṃsu, ye ca ghosena anvagū, chandarāgavas'ūpetā, n'ābhijānanti te janā.
commentary: (ANa) chandarāgavas'ūpetā'ti chandassa ca rāgassa ca vasaṃ upetā.

meaning_1: removal of interest and passion; dispelling of desire and lust (for)
example_1: yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo. yo rūpasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ
example_2: yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo. yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho'ti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
commentary: (MNa) chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti nibbānaṃ. nibbānañ'hi āgamma kāmesu chandarāgo vinīyati c'eva pahīyati ca, tasmā nibbānaṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānan'ti ca vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: teaching the removal of interest and passion (for)
example_1: paṇḍitā h'āvuso manussā vīmaṃsakā kismiṃ pan'āyasmantānaṃ chandarāgavinayakkhāyī satthā'ti

meaning_1: bound by interest and passion; held captive by desire and lust
commentary: (ANa) chandarāgavinibaddho'ti chandarāgena vinibaddho. (NIDD2a) chandarāgavinibaddho'ti chandarāgena snehena baddho.

meaning_1: removing interest and passion; dispelling desire and lust
meaning_2: removal of interest and passion; dispelling desire and lust
example_1: idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD2) chandarāgavinodanan'ti chandarāgappahānaṃ chandarāgavūpasamaṃ chandarāgapaṭinissaggaṃ chandarāgapaṭippassaddhaṃ amataṃ nibbānan'ti, chandarāgavinodanaṃ.

meaning_1: difference between (types of) interest and passion (in); distinction between (kinds of) desire and lust (for)
example_1: siyā pana, bhante, pañc'upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavemattatā'ti?
commentary: (SNa) chandarāgavemattatā'ti chandarāganānattaṃ.

example_1: chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.
commentary: (SNa) chando nidānan'ti gāyatti-ādiko chando gāthānaṃ nidānaṃ. pubbapaṭṭhāpanagāthā ārabhanto hi, kataracchandena hotū'ti ārabhati.
notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

example_1: ime vuccanti padhānasaṅkhārā'ti. iti ayañ'ca chando, ayañ'ca chandasamādhi, ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo.
commentary: (SNa) chandaṃ nissāya pavatto samādhi chandasamādhi.

meaning_1: comprised of meditative composure based on interest and active effort
example_1: so chandasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, cittasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīmaṃsāsamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, ussoḷhī'y'eva pañcamī.
commentary: (VIBHa) chandasamādhi-padhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgatan'ti ettha chandahetuko chand'ādhiko vā samādhi chandasamādhi. kattu'kamyatāchandaṃ adhipatiṃ karitvā paṭiladdhasamādhiss'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. padhānabhūtā saṅkhārā padhānasaṅkhārā. catukiccasādhakassa sammappadhānavīriyass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. samannāgatan'ti chandasamādhinā ca padhānasaṅkhārehi ca upetaṃ.

meaning_1: comprised of meditative composure based on interest and active effort
example_1: idha, brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu chandasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti
commentary: (DNa) chandasamādhi-ppadhānasaṅkhāra-samannāgatan'ti-ādīsu chandahetuko chand'ādhiko vā samādhi chandasamādhi, kattu'kamyatāchandaṃ adhipatiṃ karitvā paṭiladdhasamādhiss'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. padhānabhūtā saṅkhārā padhānasaṅkhārā.

meaning_lit: discourse on meditative composure based on interest

meaning_1: with interest as source; originating from impulse
example_1: piy'āppiyaṃ kho, devānam'inda, chandanidānaṃ chandasamudayaṃ chandajātikaṃ chandapabhavaṃ, chande sati piy'āppiyaṃ hoti, chande asati piy'āppiyaṃ na hotī'ti.

meaning_1: accomplishment of one's desire; (comm) accomplishment of the desire to do good
example_1: sīlasampannass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ… yadidaṃ, chandasampadā… yadidaṃ, attasampadā… yadidaṃ, diṭṭhisampadā… yadidaṃ, appamādasampadā…
commentary: (SNa) chandasampadā'ti kusala-kattu'kamyatā-chando.

meaning_1: wife who lives with a husband by choice
meaning_2: wife obtained with her free will
example_1: dasa bhariyāyo, dhanakkītā chandavāsinī bhogavāsinī paṭavāsinī odapattakinī obhaṭacumbaṭā dāsī ca bhariyā ca kammakārī ca bhariyā ca dhaj'āhaṭā muhuttikā.
commentary: (VINa) chandena attano ruciyā vasatī'ti chandavāsinī. yasmā pana sā na attano chandamatten'eva bhariyā hoti purisena pana sampaṭicchitattā, tasm'āssa niddese, piyo piyaṃ vāsetī'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: removal of interest; removal of desire
example_1: chandajaṃ aghaṃ chandajaṃ dukkhaṃ, chandavinayā aghavinayo, aghavinayā dukkhavinayo'ti.

jivhañ'ca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ. jivhā aniccā vipariṇāminī aññathābhāvinī. rasā aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.
example_2: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ sotaviññāṇaṃ ghānaviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sota-ghāna-jivhā-kāya-viññāṇāni.

example_1: aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.

meaning_lit: to be known by tongue knowing
example_1: jivhaṃ, āvuso channa, jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassasi?

meaning_lit: to be known by the tongue
example_1: bhusā ce'pi jivhāviññeyyā rasā jivhāya āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti. amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.
example_2: ye te jivhāviññeyyā rasā asāyitā asāyitapubbā, na ca sāyasi, na ca te hoti sāyeyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

example_1: tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjissāma, rakkhissāma jivh'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjissāma
example_2: pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti. katamāni pañca? cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ.

meaning_1: restraint of the sense of taste
with the sense of taste restrained
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cakkhu'ndriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… sot'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… ghān'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… jivh'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… kāy'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto… man'indriyasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati.
idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya, idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin'ti
sokāvatiṇṇo nu vanamhi jhāyasi, vittaṃ nu jīno uda patthayāno, āguṃ nu gāmasmim'akāsi kiñci, kasmā janena na karosi sakkhiṃ, sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci te'ti.
example_2: jīno rath'assaṃ maṇikuṇḍale ca, putte ca dāre ca that'eva jīno, sabbesu bhogesu asesitesu, kasmā na santappasi sokakāle.
commentary: (SNa) vittaṃ nu jīno'ti sataṃ vā sahassaṃ vā jito'si nu. (JAa) jīno rath'assaṃ maṇikuṇḍale cā'ti mahārāja, tvaṃ rathañ'ca assañ'ca maṇikuṇḍalāni ca jīno, jīno rathasse ca maṇikuṇḍale cā'ti'pi pāṭho. (JAa) jīno'ti jānippatto hutvā.

meaning_1: diminishes; decreases; gets less; is lost
example_1: tasmā n'ābhikkhaṇaṃ gacche, na ca gacche cirāciraṃ, kālena yācaṃ yāceyya, evaṃ mittā na jīyare.
tañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhu, n'atthi yena jāyetha, ajāyamāno kiṃ jīyissati, ajīyamāno kiṃ mīyissati, amīyamāno kiṃ kuppissati, akuppamāno kissa pihessati?
example_2: yattha nu kho, bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, sakkā nu kho so, bhante, gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā'ti?

meaning_1: is defeated; is conquered; suffers loss (in)
example_1: sabbaso nāmarūpasmiṃ, yassa n'atthi mamāyitaṃ, asatā ca na socati, sa ve loke na jīyati.
example_2: appamattako so kaliggaho yaṃ so akkhadhutto paṭhamen'eva kaliggahena puttam'pi jīyetha, dāram'pi jīyetha, sabbaṃ sāpateyyam'pi jīyetha, uttari'pi adhibandhaṃ nigaccheyya.

meaning_1: diminished; decreased; grew less; was lost
example_1: nandasi, samaṇā'ti? kiṃ laddhā, āvuso'ti? tena hi, samaṇa, socasī'ti? kiṃ jīyittha, āvuso'ti? tena hi, samaṇa, n'eva nandasi na ca socasī'ti? evam'āvuso'ti.
commentary: (SNa) kiṃ jīyitthā'ti yassa hi kiñci manāpaṃ cīvar'ādivatthu jiṇṇaṃ hoti, so socati, tasmā evam'āha.

example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, jarāmaraṇaṃ? yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko, ayaṃ vuccati jarā.
commentary: (MNa) jīraṇatā'ti ākāraniddeso.

meaning_1: ages; grows old; gets worn out; declines
example_1: jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīram'pi jaraṃ upeti, satañ'ca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
example_2: manujassa sadā satīmato, mattaṃ jānato laddhabhojane, tanu tassa bhavanti vedanā, saṇikaṃ jīrati āyupālayan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) jīrantī'ti jaraṃ pāpuṇanti.

example_1: katamāni tīṇi? jarābhayaṃ, byādhibhayaṃ, maraṇabhayan'ti. na, bhikkhave, mātā puttaṃ jīramānaṃ evaṃ labhati, ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me putto jīrī'ti, putto vā pana mātaraṃ jīramānaṃ na evaṃ labhati, ahaṃ jīrāmi, mā me mātā jīrī'ti.
example_2: ajaraṃ jīramānena, tappamānena nibbutiṃ, nimiyaṃ paramaṃ santiṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaran'ti.
commentary: (THa) jīramānenā'ti jīrantena, khaṇe khaṇe jaraṃ pāpuṇantena.

example_1: jarādhammaṃ mā jīrī'ti n'atthi koci pāṭibhogo, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ
commentary: (ANa) jarādhammaṃ mā jīrī'ti yaṃ mayhaṃ jarāsabhāvaṃ, taṃ mā jīratu.

meaning_1: is aged; is matured (by); grows old
example_1: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu.
kiṃ pana, bhante, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti? etam'pi kho, poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.
example_2: yadā mayaṃ jānāma kālaṅ'kato so puriso'ti, atha naṃ kumbhiṃ oropetvā ubbhinditvā mukhaṃ vivaritvā saṇikaṃ nillokema, app'eva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā'ti. n'ev'assa mayaṃ jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passāma.

example_1: yāvajīvam'pi ce bālo, paṇḍitaṃ payirupāsati, na so dhammaṃ vijānāti, dabbī sūparasaṃ yathā.
example_2: hirīmatā ca dujjīvaṃ, niccaṃ sucigavesinā, alīnen'āppagabbhena, suddhājīvena passatā.

example_1: hirīmatā ca dujjīvaṃ, niccaṃ sucigavesinā, alīnen'āppagabbhena, suddhājīvena passatā.

meaning_1: name of a doctor; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost layman in having faith in an individual; Jīvaka Komārabhacca
family_set: agent nouns; great disciples; names of laypeople
example_1: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ puggalappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ jīvako komārabhacco.
commentary: (MNa) ettha jīvatī'ti jīvako. kumārena bhato'ti komārabhacco.

meaning_1: name of a monastery near Rājagaha
example_1: jīvak'ambavanaṃ rammaṃ, gacchantiṃ bhikkhuniṃ subhaṃ, dhuttako sannivāresi, tam'enaṃ abravī subhā.
commentary: (THIa) jīvak'ambavanan'ti jīvakassa komārabhaccassa ambavanaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on seclusion in Jīvaka's mango grove
discourse on meditative composure in Jīvaka's mango grove

example_1: alīnacittaṃ nissāya, pahaṭṭhā mahatī camū, kosalaṃ sen'āsantuṭṭhaṃ, jīvaggāhaṃ agāhayi.
commentary: (JAa) jīvaggāhaṃ agāhayī'ti amāretvā'va sā camū taṃ rājānaṃ hatthinā jīvaggāhaṃ gaṇhāpesi.

meaning_2: name of a bird, sort of a pheasant (or partridge)

example_1: yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, dussīlo asamāhito, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, sīlavantassa jhāyino.
example_2: appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.

example_1: yo hi koci manussesu, puthusippena jīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, sippiko so na brāhmaṇo.
example_2: gacchatha, tātā, pabbatapādaṃ pavisitvā jīvantā subhikkhakāle mama santikaṃ āgantu'kāmā āgacchatha, anāgantu'kāmā tattha tatth'eva jīvathā'ti.

example_1: sattadhā me phale muddhā, jīvanto na sukhaṃ labhe, buddhagāth'ābhigīto'mhi, no ce muñceyya candiman'ti.
example_2: maraṇena'pi te mayaṃ akāmakā vinā bhavissāma. kiṃ pana mayaṃ taṃ jīvantaṃ anujānissāma agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāyā'ti?

example_1: evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.
viceyya dānaṃ sugatappasatthaṃ, ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette'ti.

meaning_1: perceiving as alive; regarding (something) as living
commentary: (VINa) jīvasaññino'ti sattasaññino.

meaning_1: for the sake of livelihood; to make a living
example_1: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā assaddhā jīvik'atthā na saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā saṭhā māyāvino ketabino uddhatā unnaḷā capalā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
example_2: lesakappe pariyāye, parikappe'nudhāvitā. jīvik'atthā upāyena, saṅkaḍḍhanti bahuṃ dhanaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) jīvikatthā'ti iṇabhay'ādīhi pīḷitā bahi jīvituṃ asakkontā idha jīvikatthikā hutvā.

meaning_1: makes a living; earns one's livelihood
example_1: yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena.

meaning_1: supporting oneself; sustaining one's life; making a living (by)
example_1: maddarājā cintesi sac'āhaṃ imaṃ ekassa dassāmi, sesarājāno kujjhissanti, mama dhītaraṃ rakkhissāmī'ti dhītarañ'ca bhariyañ'ca gahetvā aññātakavesena palāyitvā araññaṃ pavisitvā cūḷakāliṅgakumārassa assamapadato uparibhāge assamaṃ katvā pabbajitvā uñchācariyāya jīvikaṃ kappento tattha paṭivasati.
yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi
example_2: parapaṭibaddhā me jīvikā'ti, pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.

example_1: accayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ uparujjhati, āyu khīyati maccānaṃ, kunnadīnaṃ'va odakaṃ.
example_2: appaṃ vata jīvitaṃ idaṃ, oraṃ vassasatā'pi miyyati, yo ce'pi aticca jīvati, atha kho so jarasā'pi miyyati.
commentary: (SNa) jīvitan'ti jīvit'indriyaṃ.

example_1: santi loke munayo, janā vadanti ta'y'idaṃ kathaṃsu, ñāṇ'ūpapannaṃ no muniṃ vadanti, udāhu ve jīvitena-upapannaṃ.
example_2: etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavataṃ nu jīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.

meaning_1: exhaustion of life; end of one's life span; death
example_1: imasmiṃ kira jātake bodhisatto koṇḍadamako ahosi. so ten'eva paratantiyuttabhāvena jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇi. devatā kujjhitvā sakalam'eva majjharaṭṭhaṃ uṇhaṃ kukkuḷavassaṃ vassāpetvā raṭṭhaṃ araṭṭham'akaṃsu.
commentary: (ANt) jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpito'ti… māresi

meaning_1: attraction to existence; desire for life
example_1: sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno maraṇasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato jīvitanikantiyā cittaṃ anusandahati appaṭikulyatā saṇṭhāti, veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me maraṇasaññā

meaning_1: danger to the life (of); fatal accident (for)
example_1: dujjānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato vā jīvit'antarāyānaṃ, mayhaṃ vā jīvit'antarāyānaṃ. desetu me, bhante bhagavā, dhammaṃ, desetu, sugato, dhammaṃ, yaṃ mam'assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
example_2: ayaṃ kakkhaḷo pharuso jīvit'antarāyaṃ vā brahmacariy'antarāyaṃ vā karissatī'ti n'āroceti, aññe patirūpe bhikkhū apassanto n'āroceti, nachādetu'kāmo n'āroceti, paññāyissati sakena kammenā'ti n'āroceti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (UDa) jīvit'antarāyānan'ti jīvitassa antarāyakaradhammānaṃ vattanaṃ avattanaṃ vā'ti vattu'kāmo sambhamavasena jīvit'antarāyānan'ti āha. tathā hi anekapaccayappaṭibaddhavuttijīvitaṃ anekarūpā ca tadantarāyā. (KVt) bhikkhu gilāno vā hoti, kālaṃ vā karoti, verino vā taṃ māretu'kāmā gaṇhanti, ayaṃ jīvit'antarāyo.

meaning_1: ending with life; limited to existence
example_1: kāyapariyantikan'ti kāy'antikaṃ kāyaparicchinnaṃ, yāva pañcadvārakāyo pavattati, tāva pavattaṃ pañcadvārikavedanan'ti attho. jīvitapariyantikan'ti jīvit'antikaṃ jīvitaparicchinnaṃ, yāva jīvitaṃ pavattati, tāva pavattaṃ manodvārikavedanan'ti attho.

meaning_1: dependent on life; due to existence
example_1: so suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ n'evasaññā-n'āsaññ'āyatanasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, atthi c'ev'idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ, imam'eva kāyaṃ paṭicca saḷāyatanikaṃ jīvitapaccayā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) saḷāyatanikan'ti saḷāyatanapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ. jīvitapaccayā'ti yāva jīvit'indriyānaṃ pavatti, tāva jīvitapaccayā pavattadarathamattā atthī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: requisites for life; necessities of existence
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'aṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, app'āhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto
example_2: ye ca kho ime pabbajitena jīvitaparikkhārā samudānetabbā, cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārā, te kasirena samudāgacchanti.
commentary: (ANa) jīvitaparikkhāresū'ti jīvitasambhāresu.

meaning_1: limited to life; confined to existence
limited to life; ending with existence; confined to life
example_1: jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī'ti pajānāti.

meaning_1: exhaustion of one's life; using up one's lifespan
example_1: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī'ti pajānāti.
example_2: yāv'assa kāyo ṭhassati tāva naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā na naṃ dakkhanti devamanussā'ti

example_1: ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.

cakk'ānuvattako thero, mahāñāṇī samāhito, pathav'āp'aggisamāno, na rajjati na dussati.

meaning_1: arising of understanding; coming forth of knowledge
example_1: saññā kho, poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññ'uppādā ca pana ñāṇ'uppādo hoti. so evaṃ pajānāti, idappaccayā kira me ñāṇaṃ udapādī'ti.
yesañ'ca kho etaṃ bhante ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbicikicchā
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ñāto hoti yasassī. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti.
example_2: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa… te upasaṅkamitvā te pañhe pucchati.

meaning_1: kin; kinsman; relative; relation; family member

example_2: so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.

meaning_1: perceiving as related; regarding (someone) as a relative
example_1: ñātake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñātake ñātakasaññī, anāpatti.

meaning_1: certain well known; one of the famous
example_1: sace me samaṇo gotamo tathā patiṭṭhissati yathā ca me ñāt'aññatarena sāvakena assajinā nāma bhikkhunā patiṭṭhitaṃ… evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
example_2: abhijānāti no, bhante, bhagavā ahu ñāt'aññatarassa mahesakkhassa yakkhassa saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ bhāsitā'ti?

meaning_1: fact of being well known; celebrity
example_1: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti. so tena ñātattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

meaning_1: complete comprehension through what is known
example_1: phassaṃ pariññāyā'ti phassaṃ tīhi pariññāhi parijānitvā, ñātapariññāya, tīraṇapariññāya, pahānapariññāya. katamā ñātapariññā?
commentary: (NIDD1a) tattha katamā ñātapariññā? sabbadhammaṃ jānāti ime ajjhattikā, ime bāhirā, idam'assa lakkhaṇaṃ, imāni rasa-paccupaṭṭhāna-padaṭṭhānānī'ti, ayaṃ ñātapariññā.

meaning_1: should be known as; should be understood as

example_1: ekacco hi, pañhaṃ pucchissāmī'ti kaṇṭhaṃ sodheti, so itarena, idaṃ nāma tvaṃ pucchissasī'ti vutto ñātabhāvaṃ ñatvā, na etaṃ, aññaṃ pucchissāmī'ti vadati.
anuviccakāraṃ kho, gahapati, karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī'ti.
ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.

meaning_1: talk about family; discussion about relatives

meaning_1: perceiving as related; regarding (someone) as a relative
example_1: ñātikāya vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ñātikāya ñātikasaññī, anāpatti.

anāpatti ñātikāya, pārivattakaṃ parittena vā vipulaṃ, vipulena vā parittaṃ, bhikkhunī vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti, tāvakālikaṃ gaṇhāti, cīvaraṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ deti, sikkhamānāya, sāmaṇeriyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

meaning_1: who wants a family; who wishes for relatives
example_1: tvaññ'eva no ñāti ñātikāmānaṃ, tvaṃ pana bhattā bhattukāmānaṃ.

meaning_1: household; family home; family and relatives
example_1: bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā aññatarā itthī ñātikulaṃ agamāsi. tassā te ñātakā sāmikaṃ acchinditvā aññassa dātu'kāmā.
example_2: yā icchati sā idh'eva bhoge ca bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu, sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu. hoti vā pana puris'ādhippāyo, kassa vo dammī'ti?
commentary: (ANa) sakāni vā ñātikulānī'ti attano yāpanamattaṃ dhanaṃ gahetvā ñātigharāni gacchatu.

meaning_1: loss of relatives; destruction of family
example_1: atha kho tesaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ bhavissati, mayaṃ kho akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samādānahetu evarūpaṃ āyataṃ ñātikkhayaṃ pattā. yaṃnūna mayaṃ kusalaṃ kareyyāma.
commentary: (VIBHt) ñātikkhayo'ti bhog'ādīhi ñātīnaṃ parihāni maraṇañ'ca.

meaning_1: relatives home; house of a relation

example_1: uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.
commentary: (VINa) ñātakehi me cīvar'atthāya pesitaṃ, mittehi pesitaṃ, te āgatā cīvare dassantī'ti evaṃ ñātito vā mittato vā paccāsā hoti.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ chaḍḍetu'kāmā hoti. atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ñātidāsiṃ etadavoca, sac'etaṃ, bhagini, chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ, idha me patte ākirā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ñātidāsī'ti ñātakānaṃ dāsī.

example_1: so ñātidhammo ca ayaṃ nidassito, petāna'pūjā ca katā uḷārā, balañ'ca bhikkhūnam'anuppadinnaṃ, tumhehi puññaṃ pasutaṃ anappakan'ti.
commentary: (PVa) ñātidhammo'ti ñātīhi ñātīnaṃ kattabbakaraṇaṃ.

example_1: so kho ahaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena… appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.

meaning_1: loss of relatives; decline in kin
example_1: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ ñātiparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.

meaning_1: degradation of relatives; deterioration of family
example_1: katamañ'ca, bho raṭṭhapāla, ñātipārijuññaṃ? idha, bho raṭṭhapāla, ekaccassa bahū honti mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā. tassa te ñātakā anupubbena parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.

katamāni pañca? rūpabalaṃ, bhogabalaṃ, ñātibalaṃ, puttabalaṃ, sīlabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) rūpabalan'tiādīsu rūpasampatti rūpabalaṃ, bhogasampatti bhogabalaṃ, ñātisampatti ñātibalaṃ, puttasampatti puttabalaṃ, sīlasampatti sīlabalaṃ.

meaning_1: because of the power of relatives
example_1: na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sed'āvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti, ñātibaliṃ, atithibaliṃ, pubbapetabaliṃ, rājabaliṃ, devatābaliṃ. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na iti paṭisañcikkhati, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto ayaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho
example_2: ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa
commentary: (ANa) ñātīnaṃ byasanaṃ ñātibyasanaṃ, ñātivināso'ti attho.

meaning_1: because of loss of relatives; due to loss of family
example_1: na, bhikkhave, sattā ñātibyasanahetu vā bhogabyasanahetu vā rogabyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.

meaning_1: among one's relatives; in the midst of family
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho
commentary: (MNa) ñātimajjhagato'ti dāy'ādānaṃ majjhe ṭhito.

meaning_1: among one's relatives; in the midst of family

example_1: na, bhikkhave, sattā ñātisampadāhetu vā bhogasampadāhetu vā ārogyasampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. sīlasampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

example_1: kenassu nappakāsatī'ti kena loko nappakāsati na bhāsati na tapati na virocati na ñāyati na paññāyatī'ti, kenassu nappakāsati.

meaning_1: succeeds with the method; accomplishes the system

example_1: bālo puttataṇhāya c'eva dhanataṇhāya ca haññati vihaññati dukkhayati

meaning_1: name of one of the three daughters of Death
example_1: disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
example_2: atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro yena māro pāpimā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu.
commentary: (DHPa) ath'assa taṇhā aratī ragā'ti imā tisso dhītaro

example_1: ito ahaṃ vassasatāni pañca, yaṃ evarūpā vicarāmi naggā, khudāya taṇhāya ca khajjamānā, pāpassa kammassa phalaṃ mam'edaṃ.
commentary: (PVa) taṇhāyā'ti pipāsāya.

meaning_1: class of craving; category of desire
example_1: cha taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā.

meaning_1: classes of craving; categories of desire
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, taṇhā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, taṇhā.

meaning_1: wearing away of craving; depletion of desire; extinction of longing
example_1: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti
example_2: sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.

meaning_1: leading to the depletion of desire; going to the extinction of craving
example_1: taṇhākkhayañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi taṇhākkhayagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.
commentary: (SNa) taṇhākkhayassa paccayattā taṇhakkhayaṃ.

meaning_1: liberation by wearing away of craving; release through depletion of desire; freedom by extinction of longing
example_1: yo vejayantapāsāde, sakkaṃ so paripucchati, api vāsava jānāsi, taṇhākkhayavimuttiyo, tassa sakko viyākāsi, pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ.

meaning_1: freed by the wearing away of craving; liberated by the depletion of desire; released by the extinction of longing
example_1: viññāṇassa nirodhena, taṇhākkhayavimuttino, pajjotass'eva nibbānaṃ, vimokkho hoti cetaso'ti.
commentary: (ANa) taṇhākkhayavimuttino'ti taṇhākkhayavimuttisaṅkhātāya arahattaphalavimuttiyā samannāgatassa.

meaning_1: habituated to the destruction of craving; established in desirelessness; firmly entrenched in extinction of longing
example_1: so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti, nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti, pavivek'ādhimutto hoti, abyāpajj'ādhimutto hoti, taṇhākkhay'ādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhay'ādhimutto hoti, asammoh'ādhimutto hoti.
commentary: (ANa) taṇhākkhayante uppannattā taṇhākkhayo

example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi, tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ ajānataṃ apassataṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassita-vipphanditam'eva.
commentary: (DNa) tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ ajānataṃ apassataṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassita-vipphanditam'evā'ti yena diṭṭhi-assādena diṭṭhisukhena diṭṭhivedayitena te somanassajātā sassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi, tadapi tesaṃ bhavantānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvaṃ ajānantānaṃ apassantānaṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ kevalaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ'y'eva taṃ vedayitaṃ, tañ'ca kho pan'etaṃ paritassitavipphanditam'eva.

example_1: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

meaning_1: net of craving; snare of desire
enslaved by craving; a slave of desire
example_1: ūno loko atitto taṇhādāso'ti kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena catuttho dhamm'uddeso uddiṭṭho, yam'ahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
commentary: (MNa) taṇhādāso'ti taṇhāya dāso.

meaning_1: desire and view; craving and belief
with craving as companion; accompanied by desire
example_1: taṇhādutiyo puriso, dīgham'addhāna saṃsaraṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.
commentary: (ANa) taṇhādutiyo'ti ayañ'hi satto anamatagge saṃsāravaṭṭe saṃsaranto na ekako'va saṃsarati, taṇhaṃ pana dutiyikaṃ labhanto'va saṃsarati. tena vuttaṃ, taṇhādutiyo'ti.

meaning_1: spoiled by craving; ruined by desire; corrupted by craving
example_1: tiṇadosāni khettāni, taṇhādosā ayaṃ pajā. tasmā hi vītataṇhesu, dinnaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.

meaning_1: overpowered by craving; dominated by desire
example_1: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco moghapuriso avidvā avijjāgato taṇh'ādhipateyyena cetasā satthu sāsanaṃ atidhāvitabbaṃ maññeyya, iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā, anattakatāni kammāni kamattānaṃ phusissantī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) taṇh'ādhipateyyenā'ti taṇhājeṭṭhakena.

meaning_1: slave to craving; overpowered by craving; victim of desire
example_1: ye keci kāmesu asaññatā janā, avītarāgā idha kāmabhogino, punappunaṃ jātijar'ūpagāmi te, taṇh'ādhipannā anusotagāmino.
example_2: taṇh'ādhipanne manuje pekkhamāno, santāpajāte jarasā parete, tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu taṇhaṃ apunabbhavāyā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) taṇhādhipannā'ti taṇhāya adhipannā ajjhotthaṭā, taṇhaṃ vā adhipannā ajjhogāḷhā.

meaning_2: destruction of craving; crushing of desire
example_1: tvañ'ca me dhammam'akkhāhi, taṇhānigghātanaṃ muni, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD2 2.8) taṇhānigghātanaṃ taṇhāpahānaṃ taṇhāvūpasamaṃ taṇhāpaṭinissaggaṃ taṇhāpaṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānaṃ.

example_1: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro upādānā. kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro upādānā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

meaning_1: ending of craving; cessation of desire
example_1: channaṃ tv'eva, phagguna, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho
example_2: kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti? avijjāvirāgā kho, āvuso, vijj'uppādā taṇhānirodhā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) taṇhānirodhā'ti taṇhāya khayanirodhena.

meaning_1: leading to the ending of craving; leading to the cessation of desire
example_1: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako taṇhañ'ca pajānāti, taṇhāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, taṇhānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

meaning_lit: discourse on the ending of craving

meaning_1: underlying tendency towards craving; dormant desire
example_1: yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of taṇhāpaccaya
meaning_1: dependent on craving; due to desire
example_1: evaṃ maṃ avadantaṃ yo evaṃ puccheyya, kiṃpaccayā nu kho, bhante, taṇhā'ti, esa kallo pañho. tatra kallaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ
example_2: vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ
commentary: (SNPa) taṇhāpaccayā'ti kammasambhārataṇhāpaccayā. (NIDD1a) taṇhāpaccayā upādānan'ti cattāri upādānāni kām'upādānaṃ diṭṭh'upādānaṃ sīlabbat'upādānaṃ attavād'upādānaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about craving

meaning_1: produced by craving; generated by desire
example_1: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.

meaning_1: exhausted craving for becoming; consumed craving for existence; (comm) exhausted craving and becoming
example_1: yo'dhataṇhaṃ pahantvāna, anāgāro paribbaje, taṇhābhavaparikkhīṇaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) taṇhāya c'eva bhavassa ca parikkhīṇattā taṇhābhavaparikkhīṇaṃ
(VISMa) taṇhāya samādhissa ujupaṭipakkhattā sā samathapaṭipadāya paripanthinī'ti āha taṇh'ābhibhūtassa hi dukkhā paṭipadā hotī'ti.

meaning_1: craving, comparing and belief; desire, conceit and view
compound_construction: taṇhā ca māna ca diṭṭhi ca
example_1: eso me attā'ti diṭṭhiggāho. evaṃ rūp'ārammaṇā taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhiyo kathitā honti. rūpaṃ pana attā'ti na vattabbaṃ.

meaning_1: due to craving, conceit and belief
rooted in craving; stemming from desire
example_1: nava taṇhāmūlakā dhammā, taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā, pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho, lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo, vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo, chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānaṃ, ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho, pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyaṃ, macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho

meaning_2: (denominative from taṇhā) thirsts, has a craving
example_1: anupādiyaṃ na paritassatī'ti anupādiyanto agaṇhanto n'eva taṇhāparitassanāya, na bhayaparitassanāya paritassati, na taṇhāyati na bhāyatī'ti attho.
commentary: (SNt) na taṇhāyati na bhāyati taṇhāvuttino abhāvā, tato eva bhayavatthuno ca abhāvā.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in craving; delighting in desire
example_1: taṇh'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

meaning_1: enjoying craving; taking pleasure in desire
example_1: na taṇh'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, na taṇhāratassa na taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa na hoti…pe. … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa na hoti.

meaning_1: creeper of craving; tendrils of desire
example_1: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.
commentary: (THa) taṇhālataṃ… taṇhāsaṅkhātalataṃ.

meaning_2: coating of craving; smear of lust

meaning_1: extinction of craving; destruction of craving
example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā aññāsikoṇḍañño bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ paccavekkhamāno.
example_2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti

meaning_1: freed by the exhaustion of craving; liberated through the dissolution of desire
example_1: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti
example_2: vuttam'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā sakkapañhe, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttā, te accantaniṭṭhā accantayogakkhemino accantabrahmacārino accantapariyosānā seṭṭhā devamanussānan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hotī'ti taṇhāsaṅkhaye nibbāne taṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā vimuttacittatāya taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto nāma saṃkhittena kittāvatā hoti. yāya paṭipattiyā taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti, tam'eva khīṇ'āsavassa bhikkhuno pubbabhāgapaṭipadaṃ saṃkhittena desethā'ti pucchati.

meaning_1: liberation through the extinction of craving
example_1: yathā kathaṃ pana kho, kosiya, bhagavā saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsi? sādhu mayam'pi etissā kathāya bhāgino assāma savanāyā'ti.
example_2: imaṃ kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ dhāretha, sātiṃ pana bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ mahātaṇhājāla-taṇhāsaṅghāṭa-ppaṭimukkan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) imaṃ kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ dhārethā'ti, bhikkhave, imaṃ saṃkhittena desitaṃ mayhaṃ, taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttidesanaṃ tumhe niccakālaṃ dhāreyyātha mā pamajjeyyātha. desanā hi ettha vimuttipaṭilābhahetuto vimuttī'ti vuttā.

example_1: n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo gaho, n'atthi mohasamaṃ jālaṃ, n'atthi taṇhāsamā nadī.

meaning_1: source of craving; arising of desire
example_1: taṇhāsamudayā āhārasamudayo, taṇhānirodhā āhāranirodho, ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo āhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto, sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
commentary: (MNa) taṇhāsamudayā āhārasamudayo'ti purimataṇhāsamudayā paṭisandhikānaṃ āhārānaṃ samudayo nibbatto hotī'ti attho.

meaning_1: with craving as source; originating from desire
example_1: ime ca, bhikkhave, cattāro upādānā. kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? ime cattāro upādānā taṇhānidānā taṇhāsamudayā taṇhājātikā taṇhāpabhavā.
commentary: (MNa) taṇhāsamudayā āhārasamudayo'ti purimataṇhāsamudayā paṭisandhikānaṃ āhārānaṃ samudayo nibbatto hotī'ti attho. kathaṃ? paṭisandhikkhaṇe hi tisantativasena uppanna-samatiṃsa-rūp'abbhantare jātā ojā atthi. ayaṃ taṇhāpaccayā nibbatto upādinnaka-kabaḷīkār'āhāro. paṭisandhicittasampayuttā pana phassacetanā sayañ'ca cittaṃ viññāṇan'ti ime taṇhāpaccayā nibbattā upādinnaka-phassa-manosañcetanā viññāṇ'āhārā'ti. evaṃ tāva purimataṇhāsamudayā paṭisandhikānaṃ āhārānaṃ samudayo veditabbo. yasmā panidha upādinnakā'pi anupādinnakā'pi āhārā missetvā kathitā, tasmā anupādinnakānam'pi evaṃ taṇhāsamudayā āhārasamudayo veditabbo. aṭṭha-lobha-sahagata-citta-samuṭṭhitesu hi rūpesu ojā atthi, ayaṃ sahajātataṇhāpaccayā nibbatto anupādinnaka-kabaḷīkār'āhāro. lobhasahagatacittasampayuttā pana phassacetanā sayañ'ca cittaṃ viññāṇan'ti ime taṇhāpaccayā nibbattā anupādinnaka-phassa-manosañcetanā viññāṇ'āhārā'ti. (MNa) taṇhāsamudayā'ti ettha taṇhā kām'upādānassa upanissayavasena anantara-samanantara-n'atthi-vigat'āsevana-vasena vā paccayo. avasesānaṃ pana sahajāt'ādi-vasenā'pi.

meaning_1: produced by craving; proceeding from craving
example_1: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya āhāro pahātabbo. taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbā.

meaning_1: happy with craving; pleased with desire
example_1: taṇh'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

meaning_1: arrow of craving; dart of desire
example_1: taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbān'ādhimutto'ham'asmī'ti.
example_2: maccun'ābbhāhato loko, jarāya parivārito. taṇhāsallena otiṇṇo, icchādhūpāyito sadā'ti.
commentary: (THa) taṇhāsallena otiṇṇo'ti sarīrassa anto nimuggena visapītakhurappena viya upādānalakkhaṇena taṇhāsaṅkhātena sallena otiṇṇo haday'abbhantare ogāḷho. taṇhā hi pīḷājananato anto tudanato duruddhārato ca sallo'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: with craving as fetter; having desire as a bond
example_1: iti kho, ānanda, kammaṃ khettaṃ, viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ, taṇhā sneho. avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ hīnāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hoti.
example_2: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
commentary: (ANa) taṇhāsaṃyojanānan'ti taṇhābandhanena baddhānaṃ.

meaning_1: current of craving; stream of desire
example_1: diṭṭhibandhanabaddhā te, taṇhāsotena vuyhare, taṇhāsotena vuyhantā, na te dukkhā pamuccare.
example_2: saṃsārasotaṃ sañchindiṃ, taṇhāsotaṃ nivārayiṃ, bhavaṃ ugghāṭayiṃ sabbaṃ, bhūtavejjo'va mūlato.
commentary: (APAa) taṇhāsotaṃ taṇhāmah'oghaṃ

meaning_1: roaming about of craving; activity of desire
example_1: aṭṭhārasa kho pan'imāni, bhikkhave, taṇhāvicaritāni ajjhattikassa upādāya, aṭṭhārasa taṇhāvicaritāni bāhirassa upādāya.

meaning_1: due to roaming about of craving; due to wandering desire

example_1: ko nu kho, bhante, taṇhīyatī'ti ? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, tasatī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.

example_1: saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti, no ce assaddhiyaṃ avatiṭṭhati, yaso ca kittī ca tatv'assa hoti, saggañ'ca so gacchati sarīraṃ vihāyā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) tatv'assa hotī'ti tato assa hoti.

example_1: tapanīyāni kammāni, yāni dhammehi ārakā, tāni ārocayissāmi, taṃ suṇātha yathā tathaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) tathā'ti yathā vuttā tathāsabhāvā.

example_1: tatra, sunakkhatta, ye te bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu tesaṃ taṃ tath'eva hoti, ye pana te bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsu tatra, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti, dhammaṃ nesaṃ desessan'ti.
example_2: idha, bhante, ekacco nimittena ādisati, evam'pi te mano, ittham'pi te mano, iti'pi te cittan'ti. so bahuṃ ce'pi ādisati, tath'eva taṃ hoti, no aññathā. ayaṃ paṭhamā ādesanavidhā.
commentary: (DNa) tath'eva taṃ hotī'ti idaṃ ek'aṃsena tath'eva hoti.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.
passathā'ti c'āha avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā. iti kho, bhikkhave, yā tatra tathatā avitathatā anaññathatā idappaccayatā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paṭiccasamuppādo.

meaning_1: such a state; such a condition
example_1: atha khv'assa pubb'eva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tath'attāya upanetī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) tathattāyā'ti tathabhāvāya.

example_1: luddho pan'āyaṃ, kālāmā, purisapuggalo lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pāṇam'pi hanati, adinnam'pi ādiyati, paradāram'pi gacchati, musā'pi bhaṇati, param'pi tath'attāya samādapeti, yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
example_2: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ kāmānaṃ assādañ'ca assādato ādīnavañ'ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ'ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti te vata sāmaṃ vā kāme parijānissanti, paraṃ vā tath'attāya samādapessanti yathā paṭipanno kāme parijānissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (MNa) tathattāyā'ti yaṃ so dhammaṃ deseti tathā bhāvāya, dhamm'ānudhamma-paṭipatti-pūraṇ'atthāya paṭipajjantī'ti attho.

example_1: na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammā paṭipanno, kittiñ'ca sukhañ'c'ānubhoti, dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu tath'attaṃ.
commentary: (THa) dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu tathattan'ti taṃ tathabhāvaṃ sammāpaṭipannaṃ yāthāvato dhammadassī'ti paṇḍitā āhu.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of tathatta
example_1: samitāvi pahāya puññapāpaṃ, virajo ñatvā imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, jātimaraṇaṃ upātivatto, samaṇo tādi pavuccate tathattā.
example_2: khettāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ, sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto, khettajino tādi pavuccate tathattā.

meaning_2: to do likewise; lit. for taking up like that
example_1: durakkhāte, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo ca samādapeti yañ'ca samādapeti yo ca samādapito tath'attāya paṭipajjati sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
example_2: musā'pi bhaṇati, param'pi tath'attāya samādapeti, yaṃ sa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) yo ca samādapito tath'attāya paṭipajjatī'ti yo antevāsiko ācariyena samādapito tassa vacanaṃ karonto tathābhāvāya paṭipajjati.

example_1: evaṃ bhaṇeti, bhaṇayati, bhaṇāpeti, bhaṇāpayati. bhaṇenti, bhaṇayanti, bhaṇāpenti, bhaṇāpayanti. tatha'riva aññe'pi yojetabbā.

meaning_1: true characteristic; immutable quality; (comm) unchangeable nature
example_1: vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. maggo vipassanāya āgatakiccaṃ sādhetī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. phalaṃ tathalakkhaṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ.
commentary: (ANt) tathalakkhaṇaṃ aviparītasabhāvo.

meaning_1: so; thus; in such a way; likewise; similarly
meaning_2: thus, so, in that way, likewise
example_1: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ
example_2: atthaṅ'gato so uda vā so n'atthi, udāhu ve sassatiyā arogo, taṃ me munī sādhu viyākarohi, tathā hi te vidito esa dhammo.

meaning_1: in those ways; just like that; in that manner
example_1: yathā yathā vā pan'assa kāyo paṇihito hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti
example_2: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
commentary: (MNa) tathā tathā'ti tena tena ākārena.

example_1: yathā kathaṃ pana, bhante, ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hoti? sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hotī'ti

meaning_2: for so; for thus (as it has been said); for instance; because

example_1: yathāvādī kho pana so bhagavā tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī, iti yathāvādī tathākārī, yathākārī tathāvādī.
commentary: (DNa) yathāvādī'ti yaṃ vācāya vadati, tadanvayam'ev'assa kāyakammaṃ hoti. yañ'ca kāyena karoti, tadanvayam'ev'assa vacīkammaṃ hoti. kāyo vā vācaṃ, vācā vā kāyaṃ n'ātikkamati, vācā kāyena, kāyo ca vācāya sameti.

meaning_1: Such Become; realized; being in such a state; arrived at the truth; epithet of the Buddha
meaning_2: who has gone so, Enlighten One
example_1: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
example_2: n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi… yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
commentary: (SNa) tathāgatassā'ti tathā āgato'ti evam'ādīhi kāraṇehi tathāgatassa.
notes: Bhikkhu Sujāta: the EBTs give a fairly extensive set of interpretations for tathāgata, for example, 'as he says, so he does'. The overall sense is of one who speaks and acts in accordance with his realization of the truth, which fits the translation 'the realized One'.

meaning_1: going in that direction; headed that way
meaning_2: (one) who goes in that way; goes accordingly
example_1: sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathāgatako'va hoti. sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tam'eva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.

meaning_1: track of the Such Become; trace of the Buddha
example_1: idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.
commentary: (MNa) tathāgatanisevitan'ti tathāgatassa ñāṇaphāsukāya nighaṃsitaṭṭhānaṃ.

meaning_1: the last words of the Tathāgata; the final utterance of the Buddha
footprint of the Such Become; footstep of the Buddha
example_1: idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.
commentary: (MNa) tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pī'ti idam'pi tathāgatassa ñāṇapadaṃ ñāṇavaḷañjaṃ ñāṇena akkantaṭṭhānan'ti vuccati

meaning_1: preached by the realized One; proclaimed by the Such Become
example_1: evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vessakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.

meaning_2: supreme intellectual power of the Tathāgata
example_1: dasa'y'imāni, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni, yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti. katamāni dasa?
example_2: yam'pi, sāriputta, tathāgato anekadhātunānādhātulokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idam'pi, sāriputta, tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
commentary: (ANa) tathāgatabalānī'ti aññehi asādhāraṇāni tathāgatass'eva balāni.

meaning_1: spoken by the Buddha; preached by the Buddha
example_1: ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatappaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti

meaning_1: Buddha's teaching; instruction of the Buddha
example_1: yo so, sāriputta, ariyasāvako tathāgate ek'antagato abhippasanno, na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā'ti?
n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi… yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
example_2: so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhāna-adhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhāna-abhinivesa-anusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.

example_1: yāvatā, bhikkhave, saṅghā vā gaṇā vā, tathāgatasāvakasaṅgho tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. ye, bhikkhave, saṅghe pasannā, agge te pasannā.
commentary: (ITIa) tathāgatasāvakasaṅgho'ti aṭṭha-ariyapuggala-samūha-saṅkhāto diṭṭhi-sīla-sāmaññena saṃhato tathāgatassa sāvakasaṅgho.

meaning_1: lying posture of the Such Become
example_1: katamā catasso? petaseyyā, kāmabhogiseyyā, sīhaseyyā, tathāgataseyyā. katamā ca, bhikkhave, petaseyyā?
commentary: (SNa) catutthajjhānaseyyā pana tathāgataseyyā'ti vuccati. tāsu idha sīhaseyyā āgatā. ayañ'hi tej'ussada-iriyāpathattā uttamaseyyā nāma.

meaning_1: sayings of the Tathāgata, word of the Buddha
regarding the Such Become; about the Buddha
example_1: tathāgatavasena sattamanayabhūmiparicchedo niṭṭhito.

meaning_1: Buddha's meditation; Buddha's dwelling; Buddha's state of mind
example_1: yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pi, ān'āpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti.

meaning_lit: group of ten discourses starting with the discourse on the Tathāgata

meaning_2: (a place rubbed by) the frequenting of the tathāgata, trace of the tathāgata

meaning_1: marking of the Such Become; a place furrowed by the Buddha
example_1: idam'pi vuccati, brāhmaṇa, tathāgatapadaṃ iti'pi, tathāgatanisevitaṃ iti'pi, tathāgat'ārañjitaṃ iti'pi. na tv'eva tāva ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho'ti.
commentary: (MNa) tathāgat'ārañjitan'ti tathāgatassa ñāṇadāṭhāya ārañjitaṭṭhānaṃ.

meaning_2: state of being so; true state of things

example_1: atha kho bhagavā yathādhotena pattena pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi tathādhotena pattena paṭikkami.
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (KVa) tathānāsitan'ti ettha saṃvāsanāsanā liṅganāsanā daṇḍakammanāsanā'ti tisso nāsanā.

meaning_1: setting out in that direction; going that way
meaning_2: leaving thus; departing in that way
example_1: sace so samantā tīraṃ passati, tathāpakkanto'va hoti. sace pana so samantā tīraṃ na passati, tam'eva nāvaṃ paccāgacchati.

meaning_1: practising like that; conducting oneself thus; following that path
example_1: so jarāmaraṇañ'ca pajānāti jarāmaraṇasamudayañ'ca pajānāti jarāmaraṇanirodhañ'ca pajānāti yā ca jarāmaraṇanirodhasāruppagāminī paṭipadā tañ'ca pajānāti. tathāpaṭipanno ca hoti anudhammacārī.
commentary: (VISMa) tathāpaṭipanno'ti yathā samathavipassanāsukhaṃ āvahati, yathā vā satthārā anusiṭṭhaṃ, tathā paṭipanno sāsanadhammo.

meaning_1: ordained like that; renounced in such a manner
example_1: te tathāpabbajitā samānā ekā vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahit'attā viharantā nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ, brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
vuṭṭhahi c'āyasmā mahākassapo tamhā ābādhā. tathāpahīno c'āyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosī'ti.

meaning_1: of such nature; of such quality; just like that
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāti, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamanti, satthasamphassā'pi kamanti.
example_2: yaṃ tathābhūtassa rūpaṃ taṃ rūp'upādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati, yā tathābhūtassa vedanā sā vedan'upādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati

meaning_2: in this way; likewise it become; as it is
example_1: kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ añña'd'atthu bhayapaṭikaṅkhī viharāmi? yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yathābhūtaṃ yathābhūtassa me taṃ bhayabheravaṃ āgacchati, tathābhūtaṃ tathābhūtova taṃ bhayabheravaṃ paṭivineyyan'ti

atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya. tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya, tath'āyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ'ca maggaṃ samārūḷho, yathā imaṃ'y'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ āgamissatī'ti.

meaning_1: such; such kind; of such quality; so formed
example_1: attadantassa posassa, niccaṃ saññatacārino, n'eva devo na gandhabbo, na māro saha brahmunā, jitaṃ apajitaṃ kayirā, tathārūpassa jantuno.
example_2: tathārūpā'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manas'ānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
commentary: (ANa) tathārūpo'ti tathājātiko.

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: yo pana bhikkhu santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā vikāle gāmaṃ paviseyya aññatra tathārūpā accāyikā karaṇīyā, pācittiyaṃ.
synonym: anukūla, anucchavi, anucchavika, anuloma, anulomika, upiya, kappa, tajja, tadanurūpa, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpaka, patirūpī, pattayutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sampanna, sāmaggiya, sāruppa

meaning_1: suitable reason; appropriate cause; good reason
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu uyyuttaṃ senaṃ dassanāya gaccheyya aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: yo pana bhikkhu agilāno visibban'āpekkho jotiṃ samādaheyya vā samādahāpeyya vā aññatra tathārūpappaccayā, pācittiyaṃ.

example_1: anāpatti tathāsaññī codeti vā codāpeti vā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
ehi tvaṃ tāta ambaṭṭha, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi, yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃy'eva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā.
example_2: byādhidhammā jarādhammā, atho maraṇadhammino, yathādhammā tathāsantā, jigucchanti puthujjanā.
commentary: (ANa) tathāsantā'ti yathā santā eva aviparīta-byādhi-ādi-sabhāvā'va hutvā'ti attho.

meaning_1: thus composed; thus centred; thus settled
example_1: so tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti

meaning_1: of such a view; who speaks like that
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathāvādinā bhikkhunā akaṭ'ānudhammena taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissaṭṭhena saddhiṃ sambhuñjeyya vā saṃvaseyya vā saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.9) tathāvādinā'ti, tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā, te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti evaṃ vādinā.

meaning_1: who tells the exact truth; who tells is like it is; truth speaker
example_1: taṃ tathāvādiniṃ buddho, mamaṃ so etadabravi, na h'evaṃ vandiyā buddhā, yathā vandasi gotamī.

meaning_1: of such character; of such quality; such a kind of
example_1: yo ca tesaṃ tattha tattha, jānāti anudhammataṃ, catupañhassa kusalo, āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhaṃ.
example_2: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

meaning_1: who is liberated in such way; who is free like this
example_1: taṃ ce hi n'āddakkhuṃ tathāvimuttaṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānaṃ, ye taṃ namassanti pasaṃsiyā te'ti.

example_2: pathaviṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, pathavito abhiññāya yāvatā pathaviyā pathavattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya pathaviṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviyā n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathavito n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, pathaviṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.
