example_1: yāvatā, ānanda, adhivacanaṃ yāvatā adhivacanapatho, yāvatā nirutti yāvatā niruttipatho, yāvatā paññatti yāvatā paññattipatho, yāvatā paññā yāvatā paññ'āvacaraṃ, yāvatā vaṭṭaṃ, yāvatā vaṭṭati, tadabhiññāvimutto bhikkhu, tadabhiññāvimuttaṃ bhikkhuṃ na jānāti na passati iti'ssa diṭṭhī'ti, tadakallaṃ.

meaning_1: delights in that; takes pleasure in that
example_1: iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.
commentary: (MNa) tadabhinandatī'ti taṃ cakkhuñ'c'eva rūpañ'ca taṇhādiṭṭhivasena abhinandati. (NIDD1a) tadabhinandatī'ti taṃ ārammaṇaṃ taṇhāvasena abhinandati.

meaning_1: delighting in that; taking pleasure in that
example_1: iti me cakkhu ahosi atītam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, tattha chandarāgappaṭibaddhaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ, chandarāgappaṭibaddhattā viññāṇassa tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto atītaṃ anvāgameti.

meaning_1: to approve of that; to be pleased with that; to take delight in that
meaning_2: to approve of that; to be pleased with that
example_1: yo nu kho, ānanda, tañ'ca pajānāti, tassa ca samudayaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca atthaṅ'gamaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca assādaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca ādīnavaṃ pajānāti, tassa ca nissaraṇaṃ pajānāti, kallaṃ nu tena tadabhinanditun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
example_2: āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ, tassa nissaraṇaṃ santaṃ, atakk'āvacaraṃ dhuvaṃ.
commentary: (ITIa) n'ālaṃ tadabhinanditun'ti taṃ upādānakkhandhapañcakaṃ evaṃ paccay'ādhīnavuttikaṃ, tato eva aniccaṃ, dukkhañ'ca taṇhādiṭṭhīhi abhinandituṃ assādetuṃ na yuttaṃ.

meaning_1: completely avoids that; shuns that; steers clear of that
example_1: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivajjeti, tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
commentary: (ANa) tadabhinivattetī'ti taṃ abhinivatteti. yadā vā tena vipāko ñāto hoti vidito, tadā te c'eva dhamme tañ'ca vipākaṃ abhinivatteti.

meaning_1: having completely avoided that; having shunned that; having steered clear of that
example_1: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivajjeti. tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
commentary: (ANa) iminā ca padena vipassanā kathitā, tadabhinivattetvā'ti iminā maggo.

meaning_1: completely avoids that; shuns that; steers clear of that
example_1: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti. tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhinivijjhitvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
commentary: (ANa) tadabhinivattetī'ti taṃ abhinivatteti. yadā vā tena vipāko ñāto hoti vidito, tadā te c'eva dhamme tañ'ca vipākaṃ abhinivatteti.

meaning_1: having completely avoided that; having shunned that; having steered clear of that
example_1: āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivatteti. tadabhinivattetvā cetasā abhinivijjhitvā paññāya ativijjha passati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhāniye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
commentary: (ANa) iminā ca padena vipassanā kathitā, tadabhinivattetvā'ti iminā maggo.

example_1: yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya idaṃ saccan'ti upanijjhāyitaṃ ta'dam'ariyānaṃ etaṃ musā'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, ayam'ek'ānupassanā.
commentary: (SNPa) ta'dam'ariyānan'ti idaṃ ariyānaṃ, anunāsikaikāralopaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.

example_1: tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathāme'daṃ nidassanaṃ, caṇḍālaputto sopāko, mātaṅgo iti vissuto.

meaning_1: that just by this; in this (way)
example_1: saññā nu kho, tadaminā'p'etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.
example_2: tadaminā'p'etaṃ, ānanda, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalam'ev'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā.

meaning_1: that noble person; that ethical man; (or) a noble man (does not talk) like that
example_1: dubbhāsitaṃ vikkhalitaṃ, sampamohaṃ parājayaṃ, añño'ññass'ābhinandanti, tadariyo katha'n'ācare.
amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ, tadariyā saccato vidū, te ve sacc'ābhisamayā, nicchātā parinibbutā'ti.
example_2: yaṃ pare sukhato āhu, tadariyā āhu dukkhato, yaṃ pare dukkhato āhu, tadariyā sukhato vidū.

meaning_1: that would be; that could be
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
example_2: sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī'ti. tadassa uttiyassa paribbājakassa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) tadassā'ti taṃ evaṃ… bhaveyya.

example_1: yaṃ hi'ssa, bhante, vīriyaṃ tadassa vīriy'indriyaṃ.

meaning_1: relishes that; takes pleasure in that; likes that
example_1: so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
commentary: (ANa) tadassādetī'ti taṃ jhānaṃ sukh'assādena assādeti.

example_1: silokam'anukassāmi, yattha bhummā tadassitā, ye sitā girigabbharaṃ, pahit'attā samāhitā.
commentary: (DNa) yattha bhummā tadassitā'ti yesu yesu ṭhānesu bhummā devatā taṃ taṃ nissitā.

meaning_2: having the manifestation of concealing those (good qualities)

meaning_1: went there; wandered there; arrived there
example_1: so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃ kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena uruvelā senānigamo tadavasariṃ.
example_2: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
commentary: (MNa) tadavasarin'ti tattha osariṃ.

example_1: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
example_2: tadahu pabbajito santo, jātiyā sattavassiko, so'pi maṃ anusāseyya, sampaṭicchāmi matthake.
commentary: (DNa) tadahū'ti tasmiṃ ahu, tasmiṃ divase'ti attho.

meaning_1: born that very day; born the same day
example_1: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
commentary: (VINa) tadahujātā'ti taṃdivasaṃ jātā jātamattā allamaṃsapesivaṇṇā

example_1: vassasat'ūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadah'upasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
commentary: (VINt) tadah'upasampannassā'ti taṃ divasam'pi upasampannassa.

meaning_1: on that observance day; that being the observance day
example_1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
example_2: idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.
commentary: (SNa) tadah'uposathe'ti tasmiṃ ahu uposathe, uposathadivase'ti attho.

meaning_1: which appeared on that same day; which becomes available on that very day
example_1: tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya satiyā'pi paccāsāyā'ti tadah'uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.
āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, yadā kāyaṃ jahant'imaṃ, apaviddho tadā seti, parabhattaṃ acetanaṃ.
example_2: dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.

meaning_1: came there; arrived there; (or) came then
example_1: āpo ca devā pathavī, tejo vāyo tadāgamuṃ, varuṇā vāraṇā devā, somo ca yasasā saha.
commentary: (DNa) āpo ca devā pathavī, tejo vāyo tadāgamun'ti āpokasiṇ'ādīsu parikammaṃ katvā nibbattā āpo'ti-ādi-nāmakā devā āgamuṃ.

meaning_1: doing that; performing that; engaging in that
example_1: n'etaṃ tava patirūpaṃ, yadaññam'anusāsasi, anurodhavirodhesu, mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti.
commentary: (SNa) mā sajjittho tadācaran'ti evaṃ dhammakathaṃ ācaranto mā laggi.

meaning_1: gets at that time; obtains then; (comm) gets that
example_1: yaṃ gihissa'pi tadatthajotakaṃ, pabbajjam'pi ca tad'ādhigacchati, khajjabhojjarasalābhi'r'uttamaṃ, āhu sabbagihibandhanacchidan'ti.
commentary: (DNa) tad'ādhigacchatī'ti taṃ adhigacchati.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.
commentary: (MNa) tadādhimutto'ti'pi nāmam'eva.

meaning_1: (aiming at) that good result; with that benefit (in mind); (comm) benefit of arahantship
example_1: bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto, ākaṅkhe ce hadayass'ānupattiṃ, lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañ'ca, sucetaso anissito tadānisaṃso'ti.
commentary: (SNa) tadānisaṃso'ti arahatt'ānisaṃso.

meaning_1: right then; even at that time
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso yamaka, yadā hi so puriso amuṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ āha, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti, tadā'pi so vadhako'va, vadhakañ'ca pana santaṃ na aññāsi, vadhako me'ti.
example_2: tadā'pi me, bhikkhave, amanāpā nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa mantaṃ vācetuṃ, kim'aṅga pana eta'r'ahi na amanāpā bhavissati nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ.

meaning_1: that dimension; that field; that base
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, tadāyatanaṃ, yattha n'eva pathavī, na āpo, na tejo, na vāyo, na ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ, na viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ, na ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ, na n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ, n'āyaṃ loko, na paraloko, na ubho candimasūriyā.
example_2: kudāssu nām'āhaṃ tadāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yadariyā eta'r'ahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantī'ti iti anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) tadāyatanan'ti taṃ āyatanaṃ, paramassāsabhāvena patiṭṭhānabhūtaṃ arahattan'ti attho. (UDa) tadāyatanan'ti taṃ kāraṇaṃ. dakāro padasandhikaro.

meaning_1: with that as its object; based on that
meaning_2: having that (aforesaid thing) as its object
example_1: tañ'ca puggalaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharissāma, tadārammaṇañ'ca sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cittena vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharissāmā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) tadārammaṇañ'cā'ti tass'eva mettacittassa ārammaṇaṃ katvā.

meaning_2: (abhi) registration (consciousness, which has the same object as the javana that preceded it in the citta-vīthi)

meaning_1: then there was; at time there was
example_1: tadā'si yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadā'si lomahaṃsanaṃ, sabb'ākāra-var'ūpete, sambuddhe parinibbute'ti.
commentary: (DNa) tadā'sī'ti saha parinibbānā mahābhūmicālo'ti evaṃ heṭṭhā vuttaṃ bhūmicālam'eva sandhāy'āha. tañ'hi lomahaṃsanañ'ca bhiṃsanakañ'ca āsi.

example_1: tadāsu devā maññanti, tāvatiṃsā sah'indakā, yv'āyaṃ mama pallaṅkasmiṃ, sv'āyaṃ eko'va bhāsatī'ti.

grammar: aor 3rd pl of tadāsi, comp vb
example_1: sattabhū brahmadatto ca, vessabhū bharato saha, reṇu dve dhataraṭṭhā ca, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā'ti.
tadāha sabbaññuvaro mah'esī, ānandabhaddaṃ madhurassarena, ye pubbabuddhesu kat'ādhikārā, aladdhamokkhā jinasāsanesu.
commentary: (APAa) tato paraṃ vissajjit'ākāraṃ dassento tadāha sabbaññuvaro mah'esī'ti-ādim'āha.

meaning_1: feeding on that; with that nutriment
example_1: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
example_2: atha kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā rasapathaviṃ paribhuñjantā taṃbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
commentary: (SNa) tadāhāro'ti taṃpaccayo.

meaning_1: ending of that sustenance; cessation of that fuel
example_1: bhūtam'idan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhārasambhavan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
example_2: tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passati.
commentary: (SNa) tadāhāranirodhā'ti tesaṃ āhārānaṃ nirodhena.

meaning_1: produced by that fuel; generated by that sustenance
example_1: bhūtam'idan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhārasambhavan'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti, bhikkhave, passathā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
commentary: (MNa) tadāhārasambhavan'ti taṃ pan'etaṃ khandhapañcakaṃ āhārasambhavaṃ paccayasambhavaṃ, sati paccaye uppajjati evaṃ passathā'ti pucchati.

grammar: perf 3rd pl of tadāha, comp vb
example_1: nabhañ'ca dūre pathavī ca dūre, pāraṃ samuddassa tadāhu dūre, yato ca verocano abbhudeti, pabhaṅ'karo yattha ca atthameti, tato have dūrataraṃ vadanti, satañ'ca dhammaṃ asatañ'ca dhammaṃ.
example_2: yassa devā pitaro ca sabbe, sarīsapā sabbabhūtāni c'āpi, mettāya niccaṃ apacitāni honti, bhūtesu ve sotthānaṃ tadāhu.
commentary: (JAa) tadāhū'ti taṃ āhu.

meaning_1: please… that!; pray… that!; come now… that!
example_1: kutopahūtā kalahā vivādā, paridevasokā sahamaccharā ca, mān'ātimānā sahapesuṇā ca, kutopahūtā te tadiṅgha brūhi.
commentary: (SNPa) tadiṅgha brūhī'ti taṃ mayā pucchitamatthaṃ brūhi yācāmi taṃ ahan'ti. yācan'attho hi iṅghā'ti nipāto.

example_1: kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
example_2: kadā nu kaṭṭhe ca tiṇe latā ca, khandhe ime'haṃ amite ca dhamme, ajjhattikān'eva ca bāhirāni ca, samaṃ tuleyyaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

example_1: saṅgh'ādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantānaṃ ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ, dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti. dve tayo ekato samanubhāsitabbā, taduttari na samanubhāsitabbā.
commentary: (VINt) tato uttariṃ taduttariṃ, tassa tassa vuttappamāṇato atirekaṃ.

meaning_1: come to that; arrived at that; (comm) come then
example_1: te tattha mante ganthetvā, okkākaṃ tadupāgamuṃ, pahūtadhanadhañño'si, yajassu bahu te vittaṃ, yajassu bahu te dhanaṃ.
example_2: svāgataṃ na durāgataṃ, na'y'idaṃ dumantitaṃ mama, saṃvibhattesu dhammesu, yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tadupāgamin'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) tadupāgamun'ti tadā upāgamuṃ. (THa) tadupāgamaṃ tadeva upagacchin'ti attho.

example_1: n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ. ta'y'idaṃ saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ atthi kho pana saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho atth'etan'ti, iti viditvā tassa nissaraṇadassāvī tathāgato tadupātivatto.
commentary: (MNa) tathāgato tadupātivatto'ti taṃ saṅkhataṃ atikkanto samatikkanto'ti attho. (MNa) tadupātivatto'ti taṃ diṭṭhiṃ atikkanto.

meaning_1: clinging to that; grasping that; attached to that
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāti, imañ'ce ahaṃ upekkhaṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasaṃhareyyaṃ, tadanudhammañ'ca cittaṃ bhāveyyaṃ, evaṃ me ayaṃ upekkhā taṃnissitā tadupādānā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
example_2: tassa taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. yā vedanāsu nandī tadupādānaṃ, tass'upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti.
commentary: (MNa) tadupādānan'ti sā'va taṇhā gahaṇaṭṭhena upādānaṃ nāma.

meaning_1: on account of that; dependent on that
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ. tasmiṃ sati, tadupādāya, evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati, na vātā vāyanti, na najjo sandanti, na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti, na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā'ti.
commentary: (NIDD1a) tadupādāyā'ti tato paṭṭhāya.

meaning_1: suitable for that; appropriate for that
example_1: tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā thālipākasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so thālipāko hoti yato nāḷik'odanaparamaṃ bhuñjāmi tadupiyañ'ca sūpeyyaṃ.
